(My fault as people have said they sell out early since their donuts are so good!) the young lady working there was very kind and told me the best time to stop by and I told her I would come back the next day. Well today is the next day. Got there around 9:10am and WOW!! The staff greet you as soon as you walk in and they are so helpful with trying to help you decide which donut you'd love the most. I decided on a grilled cheese donut and omg. I could have easily split this with someone. I didn't know it was going to be so huge! And they DONT skimp on the cheese! It was delicious! They have so many flavors that I'm sure everyone will find something they enjoy! I shall be back for the salted caramel!

I went to Sprinkles on the Grand Opening of the store. I feel so lucky because I thought the store was already opened for a while. I believe I waited in line for about 20 minutes (maybe less). While in line, there are workers waiting to give you the flavors card and to answer any questions. I was there around 2pm (Holly Madison were there to open up the Cupcake ATM). I talked to about 3 employees while in line and the line wasn't even that long. I was able to ask details about the flavors of the cupcake which were helpful. The employees are really nice and helpful. This was my first time going to any Sprinkles Cupcake store. I thought the decoration inside and outside of the building were nice. There is a sitting area outside. Two separate doors; one door for those who want to purchase cupcakes and one door for ice cream ice cream. The cupcake line was long compared to the ice cream line. I really liked the idea of getting the flavor card (I was able to decide what flavors I wanted while I waited). I got 4 cupcakes; Black & White, Strawberry, Lemon Coconut and Vanilla. They have items with or without sprinkles. Each cupcake is $3.75. If you purchase 4 cupcakes, the price is $15. They also sell the cupcakes in a dozen, which is $24 (I think). Before the employee takes your order, there is a glass case featuring items they sell for that day (The flavor card also tells you what items are sold for that day so you don't get your hopes up). I love that the cake is not too sweet and it is soft and moist. There isn't a lot of frosting on top like other cupcake places also. My favorite flavor is the Lemon Coconut; lemon cake and coconut frosting both have a balanced flavor; none of the flavors were overpowering (loved it so much)! If you love lemon, this is a MUST TRY. I also love that the flavors aren't overpowering but you know that it's there. Perfect cupcake. I rarely say this about any cupcake or dessert place since I bake and I don't like my desserts too sweet. They have cute wooden spoons and knives that you can get before you leave the store (LOVEEE IT!). They also sell cupcake mix and t-shirts. I was thinking of getting their cupcake mix while in line but found out quickly that each mix is $15. I guess it makes sense since Sprinkles is pretty much a brand name. I decided against the cupcake mix. I parked at the Flamingo Casino for free which isn't a far walk to get to The Linq. I am not sure if The Linq has their own parking garage/lot. They accept credit cards like most Las Vegas locations. They accept Amex.
Sweet tooth rejoice. My old lady and I love this place. Great place for a light brunch or late night desert. Very nice.
The best morning buns since the Ovens of Brittany. I am glad that they only take cash as it keeps me from getting fat!

Villani's has been on my bookmarks for a while, so once I moved close to the area, and when I say close I can walk I had to stop by over Memorial Day weekend for some treats. Upon arriving the staff welcomed me, and I mentioned this was my first visit so I had to look over ALL their options, as they offer a lot. Although the bakery items, croissants, etc. looked good we had to go with sweet treats. So, we ordered a Lemon Bar, one of my favorite items as a kid, a slice of Red Velvet Cake and a few shortbread cookies. Each bite was amazing, and I can say one of the best Red Velvet Cakes I have had in a while. And, the cookies, OMG, a perfect bite. So, definitely look forward to my next visit to check out some other items, and their coffee too!

When you google doughnut and ice cream this is place pops ups. It is so good the fresh in house ice cream is beyond tasty. The people are so friendly and genuine! I had Sicilian pistachio ice cream topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch all in a warm doughnut

AMAZING ice cream! I only got to try 3 flavours today but they were all good! I ended up getting Honey Lavender (I love lavender) and Butterbeer (I'm a Dumbledork). Great combo! It's nice to know I can get hand-made ice cream for an affordable price. I cannot wait to try the other flavours! Some flavours are "rotating" so you never know when you'll come across a flavour you've never tried before. Brandon (owner?) is super, SUPER nice and friendly. He makes you feel extremely welcome and he seems to really appreciate the business of everyone who walks in. This little boy standing next to me at the store (who apparently was giddy to get his hands on some creamy, delectable ice cream, leaned over to me and said "Brandon is the nicest guy ever." :) There is limited private parking but there are enough parking along the street if you go by car. The store itself is small (stick 7 people in there and it becomes crowded), so it's not a place to sit indoors and enjoy your ice cream, but during the cooler months, there is a small outdoor seating area. But during the summer months, just get your ice cream, run to your car, and crank up the AC to enjoy the taste of whatever delicious flavour(s) you chose! I haven't tried the famed Dough Melt, but I'm trying that next time!

Amazing ice cream! Quality ingredients and flavor. The donut ice cream sandwich is so good, when I first found this place I went 3 times in one week! I always recommend this place to my friends/family headed to the downtown area. It's such a cute little shop and the staff are always very friendly.

I wanted to love this place. I saw an article in an online mag about the best eats in Phoenix and the macaron ice cream sandwich looked bomb. I knew it belonged on my Instagram. In reality you only get one macaron, so it is not really a sandwich. I really don't recommend fruity pebble- it was hard and completely tasteless. My husband got coconut and it seemed fresh. There really was a lot of ice cream and the toasted marshmallow on top was the best part. All the other customers were staring and asking what we had. Overall I was disappointed, but might give it another try next time we are in the area.

I got there at 10:30pm on a Saturday and everything was well stocked. Except, they didn't have any crumb cakes. I ended up getting several cannolis, a red velvet cupcake, and original lobster tails. They also had samples of their red velvet cake available which was delicious. We brought the desserts back to our hotel room and enjoyed them right away. I was looking forward to tasting the lobster tails. I'm a big fan of the show and I've been wanting to try these for quite some time. Maybe it was because of the build up but I wasn't impressed with the texture or flavor of the shell. It tasted like it was stale and too crunchy. The cream was a little on the runny side but it had good flavor. Perhaps the texture of the shell would be different if it were fresh? I don't know. The cannoli. I'm not even a fan of cannoli but this, this was really really good. The cream was the perfect consistency and sweetness. The shell was crunchy and slightly flaky. Yum. Get it. You won't be disappointed. I bought enough stuff to get Carlo's Bakery swag (glass cup). If I were to return, I'd order a crumb cake in advance to try it out. Hopefully I won't be disappointed.

Presti's is awesome! I live essentially right next door to the place and love to get cannolis and cafe au laits when I just want to relax and catch up with a friend. I don't get to see one of my friends much, but when I do, we ALWAYS go to Presti's. At times, we get overwhelmed with the crowd there, but we never fail to see cute babies and indulge in some fantastic desserts! The stromboli is amazing as well! The convenience is also incredibly appreciated, as there was once a wine filled evening when we all wanted some cookies. Luckily, they're not only convenient, but delicious too!
Wonderful sweet and savory pastries as well as bread. The smell alone is worth the trip.

Coconut cream is my new favorite flavor! So creamy with plenty of coconut flavor. I have been here several times, and the ice cream never disappoints. The banana splits are the best...traditional! My only reason for dinging 1 star is the wait....sometimes it takes awhile to get your ice cream, especially if there is a line.

I love EVERYTHING here ... literally, There's all kinds of yummy desserts here such as cookies and cakes & my personal favorite is the rainbow cake it's DELICIOUS Every time I visit Las Vegas I have to make a stop here just for that rainbow cake!! I usually buy one slice of it & then regret why I didn't buy 2 But the good thing is, that it's a giant slice and serves me twice!!!!! Yaayyy

The Bouchon Bakery kiosk is one of the reasons I like to stay at The Venetian, and it is also why I prefer the old tower. Located at the base of the elevators, everything I've had from Bouchon Bakery has been great. Yesterday my wife and I picked up a pistachio macaron, a peanut butter and jelly macaron and a chocolate chip cookie. All three were fantastic. In the past couple years, on prior trips, I've also had their cinnamon rolls, sandwiches, cookies, treats - you name it. If Bouchon Bakery sells it, it won't just be good - you can bet it will be great. I'm giving Bouchon Bakery 4 stars rather than 5 stars because of the staff and because of the lack of seating. The staff doesn't really display much of a sense of urgency, so the line doesn't move as quickly as it should, and there is nowhere nearby to sit down. Still, fantastic place. Highly recommend.

I visited this place twice while in Charlotte, and man their cookies are delicious. I got the chocolate puddle cookies, the nutella cookies, and the oreo truffle cookies, and the Oreo truffle was my hands down favorite. I also got their tres leches draft latte during one of the visits and I told my friend about it within minutes because it was THAT good. I hope that they one day ship their cookies to NYC because I'm sad that I'm not close enough to get a regular fix of these cookies, but I'm so glad that I checked them out while I was down there. Next visit to Charlotte, I will definitely be back. So good - definitely give them a try! A tip - they charge extra if you get a drink without ice because it requires them to use a bit more materials. It's not a bad thing, and they tell you about it before they do - but it's something that is good to know!

What can I say about Milk Bar that hasn't been said before. If you are a sweets person(yes you) then head over and go crazy. The compost cookie is the best cookie you will ever eat. Like cake? Elvis baby!

If your staying at the Venetian and Palazzo, this is the ultimate for early morning coffee and breakfast treats. This is made if you need that cure of late night Vegas. Food choices are vast for a walk up only eatery. Coffee is decent but nothing special. Usually visit a few mornings during a Vegas stay. Their bakery selection is the best. Try the beignets, either raspberry or cream. Awesome!! The croissants are wonderful as well. You can even get a small Champagne to go, add a fresh squeezed OJ and make Mimosa's in your room. It's Vegas, it's allowed, it should be allowed anywhere. Love this place.

This place summoned me from its reviews and my need of ice cream while in Scottsdale. They have a toffee banofi which was amazing!! The last time I had banofi was in India and I can't find anyplace our there that sells anything banofi. The toffee banofi is vanilla ice cream, slices of bananas, almond toffee brittle, salted buttercream Carmel sauce and whip cream in a waffle bowl. The serving is huge and definitely enough for 2 or 3 people. They have quite a few ice creams and sorbets. They also make milkshakes, sundaes or you can get plain scoops. There is 6 tables with wall seating. It was pretty busy but a table happened to open up as we were paying. The employees working were very nice and knowledgeable. My son originally wanted the mint chip and the gal suggested he try a sample of it as it was made with real mint leaves so it has a stronger minty flavor. He liked it but decided on the brownie swirl which was really good! Glad to try this place out as I have been eyeing it for a while just was not in the area. I will be back soon for that toffee banofi!!

I was thrilled the bakery was still open after the 7pm showing of Phantom ended. I've never had a macaroon before and I had a feeling this was the place to try them. I ordered 2 caramel, 2 raspberry, 1 vanilla and 1 chocolate. I got a nutter butter cookie for my husband. We didn't get a chance to eat these until we got back to Austin, but WOW! I'm sad we waited because I would have gone back and ordered MORE, but my thighs are happy I didn't. The macaroons were crazy good. Soft, delicate, sweet, crunchy and tender at the same time.
This French restaurant is absolutely excellent, particularly if you like French pastries. The staff is courteous and friendly, the atmosphere is very pleasing, and the food is excellent.

I'm sorry but went to buy a fondant cake today and they didn't have any. Bought 12 macaroons only to find when I got home they were so dried out they crumbled. I know sometimes that just happens, but to pay $24. and have this happen stings. Had great Lavender lemonaid, and the person who took care of us was nice. Cute shop.

I came here during Memorial Day, and there wasn't a line in the afternoon, though most of the tables were full. Nice to be greeted by a smiling worker once inside and handed a sample of "mini"! No wall menu, only pretty pictures of ice cream: the menus are self-take and stacked near the entrance. I actually sat down first and looked for a wall menu, which I presumed was typical of chain dessert shops like this one, but then realized my mistake (kinda wasteful to have paper menus though, most people I saw got them dirty and/or bent and they ended in the rubbish). We ordered the Hot Fudge Sundae with dark chocolate hot fudge in a chocolate-dipped Waffle Bowl. Can't really go wrong with vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, and a maraschino cherry, but I wished there had been more more chopped almonds. The ice cream and toppings were all delicious, though the ice cream was a bit frozen and too hard-packed, not as creamy as I would have liked. Unless you absolutely love waffle goods, I'd recommend skipping the bowl since it was very sweet, especially when it's already meant to be paired with ice cream. It provided nice crunch and texture, but at the end it was just too much, even with two of us sharing. Afterward, I dragged myself out of a sugar stupor to browse the corner of the store where they sell Squares and Minis by the ¼ pound and as-much-as-you-can-stuff-in gift tins ("Box must close completely!"). There are various Ghirardelli-branded gifts and walls of chocolate-dipped everything.

The only French cafe I've ever been to in Charlotte is Renaissance Patisserie so I wanted to try a new place out of curiosity. I know Amelie's is very popular here in the Queen City so I decided to go here one night after a romantic dinner date at a very nice Italian restaurant. Upon walking in to Amelie's, I felt like a stepped back in time and was transported to France. Gorgeous decor and I really love the style of the place. It made me feel like I was inside a little dollhouse. The food did not impress me like the decorations did. I got a slice of chocolate peanut butter cake and it was SO DRY I couldn't even finish it. Absolutely disgusting. I took 3 bites and tossed the rest in the trash. I also got 2 macarons and those were alright. It didn't taste as good as macarons I've gotten from other places. I was very disappointed with the food here and I can't believe this place is so popular in Charlotte. I'm gonna stick to Renaissance Patisserie whenever I want to go to a French cafe.

Pinkbox is better hands down. This place is overpriced and the donuts are mediocre at best. I set the standard too high and was expecting Pinkbox quality or better. The y taste like they are day old and super dry when you bite into them. It's not the price that bothered me as much as it is for the quality for that price. My first and last time!

3 stars... This place was recommended by local friends so we were sure not to miss it. There was a short line to get into the joint so we had high expectations. I got the Nutella and my wife got the salted caramel. Both were good and were large donuts. Ambiance is stripmall cafe, service was friendly, and prices are slightly above expectation. Not sure we picked the best of show, so at first glance this joint does not make the list, but we will definitely give them another shot next time we visit! We will be back!!

What a lovely spot for ice cream in Phoenix ! We enjoyed coming here and having this delish ice cream. Lots of flavor options and very affordable. Excellent social distancing and clean spot. You can also eat outside . Will come back fir sure .

Love their cupcakes! Glad they finally came to Las Vegas!! We've had them in Georgetown (Washington, DC) and loved them! Great location at The Linq! A must have while at The Linq! Now if we could get another location, maybe the Summerlin area for us locals so we don't have to go to the strip, that would be great!!

I'm not a local, so trying this spot out was fun! A it was easy to find (through GPS of coarse) B they had some amazing flavors and C the staff was patient with our big group order. I ordered the coconut pineapple sherbet and it was refreshing, my cousin ordered the pomegranate sherbet which was also yummy! It's a very tiny place but worth seeing. The outside patio was the perfect spot to hangout. xoxo

The macarons (not to be confused with macaroons) are the only bakery items that are gluten-free, but wow, are they amazing!! I bought a box to bring home to the kids after trying the vanilla one yesterday. Yummy, sugary heaven...

Do not order the pizza. If your idea of pizza us bread with cheese and sauce of it, then you might enjoy it. I has the pepperoni sausage. It had one piece of sausage. In my opinion, if you want pizza, you would be better to get one from 711 or a frozen one from the grocery store. However, the desserts look fabulous. It did not try any. If you want coffee/esoresso and a biscotti or other dessert then this is probably a great place.

Very busy! A good thing for the freshest pastry. The coffee is very good. The pastries sometimes can be hit or miss. Salted Carmel brownies are always a hit. Great place to people watch late in the evening/night.

Super friendly service, clean and inviting shop. Donut selection is outstanding. More importantly, the donuts are truly delicious. Super happy we made the quick stop into old downtown to check them out. I had the birthday cake donut (yum) and Travis got the lemon pistachio (also yum).

Melt isn't the same as it used to be. I was a regularly customer for several years until they and sister-business Jobot were forced to move two streets over to "gentrification central" under Roosevelt Point from their original location on 5th street. In the past 2-3 years, I've seen a great decline in taste and quality of their ice cream and overall customer service. They have gutted many products and taken away several "classic" flavors from their arsenal. I am not sure what has been happening but I hope it changes soon because the Melt that I had come to know and love just isn't the same anymore.

Mitchell's has the best ice cream I have ever had!! I have been to almost every location in Ohio countless times and I have always been satisfied by the ice cream and service. Every employee is very well-educated about what flavors would suit each individual. The staff is very patient when customers try several flavors before choosing one. My favorite thing on the menu is a small sundae with Mint Chocolate Chunk ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, salted pecans, and a cherry on top. The ingredients are always fresh and I never feel lethargic or overwhelmed by the sugar content after eating at Mitchell's. I love the Ohio City location the best because you can see the factory behind a glass wall and it always looks so clean and bright. Other than ice cream, the Sunny Day Smoothie is delicious and not too sweet! Honestly, I would love to give Mitchell's a 6 star rating if I could.
Just stopped by for an ice cream sandwich. Chocolate chip cookies with belgian chocolate ice cream. Amazing! The staff here are so friendly as well. Best ice cream shop I've ever been to!

So not like after 63 reveiws and still a 5 star rating is my review necessary as I think we all get the point....BUT it is just so good I have to put in my 2 cents! The flavors, the textures, the sweet girls behind the counter...everything is fantastic! I love love love the salted butter carmel and the basil lime sorbet is wonderful! Seriously...can't get enough of this place!!

This place is adorable with their ice cream creations. They have a whole tablet filled with your choices of ice cream and ice cream sandwiches. I got the lucky charm macaroon sandwich and it was delicious. About $6 so a little pricy but well worth it.
Icecream was delicious.. decent priced and well made. not toooo sweet.. although it is icecream, sweethtooth! lol

It's been a while since I've been to Churn but located next to Windsor and all their other delicious restaurants. It's cute and quaint with plenty of options. We got a How now, Brown cow which is a float which hubs got Coke with vanilla ice cream. It's a classic and was great. I got a 2 scoop of strawberry and milk n' cookies in a waffle cone. The ice cream is creamy and yummy and their scoops are huge. The strawberry was creamy with plenty of strawberry in it. The milk n cookies had semi baked chocolate chip cookie throughout and was amazing. The gal helping us was so friendly and helpful and definitely a reminder that we need to pop in more than every couple years. Definitely will be back soon!

The entry way of the shop is lined with shelves of nostalgic candy novelties and trinkets, the walls have cutesy hipster artwork, and the back is connected to a restaurant and opens up to a patio with seating. From what I remember, I kept thinking these desserts were rather expensive. I believe a small float was $5.25. That's nearly $6 for a float! However, the treats I sampled were quite tasty. The S'mores Sundae ($6.25) had two scoops of rich, decadent chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, graham crackers, and torched marshmallow fluff - a good treat to share but way too much on your own. I also tried Peach & Honey ice cream in a pretzel cone - I felt as though the honey overpowered the peach flavor and the pretzel cone is a good idea in theory but was a little saltier than I expected. Overall, both were pretty good and perfect with someone with a major sweet tooth!
My favorite place to go for donuts! They have a great variety. Donut Bar would be great for office visit gift.
Chocolate lovers shake was fabulous. The young gal that waited on us was very friendly.
They are not what they used to be. Variety is great, but I rather have freshness. Way over priced

Best freaking donuts I've ever had!!!! No joke! Got the Homer, it was huge and delicious like the ones at universal studios. The peanut butter cup was the best out of the three, it was a dense yet moist cake donut with peanut butter cups on top, it was perfection . Last but not least the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut that was super fun to crack and the combination of the hard sugar on top and a creamy filling was heavenly. The donutquarium made my entire life I live in summerlin but will drive all the way downtown to get these again for sure!!!!!
Sooo good! Love when the fish waffle is kind of soft and chewy instead of hard and crunchy. Ice cream and toppings are delicious! Love it here!!!

Batch. Batch of cookies. Batch of brownies. Batch of croissants. Batch of pies. Rest assured they've got a batch of something you want. Even if you enter the shop with no idea what you want, something will peak your interest. Scratch that. Everything will peak your interest. Some of my personal favorites: Salted caramel brownie Mini chocolate bundt cake CROISSANTSSSS

Milk Bar goodies are my go-to gift for birthday celebrations and sometimes a special treat for myself. I love their gluten free b-day cake truffles and cornflake cookies. Bomb treats, awesome service! Recently I bought a birthday cake for a friend's birthday and being the space cadet I am-- I didn't think to refridgerate it so it melted before the actual birthday. I called Milk Bar and the manager Michelle was understanding enough to help replace it in time before the event free of charge. I am truly blown away by her customer service and she didn't make me feel like an idiot -- which honestly lol, yeah totally a ditz move on my part. People put your cake in the fridge!

So, I gotta say the place was almost perfectly as expected. If not a little different. Having lived in Japan in the past there's a soft spot on my heart for soft serve (see what I did there?). Specifically the parfaits with a concoction of toppings. So naturally that's what I got first. The price was high! For the special parfait it's $7.80. Which I suppose I totally understand when you consider the quality of ingredients here. Most specifically in the case of the real matcha ice cream. They also hand make their own waffle cones. And free samples aplenty - definitely try out that earthy hojicha soft serve. Apparently I didn't have enough because I decided to opt for a soft serve cone at $5.50 with a swirl of hojicha and matcha. It was good stuff, ain't gonna lie. The consistency of the ice cream was certainly unique, all the while it wasn't unpalatably cold. Some dark magic is at work here! The aesthetic of the shop is on point here. They staffed primarily with teenagers who definitely fit the bill for touting the place regularly on social media. And the managers/owners are incredibly friendly and fun with both the employees and the customers. The walls and floors are a bright white and something about the lighting in here makes every picture POP when people post it. (More magic at work here...or by design??) The menu is delightfully simple once you get the hang of it. Amazing they can offer so much from so few base ingredients. They even have Japanese on the menus; I thought that was cool stuff. I will probably stop by again a little ways out in the future for that sinful indulgence and in hopes of seeing more of the non-frozen sweets on offer.
Best ice cream I've ever had! I live 30 minutes away and make the drive. Everyone is so friendly when you come in.

Annnnnd here we have the famous macarons of Thomas Keller, of French Laundry fame and so many cookbooks (including Ad Hoc, which is amazing). Given the name that Thomas Keller has made for himself, these just HAD to be the best macarons ever, right? (Well, other than Laduree in New York, which I've not had a chance to try yet (they actually invented the macaron as we know it, I believe). So here I am, with a 3.50 macaron. Pricey? Yes, but this is a pretty big macaron too. I bite into it. The shell gives away under your bite, cracking and retaining a delicious crunchy exterior that is ever so delicate. My girlfriend gushes about how these are texturally, the best macarons ever. And I agree. Out of all of the macarons I've tried, the crispness and delicacy of the Bouchon macaron is supreme. Too bad it doesn't taste like anything. We got raspberry and their special flavor of the month (or week, or something?) which was strawberry lemon. I could BARELY taste the raspberry, and subsequent bites lost all flavor completely - I could taste the almond from the almond meal. And the strawberry lemon? A bit better, at least each bite tasted slightly like lemonade and not almonds. If you're a texture hound, these are possibly the best I've had, but if you're like me, and desire macarons for the intense flavor profile that repeatedly wallops you in the face, Bouchon doesn't deliver.
Waft of ice cream, sweets hits you immediately when you open the door. Great start. Mint chocolate chip was excellent and they had plenty of sorbet options for my vegan friend. Totally hit the spot

My fiance LOVES cannolis, and one day I was driving past here and stopped on a whim to pick one up for him. When I gave it to him, it was love at first bite! I'm not much of a cannolis fan, but even I really enjoyed the bite I took. He insisted we come back during the weekend, so we stopped by on a Sunday. It was so hard to choose because everything looked so good! I chose a lemon bar and they were so nice to ask if I wanted a center, edge, or corner piece. I can't wait to come back and try the lobster tail and key lime pie!

When I realized I was staying at Venetian, I knew immediately I had to come to this place and get some pastries and macarons! When I realized that it was right next to the elevators access to the suites, I was in love!! Too bad they close at 8, or 9pm, or else this would be a good pre-clubbing dessert. However I went in the morning at 8am and the line was already super long! Since I was leaving that day, I waited it out and scored myself a sticky bun, bread pudding, 12 macarons ( in those prepackages sets, so they were smaller than the individually sold ones) and a chai latte! ( Yes all for myself, though not all in one sitting! ha) The sticky bun was delicious, but was very sweet. I thought the chai latte would complement the sticky bun well, but the chai latte was even SWEETER. Definitely will not get the chai latte from her again. When I got back home, I tried the bread pudding, and yummmmmm, it was delicious!!! And the macarons, A MUST TRY. Enough said.

Tried it yesterday, the place has a super hipster vibe to it, and a lot of sitting spaces. The service was really fast regardless of the long line. I really like the fact that it's 24/7, because you never know when the urge to get some macarons will hit you :) I tried raspberry, mixed berry and hazelnut macarons yesterday. First two were delicious, the hazelnut tasted more like a merengue, but it wasn't bad. Wish they had some floral flavors like rose or lavender. Definitely coming back to try more of the sweets and the savory items from the menu.

Who doesn't like this place? There is no way that this place deserves anything less than 5 stars. Awesome bakery items and the soups and sandwiches are perfecto. I LOVE that this place is open 24 hours a day, not sure exactly why that is, but I don't care or question it. I recently came here with 14 other gals and quickly found out that groups need to be approved by management. We ended up sitting outside the restraurant in the breezeway which was fine with us, but good to know for the future. Awesome place to take friends who are visiting from out of town which is what I'll be doing this coming weekend.

This is such a romantic and bohemian style place! I love the atmosphere in here and the women who work here/run the place are SO kind and lovely! So many delicious, fresh made and unique cakes and other sweet treats here! They also do have vegan and gluten free options! You can call and check what they have for the day before you go if you have dietary restrictions. I always make it a point to come when I'm in Pittsburgh!!
Mitchells is #1 in Cleveland. That's all I can say. The flavors are unreal. The freshness is crazy. The amaretto cookie is just stupid tasty.

Never had I've been so jazzed to try a place in Vegas in a while as I've been to try Milk Bar. So much so that I made that I came to Cosmopolitan just to try it. For those who don't know Cosmopolitan is the best hotel to go to eat if your a foodie. There are so many options as great options for fast casual options. Let's get to Milk Bar which is a truly unique option of bakery items (cookies, cakes, truffles ext) & soft ice cream. The uniqueness of the treats you can only get here are worth a try. Friendly staff and cool decor also make for a good experience. Initially I was going to get there sampler that gives you four treats for 23 dollars. I really wanted to get a milk and cereal shake instead of soft serve so I ended up getting milk and cereal shake and chocolate to truffles. Now you if your looking to get some soft serve let me make a suggestion, the crack pie soft serve and chocolate pretzel are simply amazing. I've never tried such a unique tasting frozen yogurt. The crack pie by far my favorite and the good thing is you can sample the soft serve (which is what I recommend doing) in order to see for yourself. As for the milk and cereal shake it was kind of god is what I would say. In just being uniqueness of trying something completely new it is great. I think the highlight was the sweet corn flakes that gave it an added touch m. Other than that it taste most like the taste of milk after it is been sweetness by cereal. Better than the shake was the chocolate truffles. A lot of people do the birthday cake ones, but you can't go wrong with the chocolate ones especially if you like chocolate. Value wise is where this place falls short. Even as a foodie whose use to paying much more for superb eats, this place is pricy for what you get. A regular shake is 10 dollars for a 12 once shake. The shake and truffles ran me almost 19 bucks. I think the best value is the sampler I mentioned early. If you are expecting out of this world taste for what you pay or rate this place based on what you pay you may feel disappointed. Despite value I would definitely come back and try more goodies. I hear there is a Milk Bar opening up in LA soon, so I will probably check out that location before returning.

I decided to try this place out with my friend after hearing positive reviews & I mean really positive reviews (best ice cream shops across the US) so I walked in with high expectations. I got Madagascar vanilla ice cream and something else with brownie bits in it. Anyways, it's just average ice cream. Nothing special.

The appearance and awww of this bakery I found to be slightly misleading. Upon entering I was blown away with the presentation of the baked items. After a little thinking I bought 3 cupcakes and a donut. Cupcakes were fair. First they were cold. Not really interested in cold cake. The icing was.. ok. The cake taste like it had mildew fish water. Not one but all cupcakes. Glazed donuts-only reason I'd return
Little pricey but delicious! Drive through has been surprisingly quick. Plenty of room to sit on a weekend evening. I am visiting for a week and have been there 3 times so far. Delicious!

These flavors are INCREDIBLE!!! So happy I found this ice cream spot! I got peanut butter and jelly flavor, but they also have a bunch of different types of cereal flavors (lucky charms? Cap'n crunch?) and other unique options! I wanted to try them all! The ice cream itself was super creamy, and it came in the cutest container with a fortune cookie. Highly recommend Melt!! :)

Okay, I know this location is pricier than others but I'll happily pay because it's the only location on the west coast. Anytime I'm at a Cosmopolitan, I try and stop by for cookies. I love the cereal milk soft serves and shakes (and just the cereal milk in general). The blueberry cookies are a family favorite (as are the compost cookies). I've tried the box mixes and while they're okay, they really aren't the same. Spend the extra and buy them fresh!

Jeni's always has a super long line especially on nice days but don't worry it moves at a decent speed . My friends all say good things about the ice cream. I cant attest to that because I don't eat ice cream but I did try a specialty soda , the cream soda and it was good but really sweet. Nice employees .

Yooo!!!! This place has a loooong wait but you watch them scoop it fresh and it's so so good you'll want to come back right away. I tried the 4 pack so I could taste several flavors. I wasn't a huge fan of the Graham cracker flavor everyone recommended but the others were all very good.

I was so excited to finally go to the famed Amelie's (in NoDa) today with a few friends. When we first pulled up, I noticed that the parking lot was absolutely PACKED, which usually says good things. The decor of Amelie's is quite eclectic, just as the customers are. It marks itself as a French bakery and the art decorating the walls follows that theme. Honestly, it's a gorgeous place. It has a surprisingly large interior with different rooms that are all equipped with extensive seating and tables, as well as two free wi-fi networks. A lot of people were hanging around doing work on MacBooks and eating baked goods. All in all, it appears to be a really funky, awesome place to hang out if you can find a seat. For the food, I tried the vanilla Creme Brulee ($4.99) and purchased the "award-winning" Salted Caramel Brownie ($1.79) for later. First of all, I was amazed at the speed of the guy working the counter/register when there was literally 15 people in line being quite loud. Secondly, the Creme Brulee wasn't as great as I hoped it would be. Something about the taste of it wasn't what I was used to. Regardless, it was still pretty decent. I've yet to try to the brownie, but according to the people beside me in line, it is one of the best things available at Amelie's and well worth the two bucks. My friends both tried different large chocolate creations that tasted about the same, but were both quite delicious (this coming from somebody who isn't a chocolate fan). The prices at Amelie's are pretty high, but the environment is worth it. My friends and I all enjoyed what we ordered and agreed it was worth the price. Thanks Amelie's for a great experience!
Delicious! I had the cookie cup with chocolate gelato, a caramel cookie and roasted marshmallow on top ! Great gelato!!

Love this place! The best coffee and pastries around. It is the cutest little spot and the staff is very friendly. They offer a variety of macaroons which are my favorite! I can't wait to try the macaroon ice cream sandwiches!
Cup cakes are a little too sweet for me, but over all good stop for a late night cup cakes. And the staff there are super helpful.

I was initially excited to come here, after looking at all the wonderful reviews. I ordered the cookie cup, being over seven dollars, thinking it would all be worth the money. I tasted a few flavors and decided to stick with chocolate, but the flavor or consistency was nothing special. Overall the scoop was rather small considering the price. The macaroon and toasted marshmallow on top were the only significant parts, but I've seen many other places where you can get much more for a price like that.

We found this place on yelp and decided to try something new. The ice cream is all homemade. I had the butter pecan and cookies and mint. In my opinion the pecans were over-roasted but I loved the cookies and mint! We came by at night 2 times while we were here. Each time seemed to have the same selection (was hoping to try some of the other flavors) but they did not disappoint. Would love to come back and try to get there earlier in the day next time to try something new. :)
I'm almost ashamed to acknowledge that I didn't know this place for the first several years I lived here because of the shop's history and popularity. This is a must-try of Champaign

The ice cream is delicious! Had butter pecan and some sort of caramely cashew concoction. The cookies also looked super tasty, will definitely have to try those next time. The only downfalls to this place are the parking and interior layout. There's not much parking available and if you can't snatch a spot, valet seems to be your only option. The interior is somewhat small and kind of awkward if there are more than three people in line. Would this stop me from going? Absolutely not. Love this place!

Really good & tasty! We had the Butter Pecan. The only thing negative we could say about it is that the pecans were over roasted & tasted just shy of burnt. We understand that this could be preference, but since butter pecan is my absolute favorite ice cream I've eaten plenty of it to know when the pecans were over roasted. But overall it was still pretty good. The guys behind the counter were very friendly & helpful. The decor of the parlor was lively & bright. It's not a cheap treat, 2 scoops in a cup $4.50, 3 scoops in a cup $5.50 but a nice indulgence especially with friends.
I have stopped by multiple times during their business hours and they are always closed when they say they'll be open. I don't know how you run a business and don't stick to your hours

Wow! Talk about falling off! I recently purchased a bunch of macarons, some tarts, some pastries, etc and ALL of them tasted exactly the same. Like old state desserts. Their macarons definitely do not taste like the flavor they're advertising. Big disappointment! I would not call this an authentic French bakery.
Everything here is amazing and I now will only eat macaroons as ice cream sandwiches. ORDER ONE OF EVERYTHING
Really a 4.5 star macaron that we tried. Huge and awesome Pistachio flavor!

I was super excited when I heard they were opening a location in Vegas. My first time was in California and I fell in love with it. Since then, I've been to their locations in Seattle and Hong Kong. Today was their soft opening and it did not disappoint. I loaded up my tray with all the delicious goodies from egg tarts, puff pastries and various buns. I felt like I was in a candy store all over again lol. You can see the staff members just restocking the fresh goods as it comes out from the oven. Everything tasted so good and freshly made. I didn't get a chance to order any drinks but next time for sure! I'll definitely be doing frequent stops here for coffee and delicious goods. If you never been or heard of this place, then you are missing out on some good eaten.
Got the soft serve with cornflakes. It was OK. I liked that it wasn't too sweet but other than that I didn't really care for it, unfortunately.

I've been so excited about visiting since seeing Jeni's Ice Cream all over social media. The ice cream parlor itself is so cute and trendy. I love the sleek designs of the outdoor seating and brightly lit sign making it really stand out! It's also conveniently located off the of the light rail and around tons of restaurants making it a great place for dessert. When I first opened the door to enter, I was hit with the sweet smell of freshly made waffle cones and homemade ice cream. I want to take that smell and turn it into a candle that I can just burn every day in my house. The ladies working were so wonderful and knowledgeable about each and every flavor! They let us try a few before setting on one to commit to. I ended up with the Bumbleberry Crisp and the Salted Peanut Butter in a waffle cone. It was really good and even if the two flavors didn't necessarily compliment each other, with any Jeni's ice cream you can't go wrong. You can also pick up a pint to take home so you can have some for the rest of the week!

Came here after playing a $1 at the Flamingo and before In and Out Burger as it was right next door. This is a smaller location compared to the others that I have been to. I came here to get the $10 holiday mini pack for my best friend and I. Every Christmas we bake cookies and make cup cakes, however, since we decided to go to Vegas we bought our cupcakes but obviously still kept out Christmas tradition. They actually had a lot of cupcakes since we got there early. All the holiday flavors were good with the exception of the egg nog which was a let down. It was just a vanilla cupcakes with a few spices but nothing that reminds me of egg nog. Staff were super friendly and sweet (pun totally intended). There is some sit down space inside but my bestie and I just walked around with our cupcakes since it was a really nice day outside.

I thought CJ's was up there until I tried this ice cream. This is less showy and more straight forward. The flavors were delicious and the texture was almost like soft serve ice cream. I got the 2 scoop waffle cone with Blueberry Cobbler and the Graham Central Station. They went perfectly together!

This place is hard to find. Tip: its outside of the Venetian. Also if you ask for directions, then make sure to say Bouchon Bakery not Bouchon Bistro. It's a cute small shop with fairly friendly customer service. Food-wise, the pastries were good, but not worth the price. I've had better for cheaper. My family and I ordered every croissant type they had available at the time: butter, almond, chocolate-almond, apple, & chocolate. They were all okay, but not the best. My personal favorite was the chocolate croissant.

My five stars are specifically for the crack pie...which I enjoyed everyday for breakfast... 3 days in a row! So awesome with a hot cup of coffee. It's gooey and buttery and reminds me of a cross between a pecan pie without nuts and a chess pie. I also fell in love with the birthday cake truffles. My kids loved the softserve quakes but I could not get past the sickening cereal milk taste. Make sure to get a sample of the soft serve before you commit. We also tried the birthday cake one day which I found to be dry and nowhere near as good as the birthday cake truffles. Located on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan. Near the restaurants, and right after you enter from the sky bridge.

I have been wanting to try Carlos bakery after watching Cake Boss and it lived up to my expectations. My boyfriend and I arrived at the bakery 15 minutes before they closed and we had to wait about twenty minutes to order which wasn't too bad. I got 3 cannolis, 2 regular and 1 chocolate as well as a mini white chocolate tart. The cannolis were the best I have ever eaten, especially the chocolate. I suggest going earlier in the day because they will have more pastries to choose from. The price isn't something to rave about but you're getting quality pastries, not something store bought which I don't mind to pay.

Sweet republic is wonderful!! This was my first visit to this location. We stopped in for a tasty treat! When adulting all day it's nice to have a place to rewind the clock- and enjoy a flashback to childhood with ice cream!! They have delicious options and all kinds of ways of jazzing them up! Today I had salted caramel ice cream with a waffle bowl! I added a Marshmallow to the top!! It was fantastic!! The service is fast and friendly!

I LOVE this place so much. The ice cream flavors are so unique and culturally diverse. For example, I just had a combination of Matcha Oreo and Halva ice creams! They also have other fun flavors like: Vietnamese Coffee, Hojicha, and Marzipan. Each ice cream definitely tastes like what they claim to be- definitely not something to take for granted. Each flavor has a unique consistency to is as well. The best part of this establishment is the service from the people who work there. They are so patient while customers try all the flavors and love input for what their new flavors should be. I recommend this place to anyone who is looking for locally sourced quality ice cream in Cleveland!

I came here last night for my birthday since they are my favorite ice cream spot in Charlotte! They are a ton of different flavors to chose from! The best part is that you can get a flight of 3 different scoops, or even more so you can get a little bit of a few of your favorite flavors. I got the cream puff, bramble berry, and goat cheese with cherries. They were all delicious! The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable about each flavor as they will allow you to sample as many as you'd like! If you go on your birthday, your ice cream is free too! Sometimes they get crowded and have a long line, but it is worth every second to wait! They have fresh made waffle cones as well that smell and taste delicious! I cannot wait to go back.

Wow! This place has serious variety. Tons of flavors, sundaes, floats, and more make this a tough dessert decision. Everything looks good. Reasonable prices for the ice cream. The ice cream is fairly dense and more doughy than creamy, which is great! I had the Oreo and the "This @&!$ just got real". Bit were great, but I'd choose the latter if I went again. Or, maybe I'd try one of the other 1000 menu items.

Best ice cream in Arizona!!! Friendly and helpful staff will let you sample any of their amazing flavors. I always go for the Cookie Monster, but every flavor is worth a try. Won't regret checking them out. Cute area to hang out too!
Everything about this place is awesome. Love the sweets, coffee, and tea. The atmosphere is so awesome. Virtually everything available is great, even the food. Zero complaints.
This is a very good Milk Bar from NYC. But it's very sweet for me. But cookies is very nice. There's have big menu. If's you don't know what you need just ask for recommend

Prices for cookies are steep at $4/cookie but I always come back for their blueberry and cream cookies to take back home. Their cereal milk flavored soft serve is creamy, light, and slightly salty. Cornflakes as a topping is a perfect pairing! Their can be a line at times but the service is quick and my wait for my order wasn't long at all.
Highly recommend the lobster tail & the cannolis! The items were slightly pricey but you pay for the name & quality. Caution- the line was super long but it was definitely worth it!!

Best Ice Cream Ever!! We drove here because it was recommended while in Vegas. Although it's a hike from the strip, it was well worth the time & gas. We tried: Birthday Cake - my fave! & hands down the best I've ever tasted. Period. Oreo - delicious! Pistachio - O.M.G. That's all I'll say. Banana Cream Pie - Yum! Key lime pie - delish! The flavor I will try when i come back to Vegas is Bananas Foster.

Came on a Friday afternoon. It was lovely weather so we say outside on the bench seating, there are also some 2-4 person tables as well. I wish I could leave a 4.5 start review... PROS: -Very quick service -Liked that they use metal spoons for tasting, good for the environment! -they have cool color changing spoons to eat your ice cream with, which the kids loved - nice selection of interesting flavors, we went with cookies & cream, matcha Oreo, key lime pie, honey chamomile, and committee batter. -the cones were fresh and crisp, the waffle was piping hot and fresh -prices were ok, $4.50 for a single scoop cone,$3 for a kids cup, $7 for a double scoop waffle CONS: -parking is limited -as nice as the selection of flavors are, it would be nice to have 2-3 'normal' flavors like chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, for the more conservative customer. Overall it was really good, I would recommend it to others and would probably visit again if I was in the area.

This was 'the' place to go for ice cream as a kid. Fresh chocolate banana shakes were my go to favorite, but everything is great. A wonderful, local summer treat. Their holiday flavors in the fall are delicious too.

I drive through Vegas every summer to go home between LA and Idaho, and this place will be on my essentials Vegas stops list. The hype is incredibly real. Nothing says road trip quite like delicious donuts to fuel you through the long drive up Highway 93. The Big Poppa Tart is truly as delicious as it looks. The most difficult part is truly making a decision about what you want to eat! The donuts are massive and can easily be split or shared. The Homer's Donut was my second favorite. I have a preference for raised donuts, but their cake donuts were also amazing. I do wish they had some gluten-free options, but other than that I am all about these aesthetically pleasing donuts!

I have never heard of Jeni's ice cream! My niece however from Ohio has frequent hit them in her hometown. So of course she found this place in Charlotte while we were visiting together, and we had to go here after dinner! They were crowded... A very long line outside and inside. But no complaints! It gave us time to chitchat and the lines seem to move along pretty smoothly. I'll try the Wildberry lavender ice cream it was to die for! I loved loved this flavor!! I definitely tasted hints of lavender weaved within the wild berry flavors. I believe it was a mix between a sorbet and yogurt. Everything about this ice cream has me reminiscing about it!! Very nice cool ice cream joint with an assortment of mouth watering flavors.. like Mexican Hot Chocolate, and Skillet Cinnamon Roll! Yum!! I'll have to see if they ship nationwide because that lavender flavor is calling my name!!!
Oh my gosh, these donuts are to die for!!! Stopped in on my walk thru downtown. Great concept, gourmet donuts with a awesome atmosphere. Try the soma donut, can't go wrong any of their donuts.

I had been looking forward to going to this chain of Milk Bar for so long as it was the closest one to me (geographically) and I had no idea when I would finally make it to NYC. I'd heard of its Crack Pie and unusual cookies for years hearing nothing but rave reviews. I was so disappointed! Crack Pie wasn't addictive as it's name suggests, the Birthday Cake pops tasted like other vanilla cake pops and the cookies didn't taste any better than homemade cookies. Mouth-feel was boring and the flavors were flat. If you like sweets and simple desserts then great! If you're looking for something special, go somewhere else.

Found this place on yelp and luckily got the yelp discount!! We loved the gelato, the melted homemade marshmallow and macaroons. It is very low on pastries despite what was said online about it - except macaroons. The ice cream was amazing it was organic and had a nice light feeling to it. The workers were very friendly and my family and I had a very nice time chatting with one of them. Will definitely be back!
Perfect last stop for an evening in NoDa! Tried the maple bacon macaroon and it was so good! Love the ambiance.

Bouchon Bakery when can you come visit me? Because I can't really bring you with me when I leave. *sobs* and I was expecting I could sit and enjoy your atmosphere, and you're only a take-out counter! Behind the escalator, in front of the Phantom Theatre, the baked goods were excellent. I made a beeline for the macarons, which were pretty good and not the usual one bite size, but at least 3-4 bite size. I warn you, if you decided to share... well better get your own, they sell sampler boxes of their six flavours for about $20, if you want to do that, so that may make an acceptable gift, if they are able to last the trip home. Service fail happened, when we asked for a pain au chocolat and the guy serving us looked at us as if we had grown a second head, it's kinda funny, but shouldn't they have to know that pain au chocolat is chocolate croissant, since you have it every day on your shelves? I am not a fan of Mr. Keller's shortbread though... too much sugar on top of the cookie, but I did like his carrot cake cookie very much, I couldn't find the currents in the cake, but the walnuts were quite excellent.

Had my favorite, a scoop of Key Lime ice cream, complete with graham crumbles. It's delicious and fresh. Everyone ordered outside. (Cones are not available right now.) The order comes out in a bag with your scoops in cup containers. Very efficient and friendly. In Ohio City.

Yeah, still 5 stars and I just grabbed another big box of 85C goodies. They're limiting the number of people entering which helps the lines a little bit but it's still goes way slower than those experts in CA but hey, they're working as fast as they can. New recommendations: try the caramel pudding in the refrigerator case. It's so good! Also, the almond half moon cakes are excellent. They're light, fluffy, a little bit of cream and crunchy sliced almonds. Yummy.

The flourless chocolate cake was to die for. We hid it from my brothers to make it last longer. hehe I will definitely be back. My mom is gluten free and loved the cake. It was decently priced for a gluten free treat! I just wish they had seating...but that would make me want more goodies too!

One of my favorite spots to go to in Charlotte. They are nestled in a historic building with lots of eclectic arts and extremely laid-back cozy vibe. The pastries are divine and they have something for everyone's dietary needs. The coffee is very good. The customer service is amazing considering the line is always wrapping through the building. At some point maybe I'll actually go in and have a meal instead of just dessert.

I have always loved the NoDa Amelie's, so I hate to write a bad review. I drove across town for food. After waiting in line, I got to the register around 9:30. Closing was at 10. The cashier told me "no food because we've already closed the kitchen." My order didn't require any preparation aside from heating it up and putting it in a box. I asked to take it cold, figuring I'd heat it up at home. The cashier refused again. Shutting down the kitchen early is lazy, and I doubt the owner would be thrilled about the lost profits. If you're going to cut corners so that you can leave 10 minutes earlier, at least be willing to work with customers.
OMG - I am in LOVEEE - I am usually not a big cupcake fan and pretty much dislike all frostings HOWEVER, I just had a Red Velvet Cupcake and I am in Heaven!!!!

Although small, this is one of the best places for ice cream in The Valley. They care about making great ice cream and they seem to be knowledgeable. The flavors I've tried are very creamy and delicious.

If you like terrible customers service, loud employees and overpriced bakery items that are not actually cooked from scratch, this place is for you! The was a great little gem when it opened and not it is just ghetto as heck and run more like a McDonalds. Really too bad. Must have very poor management or just absentee owners of the business.

I was excited to try this place out and thought it was okay. They don't make the cookies there as it is shipped from New York, so don't expect fresh cookies here. They are all prepackaged which sucks as I can go my local bakery for fresh cookies. The positive thing is they have very unique flavors which is the draw here. I guess if you want it fresh, fly to New York. The birthday truffle was yum and the crack pie good, reminded me of butter cake. I tried their soft serve crack pie and it was ok. It just melts quickly and they put it in a small container. Or, maybe I just lick my ice cream way too slow..*shrug* Would I be back? Uuummm..I would if I was passing by but wouldn't go out of my way to get something here.

What a surprise drive to Chinatown with the family! Whoohoo, great galore of pastries and drinks! Pick your own selections and order your drink. Then your all set and ready to go! Their milk donut is the best! We've gotta come back again for sure!

I am not vegan. Yet somehow these are my favorite donuts in the world. I moved to Texas a year ago and I still find myself dreaming about these donuts. I have tried every donut shop in Cleveland and no one can compare to Vegan Doughnut Company's maple cream filled or glazed twist. If you are hesitant about going here for donuts because they're vegan let me enlighten and encourage you. The texture of all of their donuts are heavenly, the flavors can't be compared. The glaze may be a little runnier than Krispy Kreme but it is delicious. GO HERE!!!!!

Finally made a trip out here!!!! The donuts looked amazing!!!! and of course very tasty and moist! Plus of it all was it wasn't too sweet like most donuts are! If you are looking for not overwhelming amounts of sugar this is place to visit! donuts ordered- maple bourbon Strawberry split strawberry cheesecake All were very tasty! Definitely coming back here and trying the others! Also if you are coffee lover, they do serve stumptown cold brew!!!

Great ice-cream! (Key Lime Pie, S'mores, Mint-Chocolate Chip and Chocolate peanut butter cup were all eaten during our stay in Cleveland) lots of options - even a dairy free option. This location had a lot of seating, there is some in the back of the building, and some upstairs. Also it was cool to see them making the ice cream. They also have a selection of soda and water, but you can also get a free water cup. Once we tried this ice cream we kept looking for it throughout the Cleveland area and got it whenever we could. Yum!

I came across this after eating some poke at the same plaza. The brightness and the decor caught my eye. After looking at their simple menu I understood their concept. I chose fruity pebbles for the milkshake mix in and that nostalgia hit me. Oh those kids memories! The milkshake was flavorful and soft. I had a sample of their matcha late and it was on point: not too sweet and strong matcha taste. The thing that bothered me was that the place was packed and I had to share the table with another party.
It is alright, nothing spectacular except that the vibe is cool and open 24 hours a day. You can sit, do takeout. I think the food andpastries were better years ago and now they are meh.

I have enjoyed my experience here you get a whole lot of ice cream for your $ the service is fast and friendly the ice cream was great and they gave out free samples which is always appreciated because if you have kids you know they can never decide. When in the Madison area this is a great place to stop for ice cream.
I'll start by saying Umm WOW!!! Amazing interior design!! Amazing teas Amazing macaroons and fruit pasteries....& May I add the best quiche I've ever had!!! Extremely happy I found this in DT!!!

Looking at all of these amazing pictures, I wish I would have ordered something more exciting! This was a nice little ice cream shop with a huge line out the door when I went, so you know it is good. I felt bad asking to try flavors because of the line, but I went for the butter pecan with hot fudge sauce. Usually not a flavor I would order, but I was in the mood for it. Typically I strongly prefer soft serve ice cream, but this place is incredible. I had just one scoop and it was enough for me. I did not like that there was limited seating inside because it is so tiny, but sitting outside was fine. This is a place I absolutely have to give a second try...YUM!
It's a good fun place in my opinion. Lot's of fun choices. I truly enjoyed my experience here.

Today's snack was on the Cake Boss, Buddy V ;) While the desserts my husband and I tried were all very delightful, I found that they were a bit too sweet. We had such a sugar rush after. All of the employees were very nice and helpful!

As soon as I heard that an 85c Bakery would be opening in Vegas I was stoked!! However unlike the 85c in California which always has what you need in stock until it sells out, this one unfortunately is hit or miss. I'm a very big fan of their egg tarts and green tea bun with chocolate filling, but the Vegas location is very hit or miss with the menu. Some days they'll have the pastries you want, some day's they don't. Overall the California location is much better when it comes to consistency, but taste-wise, both locations are on par. As of now I believe this place is a solid 3 star solely due to the fact that the pastries are inconsistent and the service isn't the greatest.

I have not been here in a long time since I'm avoiding sweets. But today was so hot that I had to stop by on my way home, instead of having coffee. Don't expect a fancy ice cream shop, this place is just a window you order from. They have a variety of flavors and some daily specials. I always get the four (4) scoop sampler, as I can't decide on what flavor all the time. The price is unbelievable for $4.60 out the window (get my drift). You can also get pints to take home, banana split, sundaes and ice pops. They only have two (2) windows to order from and service is good.

This cafe has items that are Asian and Europeans inspired! This store is available in china town. The store is filled with savory and sweet items. Once you walk in, you will see Tongs and trays right away. All you have to do is pick up a tray and set of tongs, and utilize the tongs to pick up whatever items you want, and there are soo many to choose from!!! Then, you get in line, where someone is standing at the end to individually bag up each item before you check out. They also offer teas, coffee, smoothies, and cakes which you can order at the check out. Will definitely be back

The best local ice cream around! Mason's is the perfect pick me up, any day of the week! We live right around the corner, and stop in probably once a week. I love how they are so adventurous with flavors and concoctions and they really do take in all the feedback they receive to make the best ice cream possible. They certainly have interesting flavors, but they always have amazing classics as well! The couple, Jesse and Helen, who run the place are the sweetest ever, which makes me love coming by even more. They have done a lot for the community and it makes me thrilled to have people like them in our neighborhood. Also, one of the best parts is the staff is so generous and love dogs, that they always give my sweet pup a free doggy scoop of vanilla ice cream! Also make sure you try out their ramen nights - they are delicious but get there early as the line is killer! They also do fun movie nights in the summer and bring in food trucks. Just the best!

Churn is designed as a classic ice cream shop (and has the accompanying candy to prove it) but also features some different flavors and interesting sundaes. I've gotten the S'mores sundae before, and though pretty good, was a little too much for me. I'd stick to a regular sundae. Usually I get the ice cream cookie sandwich. Pick two freshly baked cookies and an ice cream that they scoop right in there. Once you get your treat, head to the back patio, which adjoins the back patio for Windsor, the restaurant next door. They're open late and they're always peppy, so be prepared to reciprocate with at least a smile.

I have a love/hate relationship with Donut Bar. Unquestionably, the donuts are good. Are they worth $5 a piece? Definitely not. Donut Bar has an excellent variety and without a doubt grade A marketing. I'll literally be scrolling through Instagram, see a photo of their donuts, and instantly begin prioritizing my need to drive all the way downtown to pick up a French Toast donut. In comparison to other donut shops throughout the valley, Donut Bar offers a variety of vegan donuts, made to order options, and some very "creative" choices- such as the "Big Poppa tart", a donut literally stuffed with a pop tart. As for the quality- arguable. Yes, they open super early and obviously if you get there later in the day they won't be as "fresh"- but hey, if I'm getting a "stale" donut it seems obscure to pay $4 or $5 for it. Definitely think they need a price adjustment. Flavor is a 10/10. In all the times I've been to donut bar I can honestly say I've never not loved the taste of any of their donuts. My most favorite would have to be the strawberry shortcake and the Oreo birthday cake- both absolutely delicious! The employees are also very kind and are very quick to give recommendations. I've been here super early at opening to when they were just about sold out and have always experienced exceptional service. Overall, Donut Bar is great- I'd just recommend an early arrival and preparation to pay upwards of $30 for a half dozen donuts.

Oui ou Non? Ummm Non. Amelie's French Bakery is not quite "une boulangerie franÃ§aise." The pastries don't remind me of France or even Canada and I suspect it's because of the use of margarine as a substitute for real full fat butter. There isn't much bread to purchase which usually is a staple at a French bakery and everything taste a bit frozen. I feel like taking an international flight just to get a delicious pineapple coconut cream cheese ring or a simple freshly made baguette. The Pros: The staff are the nicest people ever. The shop stays open 24 hours which is rare in Charlotte. The food is visually appealing. The Cons: The eating area is filthy which makes me nervous about the kitchen. Seating is limited. The decor is a tacky mix of the idea of what Paris should look like mixed with the local thrift store. Overpriced for quality.
Just a wonderful little cafe - perfect for studying, catching up, or just savoring a fresh sandwich au jambon. The only hard part is choosing which treat to indulge in!

If you want the best pastries this wont be it. But this will actually be enough for the stomach. I love how cute the cakes are for$29.00 it's not too bad. I bought extra stuff like other pastries. It's not a bad place it's very clean and not your typical bakery.

My boyfriend and I went here for the first time yesterday. Customer service was amazing. We had so many samples, and the lady was happy to help. The icecream flavors are unique and DELICIOUS!!! I've been drooling about this place still. We had two cookie cups! I had fruity pebbles and salted caramel icecream with a red velvet macaroon and of course the toasted marshmallow. The macaroon is hard to dig through, so we ate that separate. The toasted marshmallow gives such a great flavor and texture to the icecream. HIGHLY recommend! We will be here again soon

Yum Yum Yum I had 3 very happy little boys who got 3 Giant scoops of Delish Ice Cream!! And only 2 Bucks on Tuesdays!! Very happy Mommy and wallet too!! I personally had the Orange Cream Dream!!! So good!! We'll see ya next Tueaday!!

This place is a hidden gem! They had fun unique kinds of ice cream and had a doughnut/ice cream sandwich that was unbelievable! On top of that, the owner was thanking every single customer walking in! Talk about amazing customer service! Thank you Novel Ice Cream! I'm going to tell all of my family and friends about you guys!

I have tried this place twice. They are very good and prices reasonable. The banana pudding is great as well as the peach cobbler (note: I do add a little lemon juice to add a bit of tartness) But this is a personal preference. It's good and it will cure any sweet tooth.

Went for the toffee banofi after watching the best thing I've ever ate. It was good but did not match up to the one shown on tv. The one Alton had was 3 scoops of ice cream & no waffle cup. The amount of Carmel & hard crunch was less than a 1/3 of what was shown & pictured in the shop. It was great tasting but I feel like they showed one thing on food channel & at $7.75 you would think it more than covers a few more squirts of Carmel & toppings. Unfortunately I had high expectations & was disappointed.
I think we might be back! "Ice cream donuts from Heaven" says thirteen-year-old Braeden
They have one of the best eclairs in town! This place is a must go for people who drinks coffee at night because they open 24/7! Do try the mini mousses! They are the bomb!!

Stopped by after dinner to grab some drinks and sweets. I had a matcha tea and it was ok. When I get hot tea I want it to be super hot and this was just mildly warm so I had to drink it faster than I cared to. My husband got the Maiko special and it was very interesting. It's a matcha ice cream with all sorts of things, like corn flakes and jelly, added into it. If you are wanting something sweet and sugary this isn't what you want but if you like Japanese flavors or just want to try something different and new you should check it out.
The shop in Carmel Commons is where we ate and what a great experience!! Food is everything it is said to be!! Excellent!!
Disgusting ice cream and way overpriced! Got a milk shake which was ok at best and a quart of strawberry ice cream which tasted horrible, could not even eat more than a scoop. Overrated.

I LOVE BOUCHON (and all things Thomas Keller). I came here multiple times since it's located conveniently RIGHT outside the entrance and exit for the Venetian rooms. My go-tos are TKOs, the pain au chocolat, and bouchons (which are so chocolate-y). Their pastries are definitely less sweet compared to other patisseries and the chocolates are more decadent-which is fantastic! I've also been to the Beverly Hills location and it tastes relatively similar! Coffee is a darker roast, but the flavor is pretty chocolate-y with a nice finish! Very comforting for the tired body and totally soothes my soul. 10/10 would recommend!

I have lived in another city where I did not eat my favorite dessert, Icecream, because there was just not good selection. I have to say the first time I built my bravery to try Mitchell's I was pleasantly surprised. Now it is my second favorite Icecream company! Simply delicious!
If you haven't been to sprinkles you gotta try it! It's a little pricey but well worth it!!!

Long lines. Not sure what the buzz about this place was. Tried it. Not my thing. My wife liked what she had. But she also didn't think it was worth the time or money. Perhaps it was the night we were there.
Location was great, bakery was clean, staff friendly and efficient. Canoili was heavenly. Cakes a little too dry. Prices were typical Vegas. Would go back for the canoili!

The bread of the day, cracked wheat, reminds me so much of what my classmates and I started to get fat on at the hostel in Madrid. Thick crust with a nicely textured inside. Really up to European bakery quality. The pretzels look plump and intriguing. The baguette though is bit too chewy to pass for the vraie chose. Expanded afternoon hours for commuters.

Got here about ten minutes before they closed on a Sunday night. Still serving - whew! WOW flavors everywhere! So many choices, it's probably impossible not to find something you like. And then you have to figure out if you want a cookie bowl, pretzel cone, dipped waffle cone, or plain sugar/wafer cone - overwhelming to say the least. Once I finally decided, I got the Z'Oreo ice cream in a pretzel cone, which was very good for me since I don't have a huge sweet tooth. Ice cream was fresh, tasty, and creative - there were bits of Rice Krispie in mine along with Oreos and something else I can't remember. Very good! Minus one star for rude staff. My friend asked if she could do four small scoops instead of two large in order to try more flavors, and the kid behind the counter said he could lose his job for doing that. No need to be overdramatic, bud.

Even during a pandemic their staff aren't taking the proper safety measures such as wearing gloves. I asked the cashier if they could put gloves on when making our four drinks but she refused and said they wash their hands ( we watched and they did not.) Multiple people have complained and asked already and they only comply when a scene is made. Ps it also stinks inside, sewage gas is a health risk.
If you want the finest ice-cream with excellent service come to this iconic historical shoppe. The ice cream is addictive.
My favorite of all the locations due to the ambience. I love the desserts but the creative environment is great for writing, inspiration, and people watching of course!
Love this place. Great cupcakes. Super moist and super yummy. Red velvet and rainbow confetti cake are great

I love little soft serve places like this. The ice cream here gets an A+. I had my classic--small vanilla cone dipped in rainbow sprinkles. People were talking about their family memories from when they'd eaten here in summers past in line--I'm not from the area, but it seems to be somewhat of an institution. Just on our first stop we saw families of all ages, couples, bikers...everyone can enjoy this place. Definitely stop by if you're headed to the south side!

Yuppies and hipsters abound, NoDa is most likely the coolest place in Charlotte. Enter Amelie's Bakery. I will be honest, the food is delicious here. However, the ambiance is definitely what takes the cake with this bakery. Yes, pun intended. I indulged in the critically-acclaimed salted caramel brownie, and it was deliciously rich. The luscious European butter used for their pastries certainly give a certain richness and flavor that normal butter cannot provide. Also, I had the French Almond and Raspberry macaroons, equally delicious, complimenting my green-white tea perfectly with every respective bite and sip. Again, the ambiance. Two acoustic guitarists, excellent finger-picking, not so excellent voices, jammed in the main seating area. Classics like the Berenstain Bears and French novellas line the shelves, and a fireplace adds to the warmth of the lighting. All in all, quite a comfortable area, and a great cafe to unwind after a stressful corporate day, one that I know all too well.
Quite possibly the best doughnut, ice cream combo I've tried. I literally eat ice cream 3 days a week and there is none better in the valley.

One of the best ice cream parlors I've been to in Arizona. Churn was recently rated one of the ice cream places in the world by buzz feed, and after a taste it is clear to see why. Upon entry I was greeted by Lisa who proceeded to give me tastes of the most popular flavors. All tasted fresh and were made in house. This place is a must visit for anyone visiting phoenix.

Best deserts you'll ever have!! They have many options and the prices are very good. You can get dessert, salads, a sandwich, or some coffee. The environment is very nice and laid back. Good spot to hang out or to catch up on some work!

We have some happy kids (and adults)!!!! This is the ultimate sweet shop. The ice cream is amazing, but the cookies also rock. I love the salted chocolate chip! Great outdoor seating to make you feel comfortable. This would be a perfect end or start to a date! Actually Windsor restaurant is next door has amazing food, so this is a one stop win!

Great Canoli's but there was a long wait. The canolis were great and the chocolate covered strawberries were sweet too. The problem was the wait. I would give this place five stars except the wait could have been avoided. There was a long line outside the bakery, so I expected to wait, but I thought it would not take too long because people are only ordered baked items. I was wrong. The staff was slow in taking orders and then packaging our baked items. After waiting in a long line and then placing our order, we had to wait for them to package our food. then call our order our for us to pay and pick up. I would definitely come here again, but only if I didn't have to wait so long.

Truly, what is not to love about a french bakery? The salted caramel brownie and vanilla eclairs are my go-to treats, but I also really enjoy their tarts. They make a killer chai latte with almond milk - the almond milk provides a nice depth to the latte that I haven't found anywhere else in Charlotte. Open 24 hours/day - be prepared to wait in line, it's totally worth it!

This pace is so pretty, gives European cafe vibes. When I reached a lot of things were already sold out, so that was a little disappointing. I ordered Chocolate Petite Gateaux - it was so rich, creamy and chocolaty. I could tell that the ingredients used were the highest quality.
