Presti's is a good Italian bakery. Their best cake is cassata cake so creamy. I don't know how they keep the strawberries so fresh inside the cake. My only complaint is the manager was a bit rude. My friend and I tried to order cassata cake for our friend's birthday. She wasn't seem to be happy and a bit short with us. Like lady, what's your problem?!?! The coffee was okay not that spectacular. Overall, I'd probably come back for the pastries.

Jack Frost is unparalleled, best doughnuts ever. They're willing to try new flavors, get creative with it, and everything I've tried is fantastic. I think my favorite is german chocolate. My heart hurts thinking about it, because I'm on a diet these days. But seriously, nothing compares to Jack Frost. Nothing!

Milk bar is a little expensive for what it is but I expect most places on the strip will charge more. We wanted dessert ASAP and decided to swing by this place. There was a line but it moved quickly even with only one person working. We both decided on shakes, I got the chocolate cake shake and my husband got the birthday cake shake. There's sprinkles all over the top and chunks of cake mixed in with the ice cream. It was really a perfect amount and didn't feel as heavy as your typical ice cream shake. They were so yummy. The straws were nice and fat so you could suck up all those cake chunks. I recommend this place if you want something sweet and cool and you want it fast.

Such a cute cafe/bakery. Great place to hang out if you have some time to spare or if you want to do some work. The napoleon pastry was delicious and the cream was very light. The icing on the top of the napoleon was overly sweet for me, but I enjoyed the puff pastry and cream. The salted caramel brownie had a great toffee flavor, but it was too sweet as well. There were endless unique flavors of macaroons to choose from that it was hard to decide. Overall, loved the pastries.
I needed a cake last minute to celebrate a friend's birthday and Milk Bar did not disappoint! Customer service is amazing at this location. Everyone enjoyed the cake.

My boyfriend & I tried the famous Donut Bar on Saturday. It was great! Donuts were very sweet but good & moist! We tried the girl scout cookie, vanilla bean, red velvet & the cone. Location isn't convenient for me so I wanted to try/take multiple ones while I was there. Staff was super friendly & helpful. Parking isn't the best but that's just how it is downtown. Restaurant itself is small but super cute! There's also an outdoor area in the back to sit& eat. I'll be back if in the area!

Amazing ice cream, probably the best I've ever had but extremely pricey. $5 for one scoop is kind of crazy, I understand it's all homemade with fresh ingredients but it's hard to pay that much. I do love the eco friendly initiatives they put in place.
They're great! The flavors are fun and tasty! I love the decor as well. Really bring my inner child out. Absolutely adore.

Came here for the ramen! Next time I do come here, I will be trying out their sweet treats. Unfortunately it aaa way too cold for me to even think about ice cream. So I heard that during the winter months in Cleveland, they will be serving Ramen to go! They don't have it on their walls but if you ask the worker if they are serving ramen they will either give you the options (pork or vegetable) or they will tell you they are fresh out. They make some in a first come first serve basis. The broth was delicious and the ingredients were in a separate container. Those include ramen noodles, the tiny sticks of mushrooms, seaweed, corn, and radish. (There may have been more but I can't remember) Because they are not known to be a ramen shop, I will give it to them. Everything seemed very authentic and delicious but I wish it was hot when I ate it rather than room temperature. But if I would of liked it hotter, it would probably melt the containers, so I can't be upset about it. The ramen is pretty pricey, but they don't have a lot of ramen shops in Cleveland. So definitely try this place out and don't forget the sweet treat! Because I'm regretting not taking home the toasted pistachio!

I always wondered where Batch Bakehouse was located on Willy Street, and after it moved opposite of Ha Long Bay and right next to ace hardware, I finally visited it! Such a convenient location!! Very simple storefront and you can see all the hardworking employees making fresh bread at the back! Love the focaccia and bacon cheddar biscuits!!! And DON'T miss out the shortbreads in the fridge. They take credit card now! And there's also some bar seats and the patio when its warmer :) Remember come early! Or call to reserve your favorite bread. Else, you won't get your loves.
The lemon blackberry ice cream was excellent. Good staff, good service, good stuff. We be back to Oberweis again. You should check it out
We had the ice cream-stuffed doughnut and it was amazing! Pretty good size, one is perfect for sharing. Fun live music in the outdoor seating area, too.

The fancy deserts are not the only interesting item at Charlotte's only actual French bakery and cafe. The cast of characters that take up on both sides of the counter. You know right away quand vous entrez (when you enter) that someone has visited France and "gets it". It took a very long time for Charlotte to obtain a square of land from the city of Lyon. It's real French edible art without the 8 hour flight.

Amazing!!! I'm a big fan of the show. Had to stop here and I was not disappointed! I had the cappuccino and a chocolate cake slice and both were heaven! I was just excited to be able to try something from Carlo's bakery!! The staff were so helpful and really friendly. As chaotic as it was they took there time and treated you like you are the only customer they had. I can't wait to make this a tradition and go back!!

Even the lack of credit card acceptance wasn't enough to justify not giving this place 5 stars. The donuts were outrageously awesome. Soooo gooey. But the star of the show was the $3.25 apple fritter as big as a dinner plate smothered in sticky apple pie filling. Don't go and expect to enjoy your donut in the shop because there are zero seats.

This little center has a lot of great options for food bf dessert. To be honest it's a tough choice to choose between this and nielsons across the way, but I prefer this place and my husband prefers them and it's fine cuz we can go get our orders and meet up at the car. I got matcha with fruity pebbles toppings and custard filled fish. Really yummy and creamy. I can't wait to try more flavor combos

Ice cream is bomb. Especially the bourbon caramel toffee crunch and honey lavender flavors. Oh, and the donut sandwich is quite ridiculous. My only regret is stuffing my face with too much pizza at a pizza joint beforehand, so I didn't do such a great job making room for more scoops of ice cream goodness. Then again, my tummy would've disowned me. Staff is super friendly and genuinely happy to be there. Will definitely be back to try more of their decadent flavors.

It's looks a little sketchy when you pull up . It has a dark parking lot but don't let that fool you. The treats are delicious! We got the Fatty Daddy and it was so yummy! Definitely go get your sweet tooth on!
The place to go if you're craving for Pinoy ice cream flavors and halo-halo dessert. Yum!

Ice cream heaven. So many flavors of soft serve and all of them are so good, you will swear that there's some sort of illegal substance hidden in there. The sundaes are gigantic and will send you into a sugar coma but you will be too blissed out to care. Even though I live on the other side of town now, we still drive here once every few weeks. Heck, I'd probably still drive here even if I moved out of the city. But I won't move away, and at least 10% of the reason is so I can easily go to Page Dairy Mart. Seriously, just go. Waiting in that long line is worth it.
I enjoy the sprinkles in California so much. I had 2 come 2 Las Vegas 2 see if it met my expectations. My go to cupcake is the red velvet.... it never lets me down :)

God I love this place! Every time I'm in the chinatown area, I have to stop here. The prices on the pastries are good and the lines have definitely died down since first opening. The boba is okay but not the best, it's enough for a quick fix for sure though. The garlic bacon, garlic cheese, and brioche are my favorites from here!

Wow, what a setup! Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream is impressive as soon as you lay eyes on it. It's retro marquee draws you in and then the pristine look let's you know that this is no ordinary ice cream shop. The menu featured flavors, both traditional and funky. And the homemade aspect of this is clearly in its name. I went with the taster duo - half scoop of chocolate peanut butter cup and half scoop of one of their featured flavors, geauga maple walnut. Both were equally delicious. Mitchell's offers the essential toppings - whipped topping, sauces, and a few candy and fruit options. Once you get your ice cream, you can hang out in their large dining area or take a stroll down west 25th street. This place is going to be booming in the summer so make sure you take some time to check it out! Update 9/14/14 - dogs are not allowed :( have to reduce my rating. I knew it was too good to be true! Building owners won't allow it.

What's with the bad reviews? I came here on a Sunday night and didn't have to wait much in line. The guy working the counter was super sweet and gave me great recommendations. He had me sample a few things and I decided to order the cereal milk soft serve with cereal flakes as a topping. Goodness. It was amazing. Tasted exactly like sweet cereal milk. I noticed a lot of negative reviews complained about price. Come on people, this is Vegas, and you're ordering from a place inside the Cosmo. Obviously it's going to be a bit on the pricier side. Doesn't take away from how good the ice cream tastes. I wasn't as crazy about the milkshake as I was the soft serve, hence one star off.
Spoiled by traveling through most of France. I wish they had traditional French pastries, even a simple Cochon would have been nice. For that I give 3 stars.

Note: Hard to find, but in the Venetian Casino underneath the stairway before you enter the Casino! If they have any left... their cheesecake is the best, comes in a cute little individual sized cup-- super creamy and not the baked kind. Stop by for a little sweet-- they have croissants, peanut brittle, macarons (yummy and a great selection!), their signature bouchon brownies and madelines among others. Prices weren't too bad if you don't get a macaron, they had HUGE cupcakes for only $3.50-- really, compared to some places that i've seen this is quite a steal. The were seriously HUGE! Macarons were about $4.00 each I think!
Friendly, fast, and fresh! Located in the heart of Little Italy, this bakery is a hit. I enjoyed he raspberry thumbprint cookies and the lemon bar. The pepperoni bread was amazing.

OMG, this place is the KING of delicious baked goods. Hands down!! Everything they offered was delicious. The kouign amman was something I could not pronounce and looked so unassuming and we were just blown away at how delicious it is. The oreo thingy, just heaven. Bouchon brownies, absolutely delicious. I cannot say enough about this place. I wished I lived in a place that has a bakery that is half as good as this place. We stayed at the Venetian, and their pop up bakery right when you exit the guest elevators is where the bakery was, and the lines are always long. Worth every minute. If only I had more room in my stomach, I'd eat here every morning. We bought a box of goodies to take back with us, and it did not make it to the airport. I wish I could give this place more stars, because I am a big fan!!!
White chocolate mousse cake and carrot cake were delicious! The white chocolate interior was so creamy like cheesecake with a cake base. Carrot cake was moist and balance of spice.

Handel's is the best Ice cream in town! It's made fresh and in small batches! Pick a flavor and you CAN'T go wrong! My favorite is peanut butter parfait, but they are all delicious! Tuesday night's special is $2 a scoop (and their scoops are BIG)! You may wait in a long line, but it's worth it! We also love the 4 pack sampler, which is pretty much like getting your cake (or ice cream) and eating it too!

Churn reminds me what it might have been like back in the '50s when we visited the local ice cream parlor for a malted milkshake from our favorite soda jerk, and then transformed into the future to discover fancy flavors like Madagascar Vanilla, Blueberry Yogurt and Whiskey Toffee Almond. The goodies, wrapped treats, and candy toys are all there, and in easy reach of the kiddos, so be prepared, but also be prepared to go through that "my eyes where bigger than my stomach" feel, because the servings are generous and the sweetness way up there, where you might not expect. Of course, you ARE in a ice cream parlor! I got the Ice Cream Cookie Sandwich with oatmeal cookie and vanilla, and really have to stuffed it down, even though I didn't have the room, but it was sooo good, and immediately gave me a sugar high that helped get me home for this early riser. Open late to round out the evening, and in a upcoming hipster area where the "cool kids" hang, trendy and upbeat, right along Central Avenue.

I am so in love with their salted caramel sauce! I could put it on anything and be a happy lady. Luckily, Churn has plenty of ice cream flavors and other treats to douse in that sweet caramel goodness! The Vietnamese Coffee ice cream is an absolute favorite of mine. It's pure sweet, creamy coffee with espresso bits. Yuuuum! I also really enjoy their vanilla - simple yet delicious. I love the inside. It's cute and brightly decorated. The shop is pretty small, but it seems much larger. The employees have always been super nice and friendly. Always quick to smile and encourage delicious decisions. Churn, Churn, Churn... this is my mantra whenever I crave ice cream. I chant their name out loud so my husband knows to prepare the automobile for delicious discoveries. I wish Churn was closer to home, but it is definitely worth the drive.

So this place is within walking distance from my hotel and man it was delicious and the donuts all look so pretty. I got myself a Boston cream and an expresso. My 5 year old got the chocolate donut. We enjoyed it so much we decided to stop by again the next day after lunch and it was closed cause they were sold out. My son was literally in tears. He really wanted to have a donut again. I was taking a picture of the sold out sign when he looked up at the right time I got the cutest sad face from being donutless. I recommend to go there before 12 noon. I highly recommend this place.
Everything I've tried at this Bakery is amazing!! I only wish they also had some seating area indoors.

Amelie's is a great bakery. I enjoy their pastries. The ambiance is good. There is ample space to sit down without being crowded or feeling rushed to leave. I also like that Amelie's is open 24 hours. Amelie's coffee is just OK. They also serve it in small sizes. You cannot order a large cup which most people are accustomed to (e.g. 20 ounces).

Wow. I mean WOW. walking in and seeing Italian cookies spread out across the top of one of the displays took me back to ny/nj. From the crumb cake to the brownies, to the cookies and muffins, it smelled so good in there. The variety of macaroons and other assorted goods made this place well above average . The price wasn't too bad either. You could tell they really had a passion for what they were doing. And this place does something that most bakeries don't, stay open past 6pm. After dinner we are always looking for a good bakery to go to, and most are closed down and home watching jeopardy before you even get a chance to yelp them and see if they are open. I can't wait to come back here and try one of everything!!

The display of sweets at this bakery is incredible. It's almost impossible to choose. So much so that I bought 6 things and brought them home to share. Everything was incredible but my favorite was the chocolate cream cheese Danish.

Thankful they put a Sprinkles ATM in terminal 3 @ McCarran airport! Was running out of time to grab travel gifts & all the stores in the terminal had relatively sad offerings. Spotted the CUPCAKE ATM & figured it was worth a shot. The most disappointing thing about these cupcakes was that I only bought three. Each flavor was fresh and delicious! I got myself a Pumpkin cupcake, it had cream cheese frosting and I cannot stop thinking about it. Will absolutely visit the ATM again, as it also saved me from having to drag extra stuff through security. SO CONVENIENT!

I happened by Churn on accident, and I was so pleased with my discovery. Being a chocoholic, I had to sample Churn's chocolate ice cream, and I was blown away! It tasted so fresh, creamy and heavenly, that I actually had to go back and buy a pint! So, glad there is a local ice cream shop that uses fresh ingredients and makes such wonderfully delicious desserts! I will be back many times, and I will recommend it to all of my friends.

Went here during labor day weekend to try the cereal milk soft serve. It was $6, but for some reason my bank statement says $6.50. I didn't catch it when he told me the total because I figured it would be just the $6. Check the amount prior to paying/leaving!! The soft serve was so gross. I can't believe all the hype on it. I took a few bites and threw it away. What a waste! My friend got the soft serve with corn flakes. She kept saying how nasty the soft serve was and how salty the cornflakes were. Aside from that experience, I've had some of the cookies before and my fave is the blueberry. Crack pie is extremely too sweet and I love sweets.

Omg omg omg!! I came here 4 years ago to relish on the famous traditional Canoli and Lobster tail.. I came back today reminiscing the day I was here last time. Beautiful place, great staff, quick service.. a place I would recommend all to definitely try and not to forget the traditional Canoli and Lobster tail. You can't come here and not try one of these!

Can you 'Handel' it?!?! The ice cream, that is. I am glad and also not glad I found this little dessert stand just because I love sweets but my waistline/jeans DO NOT....sadly. I came because it was recommended by a friend as her favorite place for ice cream. There is a large window/menu of options and plenty of pictures because they are worth a thousand words. Little mural/back story on the side of the building stating how it all got started in Ohio. I tried the 4 Sampler so I can try different flavors. So I got birthday cake, praline pecan, black cherry, and salted caramel. For me, ice cream HAS to be frozen like a rock for me to enjoy it. I guess I'll just have to call it "sticks-to-the-roof-of-your-mouth" frozen and NO - that does not roll off the tongue (intentional) From now on, Black Cherry is a must and it tastes just like cherries jubilee at another 'ahem' ice cream parlor. Birthday cake was good too has frozen buttercream and rainbow sprinkles/jimmies if you're east coast. Praline pecan is like butter pecan to me and they have that too.... Salted caramel was okay...it gets soft on me tooo quickly (even though I stored in freezer for a day). Service is pretty efficient as they greet you right away if you're standing there which is great. They seem like young kids which I think goes with vibe (y'know you're getting old when everyone seems younger) But otherwise this place is like....TOTALLY TUBULAR...or some junk...and I truly cannot wait to go back. :)

I get it. There are some restaurants out there where people love or hate it. Milk Bar is one of those places and it just resonated with me a ton since the first time I had their desserts. Most people who are coming to this Milk Bar will probably have had this at some point and this won't be your first time. However being that this closer to the west coast than most other locations (isn't there one about to open up in Los Angeles?), it may very well be the first time you lay eyes on a crack pie or cereal milk ice cream. I won't go into a lot of detail about Christina Tossi (mostly because you can watch an entire Netflix Chef's Table about her or read any other review here), but as the inventor and owner of Milk Bar, she is a sweet tooth genius. I guess it takes one to know one right (a sweet tooth that is... I am definitely not a sweet tooth genius). Although the menu may seem simple, there are a few things you'll want to try from the get go: crack pie (it's all about the buttery goodness, textures and sweetness) and cereal milk ice cream with cornflake crunch. You'd think it's simple and you'll ask why didn't someone think of it before, but it's so distinctively Milk Bar and Christina Tossi. I was surprised to find that they have a fruity cereal milk which I blended together. What a great combo! Try it out if you haven't before. The next stage is to give into their cookies. Oh so many. All oh, so good. I get a tin of assorted to take home that I can then think about sharing with others but in reality eat them all by myself. I've ordered her cakes through Goldbely before which was a great birthday surprise. Love the unfrosted sides and really allows you to enjoy the cake instead of a mouth full of ice cream. Can't wait to go back but will have to find a location nearby. Perhaps I'll just move next door to a store. That may not be good for my waist!

The cream puff flavor is the best! There tends to be a line so try to go middle of the day on weekdays. You can also order online and request delivery if you order pints. I love that they let you sample a few if you're unsure of which to order. ~$5 a scoop so make sure you eat every bit!

I brought my family here and let's just say, as soon as we walk into the bakery, the line was REALLY long... but the case and rows of pastries caught my eye - they were so appealing and just look so delicious. I can say that, i mustve started at the display case for at least 10 minutes before realizing, the line starts all the way at the other side of the bakery. It really didnt take long for the line to move- so that was good. As far as the pastries -ehhh. They are ok, Macaroons was all right, I think, our pastry chef here at works does a way better job. All I can say is SALTED CARAMEL BROWNIE - if you havent tried anything in this bakery, THIS IS THE GO TO ITEM! i am in love with this dessert. Besides the long line, a-ok macaroons. They made up for the salted caramel brownie. I will be back just for that.
Finally, tried the canoli and it was okay as I had better. HOWEVER - the Napoleon and the Lobster Tail is a must! The best I have ever had and so worth the wait.

Fantastic little bakery/cafe in Lawrenceville. The cakes are delicious and dense, and the buttercream frosting is to die for. The chai latte was the perfect temperature and wasn't too sweet. Go with a few friends so you can sample all the treats!

I loved the decor, the 90s baby in my was fan-girling when I saw the business card. I loved what I got, I was able to split it, so for $6 it was well worth the money. Next time though, I'll definitely ask for the brownies to be warmed up before they sandwich it with the ice cream. I assumed they would've done it though. My friend who got one of the gooey cookies didn't enjoy his because it was cold and hard.

This place is all about the vibe, and I think most people get that. There are a lot of factors about Page Dairy Mart that, taken on their own, could raise some eyebrows. But I love the fact that it's right under an abandoned bridge. I love the menu that's too big to be contained by a chalkboard, so it's sprawled across the walls and off onto the side of the shack. I love peering into the dilapidated storefront across the street that once sold designer fashion articles, but I guess we'll never know for sure. I love that fact that you have to inhale your soft-serve on the side of a busy thoroughfare before it melts. And if it does melt, it joins the donations of previous costumers on the asphalt around the mart. I don't love the fact that it's difficult to find legitimate parking, but hey, it did spark thoughtful conversations about "What is legitimate parking, anyways?" and "Is this safe?" and "Are we sure this is the right place?" Ice cream 10/10. Also, every time I've gone here, I've gotten a cheeseburger for some reason. It's legit too, or maybe I was just really hungry.

You must try this place! I'm glad I did and can't wait to try more goodies from this place. My first try was an egg tart from here--heavenly custard!! It was so tasty and smooth with a perfect flaky crust. Oh. My. God. And, it's size? Perfect! A great treat to cap off a busy day. I'm definitely going to be back to try their coffee and other bakery items. A++++ all around!

Located under the escalators (from the garage to the casino). Not as good as Tartine in San Francisco. Great cookie. Good regular croissants. Chocolate croissants aren't nearly as good as Tartine's. My wife enjoyed it.
Highly highly highly recommend cookies and mint! Delicious!!!! Love their ice cream and atmosphere! Can be a long wait, but well worth it!!!

1st time there, very very disappointed. At the end of the night there were only a few cupcakes there so I went back the next day when they opened. Looked like the same cupcakes and same quantity. I was mad because I wanted to leave town early but I stayed till 10 to wait for them to open. None of the flavors that I wanted were ready so I left with no cupcakes. I wonder if they realize that donut shops go in really early to make donuts so when they open the doors they have product to sell. I would never waste my time again.

What a let down- it is 24 hours but the Salted caramel brownie was the only star worthy item I tried. No one in my party liked any of the pastries or tarts, they were bland and the texture was off. In fact, one of them sat in our hotel room, one bite taken, never to be finished becasue we were so disappointed with the pastry quality...Not worth the calorie splurge
Cute local spot that's always busy. I love the logo and the marketing. Staff was friendly but the product was less than impressive. I probably wouldn't go back and didn't think it was worth the wait

Because I enjoy watching the show on TV, I was expecting an incomparable experience when tasting the products in the store. I would have preferred the lobster tail dough to be softer however the cream filling was delicious with a touch of liqueur. The cannoli was average and I expected the cup cakes a little more moist and soft. Cheese cake flavor did not stand out from others I've tried. I liked half moon and chocolate butter cookies. I also wanted chocolate covered strawberries, but there were none for sale. I feel you are definitely paying for celebrity and not flavor

Not sure what all the hype is (or why Mikey Chen recommended this place), we came here at 11am and bought 4 donuts, one of which was the highly hyped crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. They all tasted very dry and stale. Not worth paying $3 a piece. Maybe it was an off day? Whatever it was, we won't be coming back nor recommend this to anyone.

We came at the recommendation of a good friend. I was intrigued by the thought of donuts filled with ice cream. The place is tucked behind a bar/cafe so don't be afraid to walk in towards the little houses in the back. Novel is a super cute little shop decorated with the cutest paintings. My husband got the butter pecan and he said it was the best he has ever had!!! I enjoyed the vanilla and it was amazing. My 14 year old tried the donut and he was completely in heaven! Great local shop with great service. We will definitely be driving out of our way to come visit this place again!

We went there back to back for three days and had multiple crepes and drinks. I got the P.S. Milk tea which had a nice, fragrant tea flavor and the milk had a nice flavor too. My husband had a lychee mojito which he really enjoyed! We had crepes too: Eel, avocado for my husband and I got the bacon one. Both were really good. But the friendly server made all the difference; Grace is such a wonderful person. She recognized us and greeted us promptly everytime we walked in, that really made us feel special. She really connected with us and we're kind of sad that we visit Urbana only once a year for a week. We will be back as soon as we get a chance!

I was craving ice cream and after striking out at churroholic (the line was soooo long) we ended up here. The ice cream was....ok. for the price though, we could have gotten local artisan ice cream elsewhere in the valley. It just wouldn't make sense to go here unless this was close to your home. It's ice cream, so it isn't bad. It just wouldn't be my first choice in town.

We went around closing time and got 2 sandwich cookie for the price of one . This was quiete frankly enough to win me over and be loyal. BUT when I put one in my mouth, it actually melted and a rainbow of flavors burst out- and all I could do with my mouth was to have the biggest smile. Will return again. The five stars are not enough.

So, I probably don't have to tell you the ice cream is great, as all the other reviews say that already. I was hoping for a snickerdoodle cookie but it looks like they didn't have any that day. I did the "that's the way the cookie crumbles" (clever) freezie (? I could be all wrong with these new words.) I subbed the vanilla ice cream for mint and cookies, and boy was it delightful. Somewhat expensive, but if you buy ice cream out you should expect it to be pricey at this point in time, sadly. However there was plenty there, enough to share, or in my case save and hoard to eat at a later time. It's very rich ice cream, so I only need a little at a time, even if I want to eat more! Definitely recommend if you're in the area, or even if you're not it's worth the trip.

Dripps has been on my radar since I saw their sign up. They are coming in hot with a new trend a giant drill that mixes in a cereal with an ice cream base. If it sounds crazy it IS and you have to see it yourself! Since it was soft opening some items weren't available. I really enjoyed the fruity pebbles mix-in with ice cream we got. Not only aesthetically pleasing but had the right amount of sweetness. Only thing was off today my ice cream was melting too fast. Get your hands on that Hoji-cha latte! If your into roasted tea like me you'll like the smokey flavor. They also have matcha lattes for matcha lovers and drilled ice cream shakes. The decor is spot on for the gram. Cute tropical prints, yummy on-trend desserts and friendly staff! Thanks Dripps!

This place is easy to get to, is clean and the staff are nice. I had the Matcha with Strawberry puree and it was so delicious. I thought it would be too sweet and not enough matcha but it was perfect! My friend got the pink crush and that was really good too! Will be back here again

Such a fun way to eat the BEST ice cream in Phoenix! Their ice cream is like a finely aged wine and totally satisfying. Staff are super friendly and helpful when those decisions are so hard to make! They take care of our 4-legged girl too!
Amelie's was filthy and it makes it uncomfortable to imagine eating there when everything in the building looks so unclean, including the pastry case where they store the food.

Stumbled upon this place after having lunch in this shopping center. At first I wondered aimlessly drooling at the desserts. Then said WTF! And grabbed a tray and begin selecting fluffy plastic bags filled with spongy milk bread deliciousness. I don't think I've had this before so I grabbed a half dozen or so of the delicate buns as well as some cookies. I don't think I have enough experience to definitively declare a favorite because they were all tasty and I would give each one a try again. So head in to 85°C and grab a tray and a tea or boba and explore their offerings. Enjoy!!!

We stop by here not knowing what to get and Laura from Sloan's help us a lot. She is very nice and recommended some options for us. Ice cream was very good and my boys like it a lot. Thank you Laura and definitely we are coming back .

Picked up a quick snack. Ordered a Grilled cheese ($5) and took forever to be given to me. They were already prepared in the case and just had to be warmed up, but it doesn't take 10 mins to do that. Being that it took so long, I figured it would come out panini style, but it didn't! It was just as regular as it was in the case and there was nothing special look or taste wise about it. The bread was too thick for the amount of cheese that's on the sandwich.

I am obsessed with this place. I go there at least 4 times a month since it's opened. I love the flavors. My favorite flavor is gooey butter cake. The lavender, cream puff, and brambleberry crisp are also great. There's not always a line, but totally worth it even then. The staff is always friendly and you can try all the flavors you want, they never get frustrated. The line goes by fairly quick.
Fun location outside a restaurant in downtown- unique flavors that are delicious and very Instagram-able !

So I played golf, worked out for two hours, and practiced two hours on my lousy sand play. After burning thousands of calories, and getting nowhere on my sand shots, I figured I owed myself a treat. So I stopped by Sweet Republic on my way home, and tasted almost every ice cream they had - and they were all delicious. I finally settled on their Salted Butter Caramel Swirl, and loved it. Always health conscious, I limited myself to two scoops. But I am now at home calculating how many calories I will have to burn off to justify another trip to Sweet Republic. And this time to go for three or more scoops!!

This shop is the definition of "started from the bottom now we're here." From a community kitchen small batch online dibs system to a full brick and mortar cute shop, things have come so far. The owner and crew are amazing and so personable. And the flavors and quality of the ice cream are second to none. Every time I'm here it's impossible to just get one scoop. Try the flavor you think you won't like. Be surprised. I dare ya! You'll thank me later.

Ehhhhh. This place is very expensive, but everyone knows that. A cannoli and lobster tail was a little under $12. The cannoli was alright. The shell was a bit hard and there was a TON of filling. Way too much. It tasted fine. The hazelnut lobster tail was nasty. I don't know what the hell that filling is, but it was so bitter. Chewing the outside was exhausting. It made my jaw hurt. I ended up throwing it away. I only gave it two stars because customer service was good. Everyone there was very friendly and prompt.

Found Fatty Daddy's on Yelp! after noticing all the great reviews. I have to say, we were not disappointed! The girl behind the counter (I'm sorry, I forgot her name) was super friendly, extremely helpful and really took the time to explain everything and offer samples. Per her suggestion, I opted for the chocolate/coconut mix that tastes just like an Almond Joy (her creation) with an almond macaroon. I asked her to please toast my marshmallow until it was nice and crispy and she was more than happy to oblige. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, both the food and service were outstanding. Thank you!!

First, I really had a hard time deciding to give them 3 or 4 stars. Taking off a star is just from their parking. I understand that it is a complimentary valet parking but seriously who needs a valet parking for a scoop of ice cream? You are there for a cheap ice cream and you have to tip like 30% of what ice cream itself costs? I might sound too thrifty but I would love the valet and tip if I'm having a dinner at least. Last time I went there, I had to wait for a parking spot for like 10 minutes because there are like 8 spaces where you can park on the street which is full all the time. And you have to walk a long way depending on the spot you get. One time I just had to leave because I couldn't find the spot. Enough bitxxing about the parking, I really love the ice cream they have a rich flavor, my favorite is double chocolate. My only complaint will be the lack of selection. They have about 8 flavors and a few of them change time to time so there is not much you can choose from. But still I only choose double chocolate so it doesn't bother me. Oh the staff are nice too. Price is relatively cheap compared to nearby ice cream shops.

I loved this place. Came here late night with gf, and as a visitor, was surprised to see that we had about 30 people ahead of us in line. However, the decor & spirit of the place gave you that "don't worry, be happy feeling". Plus it went extremely fast. If you've never been, it is a must. I'm not a coffee drinker, but I just had to try to cafe matteriuer (sp). Goodness - Carmel sauce, sea salt and vanilla bean! Accompanied by the sea salt caramel brownie. Between the coffee and brownie -- my palate was happy. Delectable. They have an assortment of desserts. You will fall in love with the cozy ambiance which is welcoming to Everyone. Good service as well. Open 24/7, who can beat that? I wish you were on the west coast Amelie's.

UPDATE: I visited Milk bar again and had a better experience. It still seems too expensive but I had the crack pie soft serve with corn flake crunchies this time and it was really yummy!! I also sampled the cereal milk soft serve. It was definitely different than last time. Tasted a lot better! ---- I was really excited to try this. I have watched the chef's table episode about this place and thought it looked so good. Unfortunately it just didn't live up to the hype. The cereal milk soft serve was too cereal-y if that makes sense. I think it should be more subtle. This was the biggest disappointment. I didn't like it very much. Besides that, I DID really like the crack pie and we went back for another the next day. I'm bummed their prices are so high. $6 for a small soft serve? $6.50 for one slice of crack pie? I bake and I know these ingredients are not pricey or extremely difficult to make. The prices need to come down.
Great desserts. Can't believe I didn't know about this place all these years. It's recessed back in the strip mall it's located in, but somehow they are thriving. The salted caramel was the best.

Wow. This place is amazing. Not only are they super fast but oh my god do they have the best gluten free and dairy free ice cream. Was visiting for work and I am tempted to move to Charlotte for their dairy free peanut butter and jelly ice cream. I had a friend try who is not dairy free and he insisted it was the best he had ever had and could not tell the difference.

Friendly staff, tasty pastries, and decent coffee! Only thing I would like to see is less waste, less plastic products etc. pricing is a bit high too, $2.25 for a Macron is definitely steep. I'll be back though!

I had heard about The Batchmaker and her desserts for awhile from friends during quarantine of 2020 and I thought, "man, I wish I had known about her sooner to try the desserts!" Then when I heard she was reopening a store front I knew I had to go to her grand re-opening. I got there early-ish and waited in line for about 45 minutes. Not horrible if you ask me. I've waited in 2 hour lines for food before, so no big deal. Before we get to the dessert, let me start by saying the inside of the new shop was very cute and quaint. Has a cute high tea feel to it from the furniture to the delicate dishes on display behind the counter. The love for the Golden Girls is apparent when you step into the restroom and I am HERE FOR IT Cris (owner and baker) even has a little kitchen for the tiny customers/junior bakers in the making! It's all adorable. Now to the desserts... I got the following: - Apple roll - DELICIOUS! The roll itself wasn't overly sweet which balanced out the sweetness from the frosting. The apples were delicious and still had a nice bite/crunch to them, which I always appreciate. - Oatmeal creme pies - I love a good oatmeal cookie and these were very good. Again, the cookie balanced out the sweetness of the creme which has a subtle marshmallow flavor. - Apple caramel cookie - Also delicious! - Cookie butter cookie - I love cookie butter and this mixed with the chocolate chunks was so good!!! So far, there wasn't anything that wasn't delicious. Another thing I noticed while visiting was the genuine love that Cris has for her work and the customers that support her. Asked vice versa. The customers (new and returning) were so supportive and there was so much love.

Sooo yummy!!! and very friendly employees that are energetic and fun. The ice cream is creamy and creative. The mint one is a favorite. The almond joy-also delicious. They have creative menu items that you can follow by the board or add your own twist. The ice cream sandwiches are good--but Churn, if you're listening! The chocolate chip cookies have a little too much salt on them! I know the salted desserts are popular these days, but the cookie was a little too salty!

Vietnamese coffee with toasted marshmallow fluff: Yum! Coffee is my favorite flavor of ice cream, and I love Vietnamese coffee and frequently order one when I'm in Vietnamese restaurants for my persistent pho cravings. The flavor of this really tastes like an ice cream version of Vietnamese coffee with its rich, strong coffee flavor. It is also not too sweet, which is often a factor that deters me from other flavors. Since I was craving a toasted marshmallow, I added that on for an extra dollar. The combination of the Vietnamese coffee ice cream with the toasted marshmallow was divine! The sweet, fluffy roasted marshmallow complemented the creamy, more bitter coffee flavor of the ice cream. The marshmallow was also huge -- probably bigger than my single scoop of ice cream. I initially thought I could eat equal parts ice cream and marshmallow and finish everything, but I was wrong. The marshmallow was so large that I ended up throwing a part of it away, sadly. But I absolutely loved this combination, and I would definitely come here again for this same combo or something else! Service: There was a line that went out the door, but it moved very quickly. The staff was friendly, quickly took our orders, and served us very quickly. Atmosphere: The inside of the store is quite small, and there is actually no indoor seating from what I saw. There is also a lot of various candies for sale around the store, which was fun to look at. There is seating outside at the back of the store with some small tables and chairs. Overall, I enjoyed the fun, bright atmosphere complete with a cassette wall!

Was here for their 'soft' opening. The staff were really friendly, however when I arrived at 10 they already ran out of all (but 1!) of their vegan donuts! I ended up getting the Spiced Chai (which I was highly skeptical about)... But it was AMAZING. I hate chai tea and cake donuts... But the vegan Spiced Chai cake donut was yummy! I spoke with the manager and they didn't realize the demand for vegan donuts out here, and will be adding more once they open. Overall, very good but you do have to get there early for the best selection. Looking forward to trying more donuts from here... And I think this will be a very good replacement (possibly better) than O Face. I miss O Face donuts, so I'm hoping to get a chance to try the rest of their vegan donut flavors in the future.
Pretty much legendary around Charlotte. When you taste their desserts, you'll know why!

Whether you live in Phoenix or just visiting like us we highly recommend stopping by Novel Ice Cream! This cute little red cottage on Grand Avenue has figured out the way to our hearts - through delicious artisanal ice cream and super friendly service! I had an ice cream stuffed donut and it was incredible. They formulate their donuts to deliberately not detract from the ice cream in any way and it works perfectly. It is a tender, yummy donut, and then it's crammed full of such delicious ice cream! I chose the Honey Lavender, a personal weakness of mine that I like to try wherever I see it. Novel's version is amazing. It has just the right amount of lavender (there is a fine line) and honey. Thom got the butter pecan and loved it. I really love the texture of their ice cream. This is going to be a must stop for us every time we are in town now!!!

Found this amazing little place one night while on the hunt for a new dessert place. AMAZING!!! The Halo Halo I had was the best ever. All the ingredients were so fresh and the Ube ice cream was so flavorful and the texture was incredible. We also tried the shaved ice. This place serves the closest thing I have ever had to genuine Hawaiian shaved ice. They add ice cream and the sweet cream making it behind delicious. The customer service was outstanding and they were so friendly. I think I have found my new spot!
The best ice cream in the Valley hands down! Great vibe and good prices. I love the Peanut butter the best. The atmosphere is fantastic. Worth the line!

Normally I'm not a sweets kind of guy, I like my salt and savory items, HOWEVER, Milk Bar is probably my absolutely guiltiest of all guilty pleasures so it makes sense that I stopped here multiple times while in Sin City. Located in the Cosmo, this little shop its the perfect place for a sweet treat after some time spent gambling or whatever you do while in Vegas (I'm not here to judge). Let's first talk cookies: compost, corn, and blueberry and cream cookies were what I tried. The compost is that mix of sweet and salty. It's got pretzels, potato chips, coffee, oats, graham cracker, butterscotch and chocolate chips- what more do you want guys? The blueberry and cream has bits of milk crumbs and dried blueberries- amazing. And the corn is like this sweet, buttery cornbread like cookie which I never knew I needed in my life. They also have soft-serve and shakes guys and they are perfect. The cereal milk soft-serve was my first swing. They say it's supposed to taste like the bottom of your cereal bowl, which is the best thing ever, right? And they nail it on the head. Milk, cornflakes, brown sugar, and with a small amount of salt. Oh em gee... A perfect ten. They've also got chocolate soft-serve and you can make this chocolate covered pretzel thing. I mean, you guys. It's heaven. It's amazing. It's so sweet and lovely. I'll be back. I'll be back a lot more. I can't wait to waste all of my calories on this because it's worth every penny and calorie.

Came here while in town to see my son. He and his girlfriend have been wanting to try it. The people are super friendly and helpful. I wanted the doughnut-had to try that while there. I got the lavender honey ice cream. Delish! Wasn't sure about topping so decided to have them surprise me. They did fruity pebbles. Right answer!!!! This was so delicious. I'm sad and glad at the same time that I live in California, or this place would be a normal place for me! We will definitely go back when we are there in September. If your in town and deciding if it's worth it or not. Let me tell you ITs WORTH IT! Run don't walk. Don't let the long line scare you. They are very efficient and fast.

This is the review you hate writing. Sloan's ice cream looks great. The people behind the counter are lovely and helpful; truly wonderful service. The problem is that the ice cream just isn't good. Between the five of us we tried 7 different flavors from the usual chocolate to more elaborate concoctions. None of the ice cream had much flavor and some of the add ins, like pretzels, actually tasted stale.

Sausage and spinach Stromboli is simply perfect. Make sure you get a side of sauce. The sauce reminds me of my great grandfathers, it is very classic and delicious. The sfogliatelle is also amazing. Eggplant parm, chicken parm, etc etc. They get everything right here. The only downside is the price, and sometimes rude employees. It seems like some of them feel like they know they have you coming back for the food so they don't even bother trying to be kind to you.

This place has the best ambiance! The staff and manager are extremely nice and hardworking. I visit regularly now as time allows as the pastries and coffee is amazing. My favorite thing I've ordered over 10+ times would be the French Silk tart. It's perfect for chocolate lovers like me and it's not too sweet not too bitter it's just right. It compliments the other tarts in the case as well. A lot are sweet or based on fruit but this one I feel gives a full range of selection. The macaroons are the best ones I've had! The only other time ironically I've had such good ones were in France when I visited in 2017. I would highly recommend the Ukraine macaroon and the cotton candy one as well. The cafe Marcotter is my go to drink as its delicious and has a nice kick of caffeine but not too much. Overall 12/10, I would recommend this place to anyone and I already do.

After hearing so many rave reviews about Amelie's I figured it was time to experience the bakery first-hand to see if I would be singing its praises like everyone else. How do I rate it? Good but way over-hyped. The building itself, however, is pretty cool. The outside of it is fairly inconspicuous, but as soon as you cross through the threshold, you enter a whole different atmosphere. The inside resembles an old Victorian house with seating throughout. Though I was impressed by its uniqueness, I can't say that I felt relaxed there; I wouldn't spend hours at Amelie's as I would at other coffee shops. The food was OK. I kept it fairly simple with an ice tea and a turnover--nothing too crazy or special, for that matter. The service is friendly and quick, but to the Amelie's staff, I implore you---please, please, please don't call me ma'am. Especially three times during a 30-second period of taking my order. Maybe it's a Southern thing, but to us Northerners, it makes us feel old!

Love everything Amelie's has to offer. My favorite is the salted caramel brownie. They also offer yummy soups, sandwiches, tarts, croissants, lavender tea,etc. Cool atmosphere with lots of seating however it does get busy almost all the time.

My boyfriend took me here 2 Sundays ago. First of all I can't believe I have lived in the Cleveland area for this many years and did not know about this place. Part of the allure is before you even step foot inside; you can tell it's a hole in the wall mom and pop place by the sign out front. Upon entering it is a donut lover's paradise. Offering many creative flavors, presented beautifully, and the service is great too.

Presti's is fantastic! It's just a little Italian bakery that has some nice lunch options too! Their ticket service is cute, and they are very friendly! I especially like their stromboli, any kind, but be sure to ask for some sauce on the side! They also do a mean cannoli and a great tiramisu!

We come here for the Babcock ice cream! The prices are really reasonable, $2.50 for a single scoop. We took our friend from out of town to try the locally, not to mention famous ice cream that's made here on campus by the food & science department. I'd say my favorite is the chocolate peanut butter. Another winner is the pecan. The Pumpkin was also very good. Ask for lots of samples before deciding on your favorite!

I came here searching for some really great desserts, unfortunately I was very disappointed. We had the chocolate cake with chocolate mousse and strawberries and the tiramisu. The cakes was dry and bland but the mousse was good, overall the cake was a miss. The tiramisu was better with the lady fingers. For $19 i didn't think it was worth it. I thought it would be something special from a celebrity.

Stumbled upon this place for coffee and a cookie... Almost $10 later I got what I ordered. The coffee was fine nothing spectacular. However, the cookie MYLANTA - nastiest cookie I've ever had in my entire life! My best friend got one also and both of ours ended up in the trashcan. Not only Is $4 for a single cookie very expensive it's also BS when the the cookie is as dry as the desert. Absolutely awful.

This is a must stop while you're in Phoenix! Their halo-halo is simply delicious! Also, their ice cream selection is not only plentiful but also unique. My favorites are the oatmeal cookie, travis, and Cookie Monster! The owner is very hospitable as well. Would recommend this place in a heart beat.

If I lived in the area I would frequent this ice cream shop. It was suggested I give this place a try from fellow yelpers and I am glad I got here this past weekend. Like many places in Scottsdale the store is in a strip mall and it was a little hard to locate, but once we walked in I knew I would like whatever I choose. I selected the Salted Butter Caramel consisting of soft buttery caramel ribbons in creamy vanilla with a sprinkle of salt. It was SO GOOD! Definitely an adult flavor. It's a little on the pricey side, but as a sweet treat it was great. I also liked that they are proud of their yelp reviews and had a sticker for yelp on their door.

Great ice cream shop. Always come here for the sundae with hot fudge. For some reason the hot fudge here is one of a kind. Really rich and sweet chocolate flavor. The ice cream is also good. Other types of chocolates are not as good here but would recommend any of the ice cream items.

We have been to the Bouchon bakery at Napa so wanted to check out the one at the Venetian in Las Vegas. The bakery was superb. Ordered chocolate croissant, almond chocolate croissant and we always have to have the macaroon, pistachio being our favorite. The latte was also well made. Delicious. Glad we dropped by and had our fix.

Not so good. Both my wife and I got something g here and we both are half and threw the rest out. My raspberry tart was bland and very dry. It was the worst tart I ever had. I do t like giving bad reviews but I feel like they are putting no effort into their product just because it's Vegas

Not worth the wait. Was pretty disappointed to have stood in line for 1 cannoli and 1 lobster tail, only to have spent $10 on not-that-great-tasting treats. Not sure if it was just my pallet but the lobster tail was very bland. The cannoli was over creamed. Probably enjoyed the first bite of each and was immediately sick of it afterwards. If you've never had anything from this bakery, definitely try it. They have a great way of branding the name. Not to mention Buddy's restaurant is directly across the hall. Might try that place sometime. Other than that, I would take a hard pass on this bakery next time.
Highly rated ice cream shop. Very well-deserved! Both the ice cream and the service and! My whole family had a wonderful visit!

Great ice cream and service. Our only downside while waiting in line was the panhandler that was working the line. He was also seen walking around inside and approaching customers. The employees should of shown him the door.
Love this place! The ice cream reminds me of back home! Finally found the blueberry was my favorite! The 4scoop sampler is always a winner!
Great coffee, good treats and fantastic atmosphere. Have been here for anything from book club to a first date. Worth a visit.

Finally got a chance to try Jeni's Icecream. As usual it has long queue but as we wait in the line the smell of the freshly baked cone is very amazing. Based on several tips did try the Gouey butter cake which was good and I must say the darkest cake is definitely dark. The single scoop itself seem large to me.

Thomas Keller and Bouchon, you have my heart. I'm still dreaming about the red velvet cupcake with the humongous filling on the top with the red sparkly glitter. Bouchon makes Sprinkles cupcakes taste like recycled plastic brown bags. Never though I would ever spend $75 on sweets but it was worth every cent.

Having jury duty earlier this month allowed me to drop by Donut Bar for two days straight. First visit-11:30am...choosing from what was left, I tried a Strawberry Cheesecake and a Boston Creme. Both tasted okay, but the chocolate glaze on the boston creme wasn't only excessively sweet but looked dull, not shiny like other donut shops, and the dough part itself was a little more dense for my liking. Gave Donut Bar the benefit of the doubt and decided to catch them earlier the next day. Second visit-7:30am...arriving with a full display, I perused the list and ordered three types of cake donuts: Matcha, Blueberry Meyer Lemon, and The Samoa. I also ordered a Creme Brulee Donut and their special donut of the day, Strawberries and Cream. Best of the batch was the Creme Brulee Donut and the Strawberries and Cream not far behind. The yeast raised donut items here aren't as light and fluffy, but more dense and are alot darker than other shops around town. The cake donuts sound better than they actually tasted and I just took one bite of each and couldn't get passed how DRY each of them were. Couldn't taste matcha or meyer lemon, but sugary sweet(and I got there half an hour after they opened) Service was okay, and price point is kinda iffy with the fact that there are other shops in town that charge less for a better tasting product that won't leave you with buyers remorse. Like that song goes, "I'm a classic man"...I like classic style donuts that light and fluffy, and aren't hidden by thick glazes and don't need the addition of an oreo or pop tart. To me, less is more, and maybe third time's the charm, but for now, I'm in no hurry to rush back. ALOHA!!! Shaka Meter: \uuu/ \uuu/ \uu. 2.5

This is the most amazing bakery I've ever been to. I try to get there early especially on weekends because otherwise they may run out, especially of their delicious Vanilla Swirls and filled rolls. One of my favorite treats is their chocolate croissant. You can taste the freshness in everything they make, and their staff is quick with a joke even early in the morning. I recommend them to everyone who comes to Madison with a sweet tooth! Just remember to bring your cash because that is all they take!

Unique and tasty I'm not sure why I waited so long to try their donuts. Nice clean store. They had over 50 donuts in the case and I asked the lady how you know what they are. She went donut by donut and gave me a description as I picked an assorted dozen out. You definitely need a dozen to get a variety of flavors.

I finally went to Sprinkles last night and bought a cupcake at the ATM. So disappointing! It was totally awkward, waiting in line-- it took way too long.The cupcake tasted like it came from a Betty Crocker cake mix-- I expected way more for $4.50. It wasn't even very cute. The Cupcakery in Henderson has them beaten by a mile-- go there if you want a spectacular cupcake. The ATM idea is cute, but I will never go back.
Awesome please plus they are dog friendly and my Siberian husky loves coming here for his special treat

Legitimately the best icecream I've had in my life. The sun popped corn flavor was unimaginably delicious; the buttery notes with the touch of salt and the sweet was the absolute perfect balance. I adored the black current and lavender one as well; it was bodaciously bursting with sweet and tangy berry notes with a floral background from the lavender. The creativity with the flavors are astounding! I would have sampled them all if I could have! Even the little waffle cone chip that garnished my bowl was to die for. Seriously, give this place a try if you're ever in the area. You will not be disappointed-I sweat to that.

Why O Why O WHY do I love this place so much??? Every donut I have ever had was delicious! It is like their basic donut recipe is so good that whatever they do after that is just an enhancement on perfection! My absolute favorite is the oreo stuffed donut-my mouth is watering remembering the last time I had one. The Poppa Tart is so unique and delicious and I am thinking it is made to be shared but....ya know...sometimes it just has to be hidden from your family and eaten bit by bit all day long :-) My first experience with the donut bar was their happy hour; they were close to closing time and did a happy hour where an entire box of donuts was $10. We had no idea the joy we were about to experience. Since that day I often drive by the donut bar hoping to catch another happy hour but it seems like they are often sold out by the time I come by. Next week I plan to make a special trip for the weekend French toast donut, you can bet I will go early for that one! Overall the donut bar is outstanding with a friendly and comfortable ambiance. I highly recommend this place.

I have had Jack Frost donuts a few times in the past year when people had brought them in to work. This past Sunday, I decided to treat my employees who were working and stopped by there myself to buy some deliciousness. The store is a very small unassuming spot. The racks of donuts stare at you, unlabeled, begging to be chosen. These are more than donuts, they are sugary works of art. On top of a delicious donut Jack Frost adds icing and toppings in such quantities they more closely resemble a cupcake. While not good for my waistline, these donuts are sublime. I brought some home for my husband and he agrees (after we devoured 6 in 24 hours). The Maple-Bacon is one of my favorites!

I was so disappointed. I am a fan of the show so while we were in Vegas I figured it would be worth it to go. We got a chocolate mousse with strawberry cake, a lobster tail, a cannoli, and a few cookies. The lobster tail was good, but that was it. The strawberries in the cake had gone bad and ruined everything in the cake. The cannoli was inedible. It was absolutely disgusting. The cookies were Costco quality and not worth buying. I've never been to the original, but it is clear that this location does not have the same quality.
The best mint chocolate chip ice cream ever! Made with real mint! Perfect treat for a hot day!

The old fashion look is very appealing with little nick nacks and old treats every where. The shop is very small and quaint but loaded with good desserts. I tried the Cookies and Mint which very good combination of 2 favorites blended just right. I had it on a sugar cone which brought back memories of my childhood going to Baskin Robbins on my birthday in grade school. A tip is if you order a scoop ask for half scoop of one flavor and get a second flavor and it is like getting to scoops for the price of one. When we went there was no line and we walked up and were served right a way with even getting samples. The is a sitting area in the back which is nice to sit and take your time. Overall had a great first impression and will certainly come back to try other flavors and desserts. Great job Churn!

While I was still on my Thomas Keller kick, I dragged my husband to the bakery to buy treats to bring back home. Among my $100+ haul were packages of their delicate and flavorful macaroons (the pistachio and strawberry are my favorites), TKO's (Chef Keller's versions of the Oreo cookie with dark chocolate wafers and rich creamy center), blueberry lime tarts, fruit tarts, rich bouchons (brownies), and I was even able to bring back some treats for my dog! Definitely my favorite bakery when in Vegas.

A great place to get your sugar fix after a nice dinner. No place to sit. No place to even put your food down for a second. Yes, the corn flakes in the vanilla ice cream was really good. Of course, the helpings look small, but it was plenty for two of us. Speed was good considering there was a line. Great place to try once if you are tourist.
Wow this bakery is the only one I seen in ca . All there pasty are made fresh and are very delicious. Yes it's pricey but it's so worth every Pennie . I love there cannoli and cookies

What a great selection of baked goods. Some simple, some unusual, some high end. All good. I love that they open until 9pm, so you can stop by for a small bit of desert after dinner. Wonderful sweets! Must stop by there if you are in the neighborhood.
Had a milkshake. Pretty good, 4/5. The regular size is huge. They need bigger straws though, hard to drink the milkshake with the small straws.

Came here a few days ago with my s/o after ordering a brown sugar milk tea (50% sweet) with boba and a coffee crush online. Unfortunately, they were out of regular boba by the time we arrived, so I ended up with aloe vera. The tea itself was great and aromatic, but the aloe vera didn't pair well (not Rewind's fault, just a bad choice that I made!) I found the coffee crush altogether too sweet, but my s/o liked it fine. One thing to note is that the online ordering is a little buggy--I had originally wanted to order a Thai Tea w/ boba, but the online ordering didn't give me the option of adding boba to the thai tea. Would recommend ordering at the store instead of online, which also would prevent you from ordering something that isn't available. (If I had known they were out of black boba, we would have gone elsewhere) Overall, service was a little slow, but otherwise a cute store with friendly staff and tasty drinks.

this place is AMAZING!!! THEY ARE OPEN DURING COVID-19 OUTBREAK ! - (seating inside is closed and they are taking all precautions) go check them out! they have such unique flavors and they stuff donuts with their amazing homemade unique ice cream flavors! my family took me here tonight for my first time and i received the absolute best customer service i have ever received in my life. he described each flavor ice cream to me thoroughly and gave tasters. he also thanked us several times for our business and told us how grateful they are to have us there. i have never been anywhere that gave such amazing customer service and was so passionate about their job. this LOCALLY OWNED SMALL BUSINESS DESERVES YOUR BUSINESS .. AND IT IS BEYOND WORTH IT! check them out!!!! :) thank you for such an incredible experience tonight!

Venue: Amelie's French Bakery Decor: Unique, almost hippy(ish) if that's even a word. It's just different Service: Cool, somewhat works fast as a team Environment: Small groups, couples, friends meeting, solo venturing to get work done or to relax Food: Pastries (from what I saw), cakes, bread, soups, breakfast sandwiches Prices: Very affordable, not expensive Huge Pros: 24 hours Operating Debbie Downers: It can be very crowded in somewhat a decent size space. Conclusion: I am a fan of their Chai Latte. Very good stuff. I like the place. Really like that it is 24 hours, that's pretty cool. It's a glorified Starbucks Overall: It's in a quiet section not too far from Uptown charlotte. It's a nice laid back kind of venue. The service can be better but other than that, It is a place I would not mind people to hang out, relax or get work done. Grade: B
Great food and great place just chill and do research on your laptop or meet with clients or associate.
I love this place, of many bakeries I been too. This one of many good Bakeries in Las Vegas. There Red Velvet Cake with an 85 Degree Coffee. Perfect Combination.
You will never be disappointed stopping in here! It's also nearly impossible to walk out with just one thing. These cookies are absolutely amazing

Best place close to the city for a Dippy cone! I grew up in small town that hosted a Whippy Dip! Every time I see this type of privately run ice cream shop it reminds me of home and lazy summer days with my girlfriends. Riding bikes to the local pool, playing at the beach on lakeside, or causing a ruckus at the Whippy Dip! Oh, sooo serious summer romances... flirting with boys while throwing ice from our slushies was a regular occurrence. Finally, a warm spring day on the books and the only place I want to go is The Page. The location is so weird! Under this huge bridge away from any greenery or picnic tables next to a low end used car dealer. I suggest grabbing your food and heading elsewhere. There is always some sort of line and it gets worse on the weekend. These guys and gals are pros when it comes to ice cream and will recite all the flavors with speed that you might miss them. It's kind of like the Cheese steak place in Philly. Know your order when you get to the counter, pay, and move OVER! They have so many flavors of ice cream! The menu is extensive, you can get anything here, brgrs, fries, hot fudge brownie sundae, or a banana split! I will be back all summer!

We heard about this place that claims to be the best donut in the world. Read the reviews and saw the stars and we knew we had to come and see their claim to fame. With that said we came around 10am and there was no line. That was nice since we could take our time and chat with the workers. They told us their claim to fame is the Big Poppa. It's a massive size donut that has a Pop Tart in the middle. So we said to throw one in the box along with creme brulee, birthday cake, chocolate bar (it's like a long John with cream inside), and a couple of others. We were excited to dig in as everything looked good. Now this is where the song lyrics came to my head "don't believe the hype!". We cut the Big Poppa and took a bite and we both thought hmmmm it's kind of dry and not too tasty. So we cut into the chocolate bar. The cream inside was nice but once again the donut itself didn't wow us. Next was the birthday cake which the frosting and sprinkles was it's saving grace. Overall the batter of the donut was not good at all. We were both disappointed. IMHO, these donuts is more like a do nut eat it. It was like grabbing a donut from a truck stop. Sorry just being honest.

I went to the 85C Bakery in SD in 2017 and one of the workers told me that a LV location was in the works. Two years later, it's FINALLY HERE! I waited a couple days after the grand opening to visit and you could tell that some things needed improvement. It was 1pm and most of the shelves were empty. They would yell, "FRESH BREAD," but they were only cranking out 3 different kind - BerryTale, Choco Bun, and Egg Tarts. Ended up grabbing a few, just because there wasn't much to choose from. The line was about a 30 minute wait to get to the register. It was Monday and the had BOGO sea salt drinks advertised on their app, but when I go to order and ask the cashier if it's BOGO she says that they don't do promotions since they're a new store. I came a second time, this time, at 9am. The lines are better, the selection was plentiful (not just cases of BerryTale), and the FRESH BREAD that was coming out was more of the good stuff. Ended up with 2 trays full because I didn't want to pass up trying everything. I asked the cashier if they're still not doing promotions because I wanted to do the "buy a $20 gift card and get a free mug" deal, but the last time I visited they said they weren't doing it. She gave me a confused look and said they should've wrong me up for the promotion and apologized for the misinformation. I ended up eating dinner at Shanghai Plaza and took a peek at the selection and saw they still had some premium items (I could see someone picking up a pink bun which had to be the Strawberry Chocolate one). There was still a line outside, but at least I could see the shelves were still full of pastries. I have high hopes for 85C and think they're still working out the kinks because everyone and their mamas are coming to visit and wait out the lines. *Pro-tip: there's a kiosk in front to order drinks and cakes only! A girl behind me didn't grab a tray and said she only wanted a drink. One of the ladies next to me said, "you're going to wait in this line for a drink?!" I let her know about the kiosk and she was in and out quickly.

I'm a huge fan of their home made yogurt, tarts, and crossants. It is a good place to get a quick breakfast or lunch when staying at the Venetian or Palazzo and you don't have time to go up to the Bouchon restaurant upstairs. You can defenitely taste that they use high quality ingredients in everything.

Happiness is standing in line at mitchell's and waiting for a scoop of toasted pistachio. Or if you're in the mood for something decadent, theres nothing like diving into a scoopful of the chocolate peanut butter cup - the combination of the silky chocolate ice cream and chunks of peanut butter cup is nothing short of sinful. I would eat this off the floor. Some of the best ice cream I have ever had. Trust me I've had a lot of ice cream

In a word, "meh". Had the lobster tail, chocolate canoli and a cookie. The cookie tasted like it was a day old. The canoli was hard and tasteless. And the lobster tail was runny and lackluster. The staff was also unemotional, and stale. I'm a big fan of Next Great Baker but this was a huge disappointment. I feel like Buddy would be ashamed of this place.
I loved the coconut ice cream and how different this place is. It's a hidden gem. My friends want to try it out now that they know about it

Brilliant Location! Who could resist Chocolate while waiting for the High Roller? Or to Celebrate after the ride? I received a Free sample as I entered. There must be some psychology to that! Shop was immaculate & every shelf & display perfectly arranged. & The "icing on the cake?" For me, it's Ice Cream . I may be able to resist chocolate ~ but my weakness is ice cream! Brownie Sundae was delectable, I shared, of course!

Wow!!! This is the best ice cream I have ever had - seriously, folks, this place shows Sweet Republic who's boss. The ice cream is rich and creamy and full of flavor. I tried the butter pecan, banana, peanut butter and chocolate. The chocolate was unlike any chocolate ice cream I have had before - you could actually taste the coco flavor and it was more satisfying than a sugar loaded Hershey's concoction. Bonus - they have pretzel cones!! This went especially well with scoops of chocolate and peanut butter! Yum!! I hopped on the froyo train for awhile there, but this place is going to cause me to derail and get fat. Oh well. I'll be happy. The interior is a very cute, old-school ice cream parlor. It reminded me of Smeeks. There was not seating inside, but about 5 tables outside. They also have lots of retro candies and freshly baked cookies and complimentary water in a jug (flavored with lavender and lemon). I've already forgotten that Mary Coyle's is closing down...

I first visited this place on the way home from doctoral classes because it seemed like a pretty great reward for having survived statistics. I have been here, oh, four or five times now and the only reason I'm not giving five stars is that, every once in a while, I get a cake that is a little too strange, even for me. However, most of them are fantastic. Sage with prickly pear? Awesome. Earl gray? Spectacular. And the hot chocolate is real CHOCOLATE. It will change your life, seriously. Also, the brownies are the richest you'll ever find. So, basically, come here. Do it now. It is open late. Have a complex cake like Vegan lavender honey cream with edible flowers. You will not regret it. This is real cake, not a mix. Bask in it and be happy!

This had been on my list for a long time, ever since they were first featured by Charlotte Agenda. I finally got to try it and I can't wait to go back now. We got the St. Pat's Day Lucky Charms macaron ice cream sandwich and the strawberry shortcake yum-ee bun. The ice cream sandwich macaron was amazing. Everything about it was perfect. The cereal in the outside added good flavor to the ice cream, the macaron was delicious, and the sauce was the perfect complement. It was huge, so I had to bite the top and bottom halves separately. The yum-ee bun was good, but it felt like the portions were off. Most bites all I tasted was strawberry ice cream, which was disappointing. They said this was their most popular item which surprised me because I thought the macaron was better. They also make cereal milkshakes and cookie dough pops which I would love to come back and try. I definitely think this place is worth driving up to the University to try out! I will be day dreaming of their delicious desserts.
Try the hazelnut cream puff. It will knock your socks off. Went on a Tuesday so very short line and live music across the hall at buddy's made the wait fun.

Hopscotch continues to shine, especially in light of the ongoing pandemic. They've added numerous delicious new items, continue to excel at established favorites, and retain the same bright, welcoming, and safe service.

I'm a Mitchell's sucker. I just have to see that big "M" logo and I lose all focus. Seriously like a kid--I get an idea and can't let it go--once I see the "M" I HAVE to have some Mitchell's! This location is pretty freakin' cool. Not only is it big, which is a nice change from the Uptown location that I love as well, but it's also basically a field trip in an ice cream shop. You can see down into the awesome kitchen from the front of the shop, but if you walk down a hallway and head upstairs, you can get a birds' eye view of the magical ice cream production. There's also a train running around the top of the main "dining" area--that's right. AN ICE CREAM TRAIN. And there's a small "bar" along the front windows with little coloring stations so kids can make art while getting their sugar buzzes on. The ice cream itself is fabulous. The options seem endless and you can add fun toppings or get a pretzel for a sweet and salty treat. I highly recommend trying the banana creme pie with strawberry topping--so light and fruity and the graham cracker crust adds a nice crunch. I foresee a lot of visits here after a couple of beers induce an ice cream craving.
Amazing cake. Great bakery! Thank you for making a magical birthday!! Terrific bakery. Wide selection of baked goods. Super helpful staff.

This place is beautiful! Large window to see into the factory. Clean and smells great! We had the seasonal ice cream in the waffle cones and it was fantastic! The ONLY problem is the long wait. There was 1 girl working and 2 customers ahead of me. Other than that, this place is a must!

Amelie's is a wonderful coffee shop for late-nights or early mornings. The best thing about Amelie's is that it is open 24/7...not many Charlotte establishments can boast that! Amelie's is unapologetically kitschy, with French accoutrement covering the walls, tables and menu. The decor can only be explained as "what an American imagines a Parisian coffeehouse to be," although any French person would die laughing if they came inside. But Amelie's recognizes its frivolity, even relishes in it, with tongue-in-cheek art and silly t-shirts. Amelie's prÃ©tention a la cÃ©lÃ©britÃ© are the incredibly gorgeous pastries prepared daily. Cakes, tarts, honey buns, turnovers, brownies, macarons, eclairs, the list goes on and on. They even offer gluten-free and some dairy-free options, but do not offer any vegan pastries (super depressing to this girl). You can order individual portions or full-size pastries for an event. In addition to pastries Amelie's offers a menu of sandwiches, salads and drinks that updates seasonally. A personal favorite is the mushrooms duexelles tartine, a fabulous garlicky mushroom pate (almost) spread over the most wonderful crispy baguette. Usually served with cheese (for non-vegans) as an open-faced sandwich. Amelie's is a great place to take friends and family when they come visit you in Charlotte. It's cute and fun, with plenty of conversation starters, and open 24/7/365. Bon appÃ©tit!
