The shop itself is pretty tiny, and staffed with some of the nicest servers you could ask for. There's almost always a decent line, but it moves pretty quickly, and I've never had trouble finding a place to sit down and enjoy my tasty treat. They also have a wall on the back where customers can suggest new flavors, so let then know if you have any ideas!

With all the hype over cereal mixed into ice cream at Dripps, my family had to give them a try. We ordered the Strawberry Shortcake cereal infused ice cream cone, a strawberry matcha latte & the rose milk latte. The Strawberry Shortcake was captain crunch cereal, cheesecake & strawberries mixed into vanilla ice cream and topped with graham crackers & strawberry sauce. The ice cream mix was good, sweeter with the cereal & add ins. The strawberry matcha latte had strawberry purÃ©e on the bottom, then milk layer and topped with matcha. The rose milk latte has rose syrup on the bottom, milk layer in the middle and topped with blue butterfly pea flower tea. Both drinks were good but similar to what other boba places are serving nowadays. I would recommend the cereal infused ice cream cone over the drinks because it is more unique in flavor.

Presti's is a bakery with a lot of lunch options. They do a decent job of trying to get the crowds through, but It's still a bit hectic with the 'take a number' system. I suppose that's the authentic italian part. Both the food and pastries alright: sometimes a little bland, and sometimes very good. My favorite thing to get is the meat stromboli.

I really really do not like this place. They charge close to $10 for honey bread.It's literally a piece of bread with honey, whipped cream, and fruit on top. Rip off. Also their bubble tea is gross, clearly from a powder, and tastes super artificial... Just don't come here!!! This is one of the only businesses in town that I sincerely hope closes. I know they are a huge chain in Korea and with such a big Korean population during the school year I assume it will thrive, so I guess it's here to stay (and suck.
Some of the best ice cream, I've ever had! Love the unique flavors. I had the Honey vanilla and the Gooey Buttecream, and they were both delicious!

I love the donuts here! They always have different flavors. The Nutella one is my favorite but it can be overwhelming. I feel that they have a flavor for everyone. You always have to go early to have a variety to choose from since they sell out so quickly, usually by noon.
Amazing ice cream! Donuts tasted like made from gods. Put the together....... And you will fall in love. Will definitely be back!!

I used to love coming here as a college student, eating pastries and doing school work either by myself or bringing other classmates. However, recently I've noticed the inconsistency of food quality. For the past couple months, every item I've purchased has tasted like it's been in the fridge all day.... So when I ate it it was either dry, hard, or both. I think this is my last time coming to this location. I'm hoping the one they're building uptown will taste as good as the Noda location used to, if not... the company has lost a customer entirely.

My favorite brunch of all time. EVER. I like chick and waffles or the Steak Frites... so good. I think the steak is also prepared Sous Vide too! You must ALWAYS get the baked goods platter (forgot what its called). So fresh, so good. I don't know what else to say, except GO!

Milk bar isn't for everyone, but it is definitely for me. I love their milk soft serve with the corn flake. It is a bit salty, but I really enjoy it. I can see how some people wouldn't like it though... but I don't really like very sweet desserts, so it's perfect for me! I also really love their corn and cornflake marshmellow chocolate chip cookie. If you love all things corn, get the corn cookie! It's my favorite. The cornflake one is sweeter, but still very good. I love the texture that the cornflakes add to the cookie. I went to Vegas two weeks ago for a bachelorette party and got three cookies. They have a deal 3 cookies for $11. It's regularly $4 a cookie. After finishing my cookies, I asked my boyfriend to get me more cookies since he was going to Vegas the weekend after for the bachelor party. He ended up getting them and I'm soooooo happy! I will definitely stop by if I'm in Vegas again. I wish he could have also brought back the soft serve, but oh well. Can't have everything.

Yummy yummy this is so brilliant! A scoop of ice cream with toasted mallow. I had a kids scoop of banana ice cream and a toasted mallow on top, it literally just melted in my mouth. And actually a kids scoop was good enough for me to have it at night, the flavor wasn't too artificial, so it was good. They have a variety of flavor options, which made me a little difficult to make a choice. Anyways they also open til 9:30pm, so if you are craving something sweet at night, this is the place!

I mean where to start ok went in for the creme brulee donut order a dozen different donuts almost 30 bucks wtf waaaaaay over priced, but anyways my creme brulee donut was good flavor but half my order was soft didnt even have the crunchy top they are suppose to have, all other donuts tasted like Albertsons donuts not impressed , Pink Box hands down are running circles around this place if you are about flavor and not ooh i have a pop tart in my donut WTF it was gross by the way, and i drove all the way from summerlin early as hell because they close at 1 so i thought for sure it was fire NOPE, yall got me with all these bull crap reviews thanks for keeping it fake this place sucks.

My husband and I got married on the high roller. We spoke to the manager at Sprinkles a couple months before the wedding and they were agreeable to block off some tables and chairs to reserve an area that our wedding party could go to have a mini cupcake reception. We were so pleased. The cupcakes looked and tasted amazing. The display towers that we used were classy and everything was set up on time and the area was perfectly blocked off for our guests. Jessy the manager had been extremely helpful with planning this portion of the event and made sure all details were taken care of. We truly had an amazing experience and time.
Had breakfast at the bistro delicious quiche and French toast. Kind of a hassle to get to the restaurant since it's up on the 10th floor of the hotel.

The best soft serve ice cream around hands down. My favorite is the peanut butter sundae. On my most recent visit I tried the pumpkin ice cream. It was really good but Im going back to my peanut butter sundae next time. They have MANY flavors to choose from. They do have social distance guidelines in place waiting in line, however, after you order and pay everyone is bulked in one spot to pick up their ice cream. It would be nice if there was a better system for that but hopefully they won't have to worry about this next year!

My husband, friends, and I were super excited when visiting Vegas and stumbled up the escalator at The Cosmopolitan to the Milk Bar. I am a HUGE Tosi fan and was expecting to be wowed! My husband and I ordered a full Birthday Cake to-go. We waited ~30 minutes for the cake. They boxed it up for us as we wanted to enjoy the cake back in our hotel room. I was so disappointed once we dug in. The cake tasted sour (mainly the frosting). It really had this spoiled sour taste. This has left me questioning their quality control. Did they make the frosting with spoiled milk? We don't live in Vegas so maybe I'll have to give the LA store a try someday. Or maybe we'll get one in San Francisco someday.

This is some of the best custard I've ever had and I mean that as I am a Wisconsin resident. I visited Jarling thanks to my sister recommending this place and I was so impressed. I had their cherry chocolate chip and it was delicious. The custard at this place does not taste artificial like other places like Culver's for example. I highly recommend if you are in town!

Came to Handel's for the first time with a group of friends a long long time ago, back when Kauai Cafe was still in this plaza. I didn't even know that this was an ice cream place because of the walk-up window. That's how they keep this place really clean, by not having a store with constant foot traffic. Smart, I suppose. They have a pretty big menu - cones, sundaes, smoothies, hurricanes, etc. So many flavors of ice cream, but I decided to be boring and try the Oreo. It really was nothing special. I am fine with my Dreyer's Cookies 'N Cream ice cream that I have at home. Anyway, didn't come back here for a while since I am actually a fan of Thrifty's ice cream at Sweet Addiction. When I ended up here again for the second time, I decided to order the Raspberry Sherbet Parfait since it looked good in the picture. Daaang, it was delicious! Can't even remember the last time I actually had good Sherbet, but this is the only reason why I keep coming back! Although, the amount that you get is a hit or miss depending on the employee who makes it. Sometimes the scoops are huge and stacked high, and sometimes the scoops are just sad. The lines can be long during the summer. Maybe I'll try other flavors of their ice cream in the future, but for now I am definitely a fan of their Sherbet!
Basically the best thing since sliced bread. Definitely worth the trip outside of Champaign!!

What is not to like in this place ? Too many options for desserts .. Maybe ? This place has been our stopover whenever we pass by Charlotte. They serve a variety of pastries especially the sweet ones :). Their salted caramel sweet pastries can be trusted at all times to surprise you. It is difficult to get the right balance between the level of saltiness and sweetness. I think they have perfected it. Their other pastries are definitely worth a bite. Again, don't blame yourself for being confused and undecided. Their addendum to coffee are interesting. Give the spicy mocha a shot :) Bottom line: Absolutely French & Wonderfully delicious.
Absolutely splendid. Tried a flight with blueberry muffin, monster cookie dough, and the best is yet to crumb. 10/10 recommend! I'll always support a business that gives back to the community.
Great eclectic atmosphere. Love to just chill. Zone out. Love the petit fours. Love to zone out here

Freshly made gourmet ice cream in massive portions! I stopped in for dessert and the "kiddo" size is a ginormous scoop in an oversized waffle cone. Seriously, I couldn't eat it all, though I tried. There are around 20 flavors to choose from. I was super happy to see Butter Pecan, which I never see back home in Milwaukee. The flavor was spot-on: Rich and creamy, mildly sweet with a caramel undertone, and a salty kick from the roasted pecans.
Love coming back to this sprinkles! Freshest and most moist cupcakes ever! Love their cinnamon and vanilla cupcakes! Love their boxing and packaging. Perfect for portability.

Pretty darn good. I have had this place on my bookmarks for awhile. I got a bit lost trying to find the place because I asked the concierge where BOUCHON was and I failed to mention the Bakery. I got sent to the restaurant. It's actually located near the Phantom of Opera show. Right behind the escalators. The french macarons are 3.50 a pop. Well worth it. It's not the best I've had but well worth it. I got the pistachio and chocolate flavors. I loved the pistachio ones. The chocolate ones were okay, very moist and brownie like. I also got the TKO cookie. Eh, didn't really like it. But the macarons are yummy! I need to try more flavors and get out of my comfort zone of just buying pistachio and chocolate.

How do you pick which donut you want with their amazing selection? All the donuts looked fresh and mouth watering! There is a big selection that will have you ordering a dozen! I had the s'mores donut and it was a treat. The actual donut was large and fluffy. It had a good flavor. The s'mores part was delicious. It even had a cute Hershey bar piece on it. The donuts are all appealing to the eye and they taste as good as they look!
Coconut sorbet in a waffle cone! Best part is the chocolate at the bottom of the waffle cone :)

This place is hard to find and there is no seating. Would go again though. Tried the Espresso Macaroon and the Red Velvet cupcake .. 'bout as big a 5 yr. old's head. Pass on the cupcake though..yeah it was big and beautiful but it just wasn't fresh. Frosting was great though and the macaroon was perfect. I will try again my next time out to Vegas. But, I will go early morning and during the week as suggested. So stay tuned!

One of my very favorite places in Charlotte. This place is absolutely incredible. Amelie's has managed to convince me, many times, to not move away from Charlotte. The food is incredible- we go there for breakfast often. It is open 24 hours and has a great energy.
Lines may be long, even during social distancing but it's nice to have a place where we can respectfully gather and cool off with something delicious!

When I went to school in Case Western, I went to Presti to get lunch very often. However, the taste is really just normal. The most terrible thing is the servers' speed is extremely slow!!!! It takes them 10 minutes to just get you a piece of pizza. They have enough people work there though, Those people just slow!

Bad enough my wife and I are in Vegas with our children but add an absolutely disgusting 12 dollar milkshake to the mix and it gets worse. We are staying in the cosmopolitan and we heard from friend we have to try the milk bar. Well maybe they were drunk when the ordered. The shake wasn't sour however I.T separated like the ice cream was made out of water. Basically I.T looked like a cup of milk with ice in I.T. but the milk was almost cottage cheese texture. So disappointing. And now my kids are complaining like crazy and I'm already aggro that I can't booze I.T up lol.

So happy to have found Rewind in my new neighborhood! The tea here is great! I've tried a few different drinks including lychee peach green tea, immuni-tea, butterfly rose lemonade (personal favorite) which have all been consistently delicious! I love the crystal boba!

Churn is just an awesome place. It gives you so much nostalgia. Along with their delicious ice cream are candies and toys we grew up with and you can't help but feel happy! Their ice cream is super delicious. I always get either chocolate or coffee and my boyfriend gets the mint chocolate chip. There are always lines, especially on the weekends. Take your significant other and or kids here, you won't be disappointed.

This place is awesome! A lot of different options to choose from, and the employee was just amazing. She was extremely friendly, and allowed me to try as many ice creams as I wanted. She encouraged it, even :) ! That is a bit of fresh air, because normally if you ask to try more then two ice creams at other shops, you usually get the impression the employee is annoyed. Not here! She was fantastic. We tried almost all the flavors, and they were very good. I ended up getting lavender ice cream, a turmeric honey, and another flavor that I can't remember the name of.. any ways! It was great. I would for sure come back and bring more people in. It was a good environment, friendly staff, and delicious choices for sweets! I recommend !

Lots of specialty donut places to choose but Donut Bar is our favorite! Donuts are fresh and yummy. Not an over abundance to choose from which makes it easier to have a favorite (caramel latte). Weekends they add some more specialty donuts. Coffee is really good also. Easy to get to and parking is plentiful.
Best I've cream I've had in a long while definitely worth the trip Grahm Central station flavor is the BeezNeez
Peanut butter ice cream with salted caramel drizzle...could there be anything better in life?!

I live close to Jack Frost so I pass by quite often. They are always busy early in the morning. I have not been in to buy donuts since the remodel. I only went two times prior to that. I didn't like it then and I feel the same now. I have been to several functions where they served Jack Frost donuts and they were always a bit over the top for my taste. To much going on. I like simple donuts when I do eat them. It looks like a lot of people like all the embellishments but it's not for me.

Basis for my starred ratings (which skews heavily to the food or drink): 1 star: Never again. 2 stars: Poor food, poor experience, extraordinary measures in order for me to come back. 3 stars: Average, nothing really special, nothing particularly bad. 4 stars: Very good, would definitely return. 5 stars: A favorite, one of the best. Just an update review after a long while. Still one of the best ice cream places in the country. Still do original and interesting flavor combinations without going overboard or too experimental like some other ice cream places. No gimmicks here, just quality ice cream. This time had the peaches and cream. Beauty in simplicity. Sweet cream ice cream with chunks of peaches. The sweet cream base tasted like the milk I had in France. Rich, sweet, and actually tasting like dairy. It is unctuous, decadent, even. The chunks of peaches were a biiiiit undersized, but still added flavor and a slightly tart counterbalance to the sweet cream.

Let's just get this out of the way: is it safe to walk in and order at the counter? YES. Everyone is masked and they enforce social distancing. Now, the good stuff! Hands down the best Italian bakery in NE Ohio, and honestly, probably all of Ohio! I've been coming here since my teenage years and this place has gone from a Naples, Italy-style (I know, because I was just there last year) small storefront bakery to a brick and mortar cafe and bakery with dine-in options on the same street, on the same block! Why? Because they bake consistently delicious pastries that keeps customers coming back with lines outside the door. You want cassata cake? No problem. How about 5 different flavored cannolis? Sure thing. Tiramisu? Of course! Cheesecake? Italian or NY style? They have both! Sfogliatelle? Hells yes! Macarons and macaroons? Both, in about 20 different flavors, plus many, many more delectable traditional Italian and New World pastries. Can I get a side of cavatelli to go with my dessert? Defnitely! It's made from scratch. So are the meatballs, sausage, peppers, and marinara sauce! Mama Mia!
Excellent Key Lime Rolled ice cream. Easy menu, good modern atmosphere. Also have crepes that look amazing, house made.
It's a good place for pastries and drinks. I just cant figure out why this place doesn't smell like baked pasties or cakes. Even with N95 mask on, it smells like 10 horse's vagina every time!

Worst experience at a Ghirardelli ever! As I was waiting for my order we seen some roaches crawling under the tables and on the walls. I quietly mentioned it to one of the workers because I have seen other people explode in a store after seeing a roach and was trying to avoid that for them. He told every co worker there and they all started laughing. After he went to kill it he walked away and mocked me saying "OMG there's roaches, as if they're gonna hurt anybody" Did not even finish the ice cream I was disgusted by the service.

Page Dairy Mart is about as Pittsburgh as you can get. Located off the established portion of East Carson, this shack is gritty and located underneath some train tracks. It's not a pretty location, but if you love the Pittsburgh's industrial charm, you'll be right at home here. With the typical American snack bar choices, the mart's signature for their sundaes. The Nancy B's Chocolate Chip Cookie sundae is godsent. Warm cookie from a great local bakery, hot fudge, nuts, whip cream, and the best homemade ice cream (arguably) in the area. It may have been my favorite sundae ever. The ice cream here also has a historical significance, as the Page family has been producing dairy products since the 1800s. The mart never left it's original location. On the backside of the premise, you can read up on the history of Pittsburgh dairy and ice cream. This place really is perfect, I love everything about it. It's so genuinely American, and native to Pittsburgh. The ice cream is made from generations and generations of love and passion for the dessert. I can't wait to come back to this place. 5 stars well earned.

I love cupcakes so I had to come try Sprinkles.... Ordered 5, peanut butter (was awesome!), salted caramel (another win), sugar free red velvet (excellent), vanilla cupcakes (loved it), water bottles were less than $3 each (win win)... Now the reason for only 3 stars... Lemon cupcake, a total flop. Had zero lemon flavor and although they were tasty none could stand up to the cupcakes at my local place, Gimme some Sugar here in Henderson. Overall a good experience, especially for a place located in a tourist trap.
Wonderful ice cream! Definitely find the time to stop and treat yourself while you are in Cleveland.

Omg!!!!! talk about cookies!!! I've never in my life enjoyed a cookie the way I did that day lol. My bf & I enjoy traveling just to eat and this is the biggest thing we regret is not getting more cookies or trying the ice cream. Previous to this trip we watched her on Netflix on how she started milk. Forget about all the cookies and ice cream spots you've had. This is def a must try!!!

This place is my go to breakfast in Downtown Las Vegas. The donuts are made fresh everyday and of course my favorite is the Creme Brulee donut. The outside is that caramelized sugar and the inside is a fluffy donut with vanilla creme. It's something that will be on your mind until you go back. Other than the donut, my favorite part was the vanilla custard/ ice cream in a cinnamon sugar donut cone. Yup, you heard me right. And it was drizzled in caramel sauce. Let's just say it got a little messy, but was so worth it. I came back every other day for a week for it. *Key advice: They usually sell out everyday by 1 pm and close the shop when they sell out. And make sure to check in for a cup of free espresso or drip when you buy a dozen!

Good ice cream, but the employees just didn't feel like they wanted to be there. Yeah there probably more then likely college students, but if you don't like your job then just leave. I would love to come again hopefully with a better attitude and character from the employees. Moving forward with the ice cream, I had the chocolate chip Greek yogurt (I think that's what's it called) it was great! But you MUST try the orange chocolate chip ice cream (it's a common favorite) my aunt had it. Next time your around the area stop by! All of the ice cream looked so delicious!
I paid 8 bucks for a strawberry shake. It was small and mostly milk. Won't be going back there.
Great ice cream and awesome cupcakes even better when you combine the two. Can't go wrong with red velvet.
Came down because my wife's friends were talking about it. I had no expectations but it was by far the best ice cream I have had since moving to AZ. I will be back. The owners were awesome as well.

Bouchon is pretty damn close to the best I've had. Their creations are fresh, flavorful, delicious, and baked to perfection. There are savory and sweet options. I wish I could try them all. Organizing a bite sized taste party anytime soon? We ordered the kouign amman and cheese danish. And oh lord the kouign amman brought me back to my first introduction to this magnificent creation. It wasn't as good, but it was the closest to the best I've had. It's a must order. Folded butter dough. So buttery and satisfying. I enjoyed every bite. The cheese danish was also very tasty. I love that neither were too sweet. The flavors were spot on, the level of sweetness was perfect, the quality ingredients are apparent. I'd recommend eating them as soon as they get put out on display - the fresher, the better.

I have been to the Sprinkles in Beverly Hills and the cupcakes are amazing. I have been to the store at the linq twice now. Both of the times i have had to use the cupcake ATM because there has been a long wait for the store. I am not sure if the cupcakes in the ATM are day old or they just aren't kept as fresh because they are in there. The cupcakes tasted dry. I will have to go back when the store is not as busy and get some cupcakes from inside the store.

Verdict: Delicious, but pricey for what it is. A few months ago, my boyfriend visited San Francisco...and brought me back a menu from the Ghiradellis there...making me feel ridiculously hungry and jealous. So when I found out one was opening in Vegas, I was super excited. I had an espresso escape sundae. I would consider sharing a sundae if you're going to get one. It's a lot of ice cream. I love their dark chocolate hot fudge. Delicious! I'm a sucker for chocolate. Though it was a good quality and quantity sundae, I still think almost $10 for a sundae is a bit much for me. They have a lot of sundaes you can choose from, and lots of drinks as well. There's even a family sized banana split on the menu. They also sell their chocolate and chocolate products there. You can mix and match your own chocolate pieces. I think this could be a great place for a date or a family outing. Don't park at the Quad. Their lot is small and crowded. It's much easier to park at Harrah's which is connected to the Quad - the Quad opens out to the Linq where the Ghiradelli is.

Love this place! Donut heaven!! This place never disappoints! There were so much to choose from....ya just can't have one! So it took us a few turns here and there...but then.....(Angels singing) ahhhhhhh! Let the gluttony begin.
This is my favorite ice cream place in Cleveland, and well worth the wait if there's a line. I've never had a flavor that wasn't great, but what keeps me coming back is the honey pecan.

All I can say after visiting Mitchell's is, you have not tasted real ice cream until you have tasted their homemade perfection. After trying it, I will find it hard to get a half gallon from the store, or go to a place that sells ice cream like that. Mitchell's is the real deal, and if you are in Cleveland, passing through Cleveland, or even just relatively near the area, do yourself a favor and go try it for yourself. They have a huge selection of homemade flavors. My brother, who lives in the area, says that many of their flavors are seasonal which makes for a fresh and exciting experience each and every time you visit. Although they have a variety of more standard flavors that you can get all the time. All are homemade and delicious, they will let you sample before you choose if you are having a hard time deciding. We visited in the fall and opted for an apple crisp flavor which was good, but the real winner was the wildberry crumble. It was out of this world! I still dream of this ice cream, the real fruit mixed with the ice cream, crispy crumble bits was just delicious. My brother and sister-in-law suggested getting a waffle cone which I would recommend as well to hold all of the big portions, and 2 scoops was good but plenty. By far the best ice cream I have ever had. Do yourself a favor and try it for yourself! This will be a must stop each time we visit Cleveland!

I was on a mission to find halo halo on our stop in phx. The one they make at scooptopia is beautiful, just not the proportions I'm used to. Halo halo is difficult because everyone's got their preferences for sure, so every family makes it totally different. Lots of ice, missing creamy goodness and more of that purple deliciousness that is ube ice cream. If you're a lover of the textured ice and jelly preserves this is gonna be your jam. It satisfied my craving but I also stopped at the market before getting home to pick up more ube ice cream.
Great little place. I recommend the honey pecan with an extra side of their perfectly roasted pecans. Yum!

Wanted something sweet on a trip home to ohio and this did the trick. Great, friendly customer service, accepts cash & card payments, different flavors of custard. Will definitely come again when I'm in the Euclid area and the sweet tooth hits.

What an amazing place! The staff was friendly and helpful! Oh Lawd though-lol!!! Their ice cream is the best ice cream I have ever had! My sister is an ice cream connoisseur, she would make me-take her or drag me to every ice place. So I've ate ice cream in Europe and the States-all the best of the best! But hands down this takes the cake! The texture is so creamy, the consistency is spot on-the flavor is natural and is not sugary or overwhelming. It tastes exactly what perfect ice cream should taste like! Do yourself a favor-treat yourself to some fine ice cream! You will be amazed both with their product and the atmosphere of the place in whole! ***mic drop*** I'm out!!! Going to get some more ice cream!!!!

Espresso macaroon was FANTASTIC. Ooey gooey espresso cream filling with a chewy light glazed meringue outside. Oustanding, 5 stars based on the macaroon. If I were to guess the best would be the espresso or the vanilla macaroon, the texture and sweetness of the filling would taste pretty off if it were raspberry or lemon, but it could just be my taste. Bread pudding was good but not as mind blowing. I don't know why I got it, I mean I knew it wasn't going to be hot or come with any liquor based sauce but I bit. I wouldn't say it was a mistake other than I should have just ordered more cookies and possibly a croissant. Raisins and apples, bread was adequately chewy and sweet but it was just missing some pizazz. I was sad Bouchon itself was closed when I went, the bakery was a consolation.
It was fine, not busy and the pastry was good. I got a latte and a cinnamon apple muffin

Amelie's is a great spot to catch up with friends, get work done, and satisfy your sweet tooth. We stop by Amelie's quite frequently to pick up a sweet treat or breakfast sandwiches. The interior is quite intriguing with the variety of colors and different design styles. It is spacious with a good amount of seating but it tends to get packed very quickly!! The lines wrap around since it's such a go to spot for many. Our favorites are their macarons (Pistachio and Salted Caramel) and their cinnamon sticks! As for breakfast sandwiches, we tend to do the build your own and customize it to our likings.

I was have a vegan day, so this doughnut shop popped up and I was super excited to try it! And let me tell you it's just as good as non vegan doughnuts. The shop is so cute and they have a great verity, my kids loved them as well. We'll definitely be going back.

I was so excited to go here to try the cereal milk ice cream but it is not that great. It's very salty and a little bit too much even though it looks so small. However, here are some delicious things: -crack pie - This thing is seriously so good! I can eat this all day long! I even saved it so I could take it home and let my sister try it and she loved it too! It's the perfect blend of salty and sweet. Some people might think it's too sweet though. - blueberry cream cookie - This cookie is like eating blueberry cheesecake. It's delicious! It makes me want to eat a blueberry pie or maybe just another cookie. - compost cookie - This cookie is pretty good too. I think it would be even better eaten while drinking coffee.
Delicious ice cream and super nice people! The Cookie Monster ice cream in a warm donut is perfection.

Ice cream say you, I say yes please! I really have a loathing love for the cold creamy treat and Daily Scoop would be a daily stop for me if I lived anywhere near this place. Thank goodness I don't otherwise I could kiss my lean mean physique goodbye... Anyways this place is one happening spot and the goods are righteous! Worth the wait in line. Despite a line the service is pretty fast and you get through quick.They have a whole lineup of various flavors. This will be a must go to whenever we're in the area! Mmmm good!

Donut bar never disappoints me! The dough for their donuts is always AMAZING!! Got to take my husband here for his first time today. We got a Nutella donut and two coffees. The donut was perfect size for the two of us. Overall the donut was light and fluffy just like what you would like. We wished there was more of that Nutella flavor on top, but was still very good. The coffee was KICKING which is exactly what we wanted. Also, the staff was SOOOO nice and friendly!! Can't wait to see y'all again soon
The ice cream is very good and the cashier was extremely friendly - asking us where we were from and telling us about their ice cream. The serving size was modest but the taste was great!
WOW!!! Vegan donuts are heaven and they make them so perfectly. There was a little line but it moved fast. Coffee was yummy and service was great. I'll be back here for sure.

YUM! I went when they offered a BOGO free scoop of their ice cream. It was delicious! If you've ever been to Carmela in LA, I would say this is very similar and better than Salt and Straw. You can taste the yumminess and real flavors. Wasn't too creamy or lacking in flavor. Just perfect combination. They are allowing you to sample so I ended up choosing lavender and raspberry chocolate truffle. Delish! Girls working were super nice and helpful though they seemed a bit overwhelmed by the customers coming in and didn't have their groove exactly down. The place is small and cute and has seating inside and outside. There's a bathroom in the back. Lots of parking and other places to eat in same plaza. I wouldn't mind going back. Its only $4 a scoop so not bad on pricing either. Also, great customer service cuz when I got my ice cream I saw what looked like a hair but wasn't exactly sure so I asked the girls and they weren't sure but offered to remake right away which I thought was really great service:)

I was so thrilled to try this place based on reviews, and I left rather underwhelmed. My group of friends got everything from cereal milkshakes to chicken wraps to sundaes...and it was all "meh. this has potential!" Skip the Lucky Charms milkshake. I couldn't taste any ice cream...just the mushy cereal. Maybe that's the goal, but at an ice cream shop, whether or not it's a cereal focused dish, ice cream should also shine. Also it was expensive! The food took a long time for what it was, and the sundaes were nothing special. We did not try the macaroon ice cream sandwiches so I can't comment on that. Really 'potential' is the word for this place because with some more tweaks it could be something extraordinary.

I can't help myself. Everytime I see this place whether it be at the store or at their food truck, I have to stop and get something. So many options, so little time. I have never been disappointed in the flavors or the service. I love having a spot that I can consistently get great shakes and great service. Best crew in Charlotte! Quick tip, always go for the edible rim if you have a shake. I promise you it's worth it.

The other day I went to Churn and it was sooo good. I guess it depends how you like your ice cream, but I prefer mine not to be as rich and creamy like most. A good way to describe it is it's like homemade ice cream. Now, I usually go for anything with chocolate, but they had so many interesting flavors that I had to try them. When I tried the Vietnamese Coffee, I knew I had to get it. It wasn't too bitter (like coffee) or too sweet. It was honestly perfect for me hehe. I'd definitely come back if it wasn't so far, but for now, I can only reminisce how delicious it was!!

This place took way to long to prep my order for my Postmates order. 15-20 waiting for prepping the order and when my Postmates delivery person arrived - it still was not ready. 3 Thai Teas - 1 with Boba - how long does that take to prepare?
Yummy ice cream with creative flavors. Kids loved the Cookie Monster flavor. A little hard to find but now I know. Will be a regular spot.

Usually there is a line in the evening, but it moves fast and it's worth it. Fresh and creative ice cream flavors leave you with the reminiscent sense of enjoyment of a cold creamy ice cream on a hot summer's evening while enjoying a flavor and taste that is new and unexpected. Prices are very reasonable for the quality, creativity and service received. There is no doubt why there is a line every night and I expect it will continue this way even after the fresh hype.

Got the cookies n' mint, I was told it is one of their most well known flavors - I can see why! I'm usually not a fan of mint ice cream but the cookies n' mint was definitely worth trying (and getting)!

Found this gem in the Venetian. Amazing amazing amazing!! We got a slice of the rainbow cake and it was the perfect balance of cake and icing. We also ordered two lobster tails. I wish we ate them right away. We waited a tad too long to eat them and they were a bit hard. Taste was there though... you know that it's the most popular item they have when there were only a few left on the tray. Hehe!

The best ice cream place I have ever been to! I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place till now, but trust me I have been coming here every chance I get. This is a small store but with some award winning flavors. Brandon is extremely nice and makes his customers feel super welcome. He takes his time to explain all the flavors while being patient as everyone gets to try the flavors. The ice cream itself is so creamy and on the thicker side, so it just feels and tastes so much better than any other "slow-churned" ice cream at the store. They have rotational flavors as well, but their award winning vanilla and butter pecan are some of the best of those flavors I have ever had, ever. Everything about these flavors taste authentic and real, and there is no other way to describe the flavors other than to try them yourselves. I will keep coming here whenever I am in the area and this place is there. I have yet to find a place that is as welcoming and amazing as this place, and I really think this shop brought back the ice cream loving child in me.

Some of the best ice cream I've ever had. Super creamy and flavourful home-made taste without being icy or leaving a weird film in my mouth. The prices are a lot lower than I expected, too! After trying a sample of the "Vietnamese coffee" ice cream (which was delicious but not what I was craving), I got a scoop of double chocolate on a sugar cone with a few pieces of the home-made caramel they had sitting on the counter. They have a huge list of toppings, candies (normal and home-made treats), coffee and coffee drinks, and baked goods available too. Also, local art if you're into that. I'll definitely be back for more.

Presti's Bakery is one of those places where you can go and get authentic ethnic food at reasonable prices. Italian food is available everywhere, you can find pizza in any food court all over the country but by authentic, I mean how the Italians eat in Italy. I should clarify that I have never been to Italy but I can tell when I see the real ingredients rather than canned and processed ingredients on the food. The other very good thing about this place is a location. It is in a very nice place on the corner, so it has more than one wall with glass windows, means more light. Very basic seating arrangement makes it elegant. In the summertime there are chairs and tables outside where you can seat and enjoy your meal. I ordered Pizza margarita, which is my favorite specialty pizza. I loved it. I am going to be a regular at this place.

I had heard about this place sporadically, but what finally prompted me to seek this place out was a combination of a friend's recommendation, as well as another friend from Indiana who wanted to get good ice cream in the Cleveland area. I was very impressed with what Mason's Creamery had to offer. Egg waffles, which are very difficult to find in the states, were sold here as a an accompaniment to the ice cream selection. The ice cream selection itself was very unique, as they made their own ice cream flavors and the selection changes on an almost daily basis. The Facebook page mentioned that Mason's was serving Ovaltine ice cream, something I really wanted to try as Ovaltine is a staple breakfast drink for me. While they didn't have Ovaltine available that day, I was able to sample hot chocolate flavored ice cream instead, something I had NEVER had before. It was very very good, and had all the flavors one might expect from a hot chocolate, only frozen. The salted caramel, a more common ice cream flavor, tasted a lot better than what I'm used to from other places, so I ended up getting an egg waffle with salted caramel ice cream, hot chocolate ice cream, and Nutella whipped cream. Talk about pushing the boundaries of ingredients and experimenting with brand new flavors. I'm often skeptical about new fusion styles, but Mason's nails it with the execution. The Nutella whipped cream has all the texture of whipped cream but all the rich flavors of Nutella. The egg waffle, rather than being stored and used like other waffle cones, is made fresh on order and tastes really soft and chewy. The salted caramel and hot chocolate flavors blended very well with the whipped cream, and the egg waffle absorbed all the flavors very well. Everything fit together super nicely, rather than being a mish mash of different flavors that were fighting each other for dominance. It's rare for me to have ice cream this good, and it definitely ranks among the best I've ever had. This place is HIGHLY recommended to anyone looking for a one of a kind ice cream experience.

Even though Milk Bar has locations in New York, the Vegas location at Cosmo was my first time. I will definitely be visiting the New York City stores. I only ordered the soft serve cereal milk frozen yogurt with chocolate chips. It is reasonably priced at about $7.00 with one topping. I thought the flavor was wonderful - almost a vanilla malt flavor. The combination with the chocolate chips was perfect. As I walked around the Cosmopolitan, guests asked me where I got it. I gladly pointed upstairs and told them to be ready to love every item they were about to lay their eyes on! It all looked delicious and my next time in, I will try some of the other appetizing dessert items. So here is what you do the next time you are having a late breakfast at The Cosmopolitan. Go to Eggslut (see my review) and wait on line for about 30 minutes until you are completely starving. Get and consume your wonderful breakfast there. Then mosey on over to Milk Bar (20 feet away) and order the cereal milk flavor frozen yogurt with a few toppings. You might want to get some of their crazy pastries to enjoy later. Wait about 2-3 hours then for lunch mosey on over to In-N-Out Burger at the Linq (oh wait - that will be a future review). Anytime you have the words bar, Eggslut, In-N-Out, chocolate and crazy in a review, it must be talking about Vegas!

Praise the Milk Bar Gods!!! After watching Chefs table and realizing I had seen Milk Bar in my favorite hotel/casino in Vegas.. I KNEW I had to return soon to try this "crack pie" and "cereal milk" soft serve I have seen and heard of. Well.. let me tell you the story of my Milk Bar experience! Ordered 1 crack pie. Told my friend we're going to just have one bite then eat the rest later. 3 minutes later the entire crack pie is gone.. and we're raving to eachother about the amazing buttery gooey scrumptious flavor. Every bite gets better!!! What is this witch craft?! (Butter..duh) I returned to Milk Bar.. and bought 2 more crack pies. And got a sample of the cereal milk soft serve. Have mercy.. for that cereal milk soft serve, when it hit my taste buds, a light from above shined down upon my face and a choir of angels sang. Okay maybe not.. but it felt like it should!!!! It's amazing!! I'm here for 3 days and I'm absolutely coming back.
Great service, very fast and efficient. Their menu is the best and the cashier is super helpful when you're trying to decide! Definitely recommend

I went last Saturday and got the chicken salad. I am pretty picky about chicken salad and would give theirs a three. It had great flavoring but the chicken chunks were really big. I also got their cream cheese and strawberry croissant which was good. I was a little disappointed because I had such high hopes from all the reviews and it didn't blow me away. I will definitely go back to try some of the other desserts and see what everyone is raving about.

I wanted to try out the cereal milk soft serve because of all the hype. I sampled the crack pie soft serve (too sweet!) and the cereal milk soft serve and preferred the cereal milk. I got the smallest size but after eating about half, the novelty of the cereal milk flavor wore off. I think this location also lends itself to an uncomfortable treat-eating experience (e.g., feels weird to eat soft serve when there is club music blaring and club people drinking around you).

Left without trying and i love sloans when i am in florida. All the flavors i was interested in showed freezer burn. I throw out the ice cream from my freezer when it has freezer burn. No way i pay premium for that.

Best baguette in town. Oh how I love thee let me count the ways; 24hrs, frozen take-home bread, the twice baked croissants, plenty of room(s), wi-fi, coffee, sandwiches, coolness obtained by being there, etc. 5*s for it being in Charlotte. 3.5*s overall because the butter croissants are a little weak and the prices a little high, but it's worth it for that baguette... emoteuntildeath.blogspot¦

Gone to this ice cream place twice already and guess when...TUESDAY. Why? $2 buck TUESDAY! Handel's gives enough ice cream for you to enjoy. I like how there's just a window for you to order and not the typical ice cream businesses. It reminds of the old days. We usually order Pistachio or Butter Pecan. Recently we tried their seasonal ice cream called Pumpkin Pecan. The best choice! It was delicious!

I am usually not a fan of ice cream, especially the creamy rich kind, but Mitchell's is amazing. Been to three of their locations - Ohio City, Beachwood (in the mall), and University Circle. All three are excellent. The pricing is great - about $3.65 for 2 big scoops. 2 scoops is enough to make me full enough to not want to eat for awhile, lol. My favorite flavor is the honey lavender - not too sweet and has the nice lavender fragrance. Second favorite is the salted caramel - but this one I can't eat too much of just because it's way richer than the honey lavender. Anyways, I have sampled many of the other flavors there, and whatever you choose, you can't go wrong.
The choices were wonderful and the line moved very quickly. The ice cream tastes so yummy

This was an awesome experience, a little more than I'd like to spend on milkshakes but definitely a cool experience and I highly recommend doing it at least once, the staff was great the facilities were clean. I will say seating is limited so it can get crowded.

Came here on a Sunday around 6pm and there was a long line! We waited approximately 30 mins to get in due to their Covid policy of only letting in 2 customers at a time. However it was well worth the wait! The service was great, very friendly and the selection is large. We got the red velvet cake slice which was moist and delicious, the lemon bar which was perfectly tart and sweet, and the s'mores bar which was a bit on the dry side but still good! Highly recommend

Most unreal peanut butter ice cream. Had it in a sugar cone. No extras. Just all peanut butter creaminess. It wasn't too sweet either; I'm pretty sure it was made with really high quality natural peanut butter. Jonesing for my next visit. Other types of ice cream is good too, but man, I'm here for the PB.
Great place for a cold treat!!! So many flavors and they are all delicious!! My favorite go-to is the mint chocolate shake!!
Came for the internet and ended up with the caramelized onion and asparagus crustless quiche. this was very good and savory. Not pictured is the coconur matcha latte which is a hit!!

Churns is my new secret crush...... as my hubby and I notice a little store with a line outside of it. I was so intrigued I ran across two street lanes to find my place on the line. I'm excited I'm next online....my head was like an oscillating fan. Churns is a cute hole in the wall ice cream parlor. They don't have a huge selection but what they have is amazing goodness. If you look around they also have old school candy that I remember as a kid. I ordered the butter pecan and WTF...... HAVE I GONE TO ICE CREAM HEAVEN...... The butter pecan was buttery goodness. I ordered it on my favorite childhood cone.....the waffle cone. This place brings back memories.... great memories of just closing your eyes and taking your first bite of your icecream cone and someone slaps your hand..... LoL..... that did happen but not Today! I really like this place..... trust me. You'll find yourself falling for Churns too!

They have several locations The downtown was the cutest but shut down during covid. No longer have indoor seating but some locations w outdoor seating. All of their dessert pastries are delicious especially tarts, and macaroons but pricey Coffee solid.

Ice cream was amazing especially on this hot summer day. On my first time here I decided to go with the most popular and recommended graham central station I believe it's called and boy I was in for a treat. The flavors just made you want to keep eating. I will definitely be coming back to try everything! If you're ever on the west side and craving ice cream this is the spot. My number 1 hands down choice.....Enjoy!

My boyfriend and I came here every morning during our 4 day vacation in Vegas. However, the first morning we mistakingly went into the Bouchon restaurant. When we got there i told the hoestess that I had thought that Bouchon was just a bakery not a full fledged restaurant and she replied oh no we are a full restaurant.... Yeah not sure why she didnt tell me that the bakery was just downstairs.... Anyways i had tried the chocolate almond croissant and the pecan cinnamon roll when we had breakfast at the restaurant which was really good but pretty expensive.... typical Vegas... The pecan roll was just okay but the chocolate almond croissant, i fell in love with. I proceeded to get one every day we were there after that.... yeah its that good. I really wanted to try a macaron, but i like the very clever, atypical flavors. They only offer the very standard vanilla and chocolate kind of flavors, so i opted to pass.

I had high hopes for this place but it's kind of overrated. I got the Milk & Cereal soft serve thinking that it'd taste like a vanilla soft serve. I wasn't a fan of it... I added rainbow crunch to it and it helped a little but the flavor was too strong. My boyfriend's niece got the crack pie soft serve and that was much better. I highly recommend getting that flavor if you're trying for the first time. But honestly, it's like a one and done situation for me - I don't think I'd go back.

The word "vegan" isn't normally my cup of tea, but these fresh and colorful donuts did not disappoint. I waited ten minutes in a very quick line and chose from maybe 8 colorful donut options. I really enjoyed the strawberry cream filled one and the strawberry shortcake was also a hit. Will be back.

I'm not much of a cupcake person. I initially came here for the ice cream but I was lured in by the nice presentation of their cupcakes! I had the banana cupcake with vanilla frosting and it was pretty good! Had a deal on my receipt for a buy one get one free offer for cupcakes, cookies or ice cream that I used before I flew back to seattle. The seasonal flavor, apple pie ice cream was beyond outstanding! Will come back no doubt!
Great ice cream shop over in Southend! I love that they change out the flavors and have very unique flavors like lavender. Highly recommend checking out if you enjoy interesting flavors!

I had an Uber Eats delivery of Mary Coyle, so this review is solely in regards to their ice cream. I ordered the strawberry banana bowl, and it was the best ice cream I have ever had. The bottom of the bowl was layered with fresh fruit, then ice cream, then more fruit, with whipped cream and a cherry on top. I ordered the pippin size, which is smaller and it was pretty big. I am seriously worried that I am going to order from them every day and gain a million pounds. I thought hard about if I should post this review and make all my neighbors fat from eating ice cream. But I figured if everyone else was eating there and gained weight, people wouldn't notice as much if I got fat, too. Let's get fat together and eat more ice cream!

Not sure what I can say about this place that hasn't already been said. This is the best bakery in Charlotte, period, hands down, no question. The selection is ever rotating, fresh, and never cloyingly sweet the way most bakeries here in the south are. I love that I can come in with my laptop (sometimes for hours), grab some tasty pastries, and a dirty chai and just get work done no questions asked. The service is always friendly and they are accommodating to my crazily specific requests for my lattes. A bit pricey at times, but you get what you pay for and personally I have no problem paying a bit more for artisanal pastries/drinks and the ambiance. I haven't been to the Uptown location, but I will drive out of the way to go to the NoDa location over the Carmel Rd. location, it just has a different feel and slightly different clientele.

The polite, helpful and happy staff offered great advice on which were the most popular and their own favorites. All the ingredients are organic. The store was not busy. So for that I gave them 2 stars. My wife had the salted butter Carmel swirl which had little to no flavor and no Carmel or Carmel taste. I had the chocolate walnut oatmeal which I could taste but the ice cream itself had very little flavor. However, I did get to pay over $8 for two of the tiniest round ball scoops of ice cream. So I gave two stars for a great staff and zero stars for ice cream that had less flavor than the cheapest ice cream I ever had.

My sister and I decided to make a impromptu ride to Amelie. Which was the best decision ever. The environment was wonderful and calming. I had the salted caramel mocha which was delightful. Will definetly return.

I only come here for the Chocolate Marshmallow and Red Velvet cupcakes. Please and thank you! It's situated in the Linq Plaza next to In-N-Out Burger. The novelty for me is the Cupcake ATM on the outside of the store. I love this machine, it makes for quick sugar rush satisfaction. However, the lady in front of me was apparently deciding on her last cupcake meal on earth before going back into the state penitentiary, standing there and pondering indecisively for a solid 8 minutes. Oh my gawd, just pick one already! Not wanting to be rude, I kept quiet and braved the long line inside instead. As others have stated, there is an ice cream station on the right side and the cupcakes on the left. The store front meets right in the middle. It makes for a bit of an awkward traffic flow but that's a non-issue for me. My eyes lit up as I saw a row of my coveted cupcakes and asked for four of them. The little boy behind me did the same. I'm glad I went first. I would hate to have to battle a six year old for some damn Chocolate Marshmallow cupcakes. All that was missing was a tall, ice cold glass of milk to go with. They also give you these nifty wooden spoons if you don't want to dive in and get a face full of frosting, which I shamelessly did. Are they pricey? Yes. Are they worth it? For me, I think so. But I rarely indulge in Sprinkles cupcakes so I made my trip worthwhile. Delish.

It was ok. The crime brÃ»lÃ©e was the best one out of the donuts I got. The poptart was a bit much and needed to be heated up to really taste good. Overall nice selection, but was hyped up a little too much.

I read about the Sprinkles ATM months ago and somehow missed it on our trip in October. When we came back for Christmas, this was at the top of my 'must visit' list. The ATM is to the right of the shop doors and oddly the few times we passed it, there was never anyone using it. The shop was packed inside and so I was quite pleased. The machine itself is very easy to use and you can see what supply levels are like. I used it at night and loved how the area that your cupcake arrives in is all lit up. I tried the chocolate marshmallow and it was divine. The chocolate taste was super rich and the little dollop of marshmallow in the middle was perfect. I think it came to $4.25 and so it sounds like you might pay a bit more to use the machine? There are plenty of tables outside though and so you can grab a treat and enjoy it immediately. I would definitely recommend visiting!

I tried the Compost Cookie and slice of Birthday Cake. Both were wayyy to sweet and cloying. I could not eat more than 2 bites of each. I was so disappointed as I was looking forward to Christina Tosi's creations. I honestly don't get what the hype is about. You can get better baked goods at any other bakery. :(
Cute little ice cream shop in Scottsdale. The toffee banaffee sundae did not disappoint. Delicious ice cream and a fun atmosphere.

They now sell slices of cake. CAKE!! Fall fast for the fall season Pumpkin Dulce de Leche or indulge in a classic birthday cake. Tried some cookies this time around. Nothing corny about a classic sweet Corn, the Blueberry & Cream is like a solid cheesecake without the cheese, and the Compost is all sorts of sugar, salt, savor, and crunch. We got half a Milkbar pie to go as well. It's the same thing as the crack pie with a family-friendly name because "family-friendly" is the first thing that comes to mind when I think about Vegas... They make it in ice cream too, and it's the best kind of sugar rush. I'll never get tired of the desserts at Milk Bar - they're quickly becoming a classic, and no matter how long they've been around, they'll never get old.

this was a major surprise on my food adventure back in my hometown. and it was amazing this service AWESOME!!!! The coffee was INCREDIBLE!!!!! and the donuts man the donuts ....... left me speechless the blueberry cheesecake donut please never take it off your menu I beg you. the maple bacon awwwww man who knew maple icing and bacon could taste so good. THANK YOU STAFF AT Jack Frost THANK YOU I WILL BE BACK EVERY CHEAT MEAL.

Ice cream here is good but owners are NOT customer focussed. I have never been to an ice cream place that charges you ADDITIONAL charges to change the ice cream flavor on a sundae, until today. Very nickel and dime. I usually would not object to something like this, but they already charge very high premium prices, and it felt like buying a car with the upsell prices. When you buy one scoop of ice cream are the prices different for every scoop? If I want a scoop of Belgium Chocolate, the price should be less since the other flavors cost more to substitute, from the smores sundae, right??? First time I had ice cream and left with a bad taste in my mouth (actually in the end I left without ordering what I intended and went to Cold Stone). While the ice cream is good I'm not sure it is worth the attitude.

I have a love for cakes, cookies, pastries and most of all, donuts. Especially on vacation. Because when you are on vacation, everyone knows that all the rules of physics go out the door and any calories you consume are offset by all the walking you do. #truth My first order of business in Las Vegas was to find some delicious donuts other than the Krispy Kreme and Dunkin Donuts variety. Located in downtown Vegas, I found Donut Bar! At the time, I didn't know Donut Bar (original shop in San Diego) was listed as the Number 1 Donut Shop on lists from USA Today, Thrillist.com, MSN and more. But as soon as I walked in, I knew I had found a gem. The donuts they offer are huge, over the top, and look downright amazing! Their most popular is their Big Poppa Tart Donut which is made with a full pop tart and weighs one entire pound! I wanted to try everything, but I decided on three: crÃ¨me brulee, blueberry with meyer lemon, and maple bacon. The crÃ¨me brulee is a yeast donut filled with crÃ¨me topped with a hard candy shell. For those with a sweet tooth, you will love biting into it. For those that like their donuts a little less sweet, the blueberry with meyer lemon is perfect. The cake donut is topped with a perfectly lemony frosting. My favorite was the maple bacon bar. The yeast donut is so soft and topped generously with thick and chewy bacon pieces that paired with the sweet maple frosting like a dream. Mmmmmm.... It's a bit of a gamble as they close when they sell out, but if you visit Donut Bar after 10am, they serve donut ice cream cones!!! I will get one of those one day!

Lavender ice cream....that is ALL you will need. The Fleur de Sel was absolutely excellent. The other Fleur de Sel Ice creams I've had are more sweet caramel, without that salt kick that makes it actual Fleur de Sel. In theirs the salt came through, along with the caramel goodness. Tried the Lime Basil--it tastes like a frozen mojito....and that isn't a bad thing. I cannot wait to come back here and try more flavors!!!

Everything was frozen rock hard (since nothing is baked here in Las Vegas ugh) and the serving sizes are a joke for the price. I was so disappointed because I was so looking forward to them finally coming here! Only thing that was ok when thawed was the crack pie but even then the slice was big enough for a three year old child. SUPER tiny.
I just love this place! Love their macaroons & strawberry croissants! Great Service, always fresh pastries,staffs are very nice and gentle.Definitely recommend this place!

I was really excited to try this place. Coming from Henderson, and I would say it isn't worth the drive. The donut and cappuccino was mediocre. The interior is super cute and the staff was kind. At 10:30 more than half the counter was sold out. We thought there would be a lot more options. Not sure if I'll be back.

I went on a Saturday mid morning, and they were out of cinnamon rolls, twists, and apple fritters, which are the three things I wanted to try. Everything else was topped with too much frosting and looked like a crazy sugar bomb. I did eat a plain glazed, and it was probably the best I've ever had, but I still can't get over the disappointment of not getting what I came for. They should make enough to not run out. Especially if they know it's popular and a weekend. I shouldn't have to get there at 6 am to guarantee myself a donut.

Sprinkles is HANDS DOWN the best cupcake place ever. And I've tried A LOT of cupcake places throughout the US and abroad. The cake part is pretty consistently good (moist) and the cream cheese frosting is amazing every single time. They're usually good even a day later. This location's cupcakes wasn't as fresh as Newport Beach CA, but still good. I tried their ice cream for the first time. I got strawberry ice cream with red velvet waffle cone and the spouse got Captain Crunch with a waffle cone. Strawberry ice cream was good, but nothing to write home about. Captain Crunch was interesting and I wish I had gotten that instead of strawberry. I didn't like the cone at all, but I've always preferred cake and sugar cone (which they do not sell) over waffle cones. Their cookies suck. They were really hard and pricey (for cookies). What I like about this location is that they're open super late (1am) compared to CA and majority of the holidays.

Definitely not the easiest place to find but it's well worth it when you do for some of the best pastries you'll find on the Strip. I don't come here often just because I try to avoid Las Vegas Blvd at all costs, but when I know a friend is in the area and in the mood for something sweet, their macarons are to die for. They're huge (and by huge I literally mean like the size of my palm) for just $3.50 each. Easily my favorite place to buy macarons, even if it means having to deal with the hustle and bustle of the Strip.

First time here. They told me the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut was vegan so how could I say no? The caramelized sugar on top was ridiculously good. I also got an almond milk latte. It was pretty good too. Very yummy and I like that they have several tasty vegan options. Def check them out.

This place is a gem, first of all. We needed something to save our disappointing lunch. My wife is a celiac, but she is willing to get sick over good desserts. She's a maniac. The menu is decadent and plenty for everyone, and when I say everyone, I mean celiacs. Taking a look at the menu we found that there were actual Gluten Free options. With cereals and cakes and cookies everywhere, they actually thought of the Celiacs. That alone is 5 star worthy. I was looking forward to have an apple fritter sandwich and was disappointed to hear it was a temporary item. Trust me, if they make that permanent item, I will be a permanent weekly customer. I settled for the warm donut with apple pie ice cream, topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal. It was awesome. My wife picked the macaroon ice cream sandwich with cotton candy ice cream, topped with gummy bears. She loved it. Only problem??? It's too far from our house!!! We will definitely be back when in the area.

I love any ice cream shop that has soy ice cream and other vegan options available. This place has hip furniture, friendly service and really low prices ($3 for a LARGE scoop). When I went, they had two soy flavors (mint chocolate and "blue something" which has the taste of fruit loops) and four or five sorbet/Italian ice options. They have two vegan ice cream cones and also a vegan waffle cone, which was a great and pleasant surprise. This place is highly recommend for its variety of vegan options, dirt cheap prices, and great central location on State Street.

I've been to Jeni's more times than I can count, and it is my absolute favorite ice cream spot in the city. It's not just the ice cream that makes it so incredible, although it is perfectly creamy and just sweet enough. It's the butterscotch waffle cones that make this place so amazing. While it would be a travesty to come here and not order ice cream, I've joked on numerous occasions that I would be happy with just the waffle cone. Yeah, it's that good. The combination of the cone with the ice cream is simply out of this world. It's worth it to wait in the line outside, especially since I've always found that the line moves very quickly. As for flavors, my favorite is the Salted Peanut Butter with Dark Chocolate Flecks. I always sample other flavors and somehow still return to this one. The peanut butter flavor is strong without dominating the dark chocolate, which is slightly bitter and pairs nicely with the overall sweetness of the dessert. However, I do also enjoy the Dark Chocolate Truffle and the new Texas Sheet Cake. No matter what flavor you choose, just be sure to get it in a waffle cone!
We got the vanilla latte, strong and full of flavor, the monkey bread, soft and sweet, and the banana walnut muffin, flavorful. Overall, nice little bakery with great selection of pastries.

I've been to every Sprinkles in the LA area and finally got to check out the one out in Las Vegas in the new Linq area. It's in the fancy new Linq area so naturally it's nice. Has one section for the cupcakes, one section for ice cream and then the ATM on the outside. I went in and got pumpkin and my wife got strawberry. Solid as always. The service was great, the selection ample and really a nice ambience to sit and enjoy the best cupcakes there are.
Maybe I caught this place on the wrong day, but we didn't get anything great here. Good donuts, but nothing I would go out of the way for. Very friendly service, so that was a plus.

Had my wedding cake done here and it was amazing! It came out exactly how I wanted it too and tasted great! We had white cake, fresh strawberries, and chocolate mouse inside the cake! I highly recommend buying your wedding cake from here! Amazing job! I even got lucky and got to watch it be made!

Wonderful Baked Goods, Deli and Gelato Presti's Bakery is a fixture of Cleveland's Little Italy for a reason. More that just a simple bakery, it offers a wider selection of foods than might be expected. Pros: Great selection of goods, pleasant bustling bakery atmosphere and delicious food. Cons: Can be a little loud and hectic, can be hard to get a seat/table. Tip: If it's busy when you first arrive (which it often is) you might want to take a number first then gaze into the delight filled glass cases. It's very tempting to do it the opposite way and end up at the back of the line.

I'm an ice cream lover and after hearing all my friends rave about how hip and great the ice cream is I decided to give it a try today. The ice cream itself was no different than any other store bought ice cream. The flavors were bland, and the ice cream I got was super melty. Other than their attraction having ice cream in a to go box with a fortune cookie. This place has a nice urban feel but the ice cream was like any other average place. Customer service on the other hand was nice because they were patient with customers trying different flavors and were very courteous.

We had to go while in Vegas just to say we've been there. The line took at least 30 minutes to get through but we got some cookies, an eclair, and a Boston cream parfait thing. The cookies were delicious, the other stuff, average. Glad we went tough!
Very disappointing. We ordered 6 cupcakes , the icing is horrible . Took them home to my kids because they are huge fans of the cake boss and we were very disappointed.

One of my mothers spots that my 2kids had treated me@! Quite nice and they did enforce the social distancing here. If u don't mind standing in short & fast served line, then come on down the Handle's!! I had a pint of salted caramel truffle packed for me to enjoy @ home. I believe that my first born had the blue monster and my nephew had the black cherry & raspberry scooped ice cream and I think my son (my 2nd born) had the banana cream pie shake. The texture of the ice cream was oh so smooth and of course delicious! So if u want to be served and handled sweetly, then come on down to Handle's everyone!! We'll sure to be back here! Thank u smooches for making me n my fam one of your satisfied customer!

Honestly they're just "okay". The last couple times I've gotten them at the Cleveland zoo they've had the taste of old oil. I prefer the yeast donut to the fry cake donut which I find rather dry. I appreciate they are different and "topped" instead of filled, but I like the creaminess of a filled donut filling. Their "topped" donuts need to hold their shape so it has the consistency of a buttercream frosting instead of a cream which I find disappointing. They are never short on flavor options though so if you're looking for a variety they have it.
Don't leave without trying the Bucaletti fig cookies. It is a shortbread filled with fig, chocolate, and nuts. Everything is good here.
Just great asian ice cream every time, taste is outstanding and the fish waffles are always fresh

Fun and affordable dessert shop! We enjoyed our visit. Definitely a cute place to bring the family. We ordered upside down ah-boong with Thai tea soft serve. It was delicious! Definitely going to recommend this place to my friends.

First time going to Jack Frost. The counter lady was very nice and helpful. This was early in the morning and she was still adding fresh warm donuts to the display case as I was trying to decide which ones I wanted to try. No stuffed cream/jelly/custard here everything is on the top of the donut l

Pretty busy for a Wednesday night. Kids wanted ice cream so we yelped closest place. Good ice cream- only 3 stars bc oredering was a weird process& the work area didn't look too clean. But friendly staff - will go back

With all the bakeries/pastry shops in Las Vegas with their extravagant display (ie: Jean Philippe Patisserie), you'd think a small behind the escalator counter would be floundering...but not Bouchon. Obviously this little boulangerie isn't just a mom and pop shop...it's owned by the famous Thomas Keller! Need I speak more? But who cares about the background....on to the goods! The selection is pretty small, but decent for the shop's size. There are macarons (of course), cupcakes, tarts..etc. I had a couple macarons (raspberry and chocolate), both of which are aahhhhhmazing--couldn't ask for anything else. Really, macarons just make you feel like you should be living like royalty Ã la Marie Antoinette without the head-getting-chopped-off part. GASP. Wished they had friendlier service--though maybe my server was just having a bad day (you never know). Also wished they had a one or two tables/chairs to sit on. Other than that... Yumz.

This actually a review for the new Rock Hill location: So good it will shut me up for a few minutes. Take my money (great prices!) Get in my mouth (delicious!) Open all the time. I miss their live streaming webcam online but I think one can find it with google chrome. They do have a day in the life of their baker on fast track which is amazing to watch. They are growing for a reason. Thanks for satisfying all of my cravings, salt and sweet at the same time. A cure for PMS, gents! Take your ladies here, or better yet, bring some home.

Staff was nice when I was there! It just kinda hard to find the location! I recommend the original cannoli, lobster tail and red velvet cake. The original Cannoli taste so much better in my opinion rather than the chocolate dipped one, cause the choco one for me was way too sweet for my liking. The lobster tails is my favorite but sometimes when you keep in the fridge too long of course the pastry kinda dry and so hard to bite. My suggestion is eat it right away for lobster tail since if you keep it too long it was way too hard to eat the pasty. The one that way over price is the cheesecake. The cheese cake is okay not that good and it almost $11 for small tiny cheesecake... yeah it's on the pricier side for all pasties and cakes.

I was happily surprised this place lived up to its hype!! Food 5/5 These donuts are FIRE. The dough is loose and fluffy, almost like brioche!! The flavors are unique and tasteful, but none were too sweet at all! They also are cleanly decorated, not overflowing with icing or messy at all. I'm shook that these are vegan I would never have guessed by their taste and texture. Highly recommend strawberry shortcake and cookie butter! Service 4/5 Line took about 40min after getting there at opening time (9am on a Sunday)! But the employees were super nice, and they have social distancing policy of only allowing one party into the store at a time and masks required! The place was pristine and very clean. Will definitely be back. Best donuts in cleveland yet!

*demoted to 4 stars. Consistency and quality control is lacking. The technique is not as good as madison sourdough down the street, but batch has more offerings. Wish they were more creative/adventurous in putting out new products. Staple items like quiche and morning bun are very good.

Veeeery busy!!!! We stood in line for over an hour to try this place and it was well worth it. The prices of everything are very reasonable, especially the cannolis. They have a wonderful selection of cakes and mini cakes, cupcakes and everything else in between. REAL CUSTOMER SERVICE; Soooo my child was getting very frustrated and angry from waiting so long and by the time we got to the front she was screaming profusely!!!! She was acting crazy and being soooo loud. THEN one of the bakers working in the back actually came out and gave her a free cookie!!!! I wish I knew her name but she was African American with glasses and I really want to THANK HER and say how much I appreciated that gesture of kindness!!!!!! I hope she gets a raise because I know she deserves it just by being a sweet person!

I love Sprinkles, no matter which shop I visit. I always have to stop in whenever I am near one! The Las Vegas one near the Linq promenade has the cupcake shop and ice cream shop, with the famous cupcake ATM on the outside. My favorite thing to get is the Sprinkles sundae with a cupcake and ice cream in the middle. They have an assortment of both to choose from so it is up to you on what to pair. They do have seasonal flavors so it depends on what time of year it is on which ones you will get to try. During October they had a caramel apple cupcake so I did a sundae, pairing it with the butter pecan ice cream. And of course I grabbed a smores cupcakle from the ATM on the way out! Both cupcakes were amazing and the ice cream was really good too. Definitely stop here when in the area. It is worth trying at least once.

Jack Frost is the mother of all donut shops in the known universe! These incredible round concoctions of tasty ecstatic delight are what gastronomical dreams are made of! They harken back to a time when ingredients and food were pure and fresh, and not laden with harmful chemicals, additives, preservatives, high fructose corn syrup, and GMO's! Hell, even the donut HOLE tastes great! Pre-diabetics and fitness freaks need not apply.

Stopped here after a friend mentioned that it was really good and was surprised after I mentioned I had not been there before. The place has so many different options of custard and sundaes, great sizes, and reasonable prices. I got the Peanut Butter Cup junior Snowstorm custard cup and it was amazing! Very delicious and filling. A 3 oz junior size cup is all you need, guaranteed. My friend let me try her Lemon Chiffon Pie and it was decent and tasted like lemon cookies. The custard seemed to melt relatively fast though. I only have been here once, but I definitely would recommend it.

After trying what is supposedly the best of the best macaroons, I've finally realized that I don't like them very much at all. I always thought that it was because I had not found one that was good. Everyone talks about Bouchon like it's the all mighty creator of macaroons. So I tried it, but for me, it was all hype. I tried every flavor they had available. Maybe it's the texture that I don't like. I expected something that was more crunchy or crispy. It just felt like chewed gum in my mouth. I am not saying that macaroons are bad in general, I'm just saying that they are not for me. My favorite was the chocolate one however. It tasted like a brownie. I wished I tried the other desserts. The red velvet cupcake was huge (twice the size of a regular cupcake) and it cost almost as much as one macaroon.

I was extremely excited to visit this spot since the concept is cool & the flavors seem tasty - however, the most anti-climatic experience of all time. I arrived around 7:50 to a long wait but decided to stick it out because the long line must mean it has to be good, right? But after waiting in line for over an hour and being third in line, around 9:10 - it was announced that they were all out of ice cream and would only be serving bowls. This experience was extremely off-putting because how do you run out of an ingredient that is the premise of your business? I likely won't return until they have settled in and are more prepared.
Expensive almond/chocolate croissant and no good at all, it is so dry and maybe it is old like couple days. No come here.
