It was crunchy, sweet and refreshingly tarty. My boyfriend was very happy with it since he's a big passionfruit fan. I was really impressed by the tiramisu, as the coffee, custard and dark cocoa powder played magic on my taste buds. I was never a tiramisu aficionado but now I finally get the hype. Those two were right, it was so tasty I couldn't stop eating it (danger to my waist line)! Overall, I'm happy we came visit and got some awesome pastries. If you get a chance, definitely pay a visit, grab some coffee and try their medium size tiramisu. You won't regret it!
Lots of gluten-free options and awesome crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e (also gluten-free).
I was so excited to try Milk. The cake was calling my name. The cake was moist but the texture confused me. I don't think I like my cake to be crunchy. Flavor tasted like a birthday cake.

Wonderful Italian bakery, old fashioned ticketing system when you walk in the door. Numerous options for both sweet and savory, grab lunch or a espresso + cookie for an afternoon treat. Always a spot when we visit Cleveland's Little Italy! Especially love there biscotti and seasonal cheesecakes.

Okay seriously the best ice cream ever! Worth the wait in line. You can't go wrong with the gooey butter cake & salty Carmel! Also the Bramble berry crisp, & brown butter almond brittle are amazing! Wow!

The Vegan Donut Company is a m a z i n g! I can't say enough great things about them. Customer service- Kyra and Kharisma are quite possibly the sweetest business owners I've ever met. They are friendly, proud of their work, and most of all seem to exude a grateful attitude in every way possible. I've visited their store front to just buy a few donuts but I've also made a custom order of over 100 for a work event and they are such a joy to work with. Taste- the old fashioned donut is better than almost any cake like donut I've had EVER. Cake donuts are my favorite, so this is a big deal for me. Amazing, just try one. Vegan donuts? I'm not a vegan but enjoy a lot of vegan foods. My boyfriend on the other hand is the furthest thing away from vegan that you could probably imagine. When I gave him his first Vegan Donut Co donut he said they were better than another very popular, trendy donut place in cleveland, and a week later he asked me if we could go back because he's craving some Vegan Donut Co. Kudos, ladies! The only reason I'm at 4 starts instead of 5 is *somtimes* the donuts can be really greasy. The last box of 4 I got had a grease stain on the whole bottom of the box after a few hours. This may just be on the outside of the donuts, because when you bite into them you don't get a mouth full of grease like the dough soaked it up. So, I'm not sure what's going on there or if it was just a off day for me, but the Vegan Donut Co is such a winner for vegans and non vegans alike.

We've seen people standing in line for several months at this place. We always wanted to go see what the fuss was all about...and after ordering the much anticipated a common Brownie Sundae and Blondie Sundae we quickly realized there was no difference between Handles and DQ. If you're willing to spend $13 on a couple of average sundaes, We recommend you run into Smiths and grab yourself some Haagen-Daza (real ice cream) and make your own. It just wasn't that good!!

Open only in warmer weather, these design-your-own custard creations are akin to Dairy Queen - but better! The wait in the long line at the stand is worth it. Choose your custard, pick candy or nuts to have blended in, and enjoy. If you're counting calories, hold out for the pumpkin pie custard, available in the fall only.

We're not allowed to go here anymore because it's too delicious. They only have a few custard flavors, but who cares when you can have a peppermint or mint chocolate chip snowstorm. Oh, shit. It's so fucking good.

Visiting Vegas and wanted to try some French pastry. Found this on Yelp. I'm less than impressed. I ordered an epi bread mini baguette, 6 macaroons in 6 flavors and a TKO cookie. The Epi bread was hard as a rock. I threw it away after 1 bite. Plus, fresh bread tastes best hot, not room temp. Next I tried the TKO. Supposedly white ganache inside a chocolate cookie crust. I love ganache so I couldn't wait to try it. Meh. It tasted like an oreo but 10 times more expensive. At least I ate that. Then I had 2 macaroons. Very gelatinous in texture. Not like a typical macaroon, which I knew from looking at it, but just not very good at all. I'll give them to my friend so at least they won't go to waste but I'm not eating anymore. Not worth it at all.

This Sloan's Ice Cream is located inside The Venetian, in their grand canal shops. While walking around The Venetian, I decided that I wanted to grab some ice cream and so I came inside. Although there was a line, I waited a reasonable amount of time to have someone take my order. I ended getting: Two Scoop Ice Cream With Waffle Cone, $8.64 after tax- I got the Almond Joy Ice Cream & Banana Ice Cream to split with my husband (and our little girl dog). The almond joy had a nice chocolate flavor with chopped pieces of almond in it. I also really liked the banana ice cream, as it had a a great banana flavor that wasn't too sweet. Service at the counter was friendly and I was able to try samples of ice cream if I wanted. Overall, a pretty good experience.
andrew is such a king fr. this man scooped my ice cream with love. he needs a raise. love u andrew

Dairy free flavors are really good BUT personally don't think they compare to the normal flavors. I got diary free cold brew with coconut AND a gooey cake batter on a waffle cone. Love that they use metal spoons and compostable containers!

This is the way a bakery should be. Family owned and family feel. You are treated with smells of good old fashioned home made treats. With beautiful decor from renaissance to Victorian, this is a unique environment. With free Wi-Fi and great hours (All day and night), this is a treat and truly a model for bakeries everywhere. Trying new items, you can expect a new surprise each time. From sandwiches to multi-cultural desserts, you will not be disappointed when you go to this establishment. Be prepared. It is fun and delicious.

I guess it fits the midwest ok..but kinda so/so. Seems really pricey for such small servings, and I dont think I would wait in a long line again for this. Nothing out of the ordinary, not sure what the ruckus is about. Try COCOMERA...seek it out, for a real experience.

I've been going here since the soft opening and all I can say it's ok. The bakery is a hit or miss depending on the day you visit. It is limited with the breads they have and every time I come here and most things run out very fast. I'm a big fan of fruit tarts and the berry one they have here is ok. The last time I came here, I was impressed with the Fresh Strawberry Milk Tea because whenever I see this at other places I am hesitant to try it. I'm afraid it might taste like Nesquik! LOL. Surprisingly, this drink hit the taste buds on the right spot. It included strawberry bits which is a bonus. The rest of their milk teas honestly just taste like half and half milk, which I am not a fan of. Also, a drink I usually get and love is their iced sea salt coffee! I would recommend this for any coffee lovers, it's not too strong-- it's just the perfect everyday iced coffee with a kick of sea salt creme. If it's a hot day, I recommend to try the iced grapefruit green tea! This place deserves a 3 star.
Bakery is the best but the service and set up is horrible. This by far the worst 85 C Bakery Cafe. A Hispanic lady cashier said to me if I don't like I can go somewhere else. 01-25-2019.
My brother took us here & I gotta say..... one of the best boba places here in AZ. There's one closer to where we're staying for our summer vacay, but we drove out a little just for this place!

Horrible, super unimpressed. We were so excited to taste their product and spent a lot of money bc we wanted to try a little bit of everything that we see them make on the show. So so disappointed. We really expected to be wowed. The stuff was dry, no flavor, a lot of items taste the same. It was nothing special, I was so bummed out.

First the fun stuff, this place is all about the theater, with the cupcakes or the ice cream. The product itself? It seemed good, certainly not bad. It's all very rich. And the portions are huge. I had an ice cream sandwich the size of a softball. The kids each had their own sundae, that they couldn't come close to finishing. My advice, plan on sharing.

We found this little hidden Ice Cream gem in yelp and all I can say is Oh my gosh, it was delicious. It is a "must try" place and the best thing is that they have glazed doughnuts stuffed with ice cream of your choice. It can't get any better than that! We tried the honey lavender ice cream and I think it is my new favorite. All of their ice cream are locally made and they have a very good variety of flavors as well as toppings. And if you get thirsty you can also grab a drink from their soft drink selection. This is a family friendly place, good for kids (I love finding places where my 1 year old is welcomed) and it is the the cutest little neighborhood down grand ave. They have only been open for a few weeks and i really hope it continues open for many years to come. It's a family run business and you can really tell they take pride in what they do! I definitely recommend this place to everyone!

After a wonderful dinner with my boyfriend and his cousin, we searched yelp for a fantastic dessert place! Although it was a bit cold, especially for dessert --- we thought what the heck-- let's do this especially since they had such high ratings on yelp. We ordered and shared: * Crack pie - Small which was an excellent size. However, not too special or amazing. * Milk icecream - Have you drank the leftover milk from your cereal? (This is less sweet) - Have you tried condensed milk icecream ) (This is less sweet) - Texture was creamy. * Birthday cake balls - Why are they only available in sets of three and why are they pre-packaged in plastic ???? It's horrible for the environment and makes them seem much less fresh. - They are delicious but taste just like cake pops without the chocolate on the outside. Maybe my expectations were too high.... Overall, I probably wouldn't return. Meh maybe to try their cookies lol.

Let me set the scene: I'm crushing the ungodly hot hell that is the LV strip with my ride or die collar poppin playas when all of a sudden this oasis comes out of nowhere. What?!? Cupcake ATM. ATM being an acronym for AnotherTimeMoFo, we Gon get ourselves some ice creams. We walk in, greeted with a smile and hope for the world through this weirdly shaped ordering line. Don't through rocks near this place because it's all glass. We watched 4 or 5 elderly women having a hard time finding their way out. High prices no doubt but they aren't crooks out for a cheap dollar. They load you up the ship you outside tithe patio where you orgasm on ice cream loaded with the worlds cupcake. BevMo punks beware- this place is taking over the ice cream world. Is Sprinkles the name of my favorite ice Cream shop or my favorite stripper? Idk but either way I'm satisfied.

I've been dying to go to Milk Bar for months considering I wasn't able to go when I was in New York a few months ago. Thankfully there was one that was close and walking distance on the Strip! It's located in the Cosmopolitan on the second floor, next to Momofuku and Allsaints. It's a very tiny stand where you can order things from cookies to soft serve ice cream. I got the cereal milk soft serve which is popular so I thought I'd give it a try. It tastes exactly like cereal milk, which was delicious.

Churn is an old school ice cream parlor. It gives you the feels as you stand in line among all the candies from your childhood. I got a double scoop of butter pecan and Vietnamese coffee with added fluff on top. The toasted marshmallow added a touch of sweetness to the coffee ice cream. It's a cute spot for an after dinner treat or a date!

A local favorite! Very worth the drive, they are more than happy to make you whatever you can dream up! Like most soft-serve/custard places, they serve their regular flavors and a flavor of the week. Creme de mint is so tasty! But so are the fruity flavors. You can also catch the Moo-mobile at the Urbana Farmer's Market and other local events. I like their ice cream sandwiches but when I visit the Sidney location, only a chocolate dipped cone will do!
Crepe was really nice. It was nice and thin. I had the Nutella and strawberry. The only downside was the service...was really slow. The crepes could of had a bit more flavour.

Best.Donut.Ever! If you are reading this review, stop, put down your phone/tablet/computer, get into your car and drive to Jack Frost! End of Story.... If you love donuts, crazy fun flavors, and DONUTS! run don't walk to Jack Frost. Jack Frost has every flavor imaginable and then some...if you have ever wanted a lucky charm donut, maple bacon, s'mores, chocolate custard, or just plain glazed this is the place for you. Yes Jack Frost is small, yes they don't post flavors so you have to ask, and yes this place gets crazy busy in the mornings and weekends so come early, come often and ask plenty of questions in your quest to find your perfect donut!

hmmmm. One of the best ice creams that I've ever had! They have a wide variety of flavors and frankly I don't remember what I had because I like trying out different flavors each time I visit and each time was always supper yummy, nice and sweet, creamy and flavorful, some with crunchies or nuts. They have some amazing sundaes too and I should probably try one soon! The staff can be a little bit more friendly though. Maybe they don't like their job...

After drooling over while watching Netflix's show Chefs table, I definitely wanted to try Christina Tosi's milk bar. Milk bar is located on the 2nd floor at the Cosmopolitan. It's right next to Momofuku. We went around 11am and it wasn't that busy. We got the cereal soft serve with the cornflakes topping. I wanted to try the crack pie but it was already so pricey that I skipped it. The soft serve was delicious, I loved the crunchy flavor of the cereal, it was not too sweet but had a slight salty flavor to it. I really liked the texture it was dense and rich. The taste made me all nostalgic of my childhood. The milk bar is definitely worth the try and I would recommend it. I would want to try the crack pie in future, saving this place for my future visit.

We are Thomas Keller groupies. His restaurants are delicious - this was no different. We went there for breakfast. My husband had the French toast, and I had an omelet special. We had to try the truffle fries off of the appetizers and the beignet special (raspberry filled beignets!), which were fantastic. Our server was great - very attentive and knowledgable. Everything was delicious! Highly recommend!

This bakery is amazing!!!!! their Deluxe Strawberry Cream is amazing, the whip cream is light and soft. The strawberry is a little bit tart and with the whip cream sweet taste, matches well just right! I love this bakery! If you haven't tried the bakery, go try it. Definitely recommend!
Banana with strawberry topping is my favorite. Nice atmosphere great product.

This used to be our FAV family ice cream spot. It's been several months since our last visit. I was surprised to see the price jump on kid and single scoops. I got my summer favorite flavor - peach. But it was under-whelming in flavor and peach chunks were large and few. Bring back the great flavors and family friendly pricing! In the meantime, we will be looking for another neighborhood ice cream shop. Heartbreaking.

Batch supplied the mini-pies for our wedding (we decided to go with pies instead of cake), and did an amazing job. Very easy to work with, and very tasty baked creations. Trust me, they were a huge hit...

Awesome cookie cups with very different ice cream fla ors Capitan Crunch, Apple jacks, Mangoniada n as well as Netflix n chill....A must try!!! When u come into Fatty Daddys everyone greats you with a big cheesy smile oh they let u try as many flavors as you like lol

I love this ice cream! Although sometimes there can be a line, it usually goes really fast. I usually order online and pickup at the window which is a much faster! I will always recommend this place for the best ice cream in town!

We stopped by after dinner for dessert. We had teramisou and a capochinno brownie. Presti's is has so many delightful deserts it's very difficult to choose. The staff is always very friendly and helpful. The seating area inside is very conducive to conversation. I highly recommend them.

Waited in line for freaking 40 minutes. I wanted to see what all the hype was about, uh no never again. Had the canollis, lobster roll & chocolate chip macadamia cookie. To say the least the cookie was the best part. Overpriced all the way around

First time coming here and my family and I love it! Staff is friendly, and prices are descent for the size. Ice cram is amazing!! And not to mention they make it at the shop!! We will be coming back for sure!!

Three stars because their cupcakes are delicious but spending $3.75 for one regular sized cupcake is ridiculous! I had bought one of each to try them over a few days. My favorite was the lemon meringue. My least favorite was the cinnamon sugar. The lemon meringue was worth the $3.75. It took a lot of effort and creativity to come up with that one. The cinnamon sugar was basically a muffin. Don't be fooled when you look at this one it does not have frosting!!! A cupcake has frosting! This highly disappointing muffin is nothing special at all! I'll be back but not often!
Go, just GO! The Ubu ice cream was incredible, as was the Twinkie Cream flavor. Heading back with a friend tomorrow night- cannot wait
Wow!! Hello delicious. Seriously so good and very nice people. The ice cream texture and flavor are on point. Go visit them!
The young guy who was working this afternoon is very nice. & The pink Macaroon was yummy!

We ordered our cake from here for our wedding. A simple cake but somehow they screwed it up. Starting with the bakery in our home state never forwarding the order to the Las Vegas location. Fortunately I called a few days before to make sure our order was good to go. After a mere 30 minutes and 3 phone calls I thought we were all set! After arriving in Vegas we picked up our cake, a few hrs later we were ready to indulge. Much to our surprise there was hardly any filling and they used the wrong frosting. I know what the cake should have been like since I paid for the tasting and experienced the exact cake we wanted. Cake boss I think not! this operation is far less than advertised, had I ordered a cake from a bakery in a supermarket I would have had better luck! It just shows that you can have a TV show where you talk like you know how to run a business but in reality you just have drama!
Best iced cream in Las Vegas.. convenient, consistent . Creative. I've tried all the flavors.

Best believe it -- it's a little bit of Japan food dessert culture in NC and it's worrrrth! I don't understand how these less than satisfied comments made it on this yelp page, to be fair the business might've improved after their soft opening. I can only speak to the signature Maiko special. The cafe style and personality is adorable, the staff reminds me of the service in Japan, too. The matcha tastes OG, the blend of their Maiko special is not overbearingly sweet. The cake is moist and goes well with the adzuki beans, mochi, jelly, cornflakes and chestnut. Diversify your dessert taste buds here!

This place needs to be called out because what happened to us tonight was not okay. My friends and I were ignored by the server behind the counter (tall, lanky guy with dark-blonde curly hair working on 10/4 at 7PM). He clearly saw us waiting patiently for him to finish with the party he was serving. When he continued to ignore us and serve 3 Caucasian groups that had walked in after us, I came to the sad realization that we were being ignored because we were non-white (I'm Asian and was with Asian and middle eastern friends). When I tried to bring to his attention that we were actually next, we continued to be ignored. This ignorant and disrespectful occurrence left a sour taste in my mouth and ruined our night.... no place is worth patronizing for this display, no matter how good the ice cream is. We left empty handed and will never come back.

Can't go wrong on a Sunday afternoon with Mitchell's iceceam. Love that you are able and they are willing to let u try a small sample before making decision. The smell of the waffle cones and the chance to look at behind the scenes the staff work on the craft is a plus. Husband ordered tin roof sundae and I had a standby mint chocolate chip hot fudge sundae or friend ordered traditional banana split and his wife ordered peanut butter on waffle cone. The place is clean and loved looking out the window.. We were taken aback by the panhandling inside with someone going table to table. Expect that outside.. they were busy so I'm sure that the staff didn't see that someone was going table to table..

Oh goodie! This place is super cute and huge! It used to be a old theater and now it's an ice cream factory! We got the sampler (2 scoops) cherry chocolate chip and mango sherbet. Soo tasty. There's an upstairs that you can hangout and watch the how they work through a glass. Would recommend it!

I am giving my experience a five star and the actual food I had a three. I ordered the pie because it was very popular in reviews unfortunately it was so sweet that I could only take a few bites before I recognized I needed to not eat anymore. The birthday cake was twice as expensive, totally recognizing we are in Las Vegas and things are going to be expensive but nearly $15 for a slice of cake is a little extreme. The staff was nice and on my next visit maybe I will try the ice cream. But the pie was way too sweet for me.
The halo halo here is very good. Staff is rly friendly and nice. There's a lot of ice cream and milk tea flavors too
Finally a dessert place that's good and stays open late. I had the chocolate cake and chocolate chip cookie and both were amazing!!! Staff was friendly and helpful and I can't wait to return

Out of all the food kiosks that were in Eataly, the one that stood out for me the most was La Pasticceria. Sweets have a special place in my heart though, so naturally I gravitated toward La Pasticceria. My boyfriend and I arrived at La Pasticceria around 2pm on a Friday. It was a little bit busy, but the server who was taking the live orders was very quick and efficient in fulfilling them. Thus, the line went by fast. La Pasticceria had a great selection of artisan desserts. It was also a cafe, so you could order various coffee beverages from there. I ordered one large tart and 4 mini ones. I didn't capture the proper Italian names for each dessert, so I'll do my best to describe the essences of what they were. The large tart was made with an almond mousse and filled with a dark chocolate ganache. One of the mini tarts was like a lemon meringue tart. Another mini tart had a toasted meringue. A third mini tart had a chocolate espresso flavor. I actually remembered the fourth one being called tiramichoux, which was a tiramisu flavored pÃ¢te Ã choux. Each one was nice in their own ways, but I did have my favorites. The large almond tart, mini lemon meringue tart, and mini chocolate espresso tart were fantastic. I didn't care much for the tiramichoux and mini s'mores looking tart with the toasted meringue.
Novel remaking of soft serve experience. Black sesame not available at this location and out of chocolate on a busy Saturday afternoon.

This place is soooo good!!! Not too overpriced, but the taste of their desserts and pastries is worth every penny! I would have given them 5 stars, but I had to wait in line for 1 hour just to get into the bakery. I had my kids with me and they were not doing well with the wait so I had them stand against a wall (totally out of the way of everybody), but security there at The Venetian was very rude and said they were in the way of traffic (they were not) and made them come back in line with us! Would come back again, but I wouldn't bring my kids next time...and I would be prepared for the wait and have my comfy shoes on!!

I haven't gotten the chance to visit the one in NYC, which is more convenient, but always busy. So, I figured it was my chance to try Milk while I was on vacation with a very, very short waiting time. I just have to say everything was amazing: the cookies (I got 6 for $17, expensive I know but you have to understand 1. Your in LV 2. This is located in a hotel 3. It's Milk), the crack pie (now I know why everyone is obsessed) and the Cereal Milk soft serve with the crunchies. The only thing Negative thing I would say is that, when I was trying to figure out what I want to get, the person taking my order wasn't really any help and kinda looked at me like I was stupid.

Amazing Ice cream! I tried the dough melt which was overwhelming and I couldn't finish the entire doughnut. The Cookie Monster ice cream flavor was delicious! It goes well with captain crunch topping. The cookie monster ice cream does turn you mouth blue however. I don't think I will try the dough melt next time just because how heavy it turned out to be. But ice cream was great! Service was good too. The catchier explained everything about the menu and ice cream pretty well and answered all our questions. It was quick too!
Food, outdoor dining, and pastries are AWESOME! The service could use a shot of friendly.

Tried out the Sprinkles in Vegas at The Linq which is on the Strip. Easy to find parking because it's near the Flamingo. Sprinkles FB sometimes has Bogo deals, I lucked out when I went they had a Holiday Bogo so Buy 1 ice cream get 1 FREE. I should have asked for samples, but I just went with the peanut butter cup ice cream $3.75 on a Red Velvet waffle cone $1 extra. B. got boring vanilla in a cup. B. also got a coffee but you have to pay on the cupcake side of the store. Tasted ok, nothing special. Cupcake ATM is outside.
Very cute, small store. I got the chai and banana flavored ice creams. The chai was good, but the banana ice cream was very icy. Overall, the ice cream was just OK.

A good old fashioned ice cream store with yummy frozen treats. I normally stumble into Churn after having a dinner at Federal Pizza. I make sure I have room for dessert when I'm in the neighborhood. Churn is an adorable shop that has Great homemade ice cream with tons of toppings to choose from. They even sell nostalgic candies and toys. You remember the Fortune Fish that you would put on your hand to tell your fortune, they have it! I will be coming back for more treats soon!

Almost hidden, this place is well worth the search. The macarons are very good (the pistachio and chocolate were exquisitely made and the quality of the ingredients shined in every bite). They are expensive ($4+ each) but they are of the 'large' variety and any sane person would be completely satiated with just one (i of course had to have 3...). The only thing I had here that i didn't completely enjoy was the 'nutter butter' sandwich cookie..i will not blame Bouchon Bakery for this however as I had no business ordering this type of American style/flavor treat here. If i truly wanted a nutter butter i should have gone to 7-11 convenience store. Highly recommend. Another tip: there is NO better dinner party, housewarming, or 'i was thinking of you' gift than a box of macarons (*hint* to any of my friends that may be reading this).
Yummy! Enjoyed a delicious hot chai tea latte and breakfast croissant sandwich. The croissant was light and delicious. I also bought a pound of their cookies. Yummy!

Looooooooove this spot. If you're in the mood for sweets, this is DEFinitely one place to check out. Just about everything sweet that I've had here has been magNIficent. I never even thought I would dig macaroons like that, but at Amelie's, I do! And they have sooo many flavors! One of my favorite sweets, that may just send you into an immediate diabetic coma, fyi, is the Salted Caramel Brownie TORTE. DeeeeeeeeeeeeeLIcious. If you've had the Salted Caramel Brownie and loved it, I strongly recommend upgrading to its even lovelier big brother. I also really dig their teacakes -- lemon, almond, annnd raspberry. On the non-sweets side, I LOVE their Spinach-Artichoke Soup!! And a few of their croissant sandwiches. So much delicioiusness here. The only dish I would not recommend here is any salad. I feel like they don't give you much for the price, and what little they do give you isn't great. Other than that, the only other halfway negative about this place is that most of the sweets are not cheap! Which I guess can be a good thing so you don't overdue it and expand in your waistline as you shrink in your wallet, ha! But nonetheless, it is something worth mentioning. And other than the edible goods here, I just LOVE Amelie's as a whole -- the real laidback, chill atmosphere...and the very eclectic people (to match the also-very eclectic decor).. many who tend to be very friendly and conversational if you're up for it! It's a great place to go and either hang out with friends or solo, study, read a book, write a paper, hit up after the club, or just chill out. ALSO, and one of the greatest things of all: It's 24 HOURS, 7 DAYS A WEEK!!!! How many places in Charlotte (or North Carolina) are there that you can say that about? So yes... Amelie's: One of my faves.

i found the food to be ok nothing great. The pastries were better but very pricey They could work on cleanliness I couldn't find a clean table & had to wipe it down myself would return only for takeout dessert

Being from the Cleveland area, I was long overdue to try Presti's. I have lived in Columbus for over 10 years, but every time I'd go back to the CLE area and we'd head to dinner in Little Italy, it was typically a Sunday and Presti's would be closed by then. Luckily, I scheduled a date night with my boyfriend on a Saturday in Little Italy. We went to Mass, dinner at Mia Bella and then over to Presti's! I was so excited! However, when we walked in the door, the first thing we saw right away was a serious cluster. There were people at almost every table, however none of them with food. And then there were about 20-30 people hovering around the cases with no clear line in sight. We walked around for a bit trying to find the beginning and end of the line, but there was none. We also saw signage to "take a number" but we couldn't see anything pointing where you were supposed to take a number. Luckily, I spotted a woman with a paper number in her hand and asked where she got it from. It was hanging on the first post to your left when you walk in. We got our number only to see there were ~30 numbers in front of us. We grabbed a table inside and waited it out. It did take quite a long time, but they have signage up front so you can see what number they are on. We walked up to the glass case a few times to see what we wanted. Honestly, everything here looks fantastic! You can spend so much time just looking at everything (hence why there was a huge blob of people up front the entire time we were there). I'd say overall it took about 30 mins from the time we walked in to the time we were taken care of. A tad too long in my opinion. At one point, we counted that they only had one associate working for that many customers. Luckily, he was eventually joined by a few others. I couldn't decide between the cheesecake and the gelato, so I ended up getting both! I got the cherry cheesecake (the round one, not the New York slice cheesecake) and the stracciatella gelato. My boyfriend got the chocolate cheesecake, a very sweet option for him. I was kind of annoyed though because my boyfriend asked if they had any cassata cake left as we had just seen another customer take the final slice. My boyfriend said that if they didn't have that, he'd order the chocolate cheesecake. The associate said he'd go back and check and he was gone for a bit, came back out, put a slice of chocolate cheesecake on the tray and told us our total. I thought it was kind of rude that he didn't even say "Sorry we are out" or anything. Overall, I found the staff there to be kind of short, overworked and not really pleasant. We wanted a seat outside, but the tables were packed....all with people who had no food. It was frustrating because some of the people out there had been sitting out there since we got there. So I don't know if they had food and just finished it and were chillin out there for 30+ minutes or if they were loitering or what. So we took one of the only empty tables inside and sat down there. Overall, I enjoyed the gelato. I wish it had more chocolate in it though. Tasted a tad too vanilla. Also, I didn't love the cheesecake. It was just okay. I felt like it was the type of cheesecake with that "lemony" flavor to it, even though it was cherry cheesecake. I guess I could expect that from an Italian bake shop. Next time, I'd like to try the NY style cherry cheesecake. I had a bite of my boyfriend's cheesecake and again wasn't overly impressed. Tasted like it came out of a box. Overall, I'd definitely go back because there were a lot of different things I'd like to try. However, I think they need to get a better system in place because there are just way too many people standing around and/or sitting down with no food. Also, the sweets I had were just okay. Looking forward to hopefully updating my review in the future.

It's great to have good, local ice cream in downtown Phoenix! And, the outdoor seating at this place is perfect and much safer for kids than Pink Spot. The people here are friendlier than at MacAlpine's, and it's easier to park than Churn.
Pretty amazing donuts! Really amazing service! I recommend it! Try the homemade strawberry milk! Just 4 stars because it is a little pricey.
Coffee is fantastic, bakery stuff is amazing, and the staff never fail to put a smile on my dial.

My friends and I were really disappointed with our experience at Ninety's. We had seen their instagram photos of delicious looking desserts and treats and so we made the drive from SW Charlotte to come check it out. What we got was not worth the money. The yum-ee bun was essentially a Hawaiian roll with ice cream and three pieces of cereal stuffed in it. Nothing to be excited about. The macarons were nothing special either. Please just save your money and go elsewhere.
Cute atmosphere, friendly staff, great food and the pastries and desserts are amazing! Plus, I found out if you bring in your own coffee mug, you can get coffee for just $1!
The pastries here are delicious, specifically the chocolate covered cannoli!! They are slightly pricey, otherwise I would have given them a 5 star.

Really good ice cream, super adorable/old school/nostalgic/fun/cute shop. Hi, I'm an ice cream snob. And as such, I'm required to know where to find the best ice cream. Churn is toward the top of my list in the Phoenix area so far, bc of their unique flavors that don't sound ridiculous/terrible AND they've got a decently creamy, buttery consistency (though I wish it were creamier and velvetier!). The shop itself literally makes me feel like a fat kid in a candy store, partly bc of all the retro vibes, and bc they also sell candy...and other goodies/novelty toys. For a tiny shop, you sure can spend a crap load of money here. My toddlers go nuts over this place. Employees (for the most part), are peppy and sweet and they genuinely seem happy to give out samples. The most memorable flavors I've had are: - butter pecan - chocolate - Vietnamese coffee - cookies and mint - carrot cake It's ALL been good and it tastes like they use high quality ingredients. On top of the classic cone options, they even have a fun pretzel cone that's pretty unique and yummy. There's a couple tables and chairs out front (and a shared dining area in the back with the neighboring restaurant). But beware: during their peak times (i.e. after dinner/Fri-Sat nights) the line can get pretty freaking long and limited seating can get ugly since the shop is small.

I learned about this place from a friend who told me to try the lobster tails and I was glad I did. Keep in mind, that's the ONLY thing I get from here. Food: I only order the original lobster tails from here when I'm in town. I've tried the other 2 variations they have and they were way too sweet for my taste buds so I stick with the original. They can run out if you're in at night during peak season for Vegas so try to go in the mornings. Staff: Everyone is helpful and they have multiple people working behind the counter to try to keep the lines down. They separate the people that put your order together and the ones that are the cashiers to make the wait go by faster which I think is smart. After you order all of your stuff, they tell you to wait by the window until your name is called by a cashier then you pay and get your treats. Location: This place is tucked away in the Venetian mall in one of the side walkways but it's not hard to find as they have signs to it. I love watching them work in the bakery as you can see the pastry chefs working on their next creation during normal business hours. It's fun to watch and keep you distracted if there's a wait.

super rich, super creamy, super delicious. they let you sample and there are quite a variety of flavors. there has to be something for everyone here! they even have soy icecream! and cookie bowls. i didn't know that was a thing, but it is.

This is probably one of the most unique places I've ever been to. I was walking through the city of Charlotte and I friend recommended me this place. Has to be my favorite spot to have coffee thus far. The art work is so creative and beautiful. I took pictures nonstop. The coffee was amazing. You have to definitely try this spot.

The ice cream dude wanted me to have the caramel cashew........... My mom and I stopped in. When I step up to order the guy says "caramel cashew?" And I'm like no.... and I order my coffee ice cream scoops and my moms chocolate fudge 5 scooper. What do I get, the caramel cashew... men have such poor listening skills! Why do I look so caramel cashew-y??? It wasn't bad, don't get me wrong! I didn't complain so my bad. I was mostly creeped out when he called me by name after looking at my credit card so I didn't want to point out his mistake. When my mom mentioned we used to go to the old location he said "I think I remember you..." so fake because we haven't been there in 15 years. I really hate to complain about an ice cream store, like damn I also hate puppies and rainbows.
I try ice cream in every state I visit. Handel's is delicious. I really like the Nutter Butter flavor. I do not like their pie flavors. Worth a visit! I think they have specials on Tuesdays.

Sprinkles is a perfect place for The Linq, I almost always make a stop here whan I am playing tourist at The Linq because their treats are fairly priced and it always hits the spot. I always get ice cream here. Hahaha. GET THE RED VELVET WAFFLE CONE! Not just a gimmick, it actually is sweet and tasty! I am always happy with their coffee almond fudge ice cream, so if you're a coffee fan, this will do the trick for ya.

THE BEST DONUTS EVER! Anytime I'm craving sweets this is were i go. You can satisfy any craving with all the different options and you can tell they're made with love!! Joe & Jeff are the nicest guys as well!!
Amazing place! The donut melt is the way to go and the staff are super personable! Definitely recommend!

I enjoyed the strawberry cheesecake ice cream today from Ninety's Ice Cream & Sandwiches. A co-worker was kind enogh to bring me a surprise flavor. I had other opportunities to taste this flavor but passed them up. You see, my mind says yes but my body says no. I enjoyed the strawberry flavor with just the right amont of graham cracker crust mixed in. Also, I heard more about the lunch items offered prompting me to make a visit to this location VERY soon!

Love the Chinese take out box presentation.. How original! I was in Phx for a convention. Wanted to try something "local" and not something I have in VA already. Found Melt on Yelp. Very good usual flavors like "Trix" cereal and Nutella.. Very good and worth the walk. Don't be turned off by the block and houses that are now businesses.
Great coffee and food. Only been to the uptown location. Line/waiting area could be improved - so 4 out of 5 starts but overall a great place worth visiting.
Italian cookies, coffee, and savory options are great! A great place to relax and chat with a friend or people watch outside.

Let me start by saying that the quality of their ice cream is good, however, I called to ask if they had a product that they've been out of for months and the owner/manager responds that he wouldn't put something up if he didn't have it. However, I've come here before, and it was posted as if I they had it in stock, only to find out that they didn't have it due to supply issues. Bottom line: he was rude, unprofessional and quite frankly a jerk! I will never patronize this business again!

They taste even prettier than they look and that says a lot with these prime aesthetics. Started planning my next visit mid-way through the first bite. I would recommend to anyone as the best donuts in CLE. Honestly, this is a short review because the flavors speak for themselves. From the July 2020 menu: Strawberry shortcake, lemon lavender, cookies and cream, 2 x Boston creme, and blueberry cake. If you are decisive--unlike me in this shop--and only want to try one, the Boston creme or blueberry cake would be IT.

I came in around 3:00 and was literally the only customer. When I walked in the gal behind the counter was on the phone having a full on conversation, never bothered to tell me to hang on, or go in the back or anything. I was ready to order and just looked at her...she looked right back and kept on talking. Laughing and chatting. So bizarre. Never been someplace where someone was so blatantly oblivious that this was bad customer service. She finally hung up and gave me my ice cream. Box was cute and so was fortune cookie. Ice cream was just ok.

24 hour coffee and French bakery. Why don't they have these everywhere? I love it. The soy lattes are amazing, as are the pastries. I only visited twice a day while I was in Charlotte but I wish it could have been more. The bread pudding is great with coffee at 5 am. Sure, the place is filled with hipsters but that is NoDa. Come at a quiet hour, like 4 or 5 in the morning, and enjoy great coffee and hip surroundings.
Awesome place... The entire staff was awesome and the prices were very reasonable! They gave great suggestions and recommendations. I will definitely stop by the next time I'm in Scottsdale!

So.. I don't know what took me so long to try Jarling's until now, but I finally stopped by to see what's the hype. Did they meet my expectations? Yes! Their menu is super extensive with various toppings and ice cream combinations. I ended up getting their homemade fresh waffle cone sundae with one topping and ended up getting cookie dough bites. The waffle cone sundaes comes with nuts, whipped cream, and cherry on top, but I opted out of the whipped cream and cherry. I think the prices are pretty reasonable for the quality and taste of ice cream. They've tried their best to help people social distance, but it's a popular place so expect there will be lots of people without masks eating ice cream.

I'm definitely one that loves donuts and prefers not the traditional style with traditional toppings we came in for Labor Day weekend and saw donut bar. I was able to get a birthday cake donut on my birthday it tasted exactly like birthday cake!!! I also noticed that they have franchise options I had no idea donut bar was a franchise? Maybe one of these will pop up in California close to me soon because their donuts are fantastic!!!! They also have a large selection of drip coffee. Heather just having decaf or regular there were five options that you could choose from even in flavored coffee

I think that might have been the best ice cream I have ever had. Flavors were great too (I had s'mores and coffee), but the underlying ice cream base was spectacular - super fresh cream and just the right consistency and richness. Wow. It's a good thing they don't have this where I live. :-0 Cool to be able to watch them making various flavors from the second floor space overlooking the production area. Definitely worth a visit.

Cute little area. Several doors and light lettered writing is a bit hard to see when it's very bright outside and your eyes have to adjust. Sucks they don't have common flavors on the regular and the specialty ones take over. On the flip side... This ice cream was DELICIOUS. A bit over priced but, not excessive. Pleasant service people and modern design. Ordered the red velvet ice cream. Shouldn't charge a Dollar for ALL toppings... But oh well. Friend ordered Mint Chocolate Chip and Rocky road.... Heads up Mint is spearmint not regular mint. =)

I am not a big ice cream or frozen custard fan. I had never been to Jarlings before and I have lived in this area all my life. I started a new job and was asked if I wanted something from Jarlkings. Since they were buying I said OK I will try it. I ordered the special for simplistic sakes. I surely could not pick one thing out of all the choices they have. The special was a carmel apple snowstorm and it is fantastic. I ordered a small but I couldn't finish it so I put it in the freezer and ate it again the next day and I think I liked it a little better the second time because it was frozen more than the first if that makes any sense.

Love it how they have so much to choose from And also it really satisfies your cravings that's for-sure I love this place overall amazing and I really can't wait to bring my family here to try them out well worth it I appreciate this place for not only having a good selection but amazing service

I actually came here when they first opened and several times since. It lives up to the hype of that video and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts. Damn that crackle on that creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and French toast donut. Also don't just come for this donut, all their other donuts are beautiful, unique, and bloody delicious. Come hungry for donuts. Not a lot of places to sit and the outside patio is nice when it's not 100 degrees. I would also make sure or know your order and get your box of donuts all in one go to forgo the long lines. Parking is also freaking terrible and make sure to pay attention to the signs

Seems like some people in Champaign don't appreciate what they have in this place. Reasonably priced, great tasting custard and sundaes. They now accept cards as payment, and their service is always solid. It's amazing to me that people are really making comments about the time it takes to get served. It's a popular place, and I've never had to wait longer than 10 minutes. Best ice cream in the area, hands down.

Went here for Valentine's Day with my girl and it was really good. Everything they make from scratch. I really liked the fact that the marshmallows were also home made. Everything was tasty the flavors were also really innovative. The sea salt caramel and the Irish whiskey were great. I'd love for them to maybe do more in the future like cookies as an option instead of macrons but those were really tasty as well.

We kept driving in circles trying to find the place- there wasn't a sign that we could see on the outside. We parked and asked someone walking by about it and they confirmed we had the place. The ice cream was delicious and the atmosphere very fun- a great place to come for food, ice cream, coffees and teas- we loved it!

My brother took me here after our candle making class just around the corner and I have to say although they didn't have many non-dairy options I did find one that was pretty good my only complaint was it was too sweet for me. But overall everything was very clean and organized and I did appreciate how all of the associates had great customer service. The overall decor is very cute as well! I thought the box of water was cute too!
This place is amazing. We have been looking for a good homemade I cream place and it did not disappoint. Ice cream was delicious

Cute little ice cream shop! Got the strawberry shortcake (scoop of strawberry and Madagascar vanilla ice cream, pieces of strawberries, whip cream, strawberry sauce, and two pieces of shortcake) and it was delicious. Loved the texture of the shortcake itself. Definitely recommend trying it! Wouldn't mind coming back to try other items on the menu
Find ice cream place the only complaint is that they run out of supplies quite regularly and the substitutions don't seem to make up for it

It was a treat to finally try one of Christina Tosi's dessert creations. The Milk Bar menu had a wide selection of interesting ingredients which one would never thought of using in desserts but apparently Christina Tosi was able to concoct interesting texture and flavors using ordinary pantry items like corn, cereal, malt, etc. Ingenious! After asking for the least sugary cookies that they have, I was referred to the corn cookie which consists of both corn and corn flour - surprise! And to my delight, the cookie was chewy, buttery and more than satisfied my craving for that bit of sweetness.

Our family loves this place! The customer service and the quality of the ice cream is superb especially when you're lucky enough to have Danny serve you. She is such a kind person and always has a big smile on her face and makes delicious ice cream taste even sweeter than it regularly would. If you haven't tried Handel's homemade ice cream it may be time to go by and sample all of their different flavors.

Go, just go! Five bucks a donut and iced mocha in Vegas is a treat; however, donuts approved by local deputies is a sure sign you have found the best donut shop in Vegas. The friendly staff has reason to smile because they know you are in for a real treat when you order any of their donut creations!

The macaroons are always good here. In fact, I really wouldn't be surprised if everything else here was just as good too. However, when I came here last week to grab some macaroons for my gf's family, the service sucked a bit. Now this is rating is lowered for the service, and I would've normally given this place four stars if it wasn't for the girl that helped us. Honestly, if you're going to help people, especially excited and eager people that are already sold on the product you offer, don't roll your eyes blatantly in front of us because we ordered more than three things. Especially when the macaroon sets are out and you visibly pouted because you had to put one together in a regular box on the spot. I'm willing to give her the benefit of the doubt that maybe she was having a bad day, but I've worked in retail and having an attitude problem isn't the way to go. I mean, what the hell, we were saying sorry for the "trouble" and we really didn't have to do that.

The flavor of the ice cream and macaron were good. The toasted marshmallow on top was cool. But very small for the amount you pay. I am glad I tried it, but do not feel compelled to come back. The prices are a tad too high. Cookie cup is $6.25.
This place is amazing. The chocolate almond croissant and TLC cookies are my favorite. The shortbread cookies are heavenly. Every time I visit Vegas I go out of my way to visit this sugar jewel.

I absolutely love coming to Novel whenever I am in the Tempe area. It's a must. I am in love with their lavender honey ice cream and before I left back home to Boston I bought a pint because it was that good. If you're like me and you like sweet stuff but also something that i refreshing then I would recommend this. One of the many things that I love about Novel is that they are always changing the flavors and being innovative. They currently have this Madagascar vanilla ice cream that is so delicious!! I love all of their staple flavors there and donuts. Everything there is handmade and artisan. Which is what I love, it's nothing artificial, it's all real flavoring and made with real ingredients. The staff there are incredibly nice and welcoming. It's always a joy to see them and they make it all worth the trip coming down there!

Best mint chip ice cream! Bought my daughter here as a treat and she loves the mint as well. The waffle cone is nice a sweet and is a great compliment to the ice cream. Also had the brownie swirl and that is great as well! I love ice cream and unfortunately I have it way too often at least with sweet republic their ingredients are all natural. So that's a feel good moment. There's another location on 16th St and Bethany Home which is closer to where I reside. I'll become a regular.

Oh man! Disappointed. We ordered the white cake with fudge icing and it had no flavor. The chocolate icing didn't taste like chocolate at all. The outside of the bakery smelled so wonderful, but I don't think that wonderful smell was the cake. We wouldn't go back here again most likely.

Not Impressed. We got a wedge of pecan pie, a chocolate dipped cheesecake, a cookie and cream cupcake, and a slice of rainbow buttercream cake. The pecan pie was the only thing with good flavor. The chocolate dipped cheesecake was mediocre. The cookie and cream cupcake was a slightly dry underflavored chocolate cupcake with some gritty speckled frosting on top that tasted nothing like cookies and cream. The rainbow cake was equally flavorless and unimpressive. I'm honestly pretty upset with the inflated prices we paid for underwhelming bakery goods. Don't get lured in by the Carlos name and Buddy's face everywhere. You can get a better cake out of a box at the store for $2 and save yourself $20. The only reason this isn't a one star review is because the staff were great.

Starting off with good things: Churn was very mindful of COVID, which I was very happy about! They only allowed 1-2 parties in at a time. They also offered my pup a pup cup which consisted of whipped cream which was really nice of them!! As for the ice cream itself, it was overhyped. I got a vanilla snickerdoodle ice cream sandwich and it was just alright. The ice cream itself was not super unique or notable, it was just ice cream. The cookie was good and dense, perfect for an ice cream sandwich, but I think it could've been warmed or freshly made because mine was rock hard when I ate it. It was a nice, sweet treat, but nothing I would shout on the rooftops about.
Great customer service and best ice cream ever!! The manager there the night we visit was friendly and nice. The sundae with warm chocolate chip cookie was soo yummy!!

I love getting there mango stuff!! It's so good!! It salty, soury, and have spices to it which I love the most! I have gotten this like twice and both times I have loved it. I also love there ice cream! My friends have gotten their different drinks/ milkshake and they have love it. I love this place. This place has never disappointed me!!

On my last trip to Vegas with the hubby, I looked on Yelp for some ideas on where to eat. Bouchon Bakery got really great reviews and hubby loves all sorts of pastries so we decided to stop by. Thanks Yelp for helping me find Bouchon because the croissants here are to die for. ! At first we each got 1 croissant... but after finishing our croissants we went back to stock up on more for the rest of the day. I'm not someone who enjoys eating any sort of bread, muffin, or pastry...but I seriously can eat 3+ Bouchon croissants in one sitting. Some advice, come here early as the croissants seem to sell out pretty fast. And don't try to buy croissants for the next day. They are edible but just not as good.
I love coming here. Prob my fav ice cream spot. They make sure to label each ice cream with any allergies. Which is a huge deal for someone like me.
Came here to find gluten free options since it shows as having them on Yelp, but they had none. It would be helpful if they would remove that descriptor from their business.

I'm a little concerned to be living within walking distance to the Chocolate Shoppe. I used to live across the street and my room mate and I ended up here far too often. CS's super-premium ice cream is as rich and creamy as you'd expect, and they have case after case of flavors. I am a bad decider, so it often takes me several minutes of pacing up and down the store to choose what I want. On my last trip some visiting friends and I were on a milkshake mission - I chose to do a Zanzibar chocolate malt. Delicious, for sure, but not quite malty enough - the Zanzibar chocolate has such a bold flavor that it overwhelmed the warmth of the malt. No worries, though - it turns out pure liquid chocolate is still delicious. Crazy, right? Last month I tried one of their new flavors, banana cream pie. Banana ice cream, Nilla wafters, and marshmallow sauce. Yum. Yes. I'll have another scoop, please. In addition to their regular ice cream, Chocolate Shoppe also offers BANG!! ice cream (one scoop has the same amount of caffeine as an energy drink) and several non-dairy options (that I might try so as to pretend I'm making a 'healthy' choice). Glad to have such a great shop(pe) in the neighborhood, and I'm sure they'll get to know my smiling face soon enough.

When you're in the need for a snack, check this place out. They have scrumptious ham and cheese baguette sandwiches that really hit the spot. If you're looking for something sweet, they have all kinds of pastries and bite-size desserts to satisfy your craving. Pair it with a hot cup of coffee and you're ready to keep rockin' it in Vegas.

I have to admit that this place has always been a favorite to al lot of people to include me. I love sweet breads and of course pastries. The place is smaller than. A lot of the 85 degree bakeries in California but I think it is perfect size here in Vegas. The place is nestled int he middle of china town. There is good parking areas and a lot of restaurants around the new plaza. There is usually a line ( maybe because the place is new ) but it does not matter because it goes pretty fast. This is a great place to stop by when your around the are a or just when you feel like having sweet rolls and pastries. They also have smoothies and bobas. I would've put 5 stars but opening the bread bins can be difficult , you have to open all the way up and push inside before you can serve yourself and if you dont know how to use the bin cover it can be hard to get your bread.. but it's alriggghttt it can be done.

Their Vanilla swirl can never go wrong!!!! It's always my ultimate goal for visiting this place. I also tried their croissant, which is another goodie. I'll make more trips to this place so I can try many more which I'm sure will never fail my expectations! The service is very good. They respond attentively and give us enough time to look around without giving any pressure.
The line is very long.The crumb cake-not good.The chocolate cannoli-good.The dark chocolate mini cake-amazing! -Samantha (Sami)

Churn is an extraordinarily cute Ice Cream parlor located right next to The Windsor. However, for the prices I was under the inclination I was having artisanal ice cream or something. While the ice cream itself was fair and admittedly very very fresh, the prices are a bit extortionist. They do have a lot of options to go with the ice cream, from customized cones to a variety of toppings but I truly do not think the ice cream was as expensive as they made it out to be. Also, for anyone that is curious at all, their rotational menu is all their flavors on rotation, they only really serve about 8-10 flavors at the location. You might want to call and ask what they have before you make the trek there or refer to the online menu, I *believe* it's updated daily. Good ice cream, just pricey.
This is very high quality and tastes super good! You can get super creative with the flavors and mix-ins. I'll be coming back many more times!

I wish this bakery was in Michigan! I go here every time I am in town. The creme brule is amazing. The fudge brownie cookie is also one of my favorites. The food in their cafe along with their drinks are also great. I look forward to my trips to Cleveland just to go here.

This spot is in a small little building clustered with some other businesses. There's no indoor seating but there is plenty outdoor seating and the whole area has a nice vibe. We were immediately greeted by the super nice staff. Upon learning it was out first time visiting, they walked us through the place and the flavors, even asked us if we wanted any samples. I tried the Fat Elvis, which was a peanut butter/banana/bacon concoction. It was so good I just decided on getting a scoop right then and there. Honestly, as I devoured it, it was probably some of the best - if not THE best - ice cream I have ever had. The flavor was just perfect. My girlfriend sampled the almond joy flavor and enjoyed it, but decided to go with the vanilla since she wanted to get the Leslie Knope: a waffle sandwich including a topping of your choice. She said it was honestly soooooo amazing. One of her favorite desserts she's ever had. They said that they have some standing flavors and others they they rotate, so we will definitely come back. 100% check it out if you like ice cream, it's that good.

This is one of my favorite spots in Little Italy. I love hanging out here and catching up with friends. I usually get the chai tea, and occasionally a baked good. I remember their gelato also being tasty. I love going here in the summer so I can sit outside and people watch. Staff is always very friendly. Lines can get long during peak hours, but moves pretty efficiently.
Banana splits were incredible! Ice cream was soft and old fashioned, hot fudge was perfect.

The cakes here are good but not spectacular, which might be because of how late in the evening we came. The service was quick and friendly, but the cakes were way overpriced considering the quality. In addition, the slices were served cold, and cold cake tastes like old cake. After just a few bites, we took our slices home where we let them warm up, after which they tasted like entirely different--much better--cakes.

We come here quite often and we are never let down. Their ice cream here is stellar and refreshing to see new flavors weekly. Brandon is amazing and the customer service is out of this world! I highly recommend this place for anyone in the area!

I had the Florence (egg, spinach, gruyere) and it was delicious! I liked the fact that they were using freshly ground pepper and (what seemed to be) pink rock salt. I'm not too fond of sweet crepes but I would like to try one from this place next time.

This was such a cute little ice cream shop in the middle of a deserted strip mall. Awesome flavors fresh made from scratch, lots of different combinations, delicious! I would definitely return. I guess my only feedback is that you couldn't see that ice cream so you had to go based off of the description

Dear Minister Mather, I had recently reported the likelihood of Goody Glover to be a witch, which you confirmed and took proper actions. Therefore you understand my ability to discern between witches and common men with astute accuracy. It is then with fear and great concern that I must report this establishment of witchcraft. I am nay knowledgeable of the quantity of individuals involved nor the extent of their involvement but there are witches among them. My venture here was extraordinary in a way God hath not intended. They served buttered corn in the form of ice cream sir. The same vegetable I place in the fire and glaze with freshly churned butter was being served to me in a spoon. Unbeleivable sir. To be safe of their hexing I ordered a flavor with fire in the name...campfire smores. Sir I lie to you not when I tell you I tasted the charred melting marshmallows in the very fibers of that cream. Sir I SWEAR I smelled the aroma of the warm fire crackling on a fog filled night. They have vexed me sir! SIR I have been vexed! To the stake with them Minister Mather! To the stake! Warm Regards, Goody Electron

Stopped by last night after a fantastic meal at Fuego Tacos. The place is set up like a shabby chic (more chic than shabby) candy shop and they do actually sell candy. I tasted the peanut butter and the blueberry. Both were good, but didn't strike my fancy. I ended up getting a small with vanilla and vietnamese coffee. The coffee ice cream was the better. The vanilla tasted a little icy, like freezer burned ice cream tastes, you know? And like I said, the coffee was good, but I think any gelato place in the cenpho/arcadia regions can make it better. Price was pretty good at $2.75 for a small which comes with 2 scoops. I'm always a fan of locally owned. I know they're new so I'll give them at least one more chance ;)

If you don't know already, you really should! This place is a dream. Everything is impeccable down to everyone working there including the owner. You can really taste the difference here as everything I've tried has been better than expected. My favorite thus far has been the Luna cookie but all s'mores things, brownies, and especially cookies are phenomenal. I can't wait to try more. If you want to try some of their famous treats be prepared to arrive early because they sell out! As a side note: If you're a fan of food porn or positivity I suggest that you do yourself a favor and follow her instagram as well. You won't be disappointed as it's also a great place for info on new products and other great information.

Just received a heart-warming message from Patrick Frank the owner of Handel's telling me to "get a life" in response to my 1 star review for Handel's not caring about their customers enough to make their employees wear masks. That definitely warrants another 1 star review.

If I could give zero stars I would!! So I went to the bakery to buy cookies 3 weeks before I ordered the cof course I get there they were sold out. I asked the owner that I wanted to order a cake she said I HAD to do it on line I said I'm here I want to order it she said no that's not how we do it. So I sent and email because that's how you order it. Wait 2 days to get a response the pick up date was 2/19 also order cookies. During the week I tried to get them to hold cookies and I was told no they couldn't? I'm like I'm spending about $100 and you can't hold cookies? They said no. So I get there picked up the cake and the special cookies. Thankfully they had cookies so bought some. Well fast forward we cut the cake on my moms birthday and OMG!! The cake was raw!!! The third layer on the top you can see it. I'm so disgusted!! I reached out to the owner and she seemed as she was going to do blues clue and find out?? Meanwhile I'm embarrassed that everyone at the party was like what's that in the cake. I expressed this to the owner and it meant NOTHING to her. I got charged for the cake....cookies....I even paid a tip???? Since when do bakeries do this?! She was not sympathetic nor did she offer me no type of compensation towards HER mistake. Very disappointing and sad that she gets to do this and have no type of customer service!!
This by far was the best ice cream I've had in a long time! I had the FAT ELVIS and can't wait to go back and have it again!

I liked this place but I think it comes down to what you were raised on. I think Krispy Kreme is trash because I grew up on Shipleys. Shipleys has the best yeast donut to Me. This place the yeast is gigantic and a lil heavier but there glazes are really good hear. They are at a premium price but I will say the donuts are large. Lots of cool flavors to try, I wish the Pop tart one had actual pop tart filling but that's asking a lot. A lovely young lady in line with me suggested the French toast joint so consider it if you come. Nice way to stretch your legs in the morning if your staying on Fremont and wake your crew up with donuts.

Best croissant of my life. Oahn N. is right on about it being "buttery and flaky, cripsy, yet moist". Perfect, really. Quick, friendly service and convenient. I really wish I had one of these in my city.
Why are you wasting time reading these reviews? Just come already and order whatever catches your eye...it will be amazing!

Seriously? Really? You gotta be joking! Those were some of my replies when I asked people about the sandwiches and pastries served here when they told how good, and what an orgasmic experience it was to eat stuff here. Well, shit, call me a lemming, but I had to try it out for myself. I came here to eat a light lunch, and after looking at the size of the sandwiches, it was an ultra light lunch. For that size, being $11, it better be the best fucking sandwich I've ever had in my life. Sadly, totally not the case. I ordered the turkey and cheese (brie) on a focaccia bread (toasted) and it was really OK. I mean for such a famous place, and supposedly great bread, I wasn't WOWed by it. The sandwich overall was not bad, I mean the brie really meshed well with the turkey and the turkey was flavorful. I guess I was expecting a lot from this place, and I left slightly disappointed. Now, I was told the Macaroons are amazing here, but I think next time, I'll take a pass and eat something else. Honestly, I'm just not a fan and I would have been just as happy with a sandwich from Johnny Rocket down in the food court.

ummm... YUM!!! I love Ad Hoc, so I dragged my Mom to Bouchon Bakery for treats one night while we were walking the Strip. So good! We went back another morning for breakfast. Delicious baked goods (Do yourself a favor and try the PB&J Brioche). Tasty sandwiches. Super fresh orange juice. Fantastic coffee. Thanks, Thomas Keller!

Had the absolute delight of speaking with Gina and Danny who gave us some of the BEST customer service we have ever had. They gave us the full assortment of absolutely delicious large French macarons and made us return customers. Chocolate is now my favorite flavor. Thank you Gina and Danny for ending our stay at the Venetian on a sweet note.

Thanks, Yelpers, for pointing out this local spot while we were in Scottsdale for our Spring Training trip. Reminds me a lot of some of our favorite ice cream establishments in Denver (Sweet Action, Liks, Little Man Ice Cream) - great quality, friendly people, and they're ready and willing to get you whatever taster you need. I loved every second of my visit to Sweet Republic!

ooooooooo how delicious their cupcakes were!!!!!!! This place has a variety of choices for cupcakes and it is so worth to try it out! The promenade one even has a little cupcake ATM right outside of it in case you miss their operating hours or the line for the store is crowded for you. It only takes credit card, but during their hours you can go inside and go into the cupcake or ice cream area. They had plenty of people working the Sprinkles shop and didn't laugh when I went in the wrong area initially lol. I had the chocolate chip cookie cupcake and my mom had the coconut cupcake! The presentation in itself is marvelous and the way they package their items are so nice! And lastly, we loved the taste of the ones we got and almost snagged another available at the McCarran airport before we left for Cleveland. All I want to say now is, SPRINKLES EXPAND TO CLEVELAND PLEASE IF YOU ALREADY HAVEN'T BECAUSE I'D BUY MANY, MANY, MANY MORE OF YOUR YUMMY CUPCAKES!!!!!

Ignoring all the comments about the location (okay, weird). But as my daughter just said: "I don't think I could make something this bad if I tried." We got the namesake peach cobbler. Where was the flavor? Where was the sweetness? Not in our little paper cup. And the ice cream? Is there a sugar shortage? Tasted like frozen milk. Love the idea, but concept fails here. Would also help if it wasn't just in this "take out lobby/warehouse." Oh well, we tried. Better desserts await!

So I seriously need to open my eyes.... we were just at Postinos across the street the other day and never even saw this place. Probably because were distracted by the view of Circle K. Super cute old fashion ice cream polar. Trendy for sure. They had tons of the old school toys and I bought a few because they were very affordable. I got the Smores sundae and the bf got the elvis sundae. They both looked like posted pictures and were very yummy. A little pricey on the sundaes $7.50 each but I could see why.
Homemade ice cream in the heat of summer! Great place to take the kids and grab a scoop on the run. Could use just a few more seats but it really dosen't matter.

Being a MasterChef fan (where Christina Tosi is a judge), I was quite excited for Milk Bar. The menu and bookshelf set up is super cute. I ordered the Birthday Cake soft serve ice cream and it was fun and tasty! I will say I thought my friend's Cereal Milk with Cornflakes was better and more unique so I'd order that next time. I don't normally eat a lot of soft serve but I found this to be an enjoyable treat after an afternoon at Marquee Day Club!

Presti's is one place I try to visit every time I visit family in Cleveland. It's always been amazing, and quintessentially "Cleveland" Today was just a profoundly sad day. Took my parents there today before returning to Chicago. We got there and the wait was painfully slow for service. That, I get. But when there are other employees behind the counter who are taking down the showcase (where the food is) getting ready to close up, that's when it becomes infuriating. Half the menu was unavailable (they claimed to have absolutely no panini which is what we came for), and everything else in the case was sparse. Oh, and any restaurant that uses a microwave period, is really not a place worth visiting. Thank God I didn't order an espresso. I saw the way they were made for the people in front of me, and it was terrible. From the way it came out of the basket, it was either too sour, or too bitter (I spent $5k on a machine for my house, trust me, I know espresso). Today's staff just didn't care. Goodbye Presti's. Too bad. You had a great reputation. You blew it. A great tradition, blown to hell.

FROZEN baked goods? The lady in front of me asked for something that was out of stock in the display, so the counter person said they could go check in the freezer for more...come on. This is supposed to be one of the better bakeries in charlotte, and they are serving frozen baked goods. That is a big no no. I've been here a couple of times now, and this time I came on a Tuesday around 12pm. I had to wait almost 30 minutes to get a turkey sandwich... I have never been extremely impressed by Amelie's. Seems like it is a bunch of bells and whistles.

I honestly cannot get enough of Milk!! Seriously the crack pie and bday truffles are my go to whenever i visit! This is a small location but the service is pretty quick and always friendly. The items are pricey but definitely worth for a once and a while expense.

Ice Cream and Candy Delicious-ness galore! After dining at Windsor, simply take a few steps on over to Churn for some homemade out of this world super creamy ice cream. It's like a mini candy store filled with cookies and ice cream. The staff happily offered a few tastings. I thought I was going to get the Strawberry but then I tasted the blueberry ice-cream. It was so good and different. We got out cool treats and then enjoyed eating it on the patio and having a little chat and people watching. What an adorable place with good ice cream to boot! See you soon.

This place is so stinking cute it's a small spot and I decided to get a soft serve which is what there know for, and it was good I would say it literally tasted like left over milk from the bottom of fruity pebbles or Frosted Flakes, but frozen and I made a mistake on getting chocolate chips with it definitely would recommend the cereal crunch instead it pairs way better. It was pricey though for two soft serves it was $14 so about $7 each ice cream with out the cone. It was good but not that good maybe if it was cheaper I would consider getting ice cream again but I'm not much of a cereal person to begin with so I might have to pass.

I practically live here in the shop. It's almost tradition to come here to get A1 top notch quality ice cream. I always get Cookie Monster because why not. And the doughnuts...don't even get me started. They're AhhhMazing!! Everything is good quality and the owners are always there and are the best people for running the best ice cream shop! I definitely recommend!

I had high expectations for this place. I was thinking it's like high end milkshakes, cakes, and unique deserts. Instead it was like diabetes. Sugar overloaded menu of colorful confetti sprinkled cakes, shakes and cookies. It just didn't look appealing to me. I ordered a slice of their $15 Chocolate BDAY cake and it was dry, hard, sweet. Skip this place in Vegas and better off trying the Hello Kitty Cafe.
Amazing!!! The staff is so upbeat and so nice. Great atmosphere. We got the salted carmel, wasn't aware it was a huge cup but it was all eaten. Super yummy!
Service is excellent! I'm not a sweet tooth person but for holiday around the corner . They have the best pumpkin pie ( Minnie size ) is the best of watching your weight . Love it !

This is a vintage-looking ice cream stand on Bridge Avenue, right where Ohio City gradually morphs into Detroit-Shoreway. When I stopped by, there were half a dozen people in line, even though it was a rainy weekday evening. Fortunately, there was an army of helpful, friendly folks inside whittling down all the orders and tending to newbies' questions (like mine) with ease. There were about a dozen flavors available, so I opted for the ube and the sweet corn. I felt both were subtle in their flavoring, although they were also reasonably dense and creamy, thereby satisfying at least some of the basic reasons for going out for ice cream in the first place. Helpfully, there were several benches in the rear, partly covered by a tent, where I could sit and savor each bite slowly and methodically. Some Yelpers have helpfully pointed out that Mason's pivots into a ramen stand during the colder months (!). Now this I'd love to see. For now, enjoy your ice cream and the summer. Pro tip: folks, it's perfectly possible to take photos of your ice cream without shoving and force-feeding them into the frame with dirty, ugly, wrinkly hands and fingernails that overwhelm the actual food, and without distracting, unnecessary backgrounds. Keep your photos classy and sanitary. Make it only about the food - unless you really want people to engage in cannibalism and eat your hands along with the ice cream. Everyone knows you're absolutely *not* an amazing, avant-garde arteeste anyway. #raisingthelowyelpelitebar

This restaurant is tucked away in the opulent Venetian. We went for brunch, and I had the Saumon Fume, which similar to a deconstructed lox bagel, but better. We also got the pastry assortment, where you get to pick 4 pastries. We thought they would be smaller sizes, but you get the full sized pastry. We had to ask for a box, and flew with it to Chicago.
