They were still tasty the next day. 5 stars because the service was fantastic. I actually got a deep paper cut on their stiff paper table cover. We asked for a bandaid, and I was provided with some Neosporin, and a small handful of bandaids. I also forgot my hat when we left, and had to run back to get it. They had placed in on a high shelf where I could see it near my table.

We came here for the first time and it's a really cute place. The whole set up makes you feel like u entered a time machine and it's quite charming. The ice cream itself is good. Nothing too crazy to rave about. All in all I had a pleasant experience but it's a little overpriced. I'll be back but I won't be a regular here.

presti's is a really cute place to go for coffee. their baked goods are pretty good, better than the savory lunch food types of things they have there (sandwiches, pastas, strombolis, etc.) and the food is aiight. that's the only word i can think of that would most appropriately describe it. i think it's just a nicer place to sit in (or outside) for normal coffee and cookies and such. but i've always come out of that place smelling like a walking human presti's for some reason. gross! 3 stars for presti's, hip hip hooray.

mmmmm.. macarons..i had 2 of each to bring back home to share with the wifey. when i told her i was going to vegas she asked to bring something back from bouchon. im glad she did. she loved the pistacio. my fave was the coffee flavored one. theyre also quite larger than others i've tried... i also had to try the oreos and too bad i only got 2.
What a great place!! Such delicious ice cream and who doesn't love Pinguins! Huge shame the location is so utterly hidden. Cool artwork as well. Definitely will be back!

The service was excellent and there is a reason why i gave it a lesser star rating, last night i went to save christmas! by buying treats for the family. I got a discount since i work at the casino. I bought a ton of brownies and macaroons and things i can't describe. Anyway, me and a coworker were having fun and we got the order which came to 22$ which, is what i expected. My only complaint is i got home, overly excited about dessert that i nearly skipped dinner and went straight for one of my fave things in the world, Brownies only to be let down! :( it tasted like it was burnt, but nonetheless i gave it the benefit of the doubt and tried another... and another it all was horriblee :( luckily the other items i bought made up for it. I'm a fan of great service so i would definetly come back, but i'm staying away from those brownies!

After hearing so much about macarons, I figured since I was staying at the Venetian I must try Bouchon Bakery's macarons. Given, I've never had macarons before, I couldn't compare it to anything else. I thought they were pretty tasty, the pistachio was my favorite. I wouldn't say it knocked my socks off. I think I'm going to have get use to them before I gave a thoughtful review. This bakery is hidden so you might just miss it.
Solid cake. They have it all ready to go and it travels well. My family was not disappointed when I walked in with slices for them!

WOW, these cookies are so fire!!! why is this my first time trying them? I was too full the past few times I was at the cosmo but I made sure to visit them this time with a lighter meal to have them for dessert. These cereal cookies do not disappoint! They make them fresh and they are portionally sized and taste so good! I wanted to go eat them again and my friend told me they have them packaged at Target so I had to get my fix on.... not the same. The actually physical location cookies are twice the size and are the real deal! Can't wait to come make another visit to this location or the one in LA. the cookies are so bomb! keep them coming and keep up the great tasting cookies! I want to try and catch them for their seasonal flavors too. Come and check out MILK bar!

My friend kept hyping up milk bar so I had high expectations before coming here. It did look good don't get me wrong, but I was not amazed. I would've shared with my friend but since he kept saying how good it was I thought i'd be better if we had our own cup of soft serve to ourselves than sharing. I got the soft serve with chocolate syrup and it was just OK. I've honestly had better soft serve elsewhere and this was pretty basic. It was also expensive as well! At least my friend still enjoyed it but I probably won't be going out of my way to get it.

First of all, it's not custard. It's ice milk. Says so on their website. Staffed by high school kids who don't understand the concept of moving quickly when there's a line out the door. Be prepared to stand in line watching teenagers fumble around trying to find all the sundae toppings. Or you could drive to the dairy barn in Sidney and drive back while your friends are still in line at Jarlings. Their ice milk is pretty decent if you happen to pass by when there isn't a line. Illini Pie is also a good choice.

These were so darn good! Much better than Carlo's Bakeshop. They were super flavorful and moist. They weren't overly sweet. Just righty. We got the Coconut, vegan red velvet, rainbow confetti, and dark chocolate. I think my fav was the dark chocolate. That frosty was so rich and creamy. I wish I could have a right now! They need to put a Sprinkles in Miami like stat! Otherwise I have to travel to Orlando to get one! They also had Ice cream next door which I didn't not try as the line was log for that but it's an added perk!

The most delicious vegan soft serve I've had in quite some time. Opted for the coconut / pineapple swirl and it was a definite hit on a 90 degree Cleveland day. Eager to come back and try more flavors!

Wanted to grab the kids some donuts before they woke up and this place was a short walk from my hotel. I was expecting a line around the corner, like the one in SD every weekend, but lucky me i was 3rd in line. All of the creations looked soo good and it was hard choosing but my ultimate favorite was the creme brulee donut!. Once you crack thru that candy shell, that yummy custard oozes out and it's heaven! I also got an americano to go. I was in and out in less than 10 minutes, which is not typical. A must try!
Creamy, sweet, delicious! The service is friendly and memorable! Way to be a local business with great food and service! If you haven't been there you have to go! A real Phoenix gem!

****3.5 STARS**** So BuzzFeed listed this place as one of the 27 must visit ice cream shops before you die. I don't think this place should have made the cut. It's good but, not amazing good. I was in town with my family helping my sister move in for school. I was really excited to try this place after seeing the list on BuzzFeed. I LOVE ICE CREAM! I could eat it everyday! What We Ordered - Ice Cream Sandwich: 2 Cookies (Kitchen Sink and Chocolate Chunk) with 2 Ice Cream Flavors (Cookies & Mint and The Stout) - Fat Elvis Sundae - S'Mores Sundae I got the ice cream sandwich. The Cookies & Mint and The Stout was a good combo together! I could have done without the cookies. The Staff recommended me getting the ice cream sandwich instead of the cone. The cookies were not that good. The Kitchen Sink Cookie was super hard!!! Not a fan of hard cookies...and no, they were not hard because of the cold ice cream. The Chocolate Chunk Cookie was really moist but too salty. I really like sea salt chocolate type cookies but this just had too much salt. :( I was really sad... I usually love cookies too. $5 for basically just the ice cream, not worth it. :( My sister's boyfriend got the Fat Elvis. He seemed to enjoy it. My sister LOVED her S'Mores Sundae but she wished there were more Graham crackers in it. I did not like the fact that there were no inside seating. Arizona is super hot. Why would there not be any indoor seating?! They had tables outside but there were a bunch of flies flying around back there. :( -1 STAR for hard/salty cookies -0.5 STAR no indoor seating and they limit the amount of samples you get

This is by far the best pastry ever! I will never be able to eat another cannoli that will measure up to the one I had here. Unfortunately I live in Charlotte, NC so I will only be able to indulge once a year.

For boba drinks, it's only 3 stars worthy. The matcha tastes good, nothing amazing. The boba had a weird texture, seemed to be undercooked.. maybe if we tried the ice cream it would get better ratings. But I wouldn't recommend it for boba. Very aesthetic but not so tasty. We're boba fiends seeing as we have our own straws. BYOS!

I've never seen the show, but have heard about it amongst other food network lovers. Every time I'm in Vegas, there's always a long line for this place. On my most recent trip, I decided to sample what was so great about this place by ordering two of the most popular items on the menu: lobster tail and cannoli. I don't have a sweet tooth, so the richness of the cream filling wasn't very appetizing for me. My partner in crime has a fondness for saccharine sweetness and even he wasn't liking the richness or quantity inside the pastries. If you happen to like cream puffs, then you would definitely enjoy a bigger version with all the filling. I might come back again to sample some other things, but for the price and mediocre quality, you're better off trying the other pastries in Vegas that come in Bouchon or Jean Phillipe form.

Mmmmm. A fantastic little dessert spot. We are from out of town and are so happy that we stumbled upon Churn. Delicious ice cream and non dairy choices. We'd love to come back if only we lived closer.

While this little Bouchon outpost has decent espressos and very nice service, I have been disappointed in the famous Keller macarons each of the three or four times I've had them. Macarons are my favorite treat and these have simply been stale every time. They are hard, not crisp and light. I can't eat the other bread-y things because I'm gluten intolerant, so I can't speak for those items. I would come back for the espresso though, certainly.

The three staff members working at 9:00pm on January 14th were AWESOME! Super friendly two guys and girl and they recommended the best ice cream flavor! They even out a toasted marshmallow on top. Everyone who's in the area should come check this place out. Clean, friendly and DELICIOUS! 10/10

Awesome donuts, more expensive than the Krispy Kreme and Dunkins of the world for obvious reasons. Don't go expecting a dozen for 10 bucks, but go expecting some awesome donuts in flavors you never thought of.

Now that I'm an Old Brooklyn native, I felt it was a right of passage I was behind on to make a Jack Frost Donuts run. But when I finally got around to it, the donuts did not disappoint.... but the customer service did. I went very early before work, shortly after they opened, and there was already a line. When I got to the counter, several flavors were already sold out. From there, I had the intimidating task of picking a dozen to fill my box..... without any labels to assist me in identifying what was what. I asked the young woman at the counter for help, and she was clearly annoyed and rushed me quite rudely. I had been excited to pick out their famed unique flavors as a gift for my husband on a special occasion. Instead, I felt pressured to just hurriedly pick based on looks and get out, not really knowing much about what I was getting, and ended up with some duds... flavors and surprise fillings that had I known what they were, I would've known he wouldn't like them and avoided picking them. At Jack Frost's premium donut prices, I expect much friendlier and helpful service. (And surely labels are a simple, easy fix?) So while the donuts we did like were tasty, I honestly have no desire to wake up that early for another unpleasant customer service experience.
The best service and great ice cream! The owner was so sweet and welcoming. We had the oatmeal cookie ice cream and it was awesome. Can't wait to come back!!

I have passed by this place a few times and have seen others post about it but I have never had anything from Milk Bar. For my birthday, my cousin said for us to get a slice of Crack Pie and I agreed. It was super bomb BUT I have no idea how to describe the taste lol. I would just recommend for you to try it and see for yourself. Apparently, they are changing the name "Crack" pie soon to just Milk Bar Pie or something like that due to the negative connotation (seriously people?!?).

It didn't live up to the hype. I purchased a cupcake and a brownie. Neither item was something that I would go back for. The place was super crowded so I guess others disagree, but I definitely think you can skip this during your trip. There's another bakery in the Venetian that I will try next time.

Honestly, Amelie's owner- management team needs to visit: Kings Bakery - Ziggys -- for baguettes - great rolls for sandwiches, brioche buns and of course, Caramel Patisserie in Salem, Mass and./or take a trip to SFO Chantal Guillon 's and Tartine, in Seattle's La Parisienne, or Ken Bakery, Nuvrei, Baker and Spice, Jinju, Little T, in Portland, Oregon. Ahh! those who truly know how to replicate France's refined pastry shops Amelie might have created fame, been great at one point... now days it is filthy, in need or a great revamp, cleaning and dusting with indifferent staff who must ingest a strong coffee before they open the doors; they are simply indifferent to the point of arrogance. Southern hospitality it is not, FRESH superb pastries are lacking, , good sandwiches NOT at all 1st with Covid ALL areas are to be clean - disinfected - sanitized at least! 2nd Simple hygiene - dusting is necessary to remove all bacteria and germs 3rd Donate your day-old food - do not serve it to your paying guests in the am, this is uncalled for! Macaron is overrated; BAKE something memorable BESIDES a brownie! like CHOUQUETES, bake own tart base don't use boxed ones, really!
These cupcakes were so pretty looking bit very dry as Hell. The icing was Awesome! Too Bad Cupcake Boss but your Cupcakes Sucks!!

This place is really good! Their ice cream is super tasty. I love how you can build your own cookie ice cream sandwich. The cookies they bake are so yummy! I would literally buy a pack of them if they sold them. Their customer service is good they are very friendly and helpful. Their menu is good they have already built sundaes or if you like to build your own you can as well. During the summer they can get very busy at night. The place has a lot of character too it looks like a 50s ice cream shop. Overall great place for ice cream with anyone.

I've never really had a good experience with Hopscotch in the past, so decided to give it another go after winning a gift card from a game night. However I do like the idea and the location and it's nice to have a bakery in town like this. First thing to know though is the staff is generally rude and if you have questions - lord help you because they'll either act like you're dumb or act like their life is ruined by you asking anything. Second thing to know : DO NOT ORDER COFFEE. Just don't - it tastes sour .. somehow. Just go somewhere else.. Third: do not get bakery items such as cakes or muffins- will 100% always be dry I recommend the lemon bar or bread pudding when it's available. The ambiance is really cute but I think that's what draws people. They also sell fun little things like notebooks, stickers and even kitchen supplies which are great for gifts. Their website is also user friendly right now due to Covid, but remember you cannot go in and browse. Overall it was exactly as expected. Mediocre quality and a cute aesthetic.
Amazing atmosphere with unique decor! Great desserts and small bites that are perfect for a quick brunch:)

Pastries? Amazing. Coffee? Stellar. Chicken salad croissant? Delicious. Turkey & Brie? Yummy. Service? Must be keeping it Paris authentic, because rude is the word that first comes to mind. From the pastry box filler to the cashier. This place gave me anxiety and had my wife not had her heart set on this place (and already filled a box with pastries), I would have walked out. Menus people could look at while they are in line would make this process move much quicker, and staff understanding that you can't see the menu until right before you order would make it much more of a pleasant visit.
Long line, inefficient staff. Maybe my expectations were too high but it just wasn't as good as I was hoping for the calories. We had the bread pudding and carrot cake cookie. Eh.

This is for the location by the escalator-to go only. Shame on Venetian/Thomas Keller to hire such rude people. We waited in line and the place one orders is before you get to the other food "showcase" around the corner. My wife and I told the employee that asked for order to hand on, we want to see the 2nd case. When we came back around to order, she RUDELY and obnoxiously told us not to cut into line and go back to the end f the line. Thankfully, the couple behind said we were ahead of them and to let us order. We put in our order and received our order, less an ice brew coffee. I simply asked were were missing a coffee and again we were rudely told they are out of coffee and making some more and to be patient. Could there not be a better way of saying that? RUINED the entire experience to have a coffee and pastry.

My favorite item is not only their coffee but their spinach, asparagus leek soup which is 9 times out of 10 always available on their menu with another signature soup of the day. I tend to pair it with the chicken goat cheese and sun dried tomato sandwich for a 1/2 soup, 1/2 sandwich choice. Everyone is super friendly and nice to be around as I'm stressing getting my work done for school haha

I usually dont give reviews but this has definitely been a lousy experience. Ice cream was mediocre and service is horrible. I understand they have a lot of customers everytime i pass by. But today happens to be one of those days wherein there was only two of us in line. Employee was rude and impatient, rushing me so i can finish my order. This was my FIRST time, it's not like i can memorize the names of ice cream flavors available and the flavor options were located in the middle so had to keep on going back and forth to give ____ my order. Seriously if you have issues pls dont bring it to work. Really disappointed.

I could pay $3 for a whole cartoon of walmart brand ice cream and its about the same. Not bad, but nothing special. Went for The Flight, but was told NOT SERVING because manager trying to decide whether to charge more for it?? Really hard to find, sign really small and lots of construction. Wouldn't bother coming again...

I was in town for a business trip and stayed in the hotel nearby. It was hot and I wanted something cool and fresh. The moment I walked into the store, I was greeted immediately by a young lady behind the counter. Everything on the menu looks really good and I finally decided to go for Shrimp Avocado Crepe with the help of the young lady. Even though it was pretty busy, but I got my crepe in just a few minutes. The avocado is just right and the shrimp is crispy, the flavor is delicious. and the setting is very comfortable. Overall I am impressed with my experience. They deserve a thumbs up!

Everyone in our family loves batch. It's near our house, it's cute, and everything is super delicious. Sadly, they most often run out of their star menu item - the simple butter croissant - very early in the day, even though they are open until 6pm. I drop my older child at school by 7:40am, and right after, my little guy and I used to sometimes stop at Batch to get croissants for his preschool teachers. Increasingly, they have been sold out before 8am. Three of the four times I stopped there this week, always before 10am, they were already sold out of croissants, and I wasn't the only one asking for them. "Susan," of Batch, comments above (responding to one of the previous reviews), that they often run out early, and one should call ahead if planning to stop by for a croissant. I can see ordering ahead a couple of dozen croissants for a party or something, but call ahead if you want one croissant (a featured menu item) at 8am, from a bakery that is open until 6pm? That's pretty silly. I understand that predicting demand for baked goods is an art, and that it is not desirable to have leftovers at the end of the day, but if you're coming up short a couple of hundred butter croissants a day from the demand perspective, maybe it's time to fiddle with the equation. If it's after 7:30am, and we want a good croissant, we now head down the street to Madison Sourdough. It might not quite equal Batch's croissant, but it's really delicious, and it'll pretty much always be in stock until early afternoon (certainly beyond 8am!).

Such a sweet spot in the middle of the desert. If you are driving by you'd have a hard time seeing it. The great thing about Phoenix is meeting new people and hearing about cool off the wall places you'd never probably find on your own. I love the feel right when you walk in and the cute art on the walls. You're always welcomed the second you open the door and can always sample the flavors to get your perfect treat. You can get a sugar, waffle or regular cone, a warm donut filled icecream, Waffle....bowl . It's endless. There's plenty of outdoor seating and if you're like me you can walk down Grand and check out all the other cool art. I heard a while back that the houses that hold these little shops held pow's in the war, but still researching to see if that's true. That would be a cool piece of history. Do yourself a favor and check this place out. Today I had peanut butter icecream with bacon in it and it was amazing. Yum!
Amazing ice cream & desserts! Staff is always friendly and helpful, you will not regret coming here.
This place is ok. The girl who waited on us was great, I just think the prices are a little high. The ice cream is good, however.

There's only one thing in the world that could possibly be better than sex with Alessandra Ambrosio-- sex with a Sweet Republic Ice Cream covered Alessandra Ambrosio. It's that good. Anyone have her phone number?

Got a fabulous custom made bday cake today for a friend! Absolutely delicious! Have had other baked items there and all were on point! Great local couple owns it and knows what they are doing! Stop in if you want a real bakery here in Charlotte.

Best Rocky Road ice cream alive. And in the perfection location of a ton of great restaurants. Anytime we eat off 7th street, we stop by Mary Coyle's for some good ol' fashion ice cream! Highly recommended! My hubbys favorite is the Cashew Salted Caramel!
This place is amazing lol truly. I've tried some other local ice cream shops but churn is my favorite. The inside is super cute and the patio is very relaxing.

This was a little kiosk behind the escalator. It doesn't offer any seating which seemed odd to me. We got green tea but I think they gave us Earl Gray. We also purchased a Buchon which is a brownie bite. Good service, reasonable prices for Vegas but no need to go back.
Cupcakes were good and order process was smooth. 2 dozen cupcakes for over $80 is really expensive but I needed convenience since I was out of town. Price was my only complaint.

Real French baking in faux Venice. Oh, Thomas Keller, you devil! My boyfriend and I almost bought out the place. If you are a hungry foodie with a sweet tooth, be vewy vewy careful or you will plunk down money you never knew you had to eat here. Everything was amazing. Everything. The pistachio macaroon, the chocolate tarte, the Danish cheese pastry, the red velvet cupcake, the vanilla eclair, the BLT baguette sandwich toasted to perfection (though it hurts your jaw after a while), the namesake Bouchon cake, the brioche...OH MY GOD, I am drooling on my work computer as I type this and I don't know how I'll explain it to IT if my computer breaks down!

I have eaten a lot of ice cream, in my lifetime, and I can honestly say, that this is some of the best ice cream, that I've ever eaten in my entire life. I go there frequently, and the chocolate peanut butter brownie, is top notch! I go here at least three times a week! Highly recommended....

Delicious! And great service. They didn't mind my indecisive manner and were very patient with me. I got Fruity Pebbles ice cream and it was magical nostalgia. I am glad I tried the flavors first because I was excited for Captain crunch ice cream, but the pieces weren't broken up like the Fruity Pebbles, so it was noticeably soggy cereal. The prices are a bit steeper than other places, but it's homemade and so unique in flavor. Worth it!

Fresh baked goods. I'm here to talk about their Stromboli. The meat one, super delicious. The spinach & sausage, even better than the meat one. Their pizzas are almost like Sicilian style. Thick crust and very traditional. Guys, when they ask you if you want the red sauce... trust me say YES you definitely want it. It's probably the best I've tasted in little Italy. Their cannolis are also fresh and flavorful without being to sweet. So lucky to have this place in my back yard!
Rewind is amazing! I had the green tea soft serve and the pink drink with crystal boba. Both were very tasty and I'd definitely recommend.
Amazing donuts, but go early as when they run out that's it ! Nice team working in there ! Can't wait to return my next visit to Vegas.

even though i am trying to lose weight, me and my friends decided to give this place a go because of the great reviews. the concept of a donut bar is kind of unique and cool, so definitely worth a quick visit if you have nothing to do. the donuts were fresh and tasted pretty good. only had two because i wasn't feeling well but my kids ate a bunch, so going with their thoughts rather then mine on the taste!

Good tasting desserts. The red velvet cake is perfect, great flavor with cream cheese frosting that is not over powering. I also purchased a cannoli, which was delicious. Chocolate chips were in the cream which was an added surprise. The prices are rather high but you are paying for the name. I would hands down purchase from this location again. They were quick and spot on with the way they were running the bakery.

This place is delicious if you're looking for inventive ice cream flavors that are still a texture and sweetness that one wants from an ice cream parlor. We got pints with a couple flavors and they are still delicious the next day. The black sesame has a nuttiness (a more savory choice) that pared well with the sweet light taro ice cream. We also got oatmeal cream pie (exactly as it sounds!) and Mexican chocolate (a wonderful sweet heat with the cayenne). They do cakes too! For my birthday a couple years ago I had a vegan cake with garbanzo meringue and vanilla lavender ice cream- so decadent! I've been to "creative" ice cream places before, but this one delivers the unique and still maintains that "you scream I scream" idea of this anytime sweet treat. The service was also super friendly. It's a little more expensive than something from the store, but obviously worth it.

Everything I expected and more! We bought a variety (chocolate marshmallow, salted caramel and the milk chocolate) and we couldn't decide which is our favorite because they're all so good! So good! Highly recommend.
Churn is my favorite ice cream shop! I am obsessed with their gluten free macaroons with the Vietnamese coffee ice cream! It is mouth watering!!

As far as ice cream goes, this is where it's at! This review is brought to you buy someone who isn't even that into ice cream. If you gave me the option of desserts, ice cream would be at the bottom of my list. BUT, not this ice cream, its more than just ice cream, its magic! My favorite flavor is the Banana Cream Pie! It has homemade marshmallows, organic bananas, and homemade shortbread cookies layered throughout a delicious banana flavored ice cream. Sometimes i like to pair it with the chocolate peanut butter cup ice cream. This location is where they make their ice cream, and you get the joy of watching them make it if you see fit. You can walk around on the main floor, or take the stairs, or elevator up to a loft area and watch them do their magic! Worth the short walk from the Westside Market, or really from anywhere. Go check it out!!!

My friends and I went today, a typical hot Phoenix summer day; what better time to try out a place that serves cold treats, right? The very friendly folks staffing the place let us try a variety of the ice cream and sorbet flavors - all very good ... and definitely the ube (purple taro) ice cream is a must-try! I ordered the all-time Filipino cold dessert favorite, halo halo. The Filipino word "halo" means mix, and indeed this refreshing item consists of shaved ice, milk, and a mixture of different kinds of Filipino dessert items such as kaong (sweet palm fruit), garbanzo beans cooked in syrup, ube jam, flan, and more; all of this is topped with ube ice cream. Needless to say, it's a pretty heavy dessert item but so good. This ice cream shop is really a sweet delightful place and so conveniently located too: it's on Central Avenue across the street from the St. Francis Parish Church, near the Camelback / Central Avenue stop of the light rail.

Page's has was a staple of my childhood and young adult life. There ice cream is great and their prices are good--evident by the line that is always out to Carson St. I wish they had a tent with seating. It rains. . .ALOT in Pittsburgh. Eating in your car is the signature of this place but I wish there was some covered seating.

I had a Sprinkles Sundae with a coconut cupcake and vanilla ice cream. The cupcake Itself was a chocolate cupcake. It was moist and not too sweet however I prefer a classic white cake. The frosting was sweet but not too sweet and complimented the cupcake. The vanilla ice cream was okay. It was icy and could not taste any vanilla. It reminded me of soft serve. My daughter had a strawberry cupcake with strawberry ice cream. It was flavorful and tasted like strawberries. The store is really cute and the staff was very helpful & friendly.

Mitchell's is one of the best ice cream shops in the nation! Whenever I try new ice cream shops I am always craving Mitchell's. The variety is perfect and the specials are always great. Pistachio is a classic but honestly there are no bad flavors. Service is wonderful and although in the summer lines can be long it's worth the wait!
Good ice cream, our choice was a bit sweeter than what we usually like, but it was flavorful and creamy.
A+ great flavors and quality ice cream, baked options. There are a lot of interesting flavors like the Jameson! Glad I chose this shop for my vacation!

I was so excited to finally get to the Linq Promenade to try a Sprinkles cupcake, and I was sadly disappointed. The cupcakes are super size Small and the flavor was very bland. We ordered a Chocolate Marshmallow and a standard Vanilla with sprinkles.The cake was pretty dry and had hardly any flavor. The frosting for the vanilla one was quite funky-monkey(not sure what it was, hard and not like frosting at all?). And, I will add, the price? Not worth it at all $3.75 for a tiny tiny cupcake? No thanks Girls were nice in the store, I guess that is the positive part of my experience there. Not what I was expecting at all, very sad... But, hey it was a beautiful night for a stroll at The Linq.
Blonde lady taking orders is rude and should not be representing your business I know your product is amazing bit lady was just not a people person!
michelle l helped us at the second day of the grand opening and she was very friendly and welcoming! tried to tip but they dont accept, boo :-(

Jason was so welcoming! I had a good experience here. He was the only one at register, which was a bit concerning especially since there was a line, but he was trying his best and it made my day. He was connecting w other customers and made sure each one was taken cared for.
Great little ice cream stand in Sidney. Delicious and inexpensive and excellent service from friendly staff! I highly recommend a stop and you too will be hooked!

Charlotte, NC- A taste of Paris in the middle of the south. I highly recommend it from its coffees to it's pastries to it's sandwiches Amelie's does an excellent job providing an atmosphere that transports you to Paris
Wanted to write a good review but I couldn't the line was so long!!!!!!!! Went there twice!!!! Sad I really had high expectations

Inventive flavors and a creamy base. We tried the County Cherry, Superman and the "$#&@ about to get real", lol... that last one was so decadent, I couldn't finish it, but I loved it! Very friendly service and only $10 for all 3. ( that's the best price I've found in any gourmet ice cream shop in a downtown area) We will stop here every time we are in Madison!

This Jeni's location just opened, so the line was out the door and down the sidewalk. We persevered anyway, because I've heard such great reviews and tried one of their pints sold in grocery stores. The space is pretty small, but service was fast. Scoopers were friendly and ready to serve. The best deal on the menu is definitely the trio of half scoops with additional scoops $1 each. We got five unique flavors, and my favorites were the rainbow sorbet and frose (both amazing to combat the heat). The trio comes with waffle wafers, so double yum! There are window counters inside and outside, but just be warned, there aren't any public restrooms! Really look forward to trying their other flavors. If you join their email list, they also offer free ice cream on your birthday, yay!
awesome ice cream !!!! so many tasty flavors to choose from. sometimes there can be long lines but it moves quickly. they are very generous with samples too !

I ordered a scoop of lemon meringue pie and peanut butter brownie. I wasn't given the lemon meringue and the one I was given was tasteless and waxy. I think they got it out of tubs of generic grocery store ice cream. Don't waste your money.
These doughnuts are delish!!! This place is a family favorite and highly recommended!! These classic doughnuts are the real deal!

The pastries are perfect.. pricy but perfect. They are not too sweet which is great because you really taste quality ingredients rather than having something overwhelmed of just sugar. It is the only place locally I was able to find a sfogliatella. They also make a great slice of cheesecake and their turnovers are excellent as well. Although I am very shy and say nothing coming in, I get a warm good morning greeting walking in.

Solid ice cream, interesting flavors. Sometimes can be a little icy, but not usually. I don't know why everyone's raving about that pretzel cone, though. I love pretzels, but this thing was way too hard to eat without completely smashing it and getting ice cream everywhere. And super salty! I figured that would go well with my butter pecan ice cream, but it was too much. Ended up tonguing my ice cream out of the cone and tossing the thing in the trash. Next time I'll stick with the paper cup!
I get the pizza every time I visit. I love that there is always ample sauce so I can enjoy it room temperature rather than warmed up. It's so good I'll even grab a slice after eating at Mama Santa's.

I could move into this little ice cream cabin of heaven, curl up into a ball on the floor with some blankets and a pillow (maybe a good book) near the ice cream freezer.......with a long spoon, and simply lift my head off my pillow and scoop more of their delicious ice cream onto my long handled spoon and be happy for the rest of my life. Their ice cream is FRIGGIN DELICIOUS. The people who work there are FRIGGIN NICE AND COOL. The prices are FRIGGIN reasonable. The flavors are FRIGGIN OUT OF THIS WORLD. They have samples! We couldn't decided between the amazing artisan flavors they offered so went full piggy and ordered the ice cream "flight". Oh, yes people, they have ice cream flights. It doesn't get any better. Oh wait, yes it does! They had a "Leslie Knope" waffle ice cream sandwich. Homemade, warm waffles with a scoop of ice cream in between. Who doesn't love Leslie Knope, waffles, and ice cream??? I loved the little courtyard where we sat and enjoyed our treats. I DID NOT like the stupid billboard I could see from the courtyard depicting our president with nazi signs. Not the businesses fault but damn that was obnoxious. I don't care what you think about our president, that is over the top. I will be happy to return when I am in Phoenix and just hope they have a different billboard by then. All in all, amazing stop! :)
Absolutely amazing. Flavor combos are unreal ... if you like classic cereals, you have to visit this place!!
Just got takeout from here during COVID, I sure hope they survive. Such good pastries and desserts!!
Overpriced on a lot of things, but open late and the salted caramel brownies are delicious!

4 Stars: Yay! I'm a fan. Thomas Keller pretty much gets a free pass on GP, but Bouchon Bakery is nice because for not much more than the price of your hotel starbucks, you get decadent baked goods that are worth waiting at least 4-6 minutes in line for. I'm not certain you can go wrong with any of the baked goods here unless you are super picky about your preferences on the way certain baked goods are prepared, or if you are just being troublesome for the sake of having a more cultured palate than everyone in your circle. I find it a little humorous that you can buy pain epi that are complimentary at Bouchon proper. If you've eaten these, you may have a sardonic grin on your face right about now. I've contemplated purchasing these a la carte before. I've also stuffed my face with about a dozen of these at the bistro. My only qualms are with the line, which at peak times can be ridiculous, the servers, who can be inattentive or somewhat forgetful when it comes to your order or requests that accompany your order, and that not all items are available year round, especially some of the fruit preserves, and without a website, or public forum to announce availability, sometimes you just need to call beforehand to see if they have something you are looking for. Also, they run out of things, which is a given considering it's not a huge location. They are a little counter tucked under a stairwell. But certainly add this place to your list of early morning haunts. I'd rank it above Payard, below Jean Philippe Patisserie. So it's good. And make sure you buy a bag of bouchons (6 for $10) to go and don't forget to ask for a little bit of raspberry sauce on the side. Heat those puppies up in the oven for a few minutes, pour some of the raspberry sauce on top, make obscene noises while consuming.

The shop itself is quaint. A bit pricey, but it's fine. My main issue is for anyone looking to order a cake or pastries for an event. I had been in contact with the owner, Kaya, since June/July for a wedding cake for May (I like to be prepared). Communication was minimal on her part. She'd email me once every week or two weeks. At first she seemed open to customization and personalization for the cake, then pulled every excuse in the book to avoid working with me (she could do it on a tiered cake, we didn't want a tiered cake, well then she just couldn't do it). My main issue is that i don't like their buttercream. I've seen some reviews stating it as heavenly. This might be true, as it's pretty close to eating a slab of whipped butter; it will definitely get you closer to death. She wouldn't make a shortening based icing. I then asked for their cream cheese icing (it's pretty tasty) and she then sent me an email that they updated their website with available flavors and she looked forward to working with me. This was in October. We had been working with each other for months. And on the new website, guess which icing WASNT an option anymore? Cream cheese. Unless you are a friend or want exactly what she'll make for you, don't expect a lot of great customer service. I don't know if she's just got too much on her plate or what, but she definitely needs to work on communication skills or hire someone else to organize custom orders.

I must admit that my guests and I were very disappointed with the pastry. It was very busy as expected but it wasn't long before we were served. We could not resist but to try buddy's desserts, only to find out it was mediocre. I would not spend another dime there but that does not stop me from being a huge fan of the show. Love you Buddy...just not your desserts!

Not worth the hype!!! The cereal milk soft serve tasted odd (they were also cheap on the fudge) and the cake offerings were over the line sweet, making them not enjoyable. You're better off somewhere else for dessert!

I love this place. I was a little turned off at first by a few things: One, this is an outdoor place. You go up to the window to order and there are only benches outside to eat at (which are really hot in the summer, so we ended up eating in our car with the air on). Two, some of the flavors have strange names, so you don't know what they are unless you ask. Three, it was kind of a long wait and there weren't that many people there. But, the good outweighs any negatives here. The staff are very helpful. I asked what some flavors were and they were happy to tell me. They gave us samples of the flavors we wanted to taste. I asked one employee for her recommendation on a flavor, and I'm so glad I did. We got the four flavor sampler, and that's the way to go. It's around $4.25 for four scoops of ice cream. We had strawberry, a graham cracker flavor, a black raspberry flavor, and salted carmel truffle. All of which were incredible. I would highly recommend eating here.
Aw it's all cute and old timey. Flavors are good too.

Finally got to Sweet Republic after wanted to try it for awhile. We arrived around 1pm or so and were the only ones in the shop (though two other parties came in shortly thereafter). The employee behind the counter was very helpful, offering up as many samples as we wanted (I was good and only had two!). The wife and I decided to split a 3-scoop cup, with Salted Butter Caramel, Almond Buttercrunch and Sugar & Spice (at least I *think* it was Sugar & Spice, I tried to grab a to-go menu while we were there but they didn't have any printed up at the time). They were all good, I probably liked the Almond Buttercrunch the best (huge candied pecans mixed in!). I also sampled the Malted Vanilla flavor, and wow...anyone ordering this as a shake is in for a real treat... I'd be more likely to make it back here if it was a little closer, but probably won't make a special trip just to go here. I'm sure I'll go again when I'm in the neighborhood though.

relatively expensive but the location is awesome especially if you are staying at the cosmopolitan and they are open till 2am everyday which is nice. my girlfriend had the white russian adult milkshake, and it was sweet but she loved it. all their ingredients are top quality and it is very clean.

The smell of this place is worth it alone. 4 stars because the pricing is a bit on the high end. $10 for 2 scoops of ice cream with almost no hot fudge on it. The San Francisco location piles it on a lot more .
Yum yum n yum!!! My only suggestion is that the use more filling in the macaroons, they were a bit disappointing when it came to flavor!

Amazing!! Great ice cream, tons of flavors and options and the people working (I believe the owners) were sooo nice and sweet!! They were so passionate about the ice cream and the different unique flavors they had. Definitely will be going back!
Not bad ice cream... I'd go Tuesday night (there's a good discount) I got ice cream sundae with fudge... give it a 4 when it comes to ice cream.

Personally i LOVE Sprinkles Cupcakes, always so good and baked right. Icing on top is delish with a circle candy on top! Banana cupcake is my all time favorite. Red velvet is great as well, but the lemon blueberry is to die for! Try them all, why not, you wont be disappointed

Cannot rave enough about this place. In back of an outdoor bar/cafe club in a revitalized area of downtown Grand Ave in a row of little stores behind the Third Space building. Heard about it but finally went at a social event held there tonight. The owners Brandon and Jenny stayed open later than they usually do on Sunday to accommodate us. The ice cream was better than the chain stores, ice cream stuffed donuts, cups, cones,a row of every type of topping possible. Glass bottle sodas, waffle ice cream sandwiches, cereal toppings, real oreo cookie toppings. Welcoming owners. I will be back. People, support your local businesses, they are here to serve you.

Believe the hype! Most novelty places don't give good portions or decent prices, but Donut Bar is jot one of those places. All their menus items are well worth the price and that's not including the atmosphere with the backyard and hole-in-the-wall set up. They offer vegan options and non vegan options worh some specials on certain days. The French Toast donut on the weekend is my favorite!!
Best tea cake I've ever had. Great chai latte... right balance for spice (get it with oat milk.) Friendly and comfortable atmosphere.
Who doesn't like homemade ice cream!? They make it there in the store. Had the Vanilla.. Terrific!!
I bought two cupcakes here and I was terribly disappointed. The cake was dry and rather lacking in flavor. I am afraid that a Target cupcake was fresher. I would not buy a cupcake here again.

Love this place! I walked there from my house and I will be back the next time I am craving ice cream (which is often). They have a variety of flavors and I love how you can get a marshmallow and a macaroon on top of your scoops. For sure a hidden gem.
Great staff. We got there late when most of the day's supply was already gone. But the staff was very friendly and still had some great options available for us. Also very affordable!
Definitely a nice place to unwind after a long day. Enjoyed a exquisite dessert with a hot cup of coffee while the soothing music and light chatter of people fill the room. Most highly recommend!
Love this place! I had a scoop of the Vietnamese coffee ice cream and my son had a butter pecan shake. Plan to visit again when I'm in town.
Great place Great to people watch. Open 24/7. Free wifi. Different rooms to sit and talk and work
Carol and I went here are part of the Tour DeFood Sunday Sunday tour and it was Awesome!

As much as I love donuts and I love ice cream, I couldn't imagine how mind blowing the combination could be. Ice cream inside a warm donut? WOW! The flavors are delicious and the ice cream is dense and creamy. The donut is glazed to perfection and the perfect consistency. The banana cream pie was hands down the best ice cream I've ever had!

PB chocolate allllll day. The absolute best flavor on the menu, no contest. (*Disclaimer: I haven't tried any others BUT they're always running out of it by the end of the night so I assume others enjoy it as well. *End of disclaimer) I love the old time vibes and incredibly kind staff. Always a good experience!

Salted caramel hot cocoa was one of the best thing I've tasted. It's been days since having one and I can close my eyes and still taste it. It was that amazing. If Charlie actually did go to a chocolate factory, I'm guessing he smelled the same aroma that hits your nose as you enter this store. So very magical. Everything is super expensive. But damn... that hot cocoa is so worth it.

This place is a lot of fun. The line was a bit long when we came, but I always take the as a good sign. They have a nice selection of interesting flavors and they have vegan options as well. We ordered a variety of flavors, the creme brulee, lemon pistachio, and strawberry strawberry split are my top picks. Their coffee is also pretty good. They are a bit pricey, but most of the donuts are huge, and they are pretty fancy donuts.

I was told ... when I'm Vegas make sure you stop here so of course I had to check it out! They're located right inside the cosmopolitan next to an Asian fusion restaurant. I asked them to give me there best recommended cookie and that's what I got! I got a warmed up cornflake chocolate marshmallow cookie - I've definitely had better cookies but I imagine if I were drunk and gambling, this cookie would've been mind blowing. I left a little disappointed but I would definitely give it another try.

I have now been to this location in Scottsdale as well as the Phoenix location. While the atmosphere here is nicer than Phoenix, the quality of the ice cream is the same. Not surprising since it probably all comes form the same place. I would say that it is mediocre. I tried the black licorice flavor. It was good, but definitely not the best ice cream in the valley. I still maintain that the cones and waffles bowls that they serve are better than the ice cream itself.

How can Cleveland be so lucky to have so many stellar ice cream options?! The flavors range from traditional to truly unique and it's so fun to try the ever changing menu. I like getting ice cream sandwiches from there. They are also totally immersed in the community too. We are obsessed with their ramen pop up nights. I recently had a baby and they went above and beyond standard customer service. Really grateful to be neighbors with an awesome and delicious business.

This is a great little joint. We stopped in here with some friends on a whim shortly before closing time but they still had all the flavors out and the staff was very nice, despite it being a few minutes before close. They were very nice about letting us try a few different flavors before ordering. I finally decided on the salted caramel which was excellent. My husband got the guiness chocolate and we another friend got the cinnamon. We all tried the bacon ice cream which was very unique and not bad at all. I tried the blue cheese ice cream and while it was good, I'm not sure I could do a whole scoop of it! They had some wonderful looking ice cream sandwiches with big cookies that I would like to try next time. I will definitely stop by here again.

Who doesn't love Ghiraradelli ?!? This Vegas location is across from in and out near the Ferris wheel. I shared a brownie sundae with my husband, it's super sweet and rich but delightful. The brownies were soft and baked with goodness. Three scoops of vanilla ice cream with placed on top of the warm brownies and a chocolate syrup to drizzled on top. We were able to use our yelp discount with no problem. Also when entering we were greeted with a free chocolate square, pretty much their signature greeting! The location is a nice size plenty of tables to sit and enjoy your ice cream. The service was quick and friendly and everything looked really nice and clean!!
Can't think of a better place to go get a sweet treat on a warm summer day. I would highly recommend Sweet Republic to anyone looking too cool down with some amazing ice cream!
Very good! I liked the coffee a lot and the ice cream was, of course, amazing. I also thought the employees were very friendly and welcoming. I'll definitely be back.
Definitely not what I was hoping for. I am an avid baker and purchasing from a professional bakery I always have high standards but the macaroons were dry and stale tasting

Picked up breakfast this morning and was pretty happy with the taste unlike the one from lavazza yesterday. The omelette had good smell of butter, chocolate almomd croissants were yummy and the parfait was pretty good along with coffee, hotchocolate and tea. Kinda of expensive but pretty good value! !

Don't give into the hype. I love buddy but after visiting his shop I was very disappointed. Everything looks very pretty but there is no flavor to any of it. I got the lobster tail, cannoli, orea cake thing, a cupcake.. All flavorless. :( I HIGHLY recommend going to Freed's if you're actually looking for great pastries and not just to visit a place that's on TV.
This place was a nice place to try but it's nothing special, especially for it's price. I probably prefer cold stone more than here.

Their ice cream is so delicious!!! We went to celebrate my daughters birthday and got a huge banana split for all 4 of us. It was incredible! They even put a candle in it for her so we could sing. Highly recommend! The shop itself is in a little strip mall that is not the greatest, but once you step in it is defiantly an old fashion style! Very cute!

We had a hard time finding this because the maps at the hotel are not very good. After asking several employees, WE MADE IT! I had been reading posts for months on Yelp, didn't know what to expect honestly. We arrived around 10:30am and there were hardly any people there. Ordered and paid quickly. Make sure you look at the prices because their things aren't cheap. I enjoyed my experience and I would go back. I ordered the lobster tail and 2 M&M cookies. My mom ordered a cream puff and my sister a cheesecake.

It's a walkup style ice cream shop. You place your order at the window and they prepare it right there. You can see inside from the window which is cool. There isn't anywhere to really sit, so expect to take it with you. This concept is exciting, but not in the Vegas heat because you wait in a line outside. They have so many ice cream flavors and mix ins. The best thing is that they have a banana split which is hard to find in Vegas! Sonic discontinued theirs so this is the next best place to get it.

I never got the chance to try the original location in California so I am happy I did since we got to stay at the Cosmopolitan. Since COVID, the hours and days are different for when they are open but if they are when you come you should definitely come try out their menu items. I went with their famous MILK butter pie. Rich buttery and great for a snack. If you feel adventurous you can try out their crazy concoctions of ice cream but I wanted something simple.

I do enjoy Carlos bakery however it seems everytime I visit they have less variety that's why 4 stars and not 5. I remember the first time I visited they had danishes and smaller bites today they had cake slices, cheesecakes, cupcakes, lobster tails which seem smaller and cannolis.

This is ice cream at its best! Tried Sweet Republic last week for the first time and it definitely lived up to the hype. Everything here is homemade, they support local diary farmers, and best of all, no artificial ingredients or preservatives! They rotate their flavors and offer 24 selections daily. It's a little pricey at $2.95 for a single scoop, but when you think about the quality of ingredients it's worth the extra cash. The sundaes look amazing and run around $7 (but include 2-3 scoops). I went with the Real Mint Chip, after being warned that it tasted unlike other "mint-flavored" ice-creams. The real mint flavor is fantastic, and the creamy texture did not disappoint. The store is located in a strip mall off the busy Shea/101 corridor near the Scottsdale Healthcare-Shea center. A little tricky to find, but the parking is easy.

We visited the Donut Bar on a Monday in late April. It wasn't busy. Great selection of donuts. The coffee was pretty awesome. We loved all the donuts, my favorite was the Strawberry Shortcake. Going into this visit I was expecting overwhelming sweetness. It was not the case. All donuts were well balanced!

Pros: Delicious desserts (cakes/pastries), coffee, tea, etc. Cookies, depending on what you get, are good but not the best I've had. Cons: Always pretty packed (and hard to get around inside due to space), and the number system with lots of people all around makes me a bit anxious. However, once you've been here a few times, you get used to it. I just make sure to look at all of the desserts and so that I am ready to choose when called.
My JF hiaku ; Jack Frost Makes Donuts Like saying The Beatles sang The Truth lies deeper. -------or------- As Jessie Pinkman would surely say: "DONUTS BITCH!"

Another visit another wonderful experience...late on a Wednesday night and there isn't a seat inside - always a great place to people watch, enjoy? some music and of course indulge in a wonderful dessert and drink. I nibbled on the fruit tart again this time and the berries and kiwi were just delicious! I sipped on a Chai Latte - Amelie's has my all time favorite! - as well and both were wonderful! If you've never been - I promise you that you won't be disappointed and they are open 24 hours a day - what's your excuse?!?!
Awesome donuts! Been getting their donuts since they were a popup. Really fresh, great variety, delicious, and super nice owners. Best vegan (or any) donuts ever!!

I was so excited to try the deserts from here after watching there shows so many times.... they did have a lot of options and yes there was a huge line so my rating is mostly on everything the pastries were really good I only got the lobster tail and chocolate cupcake which when I got home I wanted more to bad I live around 700miles away hahaha well anyways I lowered a star because they have BAD service the girl employees are so slow!!! I mean there's a huge line and there's only 3 girls helping with the order and than yhey stop to have a full conversation with each other!!! Like really do u not see the line !!! But besides there bad customer service the deserts are really good

Holy crap people. This is good ice cream. And while it LOOKS like a social media gimmick, the donut ice cream sandwich is super legit and delicious. (For those wondering, just the OUTSIDE of the donut is pressed and warm so no, it's not a drippy mess - that is key). Topping it off with the exceptionally nice humans working there means this is the place to be... honestly, don't miss it. Spend some time in the cool little hangout courtyard and make a friend or two over bomb ice cream.

Was my second time here and wasn't dissapointed! The first time I came here I had a strawberry shortcake sundae and today I had an XS sundae with strawberries and bananas. I really liked both sundaes I tried. My boyfriend got an XS chocolate sundae with fudge, his sister got a fudge brownie sundae, and her friend got a blue raspberry dipped vanilla cone. Everyone liked what they got! The only thing is I ordered a hot dog also and the actual hot dog tasted yummy but the bun was kind of weird. Other than that, it's a must go to if you're in Pittsburgh!

My wife and I came here as we were highly recommended to come here while visiting Cleveland. Just an average ice cream place. The ice cream was half melted. The shop was cute though. Disappointed. The waffle cone did not feel very crisp or fresh either.
A must do in Charlotte for baked goods and desserts, love the French patries. Inside decor is an experience in itself very eclectic, very artsy and cool.

I just recently found this delicious gem!! I luckily found it because Dairy Queen was closed and I was craving soft serve. I had no idea what I was in store for and was I ever in for a big surprise! I was especially surprised to find that they offer Red Bean TAIYAKI which is a warm fish-shaped waffle filled with choice of filling. Fillings include custard, taro, red beans and more! Red Bean Taiyaki was one of my favorite things when I lived in Japan and I've never been able to find it's equal in the USA until now. I also had the Milk Tea Swirl AH-BOONG which is their signature goldfish-shaped waffle cone stuffed with your choice of filling & soft serve. I chose the Custard filling and was so glad I did! Both of these items were super YUM! It's making my mouth water just writing this review so I think I better go back for more!!!

Carlo should focus on quality His bakery in Hoboken has been around for such a long time and is delicious ( it use to be anyway ) Spent 54.00 on some lobster tails and cannoli to bring home for a treat Got home and couldn't wait to try They were disgusting !! Literally threw them out They were old and had no flavor ! Shame on you Buddy for taking advantage and profiteering from tourists !!!

Warning! If you are a tourist and it's June 2022, you're going to have a tough time navigating in this area. There is a lot of construction that starts at the freeway and continues down into the neighborhood where this place is. It's in the downtown area. I'm sure they have great donuts but we couldn't find a way to get there. Literally, every route our very good routing system told us to take, we ran into another "construction obstruction." If you want to go, I'd call them for directions.

This place is pure magic. The gentlemen helping us were attentive and helpful with their recommendations. I enjoyed a MASSIVE piece of chocolate cake with a chocolate peanut butter ganache that was out of this world. I could only eat half. I also got a lobster tail which was delicious as well. Far superior than the other bakeries in town. Will definitely be back.
Wowowowowwowowowoowow I'm super satisfied with my cinnamon horchata ice cream donut! The area is also really nice at night

How does Prestis not have 5 stars!!! We have been customers since I was probably 5 years old. We absolutely love their cannolis and Italian cookies! When it's packed, which is most mornings!!, grab a coffee and enjoy waiting in line for their delicious pastries! Worth it!!

Over hyped and overpriced. Went on opening day..not much of a wait to order. I ordered the "Greatest Hits" combo and the strawberry-corn milkquake. Service was fast, but they did make a mistake with our order which resulted in a free sweet potato milkquake. The milkquakes (made only in Las Vegas) are supposed to be similar to a Dairy Queen blizzard. As I tried the strawberry corn milkquake, my first impression likened it to a McFlurry without an adequate spoon for eating. Milk Bar has flat wooden spatulas (larger ones are provided with the milk quake than what is on the counter). The flat spatula shape made it incredibly difficult to actually scoop the bits in the milkquake. The strawberry corn milkquake was a lot thicker consistency wise in comparison to the sweet potato milkquake we also had. Taste was so-so as I would often get a chunk of corn cereal or blob of strawberry jelly/preserve stuck in my "bubble tea sized straw). Presentation for the milkquake was also lacking. For $10, I expected something more than a clear plastic cup with a domed lid. Greatest hits combo: A nice option for those who are new to Milk Bar & want to try a little bit of everything. Presentation was lacking also as it comes in a basic brown paper bag "partially" stamped with the milk logo (see attached pics). I've had take out food presented in better packaging than this. The bday truffles were decent, but I feel like they don't match the 3 for $6 price tag (as they are very similar to a starbucks cake pop). Compost cookies were not anything special either. I know they're made up of Chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coffee, graham cracker crust, pretzels and even potato chips...but in all honesty, the flavors were muddled together and the cookie itself was drier and smaller than expected for a $3 cookie. The crack pie was ridiculously SMALL. Upon opening the clever cardboard packaging, I was shocked to realize that I had paid $6.50 for a slice of pie smaller than my hand. Marketed as a twist on the traditional Chess pie, the Crack pie was disappointing...if served independent from it's wrapper, i would not be able to identify anything unique about it. The cereal milk soft serve is just okay, a gimmicky flavor to try if you like cereal--as it tastes like cap n crunch flavored milk. All in all, my opening day experience at Milk Bar was disappointing. Presentation, portions, and taste just don't match the hype or cost. I believe there are plenty of other better looking and better priced options for sweets in Las Vegas...don't waste your dollars or calories on this one.

Amazing! Great price and delicious ice cream and toppings. You can really tell the people who work not only take pride in their business, but really love their job and their customers! Hidden gem. Been here several times and never disappointed. One word: go!
Best ice cream in Vegas hand down but I ordered ice cream for pick up today and none of the employees were wearing a mask .

Love the view, but I can get a better milkshake at Chick-fil-A for way cheaper. They will get you with the photos they have, but when it comes to taste it's average. Nothing special! Just being honest. Please go if you never been!

I had the cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes, and it was different. Was it like a bowl of cereal with even some flakes at the bottom to end the experience with a bang? Yes. Was it something I am longing to go back for? No, not at all. Maybe there is something else on the menu that would hit it on the head for someone who enjoys a truly wonderful ice cream from time to time, but this is too far off the mark to make that happen. Too sweet and a flavor, at least for this reviewer, that should still remain at the bottom of a cereal bowl.
Amazing interior, nice and professional stuff, great bisquits and pastry, main dishes weren't superb, but overall good. We will certainly go back. I recommend it for breakfast or lunch.

Delicious ice cream between two soft cookies--whose idea was this? That genius is my new best friend! Churn reminds me of my childhood days of going to the corner ice cream shop on Sundays. This place is also filled with my favorite childhood candies! What's not to like. I would have given five stars, but this place is making me fat.
So so happy to have an all vegan donut shop in the CLE. Awesome donuts and very kind and friendly staff. I highly recommend it!!

I would have given it 4 stars.... this is why I am giving it 3. ZERO control over social distancing, the line to pay was stacked up and there was no social distancing (6 feet is the standard) they were 2 feet apart WTF....... They need to control how many people are in there at a time, not hard.... just limit 10 customers in the business at a time. There isn't any excuse for that. Also, the they are slow as hell ringing people up and the guy over charged us. Simple math too, how many items price per item.... The wait in line is unacceptable for the amount of staff, get people moving, be more efficient getting the drinks out.

First thing I notice is how small and compact the place is. Area is fairly crowded and it might be a little difficult to navigate through. It might just be because the time of the day, around 6PM. First of all, service is amazing. The people are very nice and easy to talk to. Our order was fairly messed up though (missing items, got items we didnt order), but we're all human, so nothing too big. We posted a picture containing several items (lobster tail, chocolate mousse towers, cannolis, jelly cookie, eclairs, and 7 layered cookies). After trying all the items, I can say, personally, the only one I liked was the Lobster Tail. The cream was very light and fluffy and the outside was amazing. It had a light crunch, while the powdered sugar giving it a little more "character." I would definitely go back for more.(: However, the rest were fairly standard and bland. Two words doesn't do it justice. The jelly cookie tasted like a thicker sugar cookie. If you enjoy sugar cookies, i'm pretty sure you'll love these. Our picture shows a strawberry and watermelon shaped jelly cookie. All i'm saying is, super thick. 7 layered cookies has the texture of an andes mint, mainly due to the thick chocolate on top. It has a small layer of strawberry jam, with the rest tasting like cake. The eclairs were definitely my second favorite from this run. The inside is very jelly donut tasting (yes, poor choice of wording). The main hit is the bread. It's very light and easily compliments the filling. Oh, there's also chocolate on top. The cannoli has a fairly thick and crunchy shell. However, the inside is pretty light and just melts in your mouth. It kind of does break apart easily though. The tiramisu is SUPER light. I'll just leave it at that. You're eating coffee flavored clouds. Lastly, the Chocolate Mousse Tower. Heavy in chocolate and probably needs more strawberry to offset the thickness. It is Mousse, so you shouldn't be surprised. I did it enjoy it, but it gets overwhelming after a couple bites. Overall, interesting place. We had a lot of hype coming in here (my girlfriend has probably watched every episode of Cake Boss. One dream she had was to go to NJ to visit the bakery). I was just a little disappointed and probably won't be back unless its for lobster tails. We ordered a total of 10 different items and only recieved 7 of them. Big name, standard taste. Sorry Also, the organization needs working on. It'd be kind of nice to get everything we ordered.(:
Amazingly delicious! I love blended Thai tea drinks with boba and Rewind definitely was up there. Variety of flavors and decent sizes. They have ice cream options too.
Everything was wonderful. The monthly special "sriracha lime" was weird, but interesting. Hands down the BEST gluten free cupcake I have ever had! Tasted like a regular cupcake!!

I always wanted to go here and after a year I finally got to try it! The donuts are very sweet and huge!! You get the price for the looks.. however the creme brÃ»lÃ©e wasn't what I thought it would be, but it was still sweet and delicious! The pop tart donut actually has pop tart in it! It was super sweet, so prepare for your sweet tooth.

Innovative flavors that work out perfectly! I would say we order flights of savory flavors & fruity flavors! Lavender was the winner of the fruity & Bangkok was the winner of our savory. Note the Bangkok has a kick of spice so be ready for that! Definitely worth the wait in line!

Eh! Nothing special. Was craving chocolate cake so we decided to give in and check this spit out to see what the hype was about. We got there to a very long long line. The bakery was small with not a lot of seating. But the selection was big. Ordered a brownies which was tasty but very sweet. I didn't get the whole excitement of this place. I guess if you don't watch the show its not that thrilling of a place.

This review is for the cold brew and their macaroons. The cold brew was amazing. No bitter notes, very smooth! Their macaroons. Oh my god, I've never seen macaroons so large! They're about palm sized and they offer a variety of flavors. Got an box of Strawberry, chocolate, coffee, pistachio, and blueberry. I thought they were perfectly crafted while my girlfriend thought they were a bit too sweet. In her defense, I was having the macaroons with my cold brew black so maybe that was a nice complement. The line here can get a little long depending on when you arrive but the line moves fairly fast.

Thought it was pretty crazy that there was a line to go in and then a line to pay. Line outside to go into the bakery was about a 3-5 minutes wait. When you enter you grab a tray with some tongs and grab whatever desert you wanted and when you were ready you had to go into the line to pay which wasn't too bad, it was about a 5 minute wait. I wasn't in any rush or anything so I was patient and was willing to wait 10 minutes if I had to. Had I not had too much time on my hands then it would've been a different story. Anyway... first thing my son and I tried were the chocolate chip cookies. Super delicious. What made me even love them more was that my son said he couldn't stop eating them and that next time we go we should order a lot of them. He said that it was the best cookies he's ever eaten. ( he's 6 btw) I have yet to come back and try everything especially their cakes. Although you have to wait, I don't mind it at all. It's fun for my kids and super delicious.

My only complaint about Milk Bar is the prices. $4 a cookie is really steep. I read Tosi's books and even made a few of her treats at home. She does use premium ingredients. For example, the butter she uses is $8/lb at Whole Foods. She also uses Valrhona & Callebaut chocolate feves which is typically used by the finest chocolatiers @ 5-star hotels.

I drove out to purchase a dozen donuts for my friend's birthday party. As one of her favorite places, I wanted to love it, too. Upon walking in, no one greeted me. I'm a pretty independent chick, but I stood there for a few minutes before being acknowledged. I thought it was a little odd that no menu was posted explaining the flavors or their prices (Maybe it was down for cleaning?). When I told the gal it was my first time here, and asked for an explanation of what was available, she indicated that it was only what I see. This wasn't super helpful, as I know there are certain things we wouldn't love, like jelly filled, cherry flavored things, etc, and I don't typically spend money on things I can't identify. I continued to ask tons of questions and eventually I had 12 in the box. Literally, until I came home and read more Yelp reviews, I had NO idea they had more flavors that existed beyond the basic vanillas and chocolates that were available when I was there. The parking is super easy given the area, and the quality of the basic donuts I had were tasty. Given that they are a Cleveland institution, I am willing to come back and try again, and hopefully encounter more options, as well as a clear menu!

The Bouchon Bakery is a good find located by the elevators in the Venetian. You can have some of the Bouchon experience on-the-go essentially. We always stop in for the ham and cheese sandwiches, with a little bit of their mustard butter spread over the french baguettes. It's a very tasty sandwich and an excellent snack on the go. Their chocolate chip cookies are also big, buttery, and worth a try.

We are locals and came for random cupcake sundaes. They were so delicious. Highly recommend. The service could of been better. They ran out of many cupcake selections. The merchant hasn't adapted to ApplePay acceptance.

I came here for the Yelp Elite event Sunday evening. They closed the place just for us, and you could feel the tension in the air as the "regular schmegular" people walked up smiling, only to walk away in disgust. Oh well... I don't know if it was the fact that we were excited to try the ice cream, or that I'm sure many of us were having dessert BEFORE dinner! That NEVER happens in my world, but we all descended upon the place at once and the line was out of the door. Unfortunately, the weather did not care that we were standing outside because the rain began to pour down on us and we had to move our party inside. If you know anything about this place, it is small. So it became uncomfortable rather quickly, but as for me, I kept busy talking with a new friend from Florida and trying to narrow down my three top choices. I thought I was being proactive when I went online to look at the flavors and decide then, but the flavors were different. Just like many of the other ice cream shops, you are allowed to taste flavors before making a commitment. I tried the goat cheese with cherries and sweet corn with blackberries. In the end, I decided on the Gooey Butter cake first in the cone, followed by cream puff, and topped with goat cheese with red cherries. {Insert long, deep sigh here!} First of all, the flavors were strategically placed in the cone in a specific order because I had a feeling about that butter cake...everyone raved about it and whatever flavor is at the bottom of the cone, you get to enjoy most. See what I did there?!?! Let me just say that I live in the University City area and I would have zero problems driving over just for ice cream. On that note, go get some, it's totally worth it.

Love Love Love this place! The vintage decor is so charming. It invites you right in. They had a nice selection of desserts. I ate the Chocolate Cake with Strawberries and Buttercream. The cake was dense and chocolaty. The strawberries were fresh and the buttercream was light. It was very delicious. I wanted to try a little of all their creations. The young lady that helped us was delightful. I'll be back with my friends.

I first heard of Handel's Ice Cream from my bf. We decided to try the place since his dental professor claims it's the best ice cream in town! There was a line when my bf and I arrived at the location. I quickly noticed that Handel's was not your typical ice cream shop. Instead, they had two windows for placing your orders and a bench for sitting on the side. We didn't mind waiting in line, since there were so many flavors to choose from and the line seemed to move fairly quick. I ordered the "4 flavor sampler" that had butter pecan, birthday cake, cookies & cream, and rocky road. I was really impressed on how creamy the ice cream was, especially for the butter pecan! Pros: -$2 Tuesdays -Bigger Scoops (in a cone - except for the "4 flavor sampler") -Good Service -Affordable price for ice cream (awesome for those on a college budget!) Cons: No place to really sit Although I am lactose intolerant, I still make occasional stops for that butter pecan & waffle cone! Just pop in some lactose pills and you're good to go! I've tried Blue Bell & Cream... in my opinion, it still does not compare to the quality of Handel's Ice Cream.
In love with this place! Went for the first time this weekend and i loved it! Super adorable little place and delicious ice cream!!

The best dessert place in town. I was always satisfied with their amazing choice of menu and the taste. The ambience is perfect and the best part - it is open 24 hrs. When I'm hungry at middle of night I would head out to Amelie's.

Best bakery in town (I think, if there's better I would like to try it too because this is beyond delicious) Cookie dough macaron: 10/10 taste just like cookie dough whole thing is great Dulce de Leche macaron: 7/10 it was a little crunchy I think because I went there late and it could've been sitting out, S'mores macaron: 7/10 wish it tasted more like a s'more than what I got. More like Lobster tail: 8/10 the filling is light and airy, crunchy outside, powdered sugar tops it off well Mocha macaron 6/10 I don't know how I felt about it, it tasted like mocha just not one of my faves Cinnamon Toast Crunch Macaron 9/10 taste like the cereal, really good Cookies & cream macaron 10/10 tasted just like it, soft chewy everything you'd want Lavender macaron: 5/10 I'm not a lavender fan, if you are I think it would be good ! Flourless cake: 9/10 very rich taste, get it every time I go. Hits the spot every time

This place is awesome. Great ice cream!!! They even have cereal flavors and those are BOMB if you love cereal !! Paco has a great personality and made our experience great! Super nice and great service ! Can't wait to come back !

This place is a well oiled machine! So clever that they have dedicated waiting zone spots. They also have the parking setup really well. As for the ice cream, wow it's so good. I got the butterfinger, which is literally pre-mixed like a butterfinger McFlurry but in much better soft serve ice cream. My wife got the blueberry and wow it was literal actual blueberry ice cream. Great spot!
So... what can you say about the best place on Earth that a bunch of others haven't said? I'm not that good at making up niceties, so... Love this place! How's that?

We stopped in here for a coffee during a rain storm while we were waiting for an appointment nearby.
