Really yummy cupcakes! I've always to try a Sprinkles cupcake, but there just weren't any shops in my area. After traveling to Vegas, I can now gladly say that I got to experience the taste of them:) (I've had better chocolate ones, though;)

BEST Place in Phoenix!!!! The ice cream is out of this world. We're from manhattan and I am an avid ice cream consumer and I can tell you this is the best I've ever had. And the owners are so nice and so passionate about their business:)

This is an amazing little gem that is a must visit. Found this place online through a New Times article in my local Google feed. Decided to stop by with the family on the way to the state fair. We arrived right at noon, greeted by the owner who was just opening the doors to a friendly greeting and a welcome. We went inside and were walked through the offerings and offered samples of all the flavors available, while also getting a brief story of the business. Needless to say this business is a labor of love and it shows in the product. No matter where you are in the valley this is worth the drive for a treat. We will be driving from Peoria quite a bit to enjoy these amazing treats. Can't recommend this place enough. Great local business.

Had a great meal at Windsor and stopped here (next door) for dessert. Great ice cream options and they also have candy for sale. You can also sample. I had a cone with one scoop of butter pecan and one scoop of peanut butter. Both were amazing. Place gets busy but line moves fairly quickly.

Although the lines can be unbearably long, I'm always down to wait for their delicious, delicious baked goods. We always try to stop at Amelie's when we're in the area. Our default order tends to include salted caramel brownies (duh), macaroons, eclairs, and occasionally a mousse cup or tart of some sort. Just like their pastries, their drinks are delish as well. Coffee is good and I've tried their lavender lemonade as well.

Disappointed of this place, I came to get a tiramisu and I was told they took it off the menu. Really?! Tiramisu is a Italian staple! So because I wanted to try something from Carlos bakery I ordered a canolli and a chocolate covered strawberry. I was not a fan of the type of chocolate used for the strawberry and the canolli was ok at best. Not worth the lines or even come back.

Great place. We got there a little late but they still had a nice selection. Great donuts. The staff was also super nice. I even saw Joe bring out a donut and water to a homeless person passing by. I will go back if I get the chance

The flavors are great and the quality is high. Friendly staff and loud music to distract long waits for the good stuff. The smores sundae is something you need to try once (warning: you will gain 4 lbs instantly). The Vietnamese coffee is out of this world!

Amelie's is a Charlotte staple. My boyfriend and I have gone a few time and have to say we have decided their best attribute is their macaroons. They always have a wide variety, with great combinations you wouldn't think of like basil and lime which yes is seriously a choice they had last time we went. And let me tell you it was fantastic. The other dessert we get is the key lime tart it's tiny bit packs a delicious punch with its tart lime flavor and awesome meringue top. It's my go to the past three times we've gone! It's always busy late night but if you get there mid morning or late afternoon there much less of s line to wait in.
Shakes are amazing!!! Great spot and welcoming staff. We got the strawberry shake and it was the perfect amount of crunch to ice cream ratio. Will def be coming back.

Jarling's Custard Cup is a Champaign favorite. I remember hearing that Tom Hanks once stopped by when I was a kid. You can't go wrong here; everything is delicious. My two favorites are the banana split (fancy) and a single scoop of lemon on a sugar cone (simple). The Turtle Sunday is also fantastic :) In short, when in Champaign, it's always a good idea to stop by for a sweet treat!

Best. Chocolate. Chip. Cookies. On. Earth. The fat Elvis is to die for. Service is always spot on and it's always a fun time. It may seem cheesy, but I don't know that there is a single time I've been there that I have forgotten. Memories are made at this little magical nugget.

I fucking love this place. Blue moon and cotton candy are my two favorite. BUT ALL THE FLAVORS ARE SO GOOD!!!! Recommend getting a 4 scoop sampler. 4 scoops of different flavors for like $4-5!!! I get that whenever I don't go on the two buck tuesdays
Yum!! Me and two others all got different things and we were all impressed! Will definitely be going back!

I love the ham and cheese croissants, one of my favorite things anywhere. I tried a variety of macarons and the texture was spot on but the flavor was forgettable. The vanilla was the best one. I would try some other things here

Today we went there at 7/11/2020 , have a bad experience with their products. We bought strawberry tiramisu cake . Cake is not smooth at all and taste is funny . Fyi, i have been to many 85 many places at california never have a bad product there. Also today when we walked there inside is very very extremely hot inside!!! Employees said someone stole the AC . Its extremely hot inside that store !

I really wanted to come here after I heard that there was an option to get your ice cream served on top of egg waffles! They did not disappoint. Since my family and I came here right after dinner and birthday cake, we were already pretty stuffed, so we all shared. We got marzipan (almond) and black sesame ice cream. The black sesame was really good, but wow, the marzipan blew me away. It had a rich almond flavor and wasn't too sweet. It went perfectly with the hot, fresh, egg waffles. I also loved the whipped cream on top. This is a small local business that makes its own ice cream in small batches. I hear that the flavors rotate every day, so there is a lot of variety. It is quality stuff and I will definitely be back here as much as possible!
Delicious! The pop tart one is ah-mazing! Like a pop tart wrapped in a toaster strudel

I think I've seen every cake boss show so it's only fair I try their goods. The lobster tail was indeed delightful. Not too sweet with a little crunch. The cannoli's were also a yummy bite. But everything g else was just overpriced for the taste you can get elsewhere. I really wanted to being home a cake but it was way out of my budget. Lines take about 30-45mins.

Was super psyched to try the brick and mortar Jeni's after binging on the ooey gooey butter cake ice cream on my couch many a night and it didn't disappoint! Y'all know I am the FLIGHT QUEEN because sampling all the things is the way. I opted for the trio which was perfect in size - I chose the brambleberry crisp (this ended up being my favorite!), the Boston cream pie, and the pumpkin cake roll. I love how it's served with a delicious, fresh waffle cone piece. I was scooping ice cream onto the crispy deliciousness. That totally made it! They have a lot of dairy free options which is great!

After having breakfast in this new shopping alley next to the Linq we discovered this Ghirardelli. I generally don't find these ice-cream shops outside of Ghirardelli square in San Francisco, so this was a great surprise. I felt guilty but asked the gal to make me a Cable Car anyway. She knew how to make it and it was sooo delicious. I shared it with my son and I'm glad I did. This is rich stuff. There was so much whipped cream we had to scrap some off. I even got a piece of chocolate to split with my son. You've got to try this indulgence...superb Rocky Road and Burgundy Cherry/Cherry Vanilla ice cream and the fudge is the best.

February 24, 2019 Sunday - 9:30 PM for dessert 5 Adults Atmosphere - 4 stars Food - 2 stars Service - 4 stars Background - As were walking into the Cosmopolitan we saw ladies with ice cream. They told us we had to get some on the second floor. Atmosphere - Come off the escalator and you can see that it is just a walk up window. There is not much to the place. Food Drink - I had the fancy birthday cake, fancy means boozy. I think the hype in my head to have an adult beverage milk shake was going off in my head. But the hype died when using an extra wide straw and having issues getting any shake. I had to pull my straw out multiple times to eat the birthday cake that was clogging the straw. The other issue was with the vodka, it was not mixed within the shake very well. Some sips was okay that was a good milkshake, next sip you go wow that was some high octane fuel. Service - My wife is gluten free and he warned us the drink I ordered for us would not be gluten free, because of the cake. Afterwards I thinking what kind of vodka they use. By definition vodka should be potato and gluten free but many distillers use wheat in their vodka. Future - I will pass.
Yummy so good! Love the assortment of flavors. Gluten free here so make sure to order your cup of ice cream without a wafer wedge . Nice staff

I haven't had any of their sandwiches here just yet but the pastries are amazing. Also, the atmosphere is kinda a little on the "hipster-coffee house" side which usually can make a place feel a little too pretentious for my liking but I still find it comfortable there. The staff is very helpful and I'm looking forward to being able to make it by there for lunch sometime.

While on The Linq promenade, I built up a sweet tooth and decided to give Sprinkles a try! The moment I saw their sundae (cupcake of your choice with a scoop of ice cream) I knew I had to have it. I got a strawberry cupcake and cookie dough ice cream. So good. The portion sizes are also huge for their regular sized option. I suggest splitting it with someone or opting for their mini option if you're like me and can't eat a lot of sugary foods at once. Wish the one in my hometown didn't close because I'd give them a visit, like tomorrow. :/ For sure I will be back on my next visit to Vegas!

WOW!! If you are looking for really good ice cream, this is the place! I loved the Vanilla ice cream and was pleasantly surprised that they had gluten free cones!! Tasted all natural - homemade. I'm pretty picky about my vanilla ice cream - not liking anything that tastes artificial or too sweet. My sister had a scoop of the cantaloupe (tasted just like it!) ice cream and really enjoyed it.

Whenever I am in the area of Little Italy I always have to stop in at Presti's! My family and I love all the desserts they have to offer and the gelato there is authentic and rich- just like it is offered in Italy! The staff really knows what they are doing and are helpful to the people who come in and out of the store.
I love handle's! Great service , and love ice cream ! The employees have been great through covid making us feel as normal as we can !

Vegas is not Vegas without our Sunday brunch at Bouchon! We travel at least 3-4 times a year to Vegas and this place does not disappoint! It's our absolute favorite place for food! Everything is top notch and we always have great service!!! The chicken and waffles are like no other! Chef Keller does an amazing lemon brine with the roast chicken! The waffles are cooked with chives and bacon bits. My absolute favorite is the savory chasseur sauce!!! We always have fresh delicious oysters and several rounds of mimosas! Cant say enough great things about this place! if you haven't tried it, you are truly missing out!

I've been following this bakery on Instagram for quite some time and finally visited one morning last week. They have a little pick up window where you can call ahead and grab your baked goods or they are allowing about two people at a time inside at the moment. The cases are full of delicious looking treats and I went a little crazy and ordered 5 different items along with a coffee. I was pleasantly surprised at the total of 5 pastries and two coffees especially compared to some bakeries in town. The banana Nutella turnover was delicious and had just the right amount of banana in it. My husband ordered the jalapeÃ±o bialys and loved it. We both said we're stocking up on those next time. We also ordered the s'mores bar (yum!), bacon cheddar biscuit (so much real bacon) and the best was the chocolate croissant. The outside was just a little crunchy while the inside was so fluffy and full of real, smooth chocolate. I absolutely cannot wait to return and try more of their sweets!

I CALL THESE GUYS THE "CREPE NAZIS"...because even though the crepes are delicious and worth the wait in line, their customer service is thumbs down. On the day that I was there, my son asked a question and the answer was cold as ice...if you're looking for a feel-good experience from a smiling crepe maker, go somewhere else. There is no courtesy or customer service, however, since we waited in line for over 30 minutes, they're not hurting for business and maybe the don't have to be friendly, I don't know, judge for yourself.

The cupcake was out of this world! My boyfriend got one of those and I was jealous. My pistachio ice-cream wasn't as good. I love that flavor, and I just could not taste it at all in this ice-cream. Thats pretty much why Im giving 3 stars. The set up is cute, and I like how you can mix cupcakes with ice-cream its like dessert type fantasy in there, but they are a bit pricy. ( not surprised though because they are located on the strip) Either way i think its a cute little addition to the Linq area.

Used to be so good but now I feel like every time I go there, they have flavors and donuts that appeal more to the eye than what would actually taste good. Never really impressed anymore. Used to be worth the drive over to the area but honestly with how hard and unappealing they've been, I'll stick to Dunkin

Page dairy mart is delightful! There are SOOO many options that its a little overwhelming on the first visit. The menu seems to be spread out, so take a minute to soak the options in. There were a lot of people when I went, but the line moved super fast. There is also a ton of parking, so turn down the intersecting road and find a relaxed spot under the bridge. A friend recommended the snowstorm to me, so I am recommending it to yelp! I got an oreo cheesecake snowstorm and it was divine!

While this is just a walk-up stand inside the Venetian, everything is delicious! It's my go-to breakfast spot in Vegas. The pastries taste even better than they look. The lunch sandwiches and desserts are all good too!
I have a big problem with this place... I cant stop wanting to go there.. Best donuts ever! I'm getting fat... BUT its so good!

Caffe Bene is a place I really want to like, but I can't. The menu is shockingly expensive, it seems like most drinks start at above four dollars. For the price they are charging you'd expect amazing drinks, but unfortunately that is not the case. I've tried the pearl milk tea, which IIRC cost closer to 5 dollars, and it was unfortunately too sweet and the pearl was still hard in the center. I suspect it was not made from brewed tea but instead made from some kind of powder mix. I've also had the cafe mocha which was good, but it wasnt worth the price. Even though I think Caffe Bene is a poor value, I still enjoy my visits there. The decor is a nice switch from the other local coffeeshops, with a nice modern twist on the coffeeshop concept. This place is also brightly lit unlike some other places nearby. Additionally, the wifi is great and there are quite a few power plugs avalilable. This is a place I think I'll return to when I need to study or get things done.

Found it on Yelp.... Staying at the other end of The Strip.... Worth the drive! Delicious almond pastry (and very sweet) and chocolate almond pastry! Coffee was amazingly good as well (from a Starbucks coffee-lover).

We came here after seeing this place listed in an article at the top place for ice cream in Arizona. The service is very good and friendly. The place is clean and organized. However, I tried 4 flavors and none of them were great. I felt like I had to order something after getting samples so I chose the salted butter caramel on a waffle cone. The waffle cone was underwhelming also. The price was over $4 for one scoop and a waffle cone. The scoops are way too small for the price. We don't plan to come back here again

I loved the concept of Sweet Republic- everything homemade to include the ice cream, the marshmallow, the waffle cones, the everything. Unfortunately, I wasn't overly impressed with the ice cream. I got the Belgium chocolate and it wasn't as rich and the waffle cone not as crunchy as I was expecting and wanting. Instead it sort of crumbled in my mouth. The thing I did really love about this place was the portion. I asked for two scoops and quickly realized they give two full scoops, not two half scoops like most ice cream parlors do.

I had the Red Velvet cake and it was really good. Also got the berry muffin for tomorrow. Everything looks good, but a bit expensive. More of a treat than a weekly stop. The muffin was really good and fresh. My wife had lemon cake and enjoyed.

Three words: Lavender Honey Ice Cream Okay, it's four, but it will forever be my favorite ice cream and I miss it right now!!! I'm also one of those weirdos that like the white rose ice cream, but I know I'm alone on that one. When lavender honey isn't available, I usually go for meyer's lemon. Love you guys!

No Sprinkles locations in Canada sadly! I've had Sprinkles a year ago in NYC, and was excited to find out there's one conveniently located on the LV strip, very close to the Flamingo. Sprinkles offers the best cupcakes I've ever had - I had the vanilla and my husband had the coconut, and we both loved ours. The cupcake itself is super dense and the buttercream icing (legit buttercream, not the soft whip cream) is very rich. Currently, if you sign up for their newsletter in-store on your phone, you get a free cupcake! One complaint: other cupcake shops I've been to offer a free box for one cupcake, whereas Sprinkles only provides boxes for 2+ cupcakes. Instead, for one cupcake, they just package it in a paper bag which doesn't look as nice and is impractical given how delicate cupcakes with frosting are.
I ordered the vanilla cupcake with buttercream icing. The cake was tough and not fresh. The buttercream had almost no taste. It was the worst cupcake I've ever had. It was an absolute disappointment.

Had the cannoli and a coffee, enjoyed it very much at a great price. Selection is great, but I felt a bit rushed as the line moved quickly...lots to choose from! The setting is great in Little Italy, especially on a Sunday morning. Will definitely be back next time I'm in town to have a more in-depth look.

Like most television promoted bakery's (or restaurants), it is expensive. Would prefer to be able to sit down to eat our baked goods but they do not offer that here. It's pick up and to-go only. Otherwise, all else is worthy and reasonable to give it a try. We'd recommend the cannolis and cookies (peanut butter and M&M's).
OH MAN IS THIS PLACE GOOD! Staff isn't really friendly, but WHO CARES? They serve the most delicious, fresh donuts around. Way better than Randy's in LA. The salted caramel was out of this world.

Donuts were delicious as expected and I am so glad I stopped by for them before leaving Vegas. I ordered the peanut butter chocolate donut and it tasted like crushed Reese's blended into a cake. I wished some of the donuts had chocolate/Nutella based filling though for chocolate lovers like myself.

This place is such a great bakery! Plenty of options for desserts and coffee, as well as an interesting seating area with various couches and chairs. I had the Blueberry Cream Cheese Entremet ($5.89) and Raspberry iced tea. The cream cheese dessert looks like an ostrich egg with blueberry glaze on top. It is smooth and creamy, not too dense, just right. Crust is perfect, though there is not much of it compared to the amount of cream cheese. At the center is a dollop of blueberry filling. Great dessert. Super cute and super delicious. I did not like the raspberry tea. It is very earthy, but I would have preferred juice or coffee instead. I only picked the raspberry tea because I wanted to try something different. I also tried the Vanilla Eclair ($3.49). It has so much cream filling, I loved it! I was eating this in a warm room, so the chocolate started to melt all over my fingers, but it was good! Parking can be difficult depending on the time of day. There are several other shops in this area that share the parking space. If you love desserts, this place is definitely worth checking out!
Delicious ice cream and desserts! They have great milkshakes and plenty of flavors to choose from.

Splendid is an apt description for the ice cream at Jeni's! I've been twice now, and both times have had the same thing: two half scoops, one of sweet cream biscuits & peach jam and the other of gooey butter cake. The sweet cream one is truly delightful. The base has a slight tartness (maybe buttermilk?), with ribbons of peach jam and chunks of what tastes like shortbread. The gooey butter cake is similar to dulce de leche with the addition of large cake chunks throughout. The ice cream is incredibly creamy and rich. The portions are small, but satisfying. There may be a line, but you know what? Stand in it. It's worth it.

This Bakery serves some of the best coffee that I have ever had. In the last two visits, I have to say that the coffee was just slightly over average. Everyone has bad days though too. On the flip side, the cleanliness of this overall wonderful place has gone down the hill some. I try to not let that stop me from enjoying my coffee, but some attention should be placed on ensuring clean sitting areas and bathrooms for patrons. I can imagine that it must be hard cleaning up after some people who may not be courteous to others, but, the Bakery can improve in that area. Their bread pudding has different flavors in both the sweet and savory categories. The preserves that they serve with their bread selections are quite yummy. In conclusion, if you love coffee, I say make this your stop if you are in the Charlotte, NC area. And, I would not go to the one in the Uptown area. That one does not serve the same caliber of coffee. I have tried it several times in the Uptown location, and I get let down every time. If you go to the Davidson location, you have the benefit of seeing the quirky and very pleasant dÃ©cor. I heard that some Investors are getting involved with this business, if they already have not. I hope that is not true. I would hate for this place to get "corporatized" and "streamlined" in operations. If that happens, I would be concerned with this place losing its special touch.

Three or more months I've wanted to go here. Now I wish I hadn't because all other more conveniently located(for me) ice cream shops will never do it for me again. I was having a hard enough time choosing a flavor when I noticed there was an additional case of flavors on the other side of the counter. How the heck was I going to choose without trying everything? For some reason I always feel guilty trying samples at these types of places. I felt rushed and it had nothing to do with the great staff. Had to do with the 5+ person line that stayed constant the entire time we were at the parlor. I could feel them breathing down the back of my neck waiting for their fix. I tried: Avocado Jalapeno: Sweet rich creamy avocado flavor. I've now tried this in ice cream and gellato form and I gotta say its an amazing flavor. At first I was disappointed because all I had was a sweet/fat/avocado flavor but then at the very last minute I caught the spice and very green/chlorophyll flavor from the jalapeno. In hindsight this was probably a bad choice for my first taste since its a stronger flavor. Think I fried the taste buds. Honey Lavender: Had I tried this first I probably would have enjoyed it more. I got the sweetness from the honey but the lavender was lost on me. Probably due to the avocado/jalapeno I tried before. Irish Cream + Jameson: By this point I was so lost as to what I actually wanted I went with the standby of asking the lady at the counter what her favor was. Expecting her to tell me everything she said nope.. avocado/jalapeno and "Irish Cream/Jameson" now the flavor tag only said Irish cream. My brain was trying to crunch what irish car bomb ice cream would be like. It was delicious caught both flavors and neither was overpowering. They had peanut butter and coconut which would normally be what I would get but I felt I already stole enough counter time and went with the avocado/jalapeno and Irish cream/Jameson. Of course now I remember seeing a chocolate/Guinness which would have been perfect with the irish cream/Jameson that really would have been an ice cream irish car bomb. Next time! I knew they had bacon brittle and there was no way I wasn't getting a bag of that. I would recommend eating this last because again its very strong and I think overpowered the taste buds and the rest of the ice cream lost some of its flavors after that. If your smart just have your ice cream BEFORE you even get the bacon brittle because there's no way you wont tare into it if its in your hands. I don't even think I made it to the register before I was into my bag. This stuff was amazing. Large chunks of smokey bacon in perfectly caramelized sugar. Thank god for this new bacon craze because it really does make everything better. Locally sourced all natural ingredients. Everything made in house from the brownie toppings to the whipped cream.Thanks a lot sweet republic.. you ruined all other ice cream for me. *shakes his fist*

If you got sugar diabetes....take your meds!!! This ice cream sooooo damn good & sweet!! I've had Ghirardelli chocolates before from the store....but this....THIS...Ice cream sundae, sent me to heaven!!! I opted for the ocean sundae (chocolate, caramel, whip topping, and I got....GET THIS....butter pecan ice cream substitute instead of ole plain vanilla) When I tell y'all.........ain't NOTHING better than this! Worth every calorie!!!
Food is fantastic, I absolutely love the eclectic French atmosphere. Most of the time however the wait is quite long but it's definitely manageable. Amelie's is one of my favorite go-to's.

There is nothing more gratifying than enjoying a scoop, or two. from Honey Hut on a warm summer day! Buck heck, this ice cream would be a treat even in the dead of winter during a snowstorm. You cannot put a price tag on quality, and that is just what you get here with a unique mix of flavors sweetened with - you guessed it - honey! While there are many great places ice cream destinations throughout Northeast Ohio, Honey Hut easily makes the top five because quality and originality are two ingredients that many other places just don't have, e.g., Dairy Queen, Baskin Robbins.

I had the strawberry cake which I immediately regretted... it didn't hit the spot... but the lemon cake with apricot buttercream was def one of the most delectable cakes I've ever eaten (am im a professional cake eater)!! It was dense but soft and extremely flavorful. I am going to order that exact cake for my birthday next month!!

Anyone who says Bouchon has great macarons clearly does not know anything about macarons. I consider myself somewhat of a macaron connoisseur, having discovered them while living in Paris a few years ago. The macarons at Bouchon are horrible. They are overly big, too dense and chewy, and over-refrigerated. They were not fresh or delicate at all. Not even holding them to the lofty standard of Pierre HermÃ© or LadurÃ©e, they still pale in comparison to other places in NYC, San Fran, and Vancouver. We usually sit and savor every last crumb, but at Bouchon, we didn't even want to finish them. It was a chore. And way overpriced. The only reason it gets two stars is because the TKO (like an adult Oreo cookie) was good.

Luckily, Carlo's goodies were bought for me as a gift so I didn't have to endure the long wait that seems to be an issue. The desserts however were pretty mediocre. I am a fan of Cake Boss and I was stoked when I saw billboards up advertising that Buddy now had a bakery in town! Long story short, the lobster tail was pretty darn good but the cupcakes, cheesecake and cannolis could've been from the bakery section at the local grocery store and I wouldn't have known the difference. Super disappointing. Nothing was bad but nothing was worth the price or excitement.

In the wise words of Rhianna - cake cake cake cake cake cake! (And delicious coffee too!) This place is my dream. Their decor is fabulous, very Parisian Victorian with some modern etsy kitsch. Super comfortable. The staff is wonderfully friendly and welcoming...but really it's the CAKE! I can't believe I'm lucky enough to live in a neighborhood with this bakery! The desserts I've tried so far have been luxurious and decadent. Olive oil fig cake with pistachio buttercream icing...butterscotch pudding...chocolate peanut butter cake...like nothing I've ever tasted. I will happily continue to indulge in my new favorite Larryville spot.

My friend strongly recommended La Pasticceria for the pastries, so I made my trip here to try those out. WOW. I forget how eye-pleasing it could be when checking out the pastries while waiting in line. I was very tempted to get all of them-but my wallet would cry if I did. For my first try, I decided to get Apricot Croissant and Nutella Croissant. I did not disappoint! Those were so good and I came back the next day to buy some before heading home. My roommate gladly accepted the untraditional souvenir from Vegas :P FOOD + Apricot Croissant - light, fruity. I wish the apricot jam was evenly spreading out in the croissant + Nutella Croissant - can't go wrong with nutella, but... (read next line) + Chocolate Croissant - if I have to choose between Nutella Croissant vs. Chocolate Croissant, I'd pick Chocolate. I'm not sure why, I just like it better + Cream Croissant - recommended by a stranger who lined up in front of me. Yummy! AMBIANCE Located in Eataly, it was quiet in the morning at 8-9am when I stopped by. I came back to dine at another restaurant later for dinner and it was really loud and crowded. Service Staffs were sooooo friendly and nice. They were very patient too. Bonus The paper bag is really cute :P It's on the pricier side, but it's nothing wrong to treat yourself when you are in Vegas, right? Best way is to share with family/friends so you can try a little bit of everything. Also, morning should be less hectic!

This little place is in the heart of downtown phx right off grand. The ice cream is all homemade and the waffles and donuts are so fresh almost feels like your eating a cloud. Incredible this is definitely my favorite place in town to get a craving. Parking is slim but there is always parking on the street.

Amelies is like my safe place. I eat amelies like every day of the week. This place is awesome and they have the sweetest workers at the uptown location. Everyone is always so happy and full of compliments.. there's always a worker keeping me updated on all the new goodies and Treats that are in. This place is such a comfy place to go to and just relax. The prices aren't bad either. I always take the cutest pictures in there!

Neat little place north of the strip. However donuts sub par. The Homer was a unique big donut. But that's about it. It's dry and topped with sugary frosting. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was hard to bite into. If you want good donuts - try Voodoo donuts in Oregon or Denver, CO.

Such an amazing local spot I tell all visiting family/friends to stop into. I remember coming here as a kid with my dad and papa and getting the best, freshest donuts. Holds a special place in my heart, and is just as great all these years later :)

Came here for their grand opening. I think it went pretty smoothly! I got a mix in of the fruity pebbles with fruity pebbles topping in a drip cone. It was really good! And also a strawberry matcha latte. I was a little disappointed with the latte only cause I feel like I didn't get much of the strawberry purÃ©e. I love the concept though!
I had high expectations and I was disappointed. The pastries were super hard not moist at all and the prices are .... WTF? Won't be going again. EEk! me thinks, nope.

Can we talk about how aesthetically pleasing the inside of this place is so adorable and relaxing? Service has been nice and helpful. The owner makes baked good she changes up. If you like green tea this matcha place is for you. I think there is a sweetness level as well. They also offer hojicha roasted matcha which is very good and tasted almost like coffee to me in the sample. Some flavors can be mixed with soft serve. They also offer seasonal items and a variety of refreshing drinks. It is a hole in the wall location but I recommend this place. They are also offering online order curbside pickup. They also have edible gold sheets for ice cream if you're into that

Donuts are okay. They have an interesting selection. Pricier than average, but you pay for the novelty. Had a caramel espresso donut. Seems like a regular yeast donut heavily iced. It was huge. I didn't taste coffee but it was covered in caramel. Tried the birthday cake donut. It was okay. After the hype from others, I expected more. I prefer Crunch donuts for novelty.

Villani's has amazing pastries and coffee. I highly recommend their huge chocolate chunk cookies, which are layered with cinnamon and vanilla notes and definitely big enough to share. The apple cheddar scones are perfect for when you're looking for something a bit more savory. My favorite item is the coconut nitro cold brew- it is so creamy and flavorful, yet only has 35 calories. The employees are very friendly and helpful. Overall, this is a perfect bakery if you're looking to pop in and grab a coffee, treat, or cake.

I have been searching for a great Matcha Latte. I have been to many places and have yet to find a shop that takes the proper steps and uses the proper tools when preparing a matcha drink. I can happily end my search and say I found my favorite place because Dripps makes the greatest drinks!! I love the Strawberry Matcha Latte.

I absolutely love this place, it was first introduced to me by my best friend when I came to UNCC for school. New to the area, I wanted to explore what Charlotte had to offer; she took me here. I instantly fell in love with the eclectic furniture and the smell of pastries baking in the back of the store. The prices are fairly decent, service is great and the pastries? Delicious! You can't beat their famous salted caramel brownies, their delectable chocolate mousse cups with strawberries, and you won't find any other heavenly eclaires like they have. It's also a great place to study! I've gone there many a time with my iPad or laptop and sat there doing school work-- why not? It's open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and I'm a student! :)

You can't go wrong with a shop that has Perry's ice cream, chocolate covered bacon and cake pops among about 30 other types of treats! I wandered into the shop after being stuffed from dinner but still craving something sweet. I ended up leaving with more chocolate then I have ever purchased at one time before. I aslo left with an ice cream (Perry;s has a ton of unique flavors, my choice of the day was movie theater which had a faint buttered popcorn flavor along with some chocolate). My favorite by far was the chocolate covered bacon. How can you go wrong with the salty bacon combined with the delectable taste of chocolate? I also purchased a chocolate covered chili, some chocolate covered pretzels, some cake pops and a piece of fudge. Chocolate overload! There was only one person in the shop waiting on people, so it did take a little while to get service, but he was friendly and informative. The only downside is that since it is artisan chocolate, it is a little pricey, but totally worth every penny. If you are looking to satisfy your sweet tooth or try something unique, I highly recommend Sinful Sweets.

Carlo's Bakery in Las Vegas was such a neat treat! No, it is not New Jersey, and the place is small, so do not expect tons and tons of variety. For a small shop set up inside the Venitian Hotel shoppes, it was very fun to visit! My favorite baked goods were the eclaires with chocolate on top, and the pecan white puffs! They even sell souvenirs which was the icing on the cake for me! The sweets are not cheap, yet not expensive. Expect to pay about $4.00 for one sweet. You are in Vegas though, almost nothing is cheap! You can watch employees bake pastries while you wait for your sweets to be boxed and bagged! I went there twice during my stay in Vegas and even brought some home with me on my carry on!

got a crack pie soft serve and a slice of crack pie. You get a pretty huge serving of ice cream. It's way to sweet however and I have the ultimate sweet tooth. I was disappointed in the options available I suppose Pinterest hyped it up a bit to much. great service also

This place is awesome. It was great 20 years ago and it just keeps getting better. We are always raving about the doughnuts of course, what's not to love , we should at least mention the awesome coffee . Best place to stop for a cup. With or without a doughnut

I enjoyed this spot... the decor and ambiance was amazing. I live for a cafe a whole feel. I am lost in the alice in wonderland mad tea party vibe. The food: I enjoyed it. Nothing to truly write home about.... I imagine its more about the chill and meet up than actually enjoying to food experience. The staff: perfectly appointed awkward folks which make you feel at home.... downfall... it was a creepy guy in there and he stared at me and my wife for awhile... made us feel crazy uncomfortable. But thats not Amelia responsibility.

Located downtown right next to Carson's Kitchen downtown makes this quite the journey for me but I still do it. Love the maple bacon cronut! The best! They typically sell out of the most popular items really quickly. Almost everything is pretty much gone by early afternoon. If you want to get the goods head there early.
The absolute very best donuts!!! Excellent variety, get there early for best selection! Well worth the drive, one of a kind!

I have been hearing about Mary Coyle for years but had never visited, so, on one hot Phoenix summer night, the husband and I decided to ditch our usual (Sweet Republic) and try this local favorite. Well..... I can't say it was great. The people who were scooping ice cream were not exceedingly friendly, nor did they ask us if we wanted to try any flavors. I got a mini sundae (fudge, one scoop of ice cream, whipped cream, cherry) and the husband got a scoop of ice cream. This cost over 10$! To make it worse, their whipped cream came from a can.... for over 10$ I feel they should make their own whipped cream. The sundae was fine, but no better than Baskin Robbin. I wouldn't waste my time coming here when you have two delish ice cream joints within 2 miles.

I love sprinkles cupcakes. It's funny because I'm not a cupcake fan. There only a couple places I'll eat a cupcake from and Sprinkles is one of them. I was excited about this location opening up because I went to the on in Scottsdale, AZ and I couldn't stop thinking about the cakes. They are pretty pricy $3+ for a cupcake but hey it's Vegas and it's a name brand cupcake. I'm just not so keen about spending $50+ for 9 birthday cupcakes but that's just me being frugal. I don't mind buying a cupcake or 2 every now and then. The sprinkles sundaes are pretty good too. They put a cupcake in a cup w/ ice cream in it (you choose the flavors). Overall yay for sprinkles. :)
My favorite part of Sweet Republic is that the staff doesn't seem to judge me when I arrive at 9:45pm, wearing sweatpants, to order a 3-scoop bowl of chocolate ice cream.

Such a cute place! The pastries are delicious and look so darn cute. I had the lemon raspberry tart and chocolate croissant, both were amazing! :) They are open 24 hours, at times I have found the tables a little more dirty than I would like, but I guess having perfect french pastries comes with a cost.

So good, go treat your yourself! So decadent but bring a friend to share!!! The sundaes are semi customizable, we traded 2 scoops of cookies and cream ice cream for one vanilla and one strawberry scoop. So nice!
We loved this place so much we did a video review/feature on it! Go check it out! @480food2go youtu.be/x0ju1YRJipw

I love these cupcakes! Luckily, San Antonio doesn't have a Sprinkles so I only get them in Las Vegas when I make my way down to the Linq Promenade. The flavors rotate based on the day with some flavors available more days than others. My favorite is the chocolate pb chip. Yum! They are always very moist and flavorful. The best way to eat a Sprinkles cupcake is pop the top off and flip it upside down. Then you get a perfect ratio of icing and cupcake. I usually end up taking some home because they freeze well and remind me of Vegas when I have them. Pro tip: The earlier you come in, the more cupcake options they have.

Unlike the reviews posted hearer about this place. I was not impressed. Everything is extremely expensive here and of average or below quality. We had a chocolate eclair for 5 or so dollars that was dried out, and I am sort of okay with paying 11 dollars for a ham and cheese baguette if it is really good, but the cheese had dried out and the bread was stale. Not very impressed at all.

After a giant meal at a KBBQ, my little group of friends wanted to grab some dessert. It was pretty difficult since it's New Years and lots of places we wanted to go to were closed. However, my cousin suggested this place and i'm so glad she did! The combination of ice cream, macaroon, and toasted marshmallow is absolutely amazing. I decided on coffee and chocolate ice cream with a vanilla macaroon (a giant one too!); I felt heaven in that cookie cup. Would definitely go again(:

Jewel in Arizona! Must go place rather u live in Arizona or are just visiting, especially if u r a sweet tooth. The owner and the workers were very attentious and kind. They made sure we tried every flavor we wanted. They are known for the donut ice cream sandwich but I got the leslie knope, which is a waffle ice cream sandwich and it was delicious!

~ The only emperor is the emperor of ice cream ~ Ice cream rules! And Churn is a welcome addition to the CenPho landscape. First impressions: cute, tough parking lot, great seating areas. Bright, upbeat, cheery interior. I went during the week with a bunch of family. Between samples from the girl serving up scoops, and family orders, I had the fortune of trying numerous flavors. Those I found to be 5 star flavors: Blackberry, butter pecan, peanut butter Those I found 4 star: coconut, vanilla, strawberry Service was friendly and efficient. The pretzel cone was unique and oh-so-good with the peanut butter ice cream. I am not going to compare this to other places in town, as each is unique in its own right. I love Sweet Republic, but Churn is of a different genre. I think they will get the kinks worked out and future reviews will add the 5th star. In fact, I think I need to run an errand down there today, maybe I'll stop in.

Awesome vegan options! The specialty donuts that we got were delicious and huge. We also got espresso and an americano. The indoor sitting area is kind of small but we were able to find a couple seats. Cute place, definitely will go back.

Wow...what can I say that hasn't already been said about this place...I learned about this place from the line cook at our cafeteria, this place is a diamond in the rough. So good I went back 3 times in 3 days. We stayed at The Palazzo, but this stand was relatively easy to find. Its underneath the escalators inside the Venetian kind of near the Grand Lux (?) Cafe. Their croissants are to die for, not greasy or too much flour, just right. But their star is definately the oversized macaroons. I didn't even know what the hell macaroons were, but it was rich, sweet, almost fluffy treat, all you need to know. They have 6 different flavors, pistashio, almond, vanilla, chocoloate, lemon, strawberry. Goes great with coffee in the AM or a light pick my up snack in the afternoon. This place does get crowded, but the lines go really quick with attentive staff. They do have 2 or 3 kinds of sandwiches, but, why would you eat a sandwich at a bakery...? They also have a Bouchon restaurant, (I didn't get to try)

Omigawd...I think I've become an addict. A Jack Frost donut addict. I've become said addict after only a few days of snacking on donut carnage that amounted from a box of mixed dozen Jack Frost Donuts. It really wasn't my idea. You see, my brother, sister-in-law and baby niece picked me up from CLE and immediately drove to Jack Frost to get some goodies for the weekend visit. We all maintain that it was my 4-week old niece's idea. Smart girl. When we rolled into the donut shack (because truly that's what it looks like), I was awestruck by the number of sugary confections...awaiting my thighs' demise. Damn, those are some amazing donuts. Grab yourself a 10 spot (cash only) and choose a dozen options. You'll have to ask the employee behind the counter to identify each variety, but it's cool. It's part of the experience. A few donuts you can't miss: -Regular glazed (*perfection*) -Sour cream -Sour cream blueberry -Strawberry cheesecake -Apple cinnamon (warm it up! you're welcome) -Toasted coconut (they were out of this one when I visited, but everyone raves about it) I love you, Jack Frost.
Best ice cream and cupcake place i have been in Vegas. Love it. My favorite is the sundae cupcake with red velvet cupcake and vanilla ice cream.

The best bakery in Charlotte (sadly). They get like 3 bucks for one macaroon. The same thing in Boston, New York or Chicago wouldn't be a 3rd the cost at double the quality, but hey... You get to rip people off when you are the only game in town, right? Overall quality is below average for a major market, but above average for Charlotte, so take that for what it is worth.
Amazing custard!!! They always have a flavor of the week as well! Their snowstorm is my go to!

I have been dying to come here and finally made it! I had the cereal milk soft serve with cornflake crunch, my cousin had the bday soft serve with rainbow sprinkles and hot fudge, and my husband had a strawberry corn milkquake. The cornflakes on mine were so tasty; they were heavy and slightly salty which I liked. The cereal milk soft serve could have been sweeter... I kinda wished I had gotten the crack pie soft serve. The bday soft serve was absolutely amazing and the milkquake was great as well... they tossed an entire corn cookie in there! I also grabbed one of the cookies with chocolate chips, marshmallow, cornflakes, and oats... it was just okay, but I still enjoyed it. My mom and husband weren't very impressed. The only thing that was a bit disappointing was the price of the shakes; my husband's was $10 and was an average size. However, I do not mind paying that much for a novelty treat. The cookies were a steal at $3 IMO!
The bottom of the cereal bowl milkshakes and macaroon ice cream sandwiches are a must! The staff is very friendly as well.
Everything they have is cheap, all of their staff are friendly, their Ice Cream is very good, not to mention their Donuts. You'll find something you'll like here, without a doubt.

Have been waiting for this place to open since I first heard that they were coming to town. It was everything I hoped it would be. Donuts both in classic and unique flavors. They were absolutely delicious. The Donut Bar is awesome - great donuts and awesome service. It's great to have them in DTLV!

As a lover of ice cream and a hater of making decisions, this place was my heaven and hell because there were so many amazing flavors to choose from! I ended up getting one that had caramel, peanut butter, pretzels and something else in it (can't remember the name but "skippy" was somewhere in there). My husband got the French toast (good but I'm not a big maple syrup fan - at least not in ice cream). He also got an award winning salted caramel ice cream that was PERFECTION. I wish I wasn't full when we went (too much at dinner) so I could have tried more! Definitely a MUST TRY place.

This place wasn't bad, the cupcakes are little on the sweet side but were quite tasty. They had a decent selection to choose from, they are a little on the pricey side as well. The only thing I didn't like are how they are using chemicals for coloring instead of using natural foods to derive color from. The long line moved pretty quickly and I wouldn't mind returning trying some other types of cupcakes.
In a random location but great service and dessert. Gotta try the marshmallow with the ice cream. The marshmallows are made in-house. The chocolate malt and hazelnut ice creams are yummy too!

As a newcomer to Charlotte, I was here for a day before I needed to satisfy my sweet tooth. The ambience is hip & would be a cool place to work for a couple of hours. I had the salted brownie, eclair, the chocolate mousse cup, & the chocolate crossiants. I love caramel salted anything so was expecting to be blown away based on the previous reviewers. I was not awed. Chocolate mousse cup - wow!!!..It definitely needs to be shared - rich does not begin to describe this delectable, luxurious chocolate bliss.
Ivan shopping at Michelle's homemade ice cream for the past three years and I love every minute of it I have a lot a variety with ice cream it was so super delicious I would go back

Whenever I stay at Venetian, I always come here for coffee and pastries in morning. They're located near the elevator which is dangerously convenient. There's usually a line, but moves fairly quick. Their almond croissant and danish pastries are so yummy. It's perfect treat to start your day and goes nicely with their delicious coffee. Staff is really friendly and helpful. Macarons are excellent as well. My favorites are pistachio and passion fruit. In addition to pastries and desserts, they also have sandwiches, oat meal and yoghurt to start your day. Everything taste fresh and good quality. Highly recommend you check them out when you're in the Venetian.
If you have a sweet tooth and are looking for a huge selection of delicious desserts, definately go check out this unique bakery!!!

After watching Christina Tosi's episode on Chef's Table and trying the cereal milk in New York, I wanted to get my hands on some crack pie or the compost cookie. The compost cookie stole my heart. Location: inside the Cosmopolitan hotel, next to Momofuku I tried: -Soft serve in milk and crack pie flavors. They were nice to offer us samples so we could decide between the two. Milk tasted better than crack pie. -Compost cookie: a packaged cookie for $4 Overall, the soft serve ($6) topped with corn flakes was just okay. Nothing mind blowing. The compost cookie however is probably the best (and most expensive) cookie I've ever tasted. I just finished the whole 80g, 340 calorie cookie. I regret not buying more. Inside of it is: coffee, butterscotch and chocolate chips, pretzels and potato chips. What a salty sweet combo! I'll make sure to try more cookies next time.

The food quality is outstanding, but the service last Sunday around 2pm was some of the worst customer service I have ever had. I ordered two coffee drinks and was treated like an idiot because I didn't know that a "standard shot" is actually two shots of espresso. I ordered one drink with an added shot. She corrected me telling me that drink is called something different when served in a cup vs mug, and when I received the drink from the barrista, she called it something different entirely! Who knew coffee could be so complicated?! The person at the counter spoke down to me, then went to chat with her coworkers while I waited. The drinks were not started until after they finished chatting. I asked for clarification on how many shots I was getting and she just did not do a good job explaining and made me feel like a moron. I hope they correct this problem, because I really want to keep going there.
Awesome and delicious macaroons. I got the pistachio and chocolate. I think vanilla is good too. Try it and you'll come back for more. Good portions. Tasty and yummy and sweet. =)

I always enjoy Milk Bar! The soft serve is amazing. I haven't tried anything else. The cereal milk one and fruity cereal are both so delish! I like getting it with cereal and sprinkles both. I haven't tried their other dessert but next time I'll do one of the milkshakes!

I had a creme brule donut from here and hands down THE BEST iced chai tea latte. Both were amazing!!! I also bought a few donuts to go and brought them to my mom in Boston. I wish i lived closer ( but that probably wouldn't be good for my waist line) so maybe this is for the best.
Worst visit in 8 years. Nothing in the cabinet and very behind. Amelie's has always had bins full and plenty of backup. Not sure what happened but what a wasteful trip.
Isaac is the all time best person who works there!! He always give the best service and is always super friendly.

Was skeptical to try Milk bar again after my subpar experience in NYC, but I decided to give it another shot. I'm glad I did, I liked it so much more this time around that I ended up going twice. The first time I got the crack pie soft serve and bday cake truffles. So yummy. The second time I got the fruity cereal milk soft serve, which tasted like fruity pebbles and more bday cake truffles since they were so good the first time. Personally, I'm not a fan of the cereal milk soft serve, which is what everyone usually gets with the corn flake crunch. I think that the crack pie and the fruity cereal milk have a lot more flavor and definitely recommend getting those!! The line goes pretty fast since they have a lot of people working behind the counter. Also, if you can't decide which flavor of soft serve to get, just ask them for a sample!
Amazing!!! Yummy. So good. I have a few different treats. I'll use pictures. Treat $2 to 6 dollars each. WORTH IT!!! Seats fill up fast. Grab that first.

The dessert bar looks cool and are operated by nice people. They have baskets of cookies arranged in the front and a chalkboard menu. Only ordered the most recommended dessert, the birthday cake, since I make it a habit now to try the best thing before buying a lot of things (especially at $16/ slice with tax). Not a huge fan of the cake. The portion was substantial but the cake was dry and the frosting was plain. A friend complained it was too sweet. I'd have rather bought the pillsbury funfetti cake mix and made it myself for much cheaper and same taste. Don't waste money here for any hype, it's not worth the price or the calories.
Girl with pink / blue hair was very sweet :) she deserves lots of credit with handling how busy her location was
I read about this place and I knew I had to try it when I went to Vegas. There were so many choices it was hard to pick just one. The coffee and donuts were amazing. Try the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e one.

french macaroons! i only had the macaroons here but they were pretty tasty. possibly the biggest ones i had, for about $3.30 a piece it was a light, flaky macaroon with a light cream filling. the lemon was a bit tart but also a bit sweet making it the perfect balance. the raspberry was a little too sweet but it was still not bad if you have milk or water to wash it down. definitely coming back to try other flavors!

I like this place, I really do, however, they are not kid friendly. I have a 3 and 5 year old. They cannot eat 2.5 scoops of ice cream. I cannot stand how they have NO kid size servings. I am able to split the single serving into a cup and cone, but it has to be the same flavor. Seriously? Have you ever met a 3 and 5 year old who can agree on anything, let alone any flavor of ice cream? I haven't and it's super annoying. McDonald's dollar comes here we come!!
Best customer service I could ask for in a place! We showed up super late(felt quite guilty) but they were happy to help us anyway and completely turn our night around. Will definitely be back!

I love 85 degree bakery, however this location is at a very unfortunate spot : in the midst of a shopping center that is mostly restaurants with too little parking. The last 2 times we came there was no parking spot to be found even after 20 minutes of slow circling (with 10 other cars). We ended up leaving empty handed.if you want to purchase something do not come between 11-1 or after 5. Wish they had spots for 15 min parking only for shoppers or were in a center that had more parking (ie across the street).

Bouchon Bakery oh how we love you. If you have trouble finding them here, they are located underneath the Escalators in the Venetian. The escalators I am talking about is the one that leads to the parking structure. We stayed at the Palazzo during the weekend and we went to Bouchon Bakery twice. You can't go wrong with their goodies! Some of us got the Choc/Almon Croissant, Regular Crossiant, Macaroons (even the packaged one to take home) and their coffee. Everyone was very satisfied with what they got. Can't go wrong here! This place is always so yummmmmmmm :D *Also have been to the Yountville location.

This place is so YUMMY!!! They really bring out my little self. From small memorabilia from Hey Arnold and Rugrats to even a small lunch menu names after popular 90's shows. Their ice cream is super creamy and delicious and you can put your favorite cereal on it!!! We purchased ice cream macaroon sandwiches. I ordered strawberry ice cream topped with Reese's puffs. It was amazing!! The macaroon was well made and super good. I will definitely be returning.
Just tried their ice cream recently. Though we live nearby, but I had never made it there. Just about two weeks ago, I came to have their coconut ice-cream and I know that I will be back.

Cute, very cute. Cute little place in the middle of Little Italy. My friend and I were on the search for dessert after having a nice dinner (and I can't help it, I'm addicted to sugar). He suggested Presti's...so sure, why not, off we went. I walked in and was surprised at the assortment of pastries and food that welcomed you, all sitting in their nice little glass cases. We ordered a tiramisu to split- I got coffee to pair, him the hot chocolate, and sat down and enjoyed our dessert. It was a good tiramisu- One of my faves! He even got me to grab a spinach focaccia (or whatever it is..one of those bread pockets filled with spinach and cheese?) out the door for my lunch the following day...and man, THAT's good. I highly recommend that... Overall though, cute little bakery/cafe in Little Italy that's worth taking a stop at if you're in the area.
I got the cookie monster ice cream. It is a busy place and had a long line but it's in a very quaint location. It has a nice outdoor patio that is enjoyable to sit and talk to friends with.

Delicious food. Long line on the weekend though, I would get there early before some of the things sell out. Had the jambon et fromage... gruyere with ham. Was extremely awesome, the bread was perfect. I would be back, but this time to try all of the pastries.

spent 60$ at this place and the best was the lobster tail ,the cupcakes were poor at best, dry and the buttercream was lacking to say the least , the cannoli were poor ,I was so looking forward to them ,the tart was ok but not worth going back for ,the eclairs were just poor no flavor , its assembly line has lost its home flavor, 2 stars only because of lobster tail.....sad what a waste of 60$
Had peanut butter cup and peanut butter chocolate covered pretzel. Pretzel was hard and almost broke my tooth but both were delicious. Will be returning and getting a free pretzel.
Fun ice cream shop with a delicious menu. I highly recommend the S'mores Sundae. Nice patio area in the back to enjoy. Parking can be a little busy if you go at prime time due to Windsor next door.
Finally it's here in Vegas. Wait a long time for them to come and really enjoy the bread without going to LA

I'm 7 months pregnant, so this place opening in my neighborhood is pretty much the worst best thing to ever happen to me. There is some sort of chocolate salted caramel bar that will restore your faith in humanity. Lattes are stellar, made with homemade syrups and high quality espresso. Large ice cubes are also a nice touch. Scones are also killer.
The rose flavored ice cream takes me back to flavors of the Middle East. This place is always rocking and has different options frequently.

Melt is a sweet tiny shop with the most unusual variations of ice cream. Something for every taste. The service is adequate. Young girls doing what they can to handle one flood after another it seems. Not much room to sit unless it is cool enough to sit outside. Even so, This certainly has become a favorite for my daughter and I any time we visit Phoenix. Love it!

Loved the ice cream! So creamy! My husband had vanilla and I had Salted Caramel in a waffle bowl. The bowl tasted like it had just been made, not stale like other places I've been to. Can't wait to return!
They have the perfect amount of coco puffs and ice cream. I'm not normally a huge finisher of sweets . But I drank the whole milkshake !
It has pretty good ice cream and there are so many options on the menu. The only downside is that it is pretty small and can get really crowded.
The ham and cheese croissant was $7.40 but it was totally worth it!! And the people were really friendly :) will definitely go back!!

Meh. After all of the positive reviews I expected something better, instead I felt like I could have done a blind tasting with Baskin Robbin's ice cream and I wouldn't be able to tell them apart. It's nice that they offer a huge list of flavors, malts, & shakes but I took a couple bites of mine and tossed it. The guy at the register was really nice and offered suggestions to someone in my group who didn't know what to order, and the ice cream was ready quickly despite the long line. No place to sit aside from two benches, so be prepared to park it in your car if you don't want the ice cream to instantly melt in our 105 degree weather!

The place is good and in the heart of a busy place next to the ferris wheel. It was smaller than my expectation and the drink we ordered had too much caramel on it. They do offer free chocolates when you enter for tasting.

Great hours for a bakery - skip dessert wherever you have dinner or have a sweet breakfast at Presti's! Cannolis and all pastries are excellent. Cookies are average so skip those for the good stuff. A Cleveland MUST!
It was really good, coffee not so good. But would return for donuts . Had the French toast donut. Was delicious

Went here exactly a week ago, guy closed early. Worst ice cream I've ever had.. no flavor, freezer burned, and gritty. I wouldn't eat that ice cream for free. VERY disappointed. Even if the ice cream was good, it was severely overpriced for the sizes. Absolutely ridiculous.
milk ice cream tasted like milk, kinda interesting. compost cookie was just okay, i asked for it to be warmed, but it was wasn't warmed properly.

Went here after hearing all the raves... it was disappointing. The staff were supper nice, they described all the flavors for us and was very helpful. The donuts are not the best, the Red Velvet was super dry and not very flavorful. The maple bacon was ok. I have had better donuts for way cheaper. Almost $12 for 5 donuts!
Worst $11 chocolate milk shake ever .... according to me and my 4 kids .... seriously - UCk

I have been waiting a long time to get to a Momofuku Milk Bar location! I have baked some of the recipes in their cookbook and I never thought I'd get a chance to try the actual crack pie or cookies this far from New York! The store has "Milk" written all over it in pink with a crazy pink neon sign at the front so it's hard to miss (it helps that Momofuku is right next to it too!) and has the cookies all lined up by the entrance to the line. The menu board is huge so you'll be able to see what they have! There was nobody there when my family and I went and the woman at the cash register was friendly and let us sample a bunch of soft serve flavors (cereal milk, crack pie, and fruity cereal) and gave us recommendations of what to get (she recommended the chocolate malt cake truffles... haven't tried it yet!) I read that a lot of people were disappointed by the cereal milk soft serve and that it wasn't what they expected. It was true for me at first but the more I tasted it, the more was impressed by the soft serve samples! They really tasted like leftover cereal in a bowl and weren't overly sweet! It helps that the cereal milk soft serve I ordered had cornflake crunch rimmed at the edge, giving more corn-y flavor and texture. The sample crack pie soft serve was super sweet and tasted like caramel, which gave me a hint of what was to come with the crack pie slice we ordered. The fruity cereal tasted like sweet fruity pebbles! Yum! I'm happy to say that the crack pie I made at home that one time is one and the same with the crack pie from the bakery! It was super sweet and it felt like a sugar rush in your mouth. If you're not a fan of overly sweet desserts, this probably isn't for you! It had a rich caramel, buttery filling with an oatmeal crust that brought enough saltiness to balance the filling a little bit. I love sweets, but even I can't really finish a whole slice at once! I haven't tried the cake truffles or any of the cookies yet, but I can't wait! :) Overall, I loved my first experience at Milk Bar!! The people were helpful and the desserts were as delicious as I expected! I'll definitely come back when I have the chance!
Amazing! Seriously hands down best ice cream I've ever had. Never disappoints! And the owners and employees are so nice just makes you want to go back even more.

Finally got to visit a Sprinkles cupcake place! LOVE LOVE loooooove! I purchased a red velvet cupcake thru the cupcake "ATM" and didn't eat it until I got back home; 2days later. The cupcake was was still super moist, yummy, and since it was packed in the cute little cardboard cupcake box, it traveled well back home with me.

If you haven't ever had a sprinkles cupcake, you need to go right now and buy one! They are the best! Their vegan red velvet cupcake is out of this world! No other cupcake on this planet compares to sprinkles!

This place is great. The atmosphere is amazing. Beautiful artwork with lovely couches. The tea, coffee, and baked goods are out of this world. I cannot believe that their vegan stuff tastes as good as it does. They are also always so helpful when it comes to asking questions. I even got my wedding cake from here and it was magnificent.

I've always stock up at Buchon Bakery when I'm in Vegas! The most recent Vegas visit we actually stayed at The Venetian, so it was perfect to grab some goodies to go as we check-out! This location is right by the guest elevators on ground floor. Since I don't get to visit Vegas often, I always get the same: Kouign Amann, macaron, and almond croissant. This time I also got a ham & cheese croissant for the hubby for the road, but I also instantly regret not getting more French macaron. I guess you live and learn! hahaha Husband was oohing and ahhing while eating the ham and cheese croissant which I requested to be heated up. He said the egg was soft and the crossiant nice and flaky it was simply delicious. The macaron was soft and creamy and I'm sad I had to share it with him. Honestly I think their macaron it's even better than when I had it in LaDuree in France! There's not a bad pastry here and I also had a really nice hot latte. Although I want to mentioned that this last visit there was only one line to order on the side. And when I had to come around to see what breakfast sandwich they had, the worker totally gave me a look and rolled her eyes because I was taking a bit too long. Hence the one star knocked off.
The absolute best ice cream I EVER HAD!!! Whew I don't even like ice cream like that but this shop has amazing flavors. I ordered the butter cake and OMG it was delicious!

Best ice cream? ......No, there are other choices in the Las Vegas area that are just as good. But customer service is terrible and MAYBE not because of the server's fault. It's the store policy! My daughter, her friend, and I went into the store to buy ice cream cones. The server takes our order and hands the cone to my daughter and her friend. Well, the scoop of ice cream falls out of the cone and onto the floor. We made it a point to tell the server the ice cream just fell right out without tipping the cone. He replied the rehearsed line, "it's our policy not to replace the ice cream.".....REALLY?..... And this after you didn't smush it down into the cone hard enough so it could stay put or that the little girl didn't tip the cone over? (she's 9) So I had to shell out another $3.75 to replace the cone. I think the goodwill shown by replacing the ice cream scoop for free is better than having to charge the customer more money for something that wasn't even the girl's fault. I don't fault the server (he's following orders from the owners) but taking good care of your customers is worth a lot more than an extra $3.75. You can always make an exception, especially when it's a young child. How can you tell a child who drops their ice cream ( clean drop, no licks yet) that they can't have a replacement?
Delicious macaroons! So glad I forced my friends to help me find this location at the Venetian while we were in Vegas. It was totally worth it. I plan to stop by the location in NYC on my next trip.

It's ok if you like soft serve and enormous amounts of it. I am not a huge soft serve fan and I find the flavour of Paige's very bland. So I t tastes like cold sweet and that's about it. The atmosphere is great and it's worth a trip come here once just for that. I don't think it is worth a second trip though.
Horrible Service!!!!!! This Guys Rolled His Eyes As I Was Ordering My CrÃªpes And Sadly I Did NOT Enjoy It.
Love this place the icecream is amazing my only complaint is they run out of cookies so I miss out on my favorites a lot . The salted caramel with a chocolate chip cookie is crazy good.

Major fail. If this place is supposed to be a great representation of Pittsburgh's offerings... Pittsburgh is in trouble. :( It was a hot night. So of course we wanted ice cream. Dude... the soft serve was just a melted mess!! It was more like a gross milkshake cuz it was so liquidy. But it also tasted like hell. I ordered a coffee arctic w heath bar candy. How dare she claim that it's like a blizzard!?! This thing was nowhere near a blizzard! I could mix ingredients better at home. And w better flavor. Then... the kid ordered the mango soft serve. The server said, "we dont have mango." We had to point it out to her on the menu. They dont offer samples. She said, its "probably" good. Um... no... it was not good at all. It was so disgusting that my kid couldnt even eat it. And we NEVER throw away ice cream!! Tip to the business: if your soft serve is a hot melted mess... dont open your doors until you fix your refrigeration problem.

When I was in Pittsburgh I always visited this place and would get my birthday cake there... well today's my birthday and I was thinking about how badly I wanted a slice (but I am in Mississippi) and thus I will reminisce. It is thebest cake I have had..hands down...I love the awesome blend of flavors and the buttercream frosting is to die for! Their coffee and their one of a kind hot chocolate make for a perfect pairing with a slice of cake. Update: made it back to the burgh for one day and I just had to make it back to the Butterwood. It is just the perfect place to study (with the nicest staff), grab a coffee and a slice of cake!
Their double-baked almonds croissants are something else, we can not stop eating them.
Best ice cream EVERRRRR!! Love going to the location on 25th. Cool vibe, cool people & great quality ice cream made right in front of you. My fav hands down!

I wanted to try their sampler deal, which includes 3 mini cupcakes for $5. When I asked he worker, she said, "sorry we ran out." But I clearly saw a lot of minis on the display. I looked and her and was like, ".......?" Then one of the other workers said, "we can do it." So then she said that I can now get the cupcakes. I went in at 12 am, but they closed at 1 am. They were already closing down and putting tables away. I felt rushed while I was eating my cupcakes on the tables, because they were putting away everything around me including the rest of the tables and chairs. My cupcake was a bit dry.. and I got the vanilla mill chocolate one. I have been to the Sprinkles in Glendale, CA.. and that one was way better than this one. I also ordered the mini sundae, which was ice cream sandwiched inside a mini cupcake. The red velvet cupcake was moist.
If we're out this far in Vegas we always stop in for some handels. Heavenly Hash, you won't be disappointed. It's a mixture of marshmallow fluff, chocolate ice cream.

MUST CHECK THIS SPOT OUT! Wow. Amazing ice cream near the heart of downtown Phoenix. Spoke with the owner for a while about his product and the area. Love that this part of town is growing small business and influencing artists. The ice cream was awesome! The flavors were unique, but not so crazy you can't stand the taste. The Elvis was great, Cookie Monster was cool and the Butter Pecan, Salty Watermelon and Madagascar Vanilla also worth tasting. Enjoy!

I'd always wanted to visit New York just to go into Milk, I'd drool all over their instagram pics, so when I saw they had one in Las Vegas, I was jumping for joy, so I happened to be there at the time. I purchased a hot chocolate with marshmallows, quite good, compost cookie and birthday truffles were ok. The staff at this location seemed unenthusiastic, I felt like a burden to them, and weren't helpful at all. Overall, felt disappointed by my experience.
It's a good place. Good pastries, treats, and coffee. Good space to work on the weekend.

Holy Moly great selection of donuts some Giant! I mean would feed 3 people but anyways peanut butter with jelly filled good, Strawberry cream cake good and Maple Bacon really good. Stumptown Coffee which was a nice treat definitely must try this place!

The ice cream is kind of pricey but it's worth it. Its sweet and creamy and has a unique flavor. The service was terrific and fast and just all around pleasant. There's also 15 minute pop in parking for convenience.

A fun place for kids of all ages, as long as you've got a sweet tooth. I tried the Cookie Monster Ice Cream, the Circus Cotton Candy Ice Cream, and the Peanut Butter Fudge. Rich flavors, thick textures. A new favorite in Vegas! See it all here: youtu.be/O99LPJnnARk

I am very fond of their ice cream. The location is fantastic, it is in a very large building that can handle that masses of satisfied customers that are returning for their fix of cream of ice. The snow does not stop my taste sensations from making me drive to Ohio City to collect myself my keep. Parking is never a pleasure in Ohio City but you get used to it and you learn some of the secrets. I would have to say that a large free garage would be the most amazing investiment for Ohio City but I dare to dream yet. I had a Smorz flavor that I am in love with and I don't care who knows it. Their pumpkin was on point as well but I decided to venture away from being a basic person to get something equally as basic sounding but socially couth. The service is fantastic and I always leave with a smile. Overall, the be brief you will like it and it is worth the time to come. An added attraction is looking into the back and seeing the magic in action as it is created. Tip: Free samples will help your heart and brain find the truth to what it is that you desire.

This was the best ice cream my boys and I have ever had!!! I thought the best ice cream was in Spain, but this takes the cake! Brian was so, so nice as well! Great customer service, clean, and delicious!
The best icecream I have ever had! Not only that but the customer service was immaculate. They have so many options and flavors and this is DEFINITELY a place to check out!!

One of my favorite Italian bakeries! We stopped in on our way to NY and bought two pounds of cookies to share with family. Coffee is strong and flavorful. There is a lot of character here because locals gather for meetings, Case kids come up the street for their yummy and inexpensive lunches and in general it's a pleasant place to hang out. We love the Napoleon cake and cream puffs!

Got a 6" honey lavender cake from here, and not only was it absolutely delicious but it was GORGEOUS. They went above and beyond by arranging fresh flowers on top. Our new go-to for cakes and cupcakes!

If you want to pay $7 for a scoop of crunchy vanilla ice cream, then this place might be for you. I was utterly baffled by the concept of this place, but curiosity got the better of me. In hindsight, the $4.50 "bowl of cereal with milk" should have been a major red flag. While the first layer of caramel and brownies that topped my creation were admittedly rather tasty, the crunchy mess below was immensely unsatisfying. I'm pretty confused by other reviews pointing out ample parking and "competitive pricing," which were not my experience at all.

Sweet Republic Ice Cream - We love the flavors - Rosemary Chocolate, Pear Ginger, Brownie Swirl and too many to list! Bring us back to Sweet Republic Artisan Ice Cream time and time again for intense, interesting and delicious home made ice cream, forever! B&B Scottsdale

Had smoked salmon savory crepe here. It was really plain, lack of ingredients, and not really worth the 30 minutes wait. Line was moving very slowly that's why it took so long. I unfortunately would not recommend this place.
I got some birthday cupcakes for my birthday here!The cupcakes were amazing and delivery was fast . Its very great how they deliver to hotel rooms!

I love Handels. We have tried the Handels in Encinitas, CA and now the store in Las Vegas. The ice cream is the best. A bazillion flavors and my favorite is the Grand Central Station. Recommend this Ice Cream to all ice cream lovers

Every pastry I have tried here is good but the twice baked Chocolate, Almond and Pistachio croissants are the best to me. They also seem to sell out the fastest. If you want to make sure that you have your choice of the full selection of the pastries, it's better to go early in the morning. The evenings are the most crowded and they run out of a lot of items. They also offer breakfast sandwiches. There is a smaller location Uptown that has a more limited pastry selection. They really need to build more of these in other parts of Charlotte too :-)

Everything I have tried here, I have liked. The monkey bread, filled croissants,sugar topped muffins are my faves. If you want monkey bread on the weekends, get there before 9:00 am to be sure you get one, as it can sometimes can be a bit of a mob scene in there.(So the earlier the better!) With bread,cookies,and pastry like this, you will know why the line is there.
