Counter help is always friendly, so tip them a buck cuz they work hard!(especially on sat/sun) Thanks for being there Batch, and not being Be-atches!

My friend brought me here while I was visiting from out of town and I'm so glad she did! This place is amazing. The ice cream is so fresh. They have so many unique flavors it was so hard to choose. I loved how they have the option for half scoops so I could try more flavors. It also smells so good from the fresh waffle cones.

We had the Thunder Buddies and the Minion's Treat. Substituted banana for cheesecake on the minion's treat. The treats were delicious, the ambience was modern and hip. I'll definitely be coming back. By far the best ice cream in this part of the valley. My only mild complaint is that I wish they were a little more diligent about wiping down the tables. Go here for instagram-worthy ice cream!
They open super early at 6 a.m. I love their beignets and chocolate croissant. Their coffee and express drinks are from a machine so I would just recommend regular coffee here.

I'll make this real simple for the lost souls seeking the French patisserie... It's located in front of the Phantom of the Opera & behind the escalator. No need to search around looking up at signs to be thrown off. To simply put it... the wife loved the chocolate croissants and the large macaroons were solid. Fin.

Great place if you love sweets! Definitely recommend the yummy buns! If you have a sweet tooth then this is the place for you. The staff is amazing and they take pride in everything they do! ... Cookie dough pops are also a favorite

Unique flavors and dessert options, I've never seen alcoholic milkshakes before. The fruity cereal was enjoyable and creamy but $6+ for an ice cream is expensive. Stop by if you have the time but not a must see spot.

The absolute best ice cream I've ever had. I had 2 scoops of peanut butter chip with hot fudge and dark chocolate peanuts on top... Wow! They topped it with obviously homemade whipped cream which was amazing. It was a little spendy, but well worth it!

keller said in a magazine that he intends to expand this place but right now it's just a little kiosk behind the escalator, far from the bistro. thanks to yelp and location maps (had to check it a few times), we found this place. My husband loves the chocolate bouchons. The lemon meringue tart was ok... i think i prefer jean philippe patisserie in aria for pastries (croissant, brioche)
So So good. Carmel Cupcakes and Buttercreame cupcakes no words. I'm not a sweet eater but these were do worth it.

I was so pumped to learn Milk Bar was in our resort! I ordered the milk bar pie a la mode. It was delicious! The ice cream really did taste like cereal milk! It was strange and tasty at the same time. I also ordered the strawberry lemon cake truffles. While they tasted great, they were too rich for my liking. The line was crazy long, but service was fast and organized.
Obviously the BEST custard ever! My favorite is lemon and I'm sure they're all delicious but I can't get off the lemon. Do yourself a favor and get some.

They have a great cappuccino! I think I will get another tomorrow. They have very little food items. The pics on Yelp show omelettes and stuff, but those are not available. They did have some delicious looking pastries.

I work nearby Donut Bar & stop in to grab coffee every morning! The staff is super friendly & the donuts are AMAZING!! My favorite donut is the creme brÃ»lÃ©e cause it's unique and I love how the shell cracks just like the desert!! Last but not least the energy & vibe is very welcoming & fun to be around! They play 80's pop radio
Okay Yum! I love these donuts!!!! The key lime one is my favorite! Can't wait to go back!

AS GOOD AS IT GETS!! Checked out this place on a business/pleasure weekend and OMG!! The chocolate fudge ice cream with peanut butter cups and peanut butter with chocolate covered pretzels frozen yogurt were amazing!!! So much so we went back the next day for another round!!

I am a loyal fan of Mason's! Not only is the ice cream wonderful, but their staff is always incredibly friendly and helpful. The flavors are well thought-out and sometimes unconventional, though consistently delicious. I wish they would extend their hours, but I know they're a small operation and have a limited number of employees. Please open more locations! We would love to have you in the western suburbs!

Yo, ice cream and a donut, put together????? Where have you guys been all my life? This spot is awesome, tiny hole in the wall vibe, but the people are friendly, very informative, and the flavors are great. I had the honey lavender this last time, seriously my fav. Check them out!!!!!

How do I start I love this place for their soft serve cereal milk Ice cream. I go out of my way at times just to go here for dessert. I live in Vegas so it's one of my go to places. I don't like the other flavors that much like the crack pie or salted pretzel way too salty for me and i don't know jus too much for me but they have another one fruity cereal that I love but they don't have all the time what a bummmer. I also recommend the cake truffles if you want a burst of sweetness in your mouth. You can also take them home and freeze them if you like! Overall this place is awesome I love the vibe the girls are always friendly there! And they give big samples!

This is always our go-to ice cream place. My kids and I have been coming for years! Lines can get a little hectic, but it's worth the chaos. They have everything from flavored soft serve, to tropical snow, to milkshakes, to sundaes, to Arctic swirls (blizzards). Not to mention their other hot food, such as their fries and burgers, plus straight-from-the-barrel root beer, all make for a pretty satisfying treat on a warm summer night.

This is my favorite place in Charlotte hands down! They are located in the trendy NoDa district so business is always crowded with customers. They are open 24/7 365! I love that because I can just come here whenever I have a sweet tooth. Be prepared though, there will most likely be a line but wait isn't unbearable. My favorites are the raspberry tart and the salted caramel brownie. Their macarons are so yummy too! $2 a piece but totally worth every penny! They always have fresh pastries coming out of the kitchen. I've never been to France but Amelie's always makes me feel like I'm there! If you're craving something sweet, give this place a try!
Good icecream ! If you want to have a hood date or family time I recommend coming here !!!

I am surprised I have not left a review but it's probably because I'm too busy eating cupcakes .. I love sprinkles and I am super happy I made it in before June was over .. I got my pride cupcakes and I can't wait to eat them.. If you're at the Linq definitely give them a try .. I'm a huge fan of cupcakes especially their peanutbutter chocolate chip one but... boom! It wasn't there today however I got the pride cupcake , two red velvets and a vanilla with milk chocolate frosting .. not to mention the awesome $5 love is love three mini cupcake pack and of course some Pupcakes for my dogs .. Tanner helped us out tonight but everyone who has helped me here always is super friendly ..

Went on a Tuesday night with friends and my boyfriend, and it was $2.75/scoop Tuesday! Like it's an actual thing they have! We got there around 7, almost 8, and the line extended out the parking lot. It was pippin to be honest, but the line went by quickly and we didn't mind the wait because we were deciding on which flavors to get. See here, I have a major love for "blue Cookie Monster" ice cream. So when I saw that Handel's has "blue monster" flavor, I had to try it out myself because my mission is to find the best blue Cookie Monster in town. From my opinion it was pretty good, BUT it didn't hit the spot. I had a scoop of that and banana fosters. Surprisingly, it was good together haha! My friends and boyfriend had the salty caramel truffle and a mocha flavor one (I don't remember the name), but they all loved their flavors (even though it wasn't their original pick)! The staff who helped my friends said to check on Grubhub for which flavors are available in store.
Service is quick and friendly, raspberry regauela(sp)? Was my fave! Was outta control had to try everything! Thanks Carlo and family!

It has been a dream of mine for years to have my birthday cake from Milk Bar! I am so happy I finally got mine from here! The texture of the cake was so fluffy and the flavor was out of this world. My guy graciously made the trek inside The Cosmo to get my dream cake. All of the party guests said it was the best cake they've ever had. We got the smaller version of the birthday cake and it was enough for 14 people! I do wish we had leftovers though because it truly was decadent. I also recommend trying their cereal milk. Makes you feel like a kid agai

I recently had lunch at the Carmel Road location. I didnt like the set up given the large number of customers and a very slow and limited number of staff. Tables were not being cleaned and my party of 4 had difficulty finding a place to sit after standing in line for far too long. I have eaten at the original location in Noda several times. I think the menu offers different dishes than the usual lunch spots. The bakery alone could make me a loyal customer. The small intimate seating works for Noda location but I don't think t's working for Carmel Road lication. There are far too many customers in this larger facility to do things the same way as Noda.

I'm a Keller-phile so a stop at Bouchon Bakery is necessary. Best macarons ever. I was hemming and hawing about which flavor to get when my sweet fiancÃ© gently asked me who I was kidding. I rolled my eyes and asked for the box of 6 assorted flavors. They're huge. They're perfect. Caramel, Chocolate, and Vanilla are my favorites but the Raspberry, Pistachio and Coffee are delectable too. The flavors aren't as inventive as some larger bakeries with more offerings but between the chewy texture and the sumptuous buttercream, these are hard to beat. One star revoked for the size, limited offerings, and tricky location (under the elevator near the theater.)

Like David S.B., Jason W., and others, I had the pleasure of meeting owners Helen and Jan before visiting Sweet Republic. Had I not met Helen and Jan, I might not have made the drive up from South Phoenix to give Sweet Republic a try. Having done so, however, I can honestly say that the ice creams I sampled at Sweet Republic were so delicious, inventive, and satisfying that it almost doesn't seem right to call them ice cream. I went with Christine O., and together, we sampled the Cheese Course Duo, Ginger Pear, Rocky Road, and Salty Caramel. All four were delicious, but the Cheese Course Duo was my personal favorite. Even if you don't live or work nearby, I highly recommend finding a reason to head up to Scottsdale so that you can give Sweet Republic a try. Personally, I'm keeping my fingers crossed that after this store takes off, Helen and Jan will find a way to open a second location in South Phoenix or Downtown!
Fantastic hidden gem. So glad I stopped by. Feels like a home town I've cream shop. Very clever yummy flavors too! Whiskey Irish cream, wow!

As always it was a late night run ha ha We packed up the kids and went for it. The ice cream was delicious and the customer service was awsome! The woman had ice cream scoops but listen to me, get the ice cream stuffed glazed doughnut! It's a bad mfr!

Had to try this place because of all the hype and seeing it on TV. Covid made it hard because only 8 people are able to go in the bakery at a time. The cakes cookies and pastries looked good, but they are known for their cannolis, so had to try those. We tried their cookies chocolate fudge cupcake and their traditional cannoli. Cookies were ok and the cupcake was kind of in the dry side. The famous cannoli was just ok. Though that the cannoli would be the best item, but all were just so so. Almost forgot our friends got the rainbow cake so we were able to try some of that too. It was moist and very colorful but again nothing special. Was really looking forward to some of his pastries to blow us a away, but was disappointed. This is a place where the hype didn't meet expectations.

Woah, this is some of the best ice cream I've ever had. I got a scoop of the Key Lime Pie and it was everything I wanted and more... creamy smooth ice cream, a bit of texture from the crust pieces, and just the right bite of citrus. Oh, plus the waffle cone I got it in was pretty much perfect too! Bonus points for it being in such a cool old building, having windows to the production area, and for having a little toy train in the ceiling for some reason. Seriously delicious. If you're in the area and looking for a treat, stop here.

I love the s'more ice cream sundae. I dislike the chocolate chip ice cream sandwich. The first bite was delicious but both of my cookies had so much salt on them that I couldn't handle it. Then salt got all over my ice cream and it was so salty I couldn't eat my ice cream, a sad moment because the ice cream is down right delicious. I also love the customer service, pretty nice employees. I will be going back because I want to try the pretzel ice cream cone. The ice cream I love are the mint cookie and the Vietnamese coffee.

Been here several times, every time the service has been terrible. My last visit here, the guy working didn't acknowledge us when we walked in, acted rude, and made it seem like we were a burden for being there. I asked to try two flavors and ended up ordering the taro after I tried it. I wanted to try another flavor, but I didn't want to ruin this guy's night any more than I already had by asking to try a third. My friend also pointed out to me that there had been a fly in the mango sorbet while we were there and the guy had simply scooped it out. Other reviewers have said the ice cream was icy, but that hasn't been my experience. I enjoyed it enough to give it several tries, but it isn't worth the consistently awful service I've received here. The ice cream itself deserves 4 stars. They have good flavors that are fun, and it has a good consistency to it. However, even the best ice cream would be ruined by a dirty shop with flies and bad service.

My friend and I visited this place on Saturday. The staff was very friendly and everything moved smoothly. We came for the ice cream, but were pleasantly surprised by how good the "goonie" sandwich was. The strawberry shortcake smoothie was absolutely amazing!! Anyone who loves the strawberry shortcake ice cream pops should definitely get one :)

This quintessential Roosevelt stoner dream hut is a welcomed, unique addition to the surprisingly limited Phoenix ice cream scene. First things first: the ice cream here IS unusually soft; however, it doesn't actually melt faster, so it's okay if you're feeling a little... zoned out. With a variety of flavors paying homage to the munchies (our favorites being Cocoa Puffs, caramel popcorn, chocolate brownie, and mint chocolate cookie), be forewarned: shit is intense. Oh, and despite being visually off-putting, the un-waffled (crepe?) cone is top-notch. Plus, there's a wee 'shmallow stuck in the bottom. The folks inside cheerily slung samples, had helpful opinions, and even complimented the local competition. I stifled laughter as an elderly gentleman ordered "a couple Molly waters," and lost count of the "Fuck Trump" stickers while waiting in line. The vibe at Melt isn't for everyone (i.e. those voting for Trump, or those who just associate 4:20 with getting to leave the 9-5 early), but I doubt there's a soul out there that wouldn't benefit from some Molly water and sugar cereal ice cream on a hot summer/spring/fall/winter day/night.

With all the hype on how good the butter pecan ice-cream is, we gave it a try. It tasted just like cheap store bought ice-cream. What a disappointment!!! The cookie was the only item that tasted any good.

Amelies is one of my favorite places to go in the Charlotte area. It is different, always open, and I love to go just to try something new. My only concern is that it could be cleaner. Almost every time I have ever been to Amelies the tables haven't been cleaned. My only suggestion would be to have someone constantly sweeping and wiping down tables or just checking the atrium/inside for dirty floors and tables. Honestly who wants to eat somewhere that doesn't feel clean? I also wonder about how long some of the treats are sitting in the display. I went yesterday and ordered a croissant from the display and it was dry and hard. I also tried four different macaroons but all except for one tasted like it had been sitting for a while so it had a weird and stale after taste. Great idea in this place but needs way more of a managerial touch.

Been here twice before. Both times I got the crack pie which I would get again if I'm in the area and feel the need to indulge :) The crack pie has a nice buttery, sweet, salty taste to it though after a few bites, it gets too sweet for me so I usually save the rest to finish later. I also tried the birthday cake truffle and that was just way too sweet for me. Like it's I-can-feel-a-cavity-forming sweet. The price is steep for what you get. It's $6.50 for 1 small slice of crack pie and $6.50 for 3 truffles. But it is in the Cosmo so I can see why the prices are what they are.
Absolutely awesome place! Phenomenal macarons. Sandwiches, drinks and too too or off great courteous service!
The best ice cream I've ever tried. The price is nice and so many different flavors of ice cream. I like it! I will definitely come again.
Staffs are friendly! Got the strawberry split and cream brÃ»lÃ©e donuts and hot latte. Everything taste good! There's outdoor seating. Nice environment

Had a chance to come in and try 85 degrees. Thank goodness the line wasn't too long but still waited for a decent amount of time. I totally understand why the wait is so long and what else do you expect from a business that's so well known to finally open a location here in Vegas ? Of course it's going to be hectic for about a month or two so it seems unfair to give them a low rating due to "long wait" and "being crowded". It was around 3pm when we arrived and a lot of the pastries were out already. I definitely recommend coming in earlier to score on some of their delicious baked goods. Even though we didn't get to try a whole bunch, what we got was super good ! We also ordered drinks and I have to say that the 85 degrees iced coffee is delicious! Will be back for more. My girlfriend got the iced hazelnut latte and it was a little too sweet. *** If you come in and only want a drink, you can order from the kiosk up front so you don't have to wait in a longer line ! *** Inside is pretty big but the seating area is a bit small. I don't think it will be a good place for a study session but more of a quick casual kind of thing. Overall we did enjoy the pastries and drinks but will probably be back when they start to settle down a bit. Or maybe right when they open !

Great ice cream for sure. Worth an hour wait? Ehhhh probably not. The ice cream is tasty and creamy and the cone was fantastic. I got turned on to this brand in FL. They had some wedding cake ice cream that was a special flavor and it was absolutely amazing. But, I have to say that while it is good I can't say it's worth the line they have outside this location. Not their fault but I dinged one star for the line outside.

As soon as we saw Jeni's, we had to stop. Taste so many flavors...they all were good! I got a standard (two half scoops) on the house made, thick waffle cone: Atlantic Beach Pie: sweet cream ice cream, lemon pudding, and crushed saltines, and my favorite of all-time, Brown Butter Almond Brittle. Eric R. had the white chocolate macadamia nut cookie and the brambleberry crisp. We were happy in our ice cream heaven!

It was my first time trying Hopscotch this past week. I got a ham and Swiss croissant and cinnamon roll with a matcha latte. The croissant was delicious and flaky and the cinnamon roll had to be one of the best I've had. There's a great selection of other bakery items too. Everything is reasonably priced and the atmosphere is really chill. The person taking my order was also super nice and welcoming. This will definitely turn into a regular stop for me.
Love it. Glad one finally opened out here. Love the garlic cheese bread and the cheese bites. I went during the grand opening and it was a bit crowded. I plan to visit again to try the teas.

I love churn! The employees are always very friendly, and encourage you to try samples of new flavors. The ice cream is amazing, and the place is always clean. Whenever you're craving ice cream churn is the place to go!

The cookies were mediocre for the looooong wait in line, but the lobster claws and the canolis were amazing! I cannot understand why they do not add more help and at least two more registers. This place is all long waits. Five stars if they figure out a way to speed things up. Three hours is too long.

Not a big fan of Matcha, but I have to give this place a five star . A very nice, beautiful, cute, fancy little place. Clean, bright, friendly atmosphere. Never wanna try matcha until come to this place and give myself a shot, not bad not bad but matcha still not my things tho...but again this place so welcoming, so instagrammable, matcha lover out there, this is all about matcha...this is your place, come and try this out....they have good selection of matcha...
So so good! You don't have to be vegan to love these donuts!!!

This place is pretty small, but super cute, and with great employees. We tried their vanilla bean, honey lavander and the bourbon crunch; they were so rich and creamy! And really delicious! We plan our trip downtown around visiting this place, and it was well worth it.

My kids' favorite place for ice cream. The bonus part is that most chocolate ice cream has nut contamination and my little one is allergic; however the Belgian Chocolate is nut free! Thank you Sweet Republic for being nut-knowledgable for worried moms.

I will freely admit that I have not lived in Champaign since 1996, but my heart still belongs to Jarlings. Their "black and white" was my all time favorite. We got friends and family hooked on their custard when they'd visit, and it's still talked about when discussions of those days come up. Worth every penny of the price, and I would make the trip back just for a black and white if I could!

I've heard so many great things about this ice cream shop and I finally got a chance to check it out. This place is super popular, we ended up waiting in line for maybe 15-20 minutes but the ice cream is worth the wait. I got the butterscotch sundae and the ice cream was so incredibly creamy. Probably one of the best soft serves I've ever had in my life. The parking situation here is pretty bad though so be prepared if you make the drive over and try going earlier in the day to avoid a huge crowd. The ice cream here is so good though that it's worth the trip!

Villani's has been a sanity-saver during the pandemic! Tasty treats and great health/safety protocols go great together. I've been calling ahead to place my order, providing my payment method, and then picking up at their takeout window 10-15 minutes later. They have a very active Instagram account which allows you to keep up with their rotating cheesecake and macaron flavors and- trust me- it will keep you drooling!

Top cupcakes out there. We use to go to the Scottsdale, AZ location - same greatness. Icing is super rich - but super good. The cupcake is point - not dry at all. I do not play with the small ones - but the regular sized ones are top of the game. Have yet to find anywhere else better.

Over priced but solid coffee and desserts. It makes this place a "once in a while" "treat yo'self" kind of a place rather than a regular study spot. But, with that said, I love the decor, love the space, think it's great for studying to hanging out, and even think the uniforms are kind of cute in a fun way. On a student budget though it's definitely not somewhere I would go often especially when there are more reasonably priced places really close by.

We came here after a lunch at Carson's Kitchen. It was almost time to close, so they had a "Happy Hour" special. We boxed up one of everything they had left. They gave us a good deal and our kids were in Donut Heaven when we brought them home. We thought they were all great. You should try them all!
Cute, retro candy shop aesthetic and the ice cream was amazing! My girlfriend and I got an Oh my Affogato! and a Salted chocolate chunk cookie ice cream sandwich.

You can never go wrong with butter pecan. Their ice cream taste like homemade ice cream and it's extremely fresh and rich in flavor. They have all of the homestyle classics and they also have some of the more fun flavors too.

Pretty novel idea - mixing in fave breakfast cereals with ice cream - so it has a very familiar taste since they all have a vanilla ice cream base but is in that sweet treat realm. I had the Minion in shake form which was Frosted Flakes, banana and chocolate syrup all mixed together, which was pretty good. My son had a shake and had just Crunch Berries mixed in. On the plus side, it was a shake with Crunch Berries, on the downside, it was just vanilla ice cream, milk and Crunch Berries.... a little too close to just eating some breakfast cereal with milk. Good-ish but not great for the $5 I paid for it. If you go, choose one of their concoctions, you will definitely need a little more added to it than just cereal or it's gonna fall a little flat.

This place is the best bakery in Madison!! People are friendly, they have a nice outside space when it's warmer outside and of course the baked treats are amazing. They have sweet and savory choices for whatever your mood! I love it!!

The ice cream here is very well crafted and super delicious. The customer service was even better! My guy Brandon let me know all about the ice cream and how it's made and where it comes from. Place was super cool with it being a little building but such great service and product coming out of it. Definitely will be back soon.

Finally had the chance to go check out Carlo's bakery. We went on a Wednesday around 12:30 so the line wasn't as long. I was super excited to get the lobster tail and my hubby wanted the canolis. We waited in line for our turn but it took a little long due to the ladies in front of us buying shirts. I swear they asked for every shirt in every size! There should definitely be a pastry line and a different line for merch. Once we ordered we got: Lobster tail Cream puff Canoli Eclair Pecan cookie Everything was good, minus the canolis...I know right?!? Very disappointed. Not what I expected at all. The lobster tail was very good. All in all, I would come out again to try other items.
Awesome place for donuts!!! I would recommend the pb&j donut as well as the strawberry cake donuts. Friendly people and big delicious donuts!

Man alive this place was gross! I might have built it up big in my mind, but not good!! I am so glad they give out free samples because I would have been upset Getting totally over priced not good ice cream. We tried the plain cereal milk, fruity pebbles milk ice cream and crack pie ice cream and all of them were not good at all! The service was great, no line, just not good at all. Glad I tried it and glad I didn't spend any money.

Cupcakes on a Saturday night at home are kinda a big deal. I'm a fan of cake, but I tend to think most bakeries don't have that really good moist texture in their cakes. Not the case with Sprinkles. Had a sample of various cupcakes and I can't wait to have more Saturday nights full of cupcakes. They are incredibly moist and topped with lots of frosting. Lots of frosting is usually not my thing - it's just too sweet! But this stuff had just the right amount of sweetness and creamy texture. Yum yum yum

We bought 5 cheddar today and all of them are still raw. I ate one while driving at night so I had no idea about it. I thought it was weird cus it's sweet. It's my first time buying taiyaki at this location.

I should sue for false advertisement. The bag listed only 3 locations of Bouchon but then I come to find out that there are 5 locations (2 in NYC, 1 in Vegas, and 1 in LA). This bakery is hidden (at least in my eyes) because it is located behind and underneath the escalator at Venetian! If I recall correctly, I saw pastries (croissants, danishes, muffins), sandwiches (ham and Swiss baguettes), cakes, cupcakes, cookies, eclairs, and what I came for: macaroons. Macaroons sell at $3 a piece however, I must admit that they are huge and I should have opted that route however, being the fatty that I am, I bought a pack of mini macaroons for $13 (all flavors: coffee, chocolate, vanilla, pistachio, raspberry, and caramel). The macaroons were light, fluffy, and smooth (the filling)... I can't describe it in words that can fully justify the macaroons but I reckon I will be back every time I am in Vegas simply because I work hard and workout hard so $13 for a pack of macaroons that I can devour entirely in less than 24 hours? Hell to the yes. I should have bought 2 for the plane ride home.

TAIPEI BAKERY EMPIRE 85° C BAKERY is mastering the bake industry like a monster typhoon. Huge dominance in So-Cal and now has moved north on I-95 anchoring itself as a foodie hot spot in Chinatown's Shanghai Plaza Las Vegas. Its actually a big bakery shop, but dine-in section is closed for good reasons. The area where you personally select your pasteries is a free for all zone without any observance for social distancing. Sorta like a mob after a storm when all the fish are washed a shore. It was a scene from a Charlie Chaplin fire drill. Then you get in a queue to pay, and it's stand apart with four feet spacing. The cashiers are spaced even closer. Thank goodness everyone is respectfully masked. I choose five pasteries and three I would buy again and again. But I'm not going to compromise my health with their current methodology of social spacing. I cannot say I didn't try this 85°C.

This is an amazing ice cream place, as the long lines on warm evenings will attest. It's worth the wait. They have quite a variety of unique flavors. The ice cream is incredibly rich and creamy. I tried a "gooey butter cake" flavor, which was delicious with a ton of real butter flavors. Great place for a special treat, and only steps away from the Lynx light rail.

Based on the plethora of 5 star reviews, I really wanted to be blown away. What I got was a solid homemade ice cream experience. Better than Dairy Queen, but not the finest ice cream I have ever had. Maybe I ordered the wrong thing? (Butter Pecan sundae). Regardless, it's solid.

Had to try Milk Bar because of all the hype. We managed to go when it was crazy so there was a long line to wait for your cookies/sweets. I ordered the compost cookie because that's what I've heard you have to try. Overall it was just eh. Don't get me wrong if you need sugar then it will do the trick, but I would honestly rather eat my sugar in a different form. The cookie was a little chewy, and there was an unpleasant crunch from some of the nuts where I thought I would break a tooth. I don't know; I don't see the hype. I think next time I will go elsewhere to get my sugar fix.

Presti's can be really hit or miss. It's definitely the most popular bakery in little Italy but it's a little overpriced and I haven't enjoyed all of the bakery items I've tried. I would definitely suggest sticking to the cassata cake, cannolis or their assortment of Italian cookies, which seem to be pretty consistent in quality. They do have a wide range of food items including baked sweets, gelato, hot drinks and hot prepared food and they are a convenient dessert stop if you are grabbing dinner in little Italy.
Good selection, delicious flavors. Quite pricey though. Would come back if I was in the area not worth the drive from the other side of town though
Why didn't I think of this concept?!? Who doesn't like cereal? Had the Cosmo and Wanda shake with no whip - the Lamelo special - da bomb! Super friendly staff, fun place!

Deliciousness - 3.5/5 Happiness - 4.5/5 This is a fun place to go. Loaded with candy, the aroma of fresh baked goods wafting out of it, and a cute sign lit up brightly, its kind of like a time travel journey. My kids and I have always enjoyed it. I wish the ice cream was a little tastier. It is perfectly fine, but it lacks a punch in all flavors that takes ice cream from fine to awesome. The Vietnamese coffee is easily the boldest and best of their flavors. I also really enjoy their milkshakes and freezes, which often come with chunks of cookies and other good stuff.

This place is freakin' awesome!! It is located on the Linq. They have a retail shop that has quite a selection of chocolates. There is also a sundae bar where they make you amazing deserts. I don't know what the name of the sundae was, but it was the best sundae I have ever had. It was chocolate on top of chocolate with more chocolate. No joke. The best sundae I have ever had, so far. There were other selections I will be back to try after I go burn off all these calories. The server was very friendly. He actually made me the wrong sundae and ended up giving it to us at no charge along with our order. This was not a good day to be counting calories. The store is located in the Linq right across from the pizza shop. Definitely a must go if you enjoy ice cream, chocolate, carmel,...etc.

Thank you Sprinkles for actually providing a cheap ( $3.75 with no up-charge for gluten free dessert that is like finding a needle in a haystack) and tasty late night snack. Like others have mentioned, if all you want is a cupcake, make sure that you stand in the actual cupcake line as there are two, one for cupcakes and another for ice cream. The cupcake menu is on the back of the wall and lists which items are vegan (v) or gluten (g) free. While there is only one option for Gluten Free, the Red Velvet, it is an option! They stored it in the back, not in the display case to separate it from the other cupcakes, and it is clearly marked, a large red 'G', topping the cupcake. Overall, the cupcake is well balanced in flavor and cake to icing ratio and actually tastes like what I remember a flour filled cupcake. I definitely will be back when I am in the area for the sweet goodness of Sprinkles.
This was super fun, definitely want to go back, what a brilliant idea and everything was really good.
Totally great. A fun place to stop after a concert or event downtown.

My goodness I love this place! It's eclectic and charming and brings a smile to my face every time I visit. I haven't been here when the place isn't buzzing, so be sure to go with a bit of time to spare because you may have to wait in a line that often wraps around the inside of the building. Nevertheless, the staff moves quickly and it's worth the short wait! Amelie's pastries are adorably ornate and match the cute decor perfectly. Their famous salted caramel brownie lives up to the hype with a rich brownie layer, a crunchy sugar layer, and a soft caramel layer on top. Their CrÃ¨me BrÃ»lÃ©e is equally delicious, and their savory items like croissants and sandwiches are also quite a treat. With two locations in the Charlotte area, Amelie's is a must!

If you are rich ass bastard and staying at the Venetian you are one lucky ass fat ass. Come down your fancy elevator and eat Bouchon everyday. Then go back up stars and watch porn in your room. Viva Las Vegas
The new location is even BETTER because they are open longer now. If I could give then 6 stars, I would! I MEAN ALL OF MY SUPERLATIVES!
WoW! Don't get the cookies! Overpriced and terribile in taste. Subway has better cookies.
Had the lobster tail. Not bad, but the filling is a custard instead of ricotta cheese like a sfogliatelle. The cafe mocha was not bad either. I went early in the morning to avoid the crowds.

My only regret is not finding this place sooner! Novel is a unique gem! My husband and I came on a Friday night around 8 pm. It was busy but we got to the front of the line in about 10 min. Brandon, the owner, is amazing. He explained all of the ice creams to us and let us sample as many as we wanted. We each tried 3 or 4. I decided on the bourbon toffee caramel crunch in a glazed donut. I loved the warm/cold combo and the flavors were delicious. Brandon has an awesome staff, too. Everyone was very friendly. So excited we discovered Novel!

A macaron isn't a macaroon... A macaron is a badass version of an Oreo cookie; a macaroon is like, well a coconut wavy macaroon. There, I said it... I couldn't resist buying something from Bouchon Bakery, afterall, we were just across the way at the will call office picking up our tickets for Phantom. In addition to my usually butter croissant calling, I also indulged in a couple of macarons... yelp.com/biz_photos/aT_S¦ The coffee flavored one was just ok, but the Seasonal Orange flavor was like wow! The flavor was so vibrant, so citrusy sweet and not a hint of tartness, like a very intense orange candy lifesaver flavor... At $3.50 a pop, it's a good thing that I'm not hooked on these too otherwise I would go broke popping these in no time at all. Like everyone says, in moderation is fine...

I've been looking for a local and homemade ice cream spot for years and I absolutely love Churn! I was greeted with a warm smile and welcome by a handsome, tall, and kind server. He provided samples of a few of their ice creams to my friend and I. I tried the vanilla and chocolate mint--and both were delicious. They were so rich, creamy, and smooth; it was hard to decide which one I wanted, so the server suggested that I get a half scoop of each. I decided to do just that and add a half an oatmeal cookie to top it off. The mixture of the sweetness of the vanilla and chocolate mint and the saltiness of the cookie were just right and it was just enough to fill my sweet tooth. The cost was not bad at all--just $4. I love that this spot is local, they give samples, they have new flavors, and they are so welcoming and friendly. Definitely when I am back in Phoenix I plan to return to Churn!
This place is absolutely Amazing and the food was incredible. We'll def be adding this to our routine.

I had heard of Handel's but didn't think it was in an area we'd likely be in. But then we went for our first dinner at Anna Marie's, and there it was, right next door. The insanely long line told me there must be something to it, so we figured we'd come here for dessert, and then we did. I think it has been years since I've had a real ice cream cone. We always go for frozen yogurt, so this was a treat. I tasted just two flavors - chocolate almond and coffee chocolate chip. I was disappointed that the almonds weren't crunchy, so I settled on the coffee, and loved it - lots of chocolate and creamy ice cream. The single serve was so big I thought the server had misunderstood, but no. It's a little less expensive than B & J's, but I'm no connoisseur - I will not say what I used to pay for a cone when I was a kid because no one on Yelp would believe me! My husband wasn't as thrilled with his, but he ordered the one sugar-free flavor. But this is my review, and I'm a fan.

I don't have to try it to tell you how much I LOVE it....My Dad grew up in Youngstown OH and his parents and my grand parents took us there ALL the time....This is what I grew up on. I will defiantly be switching ice cream spots and taking my kids and grand kids. THANKS Handel's for all the great memories :)

Was super excited to try out Sprinkles cupcakes since everytime I visit the line is far too long for my patience level. The line this time wasn't nearly as long but it might have helped if they had more than one person working. I got the black and white cupcake which is chocolate cake vanilla frosting. Very basic and can't go wrong here. I saved it in the sack the guy put it in and ate it later that night. The cupcake was dry and the frosting all fell off after one bite it was very odd but still easy to eat with a fork. I just wasn't impressed with the freshness and moistness of this cupcake. I'd prefer hostess from a package. They had way too much frosting in my opinion also.

Lovely staff, impressive selection, and some of the donuts and a couple others, just meh . Went to Donut Bar after our main course at Bodega Bagel at the LV Test Kitchen. First, let me say, these donuts are beautiful. Their display case was filled when we got there bright and early. We ordered a nice selection to really test them out. By far the strawberry split was a crowd favorite. Great flavor combo and just creamy and tasty with a nice sugar coating. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was good. I loved the vanilla bean custard filling but the could've done without the hard sugar top coat. Ans finally the sleeper of the group, the pineapple donut! We threw this in last minute and although fairly sweet, it had a really good flavor and good donut base (not my usual donut selection). Would not recommend the vanilla bean. It was pretty bland. There are so many other fun options, I'd say go for the rest. My friend loved the tripe chocolate and the final verdict on the pink one...definitely made for kids (basically melted hard candies on top of an already sweet donut. Excited to come back for another round.

Things go fast, so make sure you arrive early to ensure you get the best selection, because once they're out, they're out. On our first visit, we got here around 8am and there was a good amount of people in line to get donuts. They had everything from creative choices like their version of a Pop-Tart, a variety of sugary cartoon characters, jelly donuts and their take on the classic cake creations. The problem with going first thing in the morning is that your eyes are bigger than your stomach, and you end up ordering a ton. Totally worth it. Nothing beats remembering you have a box of these treats in your hotel room after a day of drinking, or whatever it is you do in Vegas. If you come around 11am, which has been the case on most of our visits, they box up the remaining donuts from the morning and sell them for $10 a pop. You don't get to choose, but it's still a steal if you don't care which ones you get. They also have variations of Stumptown Coffee if you need a caffeine boost. It's offered in hot and cold forms, but the cold brew is my favorite between the two, especially if you're going during the warmer months. Plenty of metered parking on the street and behind the building in a shared lot. If you want to sit and eat, they have some counter space inside, and a shared outdoor area with some tables and chairs too. Totally recommend if you haven't had a chance to check them out in San Diego. They're awesome!

Great Ol' Fashion Ice Cream lots ice cream flavors to choose from. They also have specialty items like banana splits, shakes, floats, malts, and showboats. Service was fast and friendly. Dining area was clean and inviting. Prices are reasonable and ice cream was yummy!

It is hard to find. We got lost trying find this place. We stopped at the clock tower location first. They have outside tables , but the selections were limited. This lovation is inside the Venetian hotel on the casino floor. Around the corner from Grandlux. Small but has more variety. Cheese danish was excellent!!! Eclairs were good but not outstanding. Chocolate almond croissant was wonderfully also.
It's a great dessert spot. I love their Walnut Oatmeal flavor! Their sundaes are also a hit!
very disappointed that I visit Vegas to find that your location in Linq was close and I could not find an airport atm.

This has to be one of my most favorite ice cream places ever! Truth is, I had a donut filled with vanilla bean ice cream and fruity pebbles in Chicago ( my hometown.) I feel so much in love with it. I searched high and low. And came across this GEM! I have to first say that aside from it being DELICIOUS! The staff members are my favorite people on this planet! They have the cutest and bubbliest personality. It's a win for me when you serve amazing food and have great people to make your business amazing! The parking is a really small area like most places in the downtown area. I have always found a spot even when it's pretty busy ( and they certainly get busy!!!) they have an outside patio area where you can enjoy the deliciousness! The inside is SUPER tiny. But it's so so worth it! You must visit novel ice cream!

Love this bakery! The coffee is the perfect acidity and strength. I also tried a bacon and egg croissant and it was huge and delicious. They also have patio seating which I enjoy because sipping coffee and watching the world go by is entertaining. I look forward to trying other items on Presti's menu. The coffee alone will bring me back.

Wow. Just amazing! I've been dying to try this place since EVERYBODY keeps talking about it. All the hype is REAL! The service was amazing! Franciso helped us pick ( we were very indecisive go figure ) but he was patient and answered any questions needed. A variety of different flavors and your choice of macaroon followed by a toasted marshmallow - I swear I was in heaven! I love it! And I will be back - that's a promise :)
Brought my daughter in today... very cool, modern place with donuts everywhere! We had the strawberry cheesecake and the Nutella galore... so good!

I love Sprinkles back home so we stopped by for quick snacks for the ride home. Nice small location at the new outside shops at the Linq. My friends ice cream broke and fell as soon as we walked out and the employees were kind enough to give him a new one and even offered a cup to put the broken red velvet cone with ice cream in and keep both. Friendly staff. Just like home.

I was surprised and disappointed with the taste of cupcakes. I am sure we can find much more better taste bakery in this town and other states. I can't find any special their taste and decorations. Of course better than the one we buy from supermarket but Just little better. Smells good around the bakery also I don't smell artificial smell. But the frosting taste artificial ingredients but of course little better than the one we buy from the super market. Is it just the power of the Media?! I hope the original bakery is much better taste. If not that is not fair!!

I absolutely loved my first experience at Sweet Republic and am already looking for reasons to go back. I believe I will start taking all of my friends one at a time (this means many more trips for me)! I loved the customer service, the flavors and the passion that they clearly have for creating wonderful flavor combinations. Choosing was the hardest part! I was only able to decide on what to have after I consoled myself with the knowledge that I would be back soon and could have something different...

Awesome ice cream, lovely staff and a flipping viewing gallery! This place ticks all the boxes especially after a couple of beers in one of the nearby microbreweries! Four words - Reese's Cups Ice Cream

The cookies. The cannolis. The line might be daunting at times, but this is worth the wait. It's clear there is delicate care and attention to detail in their products. Ive heard the "lobster pastries" are delicious and I'm gonna have to go back again for this next treat.

We have recently discovered the Rock Hill location in the former Citizen Corners building. Such an amazing place for many reasons! Our kids are enthralled with the upstairs loft that allows you to overlook the entire shop. The quirky decor and interesting art is a feast for the eyes. And the pastry!!! Croissants to die for! Dainty little petit fours, tarts, and eclairs are just incredible. And a damn fine cup of coffee. We love this place for date night or a family treat.

Vegan friendly! Some of us can't eat regular ice cream as lactose bothers tummy. They offer lactose free ice cream and they are very good. Drinks they make here is so pretty, I originally found this place via Instagram as so many people posts yummy looking drinks online. Service is very good. Friendly and efficient. Now I learned their menu, if my lactose intolerance person wants ice cream, I know where to go.

I like that it is directly below the Venetian tower elevators so easy to grab a latte and pastries for breakfast. I enjoy the fruit croissant (blueberry, strawberry, apple depending on season). Also like the cheese danish.

Been here twice and loved it each time. The ice cream is truly incredible. I haven't found another ice cream shop in AZ that matches its quality. To top it off, both times I've been in the owner has been working and he will let you take your time to ask questions and try as many flavors as you want. You can tell he just wants you to have the best experience possible. I can't say enough good things about this place, it's definitely worth trying out.

It was my good luck that the day I happened to walk in, it was National Sundae Day and they were offering half priced hot fudge sundae's for that day only. Good thing it was half price! The normal price is over $12 for a sundae, which I think is outrageous. I was happy to pay $6 and change. The hot fudge was thick and decadent, but I've definitely had better ice cream. As I sat and ate, I watched as people walked in and were given a free Ghirardelli chocolate square. Where was mine?
A little pricy, but everything I've got here has always been good. Can be busy at times, but the line moves quickly. Staff have always been friendly. I'll keep going back.

LOVE Sprinkles cookies especially the salted oatmeal cornflake, absolutely delicious and their specialty flavor cupcakes, s'mores is my favorite. Super disappointed that the ATMs in Las Vegas are only standard flavors and no cookies. Wish the bakery had a pick up option because I am not paying the delivery fee. Sprinkles please open a shop up again in Las Vegas.

So I want to give this place 3 1/2 Not that it was bad, but we went back 2 days in a row and both days they were out of the birthday cake soft serve. So I went with the birthday cake shake on the second night. The shake was super sweet, it had a bunch of sprinkles on top so when you got to the end of the shake your mouth is just filled with sprinkles so neither myself or my husband could finish it. There were chunks of cake in the shake too that I thought was pretty good. I just wish I could've had the ice cream. They are a tad pricey, we got a small and it was over $10. They have cakes and pie, but again a little pricey.
We go here often and LOVE it. Here are our ratings for the 3 flavors we got this time: 1. Brambleberry Crisp 2. Cookies in Cream 3. Brown Butter Almond Brittle

Amazing ice cream, great interior - loved this place. Over a weekend I went three times! I tried the pistachio, chocolate and peanut chunk, and toasted hazelnut. All the flavours I sampled were really good! It's definitely a must go-to place for ice cream in Cleveland!

I am not at all a fan of the Cake Boss. I've never seen the show. However my cousin is and is the reason for my recent visit to Carlos's Bakery. When we got there the line wasn't as long as I expected from pictures that I've seen which I was pleased with. It was about a 25 minute wait to even get inside the bakery. When we finally got inside and waited for someone available to take our order the man didn't even look at me or ask if I had been helped before he greeted the lady behind me. I quickly said hello to him to get his attention, only then did he realize he skipped over me. My cousin and I had been standing for a while looking so we already had our order ready. I watched the man write down my order correctly and stepped aside to wait to be called. He called me over to check if my order was write. It was missing two things. I don't understand how you forget two things when you wrote it down and the case is literally two inches in front of your face, not to mention it wasn't a very big order. So I'm finally called up to pay and the women repeats my order back to me before charging me and everything she repeated was correct. It wasn't until I got home that I noticed she charged me for a "large chocolate cannoli" and not a "large chocolate chip cookie" even though she repeated back "cookie." The cannoli does cost more than the cookie so I was very upset with that. No one in this place has any sense of urgency. Everyone just kind of shuffles around slowly as if they didn't have a crowd outside of the door. When we sat down to eat our desserts I was desperately hoping they would at least be good enough to make all this worth it. But of course they weren't. All the desserts tasted like any other bakery. They weren't bad but weren't anything special either. If I wanted average food I would go to a regular bakery. The lobster tail was good, I'll give them that. But that's about the only good thing I have to say about it. All in all I would have to say I would never recommend this place to anyone. The workers are incompetent, the food is average and very over priced, and the wait time is ridiculous.

It's this Strawberry Cinnamon Toast Crunch Milk Shake from the good folks @dayandnight.nc Cereal Bar for me tho This is a Dope Black Owned Cereal Bar Milkshake concept that came across during my travels in Charlotte NCThey are doing some great things in that kitchen Hit them up if you are ever in the area, they rock! @dayandnight.nc
Great place to stop by and a well crafted dessert. Chill environment when not too busy. Coffee is also good.

Everyone comes here because it's Cake Boss. I'm sorry to say that my friend and I were part of those who got suckered into coming here. The shop is small and understaffed. Grabbed a number to order. 30+ minute wait. We couldn't even see what there's to order since the shop was like packed sardines with people pushed up against the displays. Finally it was our turn. The staff took down our order. Then more waiting. Order had to be packed and placed in queue at the one-person register. Then more waiting for our names to be called so we can pay. We spent 60+ minutes to get our order. Verdict? Not worth it. The pastries were ordinary if not subpar. For the wait and price, again, not worth it.

Whoa this place! I wanted to come here wvwryday while visiting. First of let's talk about the fact that the place is open 24/7. I can literally have coffee and pastries 24/7 so that instantly count my attention. The decor and atmosphere are amazing too. I ordered a vanilla bean coffee, turkey and cheese on a croissant, and a pastry. Not one crumb was left behind. BF ordered a BLT and it was the most fresh taste I've ever tasted. Wanted to order one after my sandwich. This is definately a stop next time I visit Charlotte

Now you should know that I take my ice cream reviews very seriously. I came here right after flying into Champaign to visit my friend and was looking forward to visiting a place she had grown up going to. We got to the counter and both ordered grasshopper snowstorms. It was quite popping in the back and we noticed someone holding what looked like one of our orders. After a few more minutes two people (one of which was the person we saw earlier) came to the counter with our snowstorms and the one we originally saw was starting to melt already. The seating outside was fantastic! Many large picnic tables to enjoy our desserts at. We starting digging in and after a few minutes of catching up with one another I pointed out that there was magic shell in my ice cream. My friend gives me a confused look saying she only has thin mints. It turns out they gave us two completely different snowstorms! They both had mint and chocolate, but one was with thin mint cookies and the other was with magic shell chunks! We were baffled since we had ordered the exact same thing together. Overall though the ice cream was pretty solidly average and the service was quick so I could definitely see myself coming back again for more!

I love this place. My boyfriend loves this place. My roommate says this is her favourite place in all of Las Vegas. In the interest of being upfront - I don't like icing. It's not Sprinkles fault, but it is what it is. That being said, I still love their cupcakes. (I usually choose ones like the cinnamon sugar flavour that doesn't have icing.) I've never had a bad cupcake from them. Their ice cream is also phenomenal. I've only had the cap'n crunch flavour, but it's so freaking good that I have no desire to try any other one. Their brownie sundaes are good, their cookie sundaes are good (get the snickerdoodle!), and their red waffle cones are good. You seriously cannot go wrong here.

Presti's is a good choice as a coffee shop to sit and do homework or meet a friend, or for a quick lunch or dinner. Some of the pastries are better than others. I think my favorite is the cannoli. I have a friend who claims that the chocolate chip cookie here is one of the best in the world (I disagree. I think the chocolate chip cookie here is fine but nothing special). I've had enough good experiences with pastry here that I want to try more of the options. I like the stromboli and the pizza. The sausage and spinach stromboli or the vegetable stromboli will make a nice, cheap takeout meal. Another cool thing about Presti's is the energy. It does get crowded and there can be a long line to order. People really use and enjoy Presti's. I do have one significant beef with Presti's and that is that they do not allow samples of the gelato. I get that when they're busy it's probably inconvenient to have somebody waffling over what flavor to get, but trying ones ice cream before committing is a time honored tradition that should be allowed, at least when there isn't a line out the door.

This review is for the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. Texture was great---crisp caramelized sugar glaze with a creamy center. However, the taste was very lacking. The caramelized sugar tasted burnt and had a slight bitterness to it. The donut itself and the creme barely had any taste. It wasn't too sweet (which is a bonus for me) but it wasn't too ANYTHING. Im kind of disappointed and I've definitely had better donuts for cheaper prices. On a positive note, very cute inside and service was great! Parking can be a bit tricky--the parallel parking available near the store is all pay-to-park

Old fashioned ice cream parlor. Customer service was fantastic. The employees were very helpful, enthusiastic, and seemed to love what they were doing. Good selection of ice creme flavors and free samples. Wonderful ambience and positive vibe. The quality of ice cream was extraordinary. Great location. Will definitely be back.

Went the first week it opened and was disappointed especially since my reference knows my love for ice cream. Scoops were pathetic but today I ordered 2 pints, apple pie and blueberry cobbler. Still haven't tried the $2 scoop Tuesday but the pints were far worth another try. DEFINITELY WILL RETURN.

OMG! What a great spread of flavors! My friends and I stopped here after a birthday dinner in the area. Everyone else had been here already except a few of us. The unanimous decision was: GOOEY BUTTER CAKE ICE CREAM So flavorful. It has a caramel type flavor with pieces of cake inside. I paired this with the Brandied Banana BrÃ»lÃ©e for the other half scoop. What a great match! I will definitely be back for a cool treat!

We picked this place for a sweet treat after a Wednesday night date. At 8:30, there was a line out the door. NBD- it's just 106 at night. We split a triple scoop. Most of the flavors were gone/ close to gone. We had lucky charms, blueberry moofin, and cinnamon. Delicious. I liked them all. He paid just under $7. We will probably be back.

Had occasion to try the fudge brownie, salted caramel oatmeal cookie, red velvet cupcake, pumpkin cupcake, and cinnamon sugar cupcake so far. You really can't go wrong here but that red velvet cream cheese frosting is particularly YOMNOMNOMNOMONMNMNMNOMMNOM. One caveat is that I have no idea at all what they charge for this stuff since I've been getting it free through a work thing (thus the gluttony). I might balk at the prices if I knew what they were but since I don't, welp, 5 stars.

This place was ohk for me. I was really expecting to like it.. I got the Rasberry sorbet and Mango sorbet which were pretty good but nothing for me to ride home about. Its also a bit expensive for a scoop.. almost $5 for one. Its a really cute shop, with cool artwork i will have to say. I admire the fortune cookie they give you as well! Worth a try if your into cool flavors like coco puffs and fruity pebbles.

**THE FOLLOWING REVIEW HAS BEEN REVISED** I got married last week and my husband and I had intentions early on of getting these fantastic donuts for our guest gifts at our reception. We used a different local donut shop(George's Donuts in Hudson) instead. I tried every means of communication to order them, going back months. I was calling them a couple days a week going back months before the reception and leaving messages, even e-mails to the manager's personal e-mail address I was given. I never got any response whatsoever. Eventually I sent my fiancee up there in the early am (the manager is apparently the only one who can take wedding orders and is only there very specific times of the morning), and talked with the manager, who promised to call us in a couple days to set up the order. This NEVER HAPPENED. It was becoming a workplace comedy with my co-workers who watched this happen for months. Overall, I wasted a lot of time, effort, and unnecessary pre-wedding stress trying to get them to work with us and was completely blown off. I very seriously do not think they must need the large order/money and free advertising we offered them. It's a real shame. I have loved their donuts, but I have a terrible taste in my mouth when I think of them now. (The above review was edited to reflect that we were dealing with the manager, not the owner as we originally thought.) Since this review was posted the owner and his wife both contacted us personally to find out exactly what went wrong so that it could be dealt with, and hopefully never happens again. They went way above and beyond to try to make amends and offer their sincerest apologies for this unfortunate series of events. This exceptional attention to customer service and loyalty has caused us to revise our review from one to four stars. We are certainly happy to have this resolved to everyone's satisfaction, as we truly love Jack Frost donuts, we have been customers for years and will continue to be so!

I never stepped inside, I went for the cupcake atm. I had a triple cinnamon cupcake and it was delicious! It tasted exactly like a snicker doodle. The novelty, and ease of using the atm was great, and for those of us who hate interacting with people it's a great alternative to going in the store. I'm giving my experience 3 stars because the cupcake was on the verge of getting stale. I bought it around 8:30 p.m. so it was probably baked hours before, but I'd still like a cupcake that doesn't have dried out edges.

The best donut shop anywhere, is even better since they remodeled this palace of doughy goodness. They always have a great variety of flavors like the Salted Caramel and Maple Bacon Donuts. I'm sorry but if you don't think maple and bacon together, on a donut is heaven, then please go read another review. Places like this that my grandparents took me to thirty years ago, are a dying breed. For every local, mom and pop place that disappears, two "national chain" places spring up in their spot. Places like Jack Frost Donuts not only serve up great donuts, but great memories for a lot of people who are glad places like this still exist, even if they are getting harder to find.
One spoonful of that cereal milk ice cream and I felt like I was in heaven. It was a bit on the pricey side, but if was definitely worth it! I'll for sure be back when I'm in the area again.

Anyone that knows me knows how much i love cupcakes! Ive come here numerous times since the opening because Ive always been a HUGE fan of the Sprinkles in Beverly Hills. And to top off my luck, they have Gluten Free and Vegan Red Velvet cupcakes!! they are so amazing. literally melt in your mouth. The employees here are always so sweet also. Whenever your at the Linq, you have the come here for dessert!

Love this bakery. I've been multiple times and have never been disappointed. I also used them for a friends baby shower I was throwing recently. They were very reasonably priced and the macaroons come in so many delicious flavors and colors that made mom-to-be happy.

I like to visit Amelie's from time to time and enjoy going infrequently. Sometimes I'm less than impressed with the quality and freshness of their baked goods for the price you pay. Coffee is always good and I love their late, late hours. Wish they'd offer some lighter less sweet baked goods for when you don't really want sugar/butter overkill.

I love this ice cream. I have been here before being vegan and after being vegan. It was better before being vegan though I must say. I love that the strawberry and banana flavors are so real. The fruit is real! You're not just eating some artificial flavoring. Their vegan options are a little limited unfortunately. There are a couple of non-creamy sorbet options, and a couple of creamy options. They're good! They're just not what I like. I do have some friends who do really like their creamy vegan options - I think it's vegan salted caramel and vegan chocolate. But those are just not flavors that I enjoy. The mango sorbet is super tasty and tastes like you're biting into a super juicy sweet mango. But to me it's almost too sweet. I'll definitely want to try more vegan options when they come out!
great dessertï¼haven't try something thisgoodï¼ for soooo longï¼i am picky on my dessert, and this is definitely sth I would recommend a friend. Great job owner!

The worker was nice but the baked goods were horrible honestly. Not at all tasty my friend is a baker and was dying to get to this place, broke her little heart. We're order a few different things because she wanted to taste them all and um yeah we didn't like it.

Came in around 9pm and the place was still busy, more of a quiet hipster crowd with a unique sense of style. We got a piece if chocolate cake to share which was very good, nothing to run back for but good. My wife got tea which ended up being tazo tea, I thought it would be something more non commercial but she said it was good. I on the other hand got a small french press coffee that tasted gross. It's a cool little place but I wouldn't tell my friend you have to try it.

So I basically come to Amelie's almost daily because I work nearby and it's the only "decent" food I have access to without having to drive someplace. Mostly I order the breakfast sandwiches on a croissant which are delicious. Sometimes I'll order lunch and the Seeded Roast Beef is great. The consistency of the food items (not the bakery) and especially the soups are hit or miss for me. I feel like it depends on who's cooking or preparing whether or not my asiago is melted on my sandwich or if the Leek soup tastes like high blood pressure. Some days the food is yum and also I've thrown away my share of barely eaten food on others. I'm a simple dessert kinda lady so all fruity concoctions are not my proverbial cup of tea but I have been known to get down on a cinnamon stick or 2 or 5 but who's counting?! Can I take off stars for side effects like gaining 10lbs? The other thing is the price. Amelies is expensive. Today I ordered a breakfast sandwich on a croissant and a coffee and it was $9. Most days I spend closer to $15. I get it--it's all French Bakery Swanky but dang! I like Amelie's enough to keep eating here but if I had more choices around I'd probably choose them more.

Hands down best ice cream in Ohio.I have lived in 3 other states and have never ever had anything like Honey Hut and it amazes the little yelp reviews they have. Still don't understand how people from Northeast Ohio have never even heard of Honey Hut and yet even buzzfeed has it listed as a top 25 ice cream place around the World!! Love love love the cherry sunday and of course I have to ALWAYS get my plain ole strawberry just like when I was a kid.Besides family Honey Hut is the ONLY thing I look forward to going back to Ohio wish they would expand into grocery stores or shipped outside of Ohio :(

Killin it at Dripp's! LA Ktown native traveling south to AZ for vacation with family and who would've thought there would be a dessert gem in this desert! At first glance, the store looks really clean and decorated moderate and appropriate. Alot of cute areas for photo ops(IG Worthy), sit down, relax and study. Being a first timer, the staff there were super friendly when explaining their concept of blending ice cream and treats. Strawberry Shortcake: if Cold Stones was the ice cream mixing giant of the 2000's... Dripps is the ice cream mixing innovators of the future.. seriously. The ice cream was soft and creamy and the flavor profiles of the extra mix ins were delightedly recognizable yet worked well to compliment each other. I really enjoyed all the other extra candy toppings that i got to choose. This treat was just that: A TREAT! Also try the Thunder Buddies! My nephew got it and i loved how well the Reese's blended well with the ice cream! I will definitely be back for more on my next AZ trip, thanks for the awesome visit Dripps!

What a Gem we have in Amelie's! Sweet or Savory, its all here! I believe this is the closest I will come to sitting in a French Bistro in France, and I am 100% fine with that! The dÃ©cor, staff and all the goodies are consistently top notch! Definitely don't miss this place!

I went to the Mary cole ice cream Parlor yesterday for the first time and let me tell you, it was the cutest little diner ever! The theme was set to around the 1950s! The service was incredible, the cashier felt (maddog) made you feel so welcomed and excited to be there! The Waiter alongside him was quick and really helpful. I highly recommend trying!

Today I ventured to a new bakery and was pleasantly surprised. It was small and quaint. Would be the perfect place for afternoon tea, treats, and girl talk. I was greeted and advised what I saw was all they had left which lead me to think you got to get here early for more variety. I decided to try Carmel chocolate chip cookie, S'mores brownie, and pastry. Let me say delicious. I am definitely going to go back again.

Wasn't anything too special, though it may be because we got in right before closing. Ended up getting ice cream with a red velvet waffle cone. The cone was pretty good, though because it was late in the day it wasn't as fresh and it could have been. The ice cream was also decent but because of the flavour we got (salted caramel) I couldn't eat much of it so I let me girlfriend eat most of it. Didn't get a chance to try any cupcakes because I was too full from eating earlier but I'd recommend you try and get there earlier in the day.

Best ice cream in Phoenix. I love how creative they are. I can appreciate basic flavors like vanilla and chocolate but let me tell you their vanilla ice cream is not basic and hands down the best I've ever had. The staff told me it was voted number one in some type of competition and they import a specific ingredient from Madagascar to make it. How cool!!!!

Almost always packed! Have tried the crepes and drinks and both are amazing! Have yet to try the rolled ice cream but it's likely just as good. They have games such as Connect 4 on a shelf which is useful for passing time while playing. Any foodie should stop by.

A must go-to place if you ever visit! I always stop by here whenever I'm in Cleveland. The ice-cream is so well-made with unique flavors. Whatever flavor they try, the ice-cream captures and highlights that flavor well. It changes all the time (they'll rotate through flavors). There's been Thai tea, sesame, earl grey, so many to list. There are options for waffle cone, egg waffle, affogato....I'm a fan of the egg waffle. It's the only place in Cleveland that I know that has egg waffle ice-cream and the batter is definitely on-point. I've met the owners when they first opened and they are so great with customers! They let me test-taste new flavors they were experimenting with and took in suggestions! The other workers are always so friendly :) - so patient when I'm trying out all the flavors. I feel like the overall atmosphere is so reflective of Cleveland's heart and soul! The area is a little small with limiting seating area but it's just such a warm, lively little store that I think that is not a negative aspect.

Oh my lord, this ice cream is amazing!!! I tried the Elvis just because I had to and it was delicious. Then I started with a scoop of raspberry sorbet followed by a scoop of butter pecan. I usually cant finish my second scoop, but this scoop had me almost licking the bowl for the last drop. Super cute shop and the gal at the counter knew everything about the ice cream. From ingredients, to how its made to shop and owner info. She needs a raise!!!

My trip to Vegas was for a family event. I didn't get to explore as much as I wanted but being a lover of pastry, Bouchon was on my list. Good luck finding it - the Venetian is a maze. Even with a directory and asking folks who appeared to work at the hotel, it took a very, very long time. Pastry is your reward at the end of the line. When faced with a case full of buttery, flakey, goodness - I froze. What should I get? It was all overwhelming. Suffice to say that I walked out of there with a box of macaroons and a rather large box full of goodies. The macarons were packed well for travel so they went right into my carry-on bag. They were larger than what I typically see in Seattle. Win! They were also very well done with flavors that range from chocolate to pistachio to salted caramel. Kouign amann is at the top of my list since my friend introduced me to it years ago. This did not disappoint. A hard, sweet exterior surrounds buttery, velvety goodness inside. This is enough to ruin you forever! The croissants were very large and flakey. The pan au chocolate was very well done with the signature chocolate surrounded by croissant dough. Everything else is a blur. I'm fairly certain I bit everything in the box without regard to folks I was sharing with. Overall, a very good bakery that's very hard to find. It wasn't busy when I was there because other people were hunting for it like I was.
There's always a line but the wait is quick and so worth it! LOVE the almond croissant, the chocolate croissant AND the cheese danish! Soooooooooooooo yummy!

This is my new favorite Ice Cream place! Handel's Home Made Ice Cream & Yogurt is a Walk up window service place. I was a bit overwhelmed with the menu. Tons of ice cream flavors & creations to chose from! They are constantly busy. Even with the busyness the staff still maintained good customer service. That's a bonus for me. Final three flavors were: Graham Central Station, Coconut Creme Pie & Butter Pecan. Each scoops were a very generous size. All I have to say is 3 words Oh my goodness!!! The ice cream was very creamy, full of flavor & I'm assured that it was all made with LOVE! Handel's is a must have!

We had a discount coupon of Carlo's Bake Shop by Venetian for our stay, that excite me to visit Carlo's. I found some Interesting cakes with snowman face as Christmas was approaching.. they were really CUTE worth eating hehe :-) Carlo's had lots of variety in terms of cookies/crumcakes/bisccoti/cannolis. We got there early in the morning after our venetian suite checkout and Carlo was bombarded with Carlo's lovers.We were in queue for almost 30 minutes.....Gosh! But definately worth waiting :-) Got 2 huge bags from there with thousands of calories haha :-)

Delicious donuts -- would highly recommend! Due to COVID they are only allowing 1 party enter at a time, but at Saturday at 12 PM there was only 1 party ahead of us and we only had to wait about 5 minutes. The staff was so friendly and I was happy to see that all the flavors were still available at noon. I tried the pumpkin donut and it was amazing!

Triple Cinnamon is a 3, Red Velvet is a 5 so an average of 4. Red velvet was delicious, moist and cream cheesy=perfection. The triple cinnamon was a bit crunchy on the outside and doughy on the inside. It didn't seem to be baked correctly. The flavor was good, as was the frosting. They stop baking at 10 pm so if you want a good selection get there before then. Also during the day the ATM only had one flavor available. I assume it's better stocked when the shop is closed?

Just delightful. I came to Churn after dinner right across the street and nothing beats scratch made ice cream. They had unique flavors as well as some of your classic favorites, but seeing that it was wintery and Christmasy i went with peppermint. I was with my friend who had gone there earlier that same day,but HAD to go back just because it was so darn great! She got the cookies and mint which i must say was also quite amazing. The consistency of the ice cream was just creamy enough where it wasn't overwhelming and it was just smooth and delightful as i said earlier. If you are in the mood for some delicious ice cream Churn is your spot. It also helps that the employees there were very friendly and more than happy to let you try as many flavors that you want. Had a nice seat in the back to enjoy my creamy goodness! I will definitely be going back as it set my ice cream standard for Phoenix! Cheers!

Wild berry crumble and Banana Cream Pie are LEGENDARY! I also had some other awesome flavors recently too! YES! Almond cookie & the beer flavored one! Absolutely stunning! Very creamy and delicious! Two of my favorite icecream flavors and I'm excited to try more! Banana cream pie is super accurate! Lots of flavor options, great service, you can buy pints! It's homemade (and you can taste it) what's not to like!? The atmosphere in here feels like your in a chocolate factory BUT ICECREAM! Even better! Very modern and clean! I love this place! Very inviting with awesome flavors!

The flavors here were delicious but the price was so expensive. I expected it though because I was in Vegas. Wish they had more seating to eat! The service here is awesome. Asked for a sample of every ice cream flavor and they delivered! Their samples were huge as well. Almost didn't buy a scoop of ice cream because they samples were so filling, lol. You can't go wrong with any flavor. This place is a classic! Also, you can buy the bakery items they are famous for in NY such as the Crack Pie or their birthday cake.

It's not the bakery that I go for, even though their Eclairs and Macaroons are the closes thing to heaven! It's the 24 hour availability the delicious sandwiches and coffee drinks and the free wifi. This is a great place to kick back and get some reading done or just people watch. Also, a great place to take visitors. They're impressed overtime.

You bad dirty donut bar, you had me with your ginormous big poppa filled strawberry tart and cake batter donut not to mention your filthy minds when you created the birthday filled oreo donut concoction you guys need a spanking because these donuts are banging baby! LOLZ their nutella filled donut and triple choc threat definitely has a home in my belly too bwahah. Thanks to UberEats you dropped by right before closing at noon Yas that hanger life! #thebestdonutsintheworld it must be because it's on the box lmfaoooo!

Novel Ice Cream is indeed novel. Located in a cute cottage-like establishment, they have a small outdoor patio for enjoying your creation. They have multiple toppings (including your favorite childhood cereal), homemade fun ice cream flavors, and the option to put the ice cream into a donut ice cream sandwich (you heard me) or with a vegan sprinkle cookie stuck in your cup. The staff were incredibly nice and helpful. They let us sample multiple flavors before settling on our combinations. I got a lavender honey ice cream with cookie crisp on top and the cookie. I wish they had options of other cookies but the cookie was good (more like a sweet biscuit texture). The ice cream flavor I got was potent (not for everyone) but I love lavender in anything! If I find myself back in Phoenix I would definitely seek out ice cream from here. Such a fun place with original options!
Seriously, how can you go wrong here? Delicious flavors, all the right sundaes etc, enthusiastic staff, and delicious ice cream. Did I mention the ice cream?

I love the.icecream here. They have an interesting flavor. Combined.chocolate, pistacio, and cherry. Do have a combo dissert. So u can have a dissert and add a scope of ice cream for additional 2 dollars. A little bit pricy. I hope they can have wifi. I also dont like they using plastc spins and cup for.icecream. Looks cheap amd mon enviornment friendly. Overall great. Take a number on the left side of rhe door before u order.
Friend just brought a box of macaroons we inhaled the entire box in just a few moments. Yummy. Love love love them.

Let's just say my grandmothers and moms baking is WAY better than this. It's overrated and blehhh. Definitely not worth the wait or the price. Go to your local mexican panaderia and I promise you'll spend less time, less money and say "YUM! Que bueno!" more times than this ....whatever they call it.."fancy cakes." I wish Buddy did something about those employees, they have absolutely no sense of urgency when it comes to service. ANDALE! you have people waiting mensos!!

Going to Churn is always such a treat! (no pun intended). This desert/ice cream parlor has all the right stuff to make it a grade-A establishment. The staff members are very welcoming upon your arrival, they are happy to let you sample any flavor, or give you a recommendation. Having a great staff who are happy to be at work is key to an establishments success! These guys really pull it off well. Enough about them, let's talk about the good stuff. I have never had a flavor of ice cream here that I did not enjoy, or a treat that did not satisfy. Their homemade ice cream is some of the best in town! I personally love getting their chocolate malts. 5-Stars. You will not be disappointed.
